11100321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11100321.value: Recent evidence shows that Klebsiella pneumoniae, a major causative agent of hospital infections, has undergone a series of evolutionary changes in the past decade that result in emergence of a range of phenotypic variants of clinical significance. Certain types of K. pneumoniae were evolved to become hypervirulent K. pneumoniae (HvKP) in the 1980s, while some other types have emerged into carbapenem-resistant K. pneumoniae (CRKP), with ST11 being the most dominant type in Asian countries. In 2017, however, our research team discovered a new type of hypervirulent and carbapenem-resistant K. pneumoniae (CR-HvKP) strains that caused almost 100% mortality in infected patients. This new type of superbug was found to evolve through acquisition of a pLVPK-like virulence plasmid by ST11 CRKP strains, allowing such strains to evolve into clinically prevalent, carbapenem resistant and hypervirulent organisms. This new type of superbug has since been reported in many parts of the world, with a particularly high prevalence in Asian countries. Our recent surveillance data further showed that the recovery rate of ST11 CRKP strains carrying the virulence plasmid increased dramatically in clinical settings in China, reaching 50% in some hospitals. However, the virulence plasmid in many of these strains were found to harbor mutations in the rmpA/rmpA2 genes and deletions in different parts of the plasmid. The ST11 CRKP strains carrying such mutated plasmids were also found to cause infections with varied mortality rate, indicating that some of the mutated pLVPK-like plasmids may not encode hypervirulence but are nevertheless highly transmissible. These findings prompt us to hypothesize that acquisition of the virulence plasmid by ST11 CRKP is followed by a series of evolution events that would enhance plasmid stability and transmission potential. Yet how these evolutionary changes in the virulence plasmid affects the physiology and phenotypes of the host strain is not known. It is therefore necessary to assess the clinical impact of virulence plasmid-mediated adaptation events of ST11 CRKP. This research proposal describes our plan to 1) investigate the long term impact of acquisition of the virulence plasmid on virulence expression and phenotypic changes in ST11 CRKP; and 2) delineate mutations in rmpA/rmpA2 and deletions in different parts of the virulence plasmid that are necessary for stable and long term co-existence of this plasmid in ST11 CRKP. Findings in the proposed work shall provide insights into the design of intervention strategies to control the further spread of these clinically important ST11 CR-HvKP strains. 最近的研究證據表明，肺炎克雷伯菌是醫院感染的主要病原體，在過去十年中經歷了一系列進化，導致出現了一系列具有臨床意義的表型變異。某些類型的肺炎克雷伯菌在 1980 年代進化為高毒力肺炎克雷伯菌 (HvKP)，而其他一些類型已演變為耐碳青黴烯類肺炎克雷伯菌 (CRKP)，其中 ST11 是亞洲國家最主要的類型。然而，在 2017 年，我們的研究團隊發現了一種新型高毒力和耐碳青黴烯類肺炎克雷伯菌 (CR-HvKP) 菌株，該菌株導致感染患者幾乎 100% 的死亡率。 ST11 CRKP 菌株的 pLVPK 樣毒力質粒，使這些菌株能夠進化成臨床流行的、碳青黴烯類耐藥和高毒力的生物體。這種新型超級細菌此後在世界許多地方都有報導，在亞洲國家的流行率尤其高。我們最近的監測數據進一步表明，攜帶毒力質粒的 ST11 CRKP 菌株在中國臨床環境中的分离率急劇上升，在一些醫院達到 50%。然而，發現許多這些菌株中的毒力質粒在 rmpA/rmpA2 基因中存在突變，並在質粒的不同部分存在缺失。還發現攜帶此類突變質粒的 ST11 CRKP 菌株會引起死亡率不同的感染，這表明某些突變的 pLVPK 樣質粒可能不會編碼超毒力，但仍具有高度傳染性。這些發現促使我們假設 ST11 CRKP 獲得毒力質粒後會發生一系列進化事件，這些事件將增強質粒穩定性和傳播潛力。然而，毒力質粒的這些進化變化如何影響宿主菌株的生理學和表型尚不清楚。因此，有必要評估毒力質粒介導的 ST11 CRKP 適應事件的臨床影響。該研究計劃描述了我們的計劃：1）研究獲得毒力質粒對 ST11 CRKP 毒力表達和表型變化的長期影響；和 2) 了解 rmpA/rmpA2 中的突變和毒力質粒不同部分的缺失，這些是該質粒在 ST11 CRKP 中穩定和長期共存所必需的。擬議工作的結果將為乾預策略的設計提供見解，以控制這些具有臨床意義的 ST11 CR-HvKP 菌株的進一步傳播。

11100421.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11100421.value: RNA G-四鏈體 (rG4s) 是幾十年前首次觀察到的非經典 RNA 二級結構。多年來，這些四鏈結構基序已被證明在不同的生物過程中具有重要的調節作用，但在靶向 rG4 結構和了解其生物學後果方面仍然存在挑戰。為了解決這個問題，開發新的 rG4 靶向策略和工具——尤其是靶向感興趣的特定 rG4 的能力，以及乾擾 rG4 蛋白相互作用和 rG4 介導的生物事件的潛力——是進一步探索 rG4 的兩個關鍵方面生物學和開髮用於 rG4 靶向和基因調控目的的新方法。 我們的團隊在檢測和靶向 rG4 結構方面有著強大而長期的記錄。最近，我們建立了轉錄本特異性和轉錄組範圍的方法來報告 rG4s 在不同生物系統中的形成和作用，例如在人類細胞、植物和細菌中。此外，作為概念驗證研究，我們開發了第一系列靶向 L-RNA 適配體的 rG4，並將它們應用於目標 rG4，其中報導的 L-RNA 適配體顯示出有希望的結合和選擇性特性。在這個項目中，我們將完善 rG4-SELEX 策略以建立一個高通量平台 rG4-SELEX-seq 來開發 L-RNA 適配體以靶向 rG4，通過點擊化學將線性 L-RNA 適配體轉化為環狀形式以提高rG4 結合和選擇性特性，並研究環化 L-RNA 適體在控制 rG4 蛋白相互作用和 rG4 介導的基因表達中的作用。 我們的團隊擁有執行本提案中的任務所需的所有設備和專業知識，以及本項目中開發的新方法和適體，例如 rG4-SELEX-seq、L-RNA 適體環化和 L-RNA 適體序列本身將具有專利價值。感興趣的特定 rG4 靶標包括與端粒維持和基因組不穩定性相關的人類端粒酶 RNA 5'末端的 rG4，以及與阿爾茨海默病相關的澱粉樣前體蛋白轉錄物 3'UTR 處的 rG4。還將研究其他生物學上重要的 rG4。我們的初步數據令人鼓舞，我們的團隊將繼續密切合作，以確保成功執行這個及時且令人興奮的項目。我們預計該項目的成果將為理解和控制生物學中的 rG4 功能提供新的見解。

11101121.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11101121.value: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) has been identified by the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE), World Health Organization (WHO) and the UN General Assembly as one of the most critical issues facing modern medicine. One of the suspected drivers of AMR in veterinary medicine is bacterial exposure to sub-therapeutic levels of antibiotics, resulting in the genetic selection of resistance genes. Some veterinary practices, such as administering antibiotics at low doses to enhance growth, have been identified as problematic for AMR selection and are no longer practiced in many countries. However, antibiotic resistance is still on the rise. It is possible that other practices, such as metaphylactic applications of antibiotics, also select for AMR; however, the underlying mechanisms for metaphylactic treatments driving AMR have not been fully explored, especially in aquaculture systems. Further, no one has evaluated whether this selection pressure is dependent on the half-life of the antibiotics used or whether the process is reversible. The answers to both of these questions are important for veterinarians to implement prudent use of antibiotics on fish farms. The proposed project will assess whether metaphylactic antibiotic treatment in food fish results in sub-therapeutic antibiotic tissue levels in the animals, whether it changes the diversity and the resistome profile of the fish’s gut microbiome, whether these phenomena occur across antibiotics with different half-lives, and whether any genetic and phenotypic changes are reversed post treatment. This project will provide the foundation for the development of evidence-based treatment strategies that minimize the risk of AMR associated with exposure to therapeutic and sub-therapeutic antibiotic levels, and improve treatment efficacy in aquaculture settings. The long-term impacts of this research are likely to be far-reaching, given the growth of global aquaculture and our current lack of knowledge of best practices to minimize AMR in aquatic ecosystems. 抗菌素耐藥性(Antimicrobial resistance, AMR) 已被世界動物衛生組織 (OIE)、 世界衛生組織 (WHO)和聯合國大會 (UNGA)等全球衛生組織認定為現代醫學界面臨最關鍵問題之一。獸醫治療中讓細菌暴露低於治療劑量的抗生素，而導致細菌有耐藥基因，是可能導致抗菌素耐藥性的原因之一。其中使用低劑量抗生素已被證實會促進抗菌素耐藥性，並且在許多國家不再實行。然而，抗生素耐藥性仍在上升，懷疑抗生素超量的使用，也是導致產生抗菌素耐藥性的原因，但是其潛在的機制尚未充分瞭解。此外，目前未有評估產生抗菌素耐藥性的原因是受於所用抗生素的半衰期的影響，或是抗生素抗菌過程逆轉。這兩個問題對於獸醫在養魚場謹慎使用抗生素是很重要的。 本項目將用以下方法評估在水生動物組織中過敏性低於治療劑量的抗生素治療，包括是否會改變治療後魚的菌群多樣性和抵抗力，而且此現象是否會發生於不同半衰期的抗生素中，以及這些基因型和表現型上的變化是否會隨著時間而逆轉。本項目將提供有實驗數據基礎的治療策略，以減低抗菌素耐藥性及減少暴露於適量治療劑量和低於治療劑量的風險，繼而提升水產養殖環境中的治療效果。鑑於全球水產養殖的增加，以及目前缺乏減低水生生態系統中抗菌素耐藥性最好的實踐策略，本項研究將帶來長遠的影響。

11101521.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11101521.value: 通過高頻激活 GABA 能神經元增強抑製實現癲癇小鼠的基因治療

11101521.label: Project Objectives
11101521.value: To examine whether HFLS of GABAergic neurons can potentiate the inhibition level of the mouse cortex. We will transfect the GABAergic neurons specifically with AAV carrying opsin. We will adopt the patch-clamp recording to see whether the HFLS of the GABAergic neurons can potentiate the single-pulse laser-induced inhibitory postsynaptic currents (IPSCs) of the pyramidal neuron, while LFLS not. To test whether the application of HFLS can suppress epilepsy in mice. A) We have developed the chronic epilepsy model with KA injection in the hippocampus. We will develop a software package based on deep learning to detect epileptic seizures from the video automatically. B) To activate more GABAergic neurons in the brain, we will produce an advanced-engineered, BBB-permeable AAV through intravenous injection for efficient transduction of opsins (ChrimsonR) of GABAergic neurons in the whole brain. We will first hyalinize the skull, enabling the treatment laser to penetrate it. We will select a laser with a long wavelength to enter deep of the brain. Control virus without opsins will be used to exclude the non-specific therapeutic effects other than the laser activation of GABAergic neurons. To examine whether long-term potentiation of inhibition (i-LTP) can be induced through chemogenetics in the cortex physiologically. We understand that high-frequency activation of GABAergic neurons can enhance their inhibition to their output neurons and generate i-LTP (Figs. 1-2; Ling He 2020, Ph.D. dissertation, City University of Hong Kong). We will examine whether CNO administration to activate the hM3D(Gq)-expressing GABAergic neurons can potentiate their inhibition to their output neurons and induce i-LTP. We will further investigate with patch-clamp recording whether CNO administration will trigger high-frequency firing of patched GABAergic neurons. To examine whether the chemogenetical therapy can suppress epilepsy of the above chronic epileptic mice. Like the optogenetics, we will produce an advanced-engineered, BBB-permeable AAV for efficient transduction of hM3D(Gq) to transfect GABAergic neurons. Control virus without hM3D(Gq) will be used to exclude the non-specific therapeutic effects other than the CNO-activation of GABAergic neurons.

11101521.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11101521.value: 癲癇是一種慢性中樞神經系統疾病。癲癇患者可能會突然失去知覺並出現不自主的驚厥發作。癲癇發作往往會造成身體傷害和心理負擔；長期癲癇發作會損害患者的智力並直接導致死亡（1）。目前有超過 900 萬中國人以及大約 1% 的香港人都發作過癲癇 (2, 3)。近四分之一的患者在接受抗癲癇藥物治療後仍然會有癲癇發作。 癲癇與大腦抑制和興奮之間的失衡有關 (4)。治療癲癇的策略之一是增強抑制性。我們最近在體內實驗中發現高頻激光（HFLS）刺激GABA 能神經元增強了抑製作用，這一抑制的增強在聽覺反應中體現出來。我們的目標是通過調控抑制性迴路的可塑性,來幫助治愈小鼠的癲癇症。在此提議的項目中，我們有以下假設： 1) 高頻激活GABA 能神經元增強了它們抑制性突觸後的興奮性神經元的抑製作用； 2) 這種抑制的增強有助於重新恢復大腦的抑制和興奮平衡，從而達到癲癇的治療長期目的。 在擬議的研究中，為驗證上述假設，我們將通過離體腦片，使用膜片鉗記錄來檢測是否會有抑制性的增強。我們同時設計了光遺傳學和化學遺傳學基因治療的病毒載體，並證實了它們對血腦屏障的滲透性。在將紅藻氨酸注入小鼠海馬體後，我們將通過靜脈注射攜帶離子通道蛋白（ChR2）或Gq 偶聯的人類毒蕈鹼受體（hM3Dq）的兩種腺相關病毒來分別轉染癲癇小鼠的抑制性神經元。一旦小鼠表現出穩定的自發性癲癇發作，我們會用HFLS激活ChR2, 或者用 hM3Dq 激動劑氯氮平-N-氧化物 (CNO) 以激活 GABA 能抑制神經元。我們認為HFLS 誘導GABA 能神經元的高頻放電，從而增強它們對抑制性突觸後興奮性神經元的抑製作用，而低頻激光刺激 (LFLS) 則不會起到增強的作用。這種增強作用將長期抑制癲癇發作。同樣，口服 CNO 會激活 GABA 能神經元增強抑制後能長期抑制癲癇發生。我們認為通過光遺傳學或化學遺傳學增強的抑制是長期的。我們期望將在治療後依舊能抑制癲癇的發作。 如果擬議的基因療法能成功，將為那些對當前藥物無反應的難治性癲癇患者帶來希望。

To examine whether the chemogenetical therapy can suppress epilepsy of the above chronic epileptic mice. Like the optogenetics, we will produce an advanced-engineered, BBB-permeable AAV for efficient transduction of hM3D(Gq) to transfect GABAergic neurons. Control virus without hM3D(Gq) will be used to exclude the non-specific therapeutic effects other than the CNO-activation of GABAergic neurons.

11101521.label: Major findings and research outcome
11101521.value: Temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE) is a persistent neurological condition that features recurrent seizures. Regrettably, a substantial proportion of patients with TLE, ranging from 30-40%, continue to experience seizures despite the accessibility of conventional antiepileptic medications. Therefore, there is an urgent need for innovative and effective therapies to manage refractory epilepsy. Current antiepileptic drugs primarily target ion channels or neurotransmitter systems, often leading to off-target effects or insufficient control in a significant subset of patients. A more targeted approach, such as modulating specific inhibitory circuits, holds promise for improving seizure control with fewer side effects than conventional approaches. In this study, we propose a novel gene therapy approach aimed at enhancing the inhibitory function of GABAergic neurons in the cerebral cortex as a potential treatment for epilepsy. Our research found that activating GABAergic neurons to fire at a high frequency through optogenetic and chemogenetic means increases their firing rates, which ultimately facilitates the long-lasting potentiation of inhibitory processes. To deliver the viral vectors of hM3Dq, we administered them intravenously to partially transduce GABAergic neurons in the cortex of epileptic mice models induced by injecting kainic acid (KA) into their dorsal hippocampus. Seizure severity was scored using the Racine scale, and seizure frequency was monitored via continuous video electroencephalography recordings for 24 h daily. After administering clozapine-N-oxide (CNO) orally, we observed a reduction in convulsive seizure behaviors during and more than two weeks after the drug application. These results suggest a promising therapeutic direction for chronic epilepsy by enhancing the inhibition of partially but widely distributed GABAergic neurons in the cortex. In this study, we used optogenetic and chemogenetic technologies to stimulate GABAergic neurons in the auditory cortex (AC). Activation of these neurons results in the suppression of neuronal responses to incoming stimuli, such as AS. Chemogenetic excitation also causes heterogeneous firing of GABAergic neurons, leading to potentiated inhibition and prolonged suppression of neuronal responses. To transduce GABAergic neurons in various brain regions, we intravenously administered a viral vector that penetrated the blood-brain barrier. Activation of hM3Dq, which is expressed in GABAergic neurons, significantly reduced the number of seizures. iLTP was prolonged to 24 h by chemogenetic activation of GABAergic neurons.

11101521.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11101521.value: Future studies are warranted to determine the duration of CNO administration and the particular types of GABAergic neurons that can completely eradicate epilepsy while simultaneously addressing safety concerns and applying this treatment to patients with temporal lobe epilepsy. Moreover, it is crucial to assess subtle seizure activities that are not readily apparent through behavioral manifestations but can be discerned through epileptic waveforms that propagate within cerebral circuits. Our results raise several noteworthy questions, which require further investigation. For instance, it is not clear how the activation frequency of GABAergic neurons enhances their inhibition ability. Previous studies have proposed various mechanisms to boost inhibitory effects, such as (i) increasing the release of GABA neurotransmitters to potentiate inhibitory outputs , (ii) increasing the expression of PV , and (iii) filtering glutamatergic inputs through presynaptic GABAergic inhibition. Moreover, cannabinoid receptors located on GABAergic terminals regulate GABA release, which influences the level of inhibition .

11101521.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11101521.value: Temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE) is a chronic brain condition that leads to recurrent seizures. Unfortunately, even with regular epilepsy medications, 30-40% of people with TLE continue to experience seizures. This highlights the need for new and improved treatments for patients who do not respond to current drugs. Most epilepsy medications work by targeting ion channels or neurotransmitter systems; however, they can have side effects or may not be effective for everyone. A more targeted approach, such as focusing on specific brain circuits, could potentially control seizures better with fewer side effects. In this study, we propose a new gene therapy aimed at enhancing the function of certain brain cells known as GABAergic neurons, which may offer a new way to treat epilepsy. We used a virus to deliver a gene, hM3Dq, into the brains of mice with epilepsy. The virus was administered through the bloodstream to the brain cells. Subsequently, the mice were administered clozapine-N-oxide (CNO), and a reduction in seizures was observed for over two weeks. This suggests that boosting the activity of these neurons may be an effective treatment strategy for epilepsy. The chemogenetic approach also resulted in varied neuronal activity, leading to stronger and longer-lasting inhibition.

11101621.value: 以一個具生物活性的小分子作為促進神經軸突再生及醫治神經系統損傷的潛在治療方案

11101621.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11101621.value: 與中樞神經系統 （central nervous system； CNS） 相比，周圍神經系統（peripheral nervous system； PNS）能於損傷後成功再生，這主要是由於周圍神經元的內在再生能力較強，中樞神經元較弱的內在再生能力亦成為其軸突能成功再生的主要障礙。即使如此，由於周圍神經軸突的再生速度緩慢（每天1毫米），近端周圍神經損傷由於需要軸突再生至一段較遠的距離，緩慢的再生速度導致患者的功能恢復變得極為有限。 PNS 和 CNS 的損傷通常會導致永久性的感覺和運動功能障礙，嚴重影響患者生活素質。當代科學家和臨床醫生急需要找出能重新激發受損神經元的內在生長能力的方法，以實現全功能恢復。 神經系統的損傷會誘發適應性（生長和存活）或適應不良（細胞死亡和再生失敗）的細胞反應，靠的正是一組基因精確協調得來的結果。此前的研究發現能激活PNS軸突成功再生的信號通路，包括 JAK-STAT 和 mTOR 信號通路，於CNS損傷後均未能有效激活。同時敲除Pten及Socs3成功激活JAK-STAT 和 mTOR 信號通路，其協同作用能大幅增強CNS軸突再生能力。近代研究亦於通過修改神經元的基因來促進軸突再生方面取得了進展。雖然基因治療的概念很簡單，但能於臨床上廣泛應用，科學家仍需繼續找出能達致高轉導效率且精準地將轉基因遞送到目標組織的方法。因此，我們迫切需要找出一些具生物活性的小分子，用以增強受損神經元的內在生長能力，並以此作為一種即用型療法。 為了解決這個關鍵問題，我們進行了生物信息學分析，挖掘與 Pten/Socs3同時敲除有共同調控信息通路的小分子，並使用具顯著性差異表達的基因作為基因表達特徵，用以查詢 一個名為「LINCS」的公共數據庫，與一個來自經超過 48,000 個生物活性小分子處理的細胞系，具有超過 1數百萬個基因表達圖譜來作配對。我們鑑定了一種與臨床相關，具生物活性的小分子 SB-218795，一個神經激肽 3 受體拮抗劑。我們證明 SB-218795 顯著增加了於體外培養，經軸突切斷的 PNS 神經元的軸突再生力，並於周圍神經損傷後成功促進周圍神經的再生，亦能顯著加快小鼠於周圍神經損傷後的功能恢復。更引人注目的是，SB-218795 成功於視神經擠壓損傷後促進受損CNS軸突的再生。是次項目旨在優化SB-218795的治療劑量方案，使SB-218795能於嚴重周圍神經損傷，及視神經擠壓損傷後達致最大的治療效果，並闡明 SB-218795 在軸突再生中的潛在分子機理。

11102321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11102321.value: 金屬納米材料广泛应用於許多行業，包括化妝品、材料、紡織品、能源和醫藥等。在众多金屬基納米粒子中，Cu和Zn納米（nCuO和nZnO）被廣泛用作納米催化劑和抗菌劑，但其毒性機制沒有得到很好的理解。由於它們體積小，這些納米粒子可內化到細胞中，然後與各種大分子和細胞器相互作用。雖然有許多關於納米粒子毒性的研究，但生物效應是由納米粒子、外部溶解的金屬離子或細胞內釋放的金屬離子导致的在很大程度上是未知的。因此研究納米粒子的細胞吸收和細胞內行為，以更好地預測其生物效應，優化其在生物醫學領域的應用，具有十分重要的意義。在這個项目中，我們将採用不同的新型生物成像技術來研究細胞吸收、細胞內溶解和靶向細胞器官，以及細胞毒性的控制機制。我們的具體目標是：1）研究它們的細胞內化和生物積累過程：2）細胞溶解、運輸和分布：3）細胞内溶解和分布对細胞毒性的控制。隨著新款生物探针的應用，我們將能夠從外部和細胞內来量化 nCuO 和 nZnO 的溶解。我們將進一步開展亞細胞定位和敏感細胞/代謝的生物成像，確定導致納米粒子毒性的主要化學形态。此外，我們將首次使用高時空分辨電子顯微鏡技術来跟蹤納米粒子的内化動力學。這些新型技術的應用將使我們能夠解決納米粒子衍生的金屬離子的細胞內溶解，以及它們針對的敏感細胞器，用于預測細胞毒性。因此這项研究将提供關於納米粒子的細胞吸收和亞細胞轉化過程的關鍵資訊，這是我們了解其細胞毒性和在生物醫學領域的應用所急需的。

11102321.label: Realisation of objectives
11102321.value: 1. To study the cellular endocytosis and bioaccumulation processes of NPs Cellular endocytosis and bioaccumulation processes of NPs were examined in many studies. Wang and Wang (2022)3 developed a gold-core Cu2O microparticle (Au@Cu2O) to differentiate particulate versus ionic Cu in zebrafish embryonic cells and quantified bioaccumulation, exocytosis, and cytotoxicity. We showed internalized MPs rapidly dissolved to Cu ions, which underwent lysosome-mediated exocytosis. Sun and Wang (2022)5 established a method to quantify Zn influx, partitioning between labile and storage pools, and efflux using a Zn-sensitive eukaryote with autofluorescence reporting intracellular Zn. Wang et al. (2023)9 in situ tracked crystal-surface-dependent Cu2O NP dissolution by liquid-cell TEM and fluorescence probes; cubic Cu2O NPs dissolved more than spherical ones of equal surface area due to facet effects. We also observed simultaneous growth of new small NPs alongside dissolution of pristine Cu2O, evidencing concurrent transformation pathways. Recognizing the role of extracellular polymeric substances (EPS) in metal toxicity, Yan et al. (2021)2 created an aggregation-induced emission (AIE) nanoprobe to visualize EPS distribution in situ across microorganisms, informing EPS structure–function relationships in microbe–NP interactions. Chang and Wang (2023)19 quantified leachates from six common mask types—including phthalate acid esters (PAEs), metals, and nanoparticles—and assessed cytotoxicity; Cu- or Ag-containing masks induced lysosomal acidification and alkalinization dysregulation. Wang and Wang (2023)10 evaluated Cu leachability from Cu NP-containing masks and subcellular impacts, estimating ~20 μg Cu could be inhaled (≈3% of mask Cu). Furthermore, 30–40% of Cu on mask fibers was readily released into solution, predominantly as ionic Cu, highlighting potential exposure via inhalation and solution-phase release. 2. To study the subcellular dissolution, transport and localization of NPs A few studies have extensively quantified the subcellular dissolution, transport and localization of NPs in different cells. For example, Yuan Wang (2022)4 used bioimaging to probe subcellular fate of Zn and Cu in zebrafish cells, revealing fundamentally distinct behaviors and distributions. Wang and Wang (2022)6 found CuO NP dissolution rates varied by cell type; after dissolution, only limited intracellular reduction of Cu(II) to Cu(I) occurred. Sun and Wang (2022)5 introduced a technique to quantify ultra-small AgNPs based on the suppression of Zn2+-directed fluorescence in adenine-deficient yeast [Ade(−) yeast) by dissolved Ag+, enabling determination of intracellular AgNP dissolution post-uptake. Using bioimaging, Xia and Wang (2023)20 mapped Cu among organelles in fish fin cells and observed lysosome–mitochondria interactions, with rapid digestion consistent with mitophagy removing excess mitochondrial Cu to mitigate toxicity. In rabbitfish fin cells, Xia et al. (2023)11 showed Zn toxicity and bioaccumulation were dose- and time-dependent, and mitochondrial Zn strongly predicted cellular toxicity. In an important work, Wang and Wang (2024)25 tracked cellular AgNP degradation and developed a generic kinetic model. Subcellular imaging resolved intracellular AgNP transfer, while single-particle ICP-MS tracked degradation dynamics; the model described uptake, transfer, and degradation, demonstrating substantially higher intracellular degradation than abiotic mimics and strong modulation by cellular factors. Most internalized AgNPs dissolved, with ions rapidly depurated. This model enables prediction of how NP physicochemical traits and the cellular environment shape nanotoxicity and therapeutic efficacy. Wang and Wang (2023)17 further modeled the cellular journey of nanomaterials (NMs)—internalization, trafficking, deposition, and exocytosis—emphasizing that cellular accumulation depends not only on membrane crossing but also on subsequent trafficking and exit. These advances inform biomedical NM design and technology development for probing intracellular fate. 3. To study the cytotoxicity of NPs in relation to their subcellular dissolution and localization Wang and Wang (2021)1 introduced a protocol to simultaneously measure biologically produced extracellular Cu(I) and internalized Cu(II) in Chlamydomonas reinhardtii, the first to jointly assess Cu(I)/Cu(II) during algal Cu exposure. Subsequent work contrasted CuO uptake/toxicity with ionic Cu and speciation. Wang and Wang (2023)8 revealed heterogeneous algal responses to Cu stress, identifying G2/M as a phase with high Cu quota needs; phase-dependent uptake underpinned heterogeneous toxicity outcomes. Wang and Wang (2023)6 engineered CuxS shells on Cu2O and CuO to selectively release Cu(I) and Cu(II) intracellularly, uncovering distinct mechanisms: excess Cu(I) caused mitochondrial fragmentation and apoptosis, whereas Cu(II) induced S-phase arrest and ROS generation. Deng and Wang (2023)24 showed labile Cu(I) accumulates in cytoplasmic granules, while labile Cu(II) localizes to pyrenoid and chloroplast, defining a dynamic, environmentally responsive intracellular Cu(I)/Cu(II) cycle. Deng and Wang (2024)27 linked exogenous acidification to disrupted labile Cu trafficking, expanding Cu(I) pools and altering transporter activity—suppressing Cu(I) import and activating export in acidic cells. More recently, Deng and Wang (2025)30 found the freshwater algal cell wall interface modulates Cu biotransformation via redox-differentiated membrane-localized and intracellular processes; cells assembled lysosome-related organelles and synthesized polyphosphate as detoxification to maintain homeostasis. Luo and Wang (2023)21 discovered Cu stress elongates tunneling nanotubes (TNTs), enabling directional mitochondrial transfer from low to high phagocytic hemocyte subpopulations, enhancing energy and phagocytic function—a novel stress-survival strategy via organelle sharing. Luo and Wang (2023)18 showed AgNPs and Ag+ increased lysosome number/size and caused lysosomal and mitochondrial dysfunction—more lysosomal membrane permeabilization and reduced mitochondrial membrane potential—with Ag+ contributing most to AgNP toxicity. Wang and Wang (2023)12 achieved nanoscale visualization of notochord and skeletal muscle alterations after AgNP exposure using whole-body expansion microscopy (whole-ExM), revealing notochord curvature and reduced, loosely arranged skeletal muscle; in vivo Ag+ arose mainly from AgNP dissolution. Regarding ZnO nanoparticles, Ma and Wang (2023)13 reported dietary nZnO promoted probiotic (Lactic-acid bacilli spp.) colonization in fish intestine and modulated glucose/lipid metabolism via microbiome regulation. Dietary nZnO enhanced antioxidant defenses by elevating enzyme activities and activating akt/mTOR/elovl5/elovl8 pathways to sustain resilience under extreme environments (Ma and Wang, 2023)22. Moreover, nZnO/Zn treatments activated hepatic lipolysis regulation under oxidative stress (Ma and Wang, 2025)29. Wang and Wang (2025)28 assessed tissue-specific toxicological changes and sources of nZnO versus Zn2+ in medaka visual, skeletal muscle, and digestive systems. Related findings were reviewed by Sun and Wang (2023)16 and Sun et al. (2025)31, contextualizing particulate versus ionic Zn contributions across organisms. Complicated ZnO environmental behavior and toxicity were extensively examined. Sun and Wang (2023)14 extracted ZnO NPs and microplastics from a commercial sunscreen, showing ZnO promoted microplastic photooxidation via hydroxyl radical production, increasing the carbonyl index 2.5-fold and elevating cytotoxicity—first evidence that product-derived ZnO activates microplastics. Sun and Wang (2024)23 analyzed combined effects of sunscreen-extracted nZnO and microplastics on barnacle larval development, distinguishing roles of primary (PMPs) versus secondary microplastics (SMPs) and revealing SMPs markedly modulate nZnO bioeffects, highlighting complex mixture interactions. Finally, Sun and Wang (2024)26 disentangled cellular responses to particulate versus soluble sunscreen constituents, showing bio-transformable particulates like ZnO dissolve within organelles and cause higher subcellular toxicity than bioinert particulates like microplastics, emphasizing the importance of intracellular dissolution and speciation in assessing product safety.

11102321.label: Major findings and research outcome
11102321.value: 1. Cellular uptake, dissolution, and bioaccumulation dynamics of metal-based nanomaterials Across multiple systems (zebrafish embryonic cells, yeast, algal cells, hemocytes), nanoparticles (NPs) undergo rapid cellular internalization followed by substantial intracellular dissolution that drives toxicity and fate. Cu2O, CuO, Ag, and ZnO NPs typically dissolve to ions once internalized; ionic species dominate downstream biological effects. Crystal facets and oxygen availability strongly modulate dissolution (e.g., cubic Cu2O > spherical; O2 limitation suppresses dissolution), and extracellular polymeric substances shape particle–cell interactions. In situ and operando imaging revealed concurrent NP dissolution and secondary NP formation, underscoring complex intra/extracellular transformations. 2. Subcellular trafficking governs exposure at organelles and dictates hazard High-resolution bioimaging and new quantification approaches mapped metal distribution among organelles. Lysosome–mitochondria cross-talk is prominent: lysosomal processing precedes mitochondrial impacts, with mitophagy acting as a protective route to clear excess mitochondrial Cu. Mitochondrial Zn burden predicts cellular toxicity, highlighting organelle-specific exposure metrics over bulk cellular loads. A generic kinetic model for AgNPs quantified uptake, inter-organelle transfer, and degradation, showing intracellular degradation far exceeds abiotic mimic tests and is strongly regulated by cellular factors. 3. Oxidation state, speciation, and microenvironment drive distinct toxic mechanisms Cu(I) and Cu(II) elicit different cellular outcomes: Cu(I) triggers mitochondrial fragmentation and apoptosis, whereas Cu(II) induces S-phase arrest and ROS generation. Acidification perturbs intracellular Cu trafficking, expanding labile Cu(I) pools and altering transporter activity. Spatially, labile Cu(I) concentrates in cytoplasmic granules while Cu(II) localizes to pyrenoid/chloroplast, evidencing redox-partitioned biotransformation. At the organismal level, AgNP exposure (with in vivo dissolution as the main Ag+ source) disrupts musculoskeletal development. 4. Environmental matrices and consumer products reshape NP risks Face masks release PAEs, metals, Cu/Ag, and microplastics; leachates cause nuclear condensation, DNA damage, oxidative stress, and lysosomal pH disruption, with notable Cu leachability and ionic dominance. Commercial sunscreens co-release ZnO NPs and microplastics; ZnO catalyzes microplastic photooxidation via •OH radicals, amplifying toxicity. Primary versus secondary microplastics differentially modulate nZnO bioeffects in marine invertebrate larvae, demonstrating mixture-dependent hazards. 5. Biological adaptation, intercellular communication, and host–microbiome modulation Cells deploy detoxification and homeostatic strategies, including lysosome-related organelle assembly, polyphosphate synthesis, and mitophagy. Under Cu stress, hemocytes form tunneling nanotubes that mediate directional mitochondrial transfer, boosting energy and phagocytic function—a novel survival mechanism. Dietary ZnO nanoparticles reshape fish gut microbiota (promoting lactic-acid bacilli), enhance antioxidant defenses, and modulate lipid/glucose metabolism and hepatic lipolysis; system-specific assessments distinguish particulate vs ionic Zn contributions across visual, muscular, and digestive tissues.

11102321.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11102321.value: Building on these advances, we will generalize mechanistic insights into predictive, regulation-ready tools while engineering safer materials. First, extend the AgNP cellular kinetic framework to CuO, Cu2O, ZnO, and core–shell systems, explicitly parameterizing crystal facets, coatings, oxygen tension, and EPS/NOM effects, and validating across cell types and species. Second, standardize redox-speciation–resolved toxicology by developing multiplex AIE/bioimaging panels for Cu(I)/Cu(II), Ag0/Ag+, Zn(II), with organelle resolution, establishing quantitative biomarkers (mitochondrial Zn load, lysosomal pH shift, mitophagy flux) and rapid assays to apportion particulate versus ionic contributions in complex products. Third, map mixture interactions among nanoparticles, primary/secondary microplastics, and leachates (PAEs, metals), and co-design “safer-by-design” masks and sunscreens that minimize ion release and •OH generation, targeting >50% toxicity reduction. Fourth, define microbiome-mediated mitigation via fish, multi-omics, and probiotic/dietary interventions that preserve essential metal homeostasis while buffering oxidative and metabolic stress. Fifth, translate imaging (whole-body expansion microscopy, liquid-cell TEM) into interlaboratory SOPs and benchmarks, engaging regulators to incorporate intracellular dissolution and organelle metal metrics into risk frameworks.

11102321.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11102321.value: Nanoparticles are tiny materials used in products like masks, sunscreens, and medical tools. Our research shows that what matters most for safety is not just the particles themselves, but what happens after they enter cells. Many metal-based nanoparticles (like copper, silver, and zinc oxide) quickly break down inside cells into metal ions, and these ions drive most of the effects—good or bad. We discovered that a particle’s shape, surface, and the amount of oxygen around it change how fast it dissolves. Inside cells, the particles and ions move between compartments such as lysosomes and mitochondria; this “trafficking” can damage energy production, but cells can also protect themselves by recycling damaged parts. We also studied everyday products. Some face masks can release chemicals, metals, and microplastics that stress cells and damage DNA, with copper- or silver-treated masks releasing more ions. Sunscreens can release zinc oxide nanoparticles and microplastics together; sunlight makes these combinations more reactive, increasing potential harm to marine life. On the positive side, carefully used zinc oxide in fish feed can support helpful gut bacteria and improve resilience, showing that benefits are possible with good design. Overall, our work points to smarter, safer materials and clearer testing methods to protect people and the environment.

11102421.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11102421.value: Epidemics such as COVID-19 can place great strain on healthcare systems for extended periods of time, especially in intensive care units (ICUs) where high operating costs means resources can be scarce even during normal times. In this project, we will develop new solutions for resource planning and network engineering of ICU networks in metropolitan cities such as Hong Kong. This will allow city governments to proactively prepare for infectious outbreaks, e.g. future waves of COVID-19, seasonal outbreaks such as influenza, and new infectious diseases, thus minimising undesirable capacity-linked patient rejection and resulting mortality. To improve its services, the Hong Kong Hospital Authority (HKHA) promotes the “development of cluster/network-based services or structures” in its Strategic Plan 2017–2022 to “support the management of caseloads between hospitals through redistribution of cases”. In this project, we will develop models for a city-wide ICU network to optimise efficiency and minimise the patient rejection or deferral rate, especially during epidemics. The ICU network will include a centralised management policy for the admission of infectious patients and policies for the admission of regular patients, including the deferral of elective patient procedures and the referral of emergency patients between different ICUs depending on the network state. Our proposed policies will help improve ICU network performance in metropolitan cities such as Hong Kong, particularly during epidemics, by redistributing patients both geographically (between ICUs) and timewise (by deferring elective patients). Additionally, this project will study optimisation methods for the allocation of additional ICU beds whenever resources become available. These optimisation methods will allow ICU administrators to decide how many additional ICU beds to procure and where to add them to maximise the improvement in ICU network performance. This work is motivated by the PI's practical experience and recent research achievements in teletraffic modelling and the clinical needs of the Co-Is' professional institutions. The Co-ordinating Committee of Intensive Care of HKHA fully supports this project and will collaborate with our research team at CityU (see the attached support letter). The PI's role will be to oversee the project and provide the mathematical methods underlying the study, whereas the Co-Is' role will be to oversee the collection of ICU patient data, provide opinions on modelling assumptions, and to review the potential applications of the research outcomes. The collected patient data will be used to test our ICU network policies and optimisation solutions on a real ICU network. COVID-19 等流行病可能會在很長一段時間內給醫療保健系統帶來巨大壓力，尤其是在重症監護病房 (ICU) 中，高運營成本意味著即使在正常時間資源也可能稀缺。在這個項目中，我們將為香港等大都市的ICU網絡的資源規劃和網絡工程開發新的解決方案。這將使市政府能夠主動為傳染病爆發做好準備，例如未來的 COVID-19 浪潮、季節性爆發（如流感）和新的傳染病，從而最大限度地減少與容量相關的不良反應和由此產生的死亡率。 為改善服務，香港醫院管理局（醫管局）在其 2017-2022 年策略計劃中提倡“發展集群/網絡服務或架構”，以“通過重新分配病例來支持醫院之間的病例量管理”。在這個項目中，我們將為全市 ICU 網絡開發模型，以優化效率並最大限度地減少患者拒絕或延遲率，尤其是在流行病期間。重症監護病房網絡將包括傳染病患者入院的集中管理政策和普通患者入院政策，包括根據網絡狀態推遲擇期患者手術和不同重症監護病房之間急診患者的轉診。 我們提出的政策將通過在地理上（ICU 之間）和時間上（通過推遲選擇性患者）重新分配患者，幫助改善香港等大都市的 ICU 網絡性能，尤其是在流行病期間。此外，該項目將研究在資源可用時分配額外 ICU 床位的優化方法。這些優化方法將允許 ICU 管理員決定購買多少額外的 ICU 床位以及在哪裡添加這些床位，以最大限度地提高 ICU 網絡性能。 這項工作的動機是首席研究員 (PI) 在遠程通信建模方面的實踐經驗和最近的研究成果以及共同調查員 (Co-Is) 專業機構的臨床需求。香港醫管局重症監護統籌委員會全力支持這項計劃，並會與我們城大的研究團隊合作。 PI 的作用是監督項目並提供研究背後的數學方法，而 Co-Is 的作用是監督 ICU 患者數據的收集，就建模假設提供意見，並審查該研究的潛在應用研究成果。收集的患者數據將用於在真實的 ICU 網絡上測試我們的 ICU 網絡策略和優化解決方案。

11103221.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11103221.value: Pseudomonas syringae pathovars are widespread pathogens that infect various staple crops, thus causing huge economic losses and presenting a threat to food security worldwide. Like many other phytopathogenic bacteria, P. syringae deploys its type III secretion system (T3SS) to invade host plants and cause lethal diseases. Although a number of components regulating the T3SS gene expression have been identified, how the bacterium senses the environmental conditions and further transduce the signal(s) to the known regulatory components remain largely unknown. We have recently found plant sourced polyphenols specifically activated RhpRS. In our previous studies, we found that the N-terminal sensor domain of RhpS played an essential role in polyphenols perception. We also have identified that three non-cognate histidine kinases PSPPH_5115, PSPPH_3736 and PSPPH_3550 collectively acted as kinases on RhpR. We propose a novel signaling pathway of polyphenol-RhpRS-PSPPH_3550/3736/5115-T3SS, whose verification is the focus of the proposal. Genetic and biochemical characterizations of this novel phosphorelay pathway is the first step toward identifying signals to which the T3SS responds, and toward the development of new strategies for disease control based on T3SS manipulation. Our long-term goal is to leverage the outcomes of the herein proposed studies to develop better therapies against P. syringae infection. 丁香假單胞菌病原體是一種廣泛存在的病原體，對全球糧食安全構成威脅。該菌利用其 III 型分泌系統 (T3SS) 入侵寄主植物並引起致命疾病。盡管已經鑒定了許多調節 T3SS 基因表達的成分，但細菌如何感知環境條件並進一步將信號轉導到已知的調節成分仍然很大程度上未知。在我們之前的研究中，我們發現 RhpS 的 N 端傳感器域在多酚感知中發揮了重要作用，而且確定了三種非同源組氨酸激酶共同作為 RhpR 上的激酶。我們提出了一種新的多酚——組氨酸激酶信號通路，這種新型磷酸傳遞途徑的遺傳和生化特征是識別 T3SS 響應信號的第一步。我們的長期目標是利用該項目的研究結果來開發針對丁香假單胞菌感染的更好療法。

11103921.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11103921.value: 結直腸癌 (CRC) 是全球範圍內第三大最為常見的癌症，也是導致癌症死亡的第二大原因。這種疾病的異質性阻礙了輔助化療的決策，並使得開發靶向藥物變得困難。 2015 年，我們與結直腸癌分型聯盟 (CRCSC) 的其他團隊一起，為鑑定具有不同分子特性和臨床特徵的四種共識分子亞型 (CMS) 做出了貢獻。近年來，已有大量研究描述了這四種 CMS亞型 的預後及更為重要的藥物反應預測的特性，為其臨床效用提供了證據。然而，由於 CMS 是基於塊狀腫瘤轉錄組學特徵開發的，因此該亞型系統主要捕獲腫瘤間的異質性。因此，自發表以來，CMS分型體系受到以下挑戰：腫瘤浸潤基質的混雜因素可能導致細胞系和患者來源的異種移植物 (PDX) 的潛在不穩定分類。到目前為止，如何整合腫瘤內和腫瘤間異質性以進行更穩健的疾病分類仍然是一項具有挑戰性的任務。 基於組織切片的組織病理學圖像含有豐富的細胞形態和組織結構信息，提供了一種經濟高效且易於獲取的分析方法來解剖腫瘤微環境。我們的初步研究提供了令人信服的數據表明：CMS4-間充質亞型仍然是異質的，並可以根據空間多樣性指數 (SDI) 進一步分類。該指數量化了腫瘤近端和腫瘤內各種組織類型的生態多樣性。在擬議的項目中，我們的第一個目標是對 H&E 染色的組織病理圖像的空間特徵進行更全面、多尺度的“組織組學”分析，並鑒定可用於預後的特徵，以便更為系統地剖析腫瘤內異質性。整合獲得的組織組學譜和基因表達數據，我們的第二個目標是採用機器學習方法來識別生物學相關和臨床相關的亞型。為深入闡明亞型特異性分子機制。我們的第三個目標是進行多組學和臨床表徵，以及調控網絡分析。為了支持該項目，我們基於 19 個公共數據集和兩個內部數據集構建了一個大型數據隊列，總共涉及 4600 多個患者樣本、細胞系和 PDX。為實現這些主要目標，我們將整合圖像處理、生物信息學分析、機器學習和人工智能方法，以及由阿姆斯特丹大學學術醫學中心和中山大學的合作者全力支持的必要的實驗驗證。

11103921.label: Realisation of objectives
11103921.value: In this project, we analyzed multi-omics profiles from a total of 2580 patient samples, including TCGA-CRC (n=622), MVRM (n=522), AMC-AJCCII-90 (n=90), SYSU-CRC (n=422), and other public datasets (n=1346). The TCGA-CRC, AMC-AJCCII-90, and SYSU-CRC cohorts, including omics and H&E-stained histological images, were used for spatial characterizations (AIM 1), integrative subtyping analysis (AIM 2), and molecular and clinical characterizations (AIM 3). For training a gene-expression based classifier, we employed the CRCSC cohort (n = 1975). The other datasets were used for independent validations of the classifier, comprehensive molecular and clinical characterizations of each subtype identified. 1. Comprehensive multi-scale spatial characterizations of intratumor heterogeneity in the colorectal cancer microenvironment Using the deep-learning framework CRC-SPA previously developed by our group, we performed tissue classification of the H&E-stained whole-slide images in the SYSU-CRC cohort (n = 422) and employed a multi-scale quantification approach to calculate spatial organization features (SOFs). Briefly, H&E images were tessellated into non-overlapping 224 × 224 pixels (px) image patches using Openslide. Image patches with a high ratio of blank surface (> 50%) were removed, and the remaining patches were color-normalized using Macenko's method and converted to a reference color space. Various hand-crafted spatial features proposed by us and other groups were quantified at multiple magnification levels (10x, 20x, and 40x) within the tumor, tumor-proximal, tumor-distal regions, and the whole slide. Together, 360 features were generated for each H&E image, providing comprehensive profiling of the tumor microenvironment of CRC. Out of the total 360 SOFs calculated for each histology slide, 253 features were retained as significant variables (P < 0.05) for the following analysis. Consistent with our previous findings in Caucasians using the TCGA-CRC cohort, each CMS is also characterized by distinct tissue types. Specifically, CMS1 tumors had the highest fractions of lymphocytes, consistent with their higher immune cell infiltration levels (P = 0.004). CMS2 is a canonical, epithelial subtype, coinciding with the more abundant tumor cells than other subtypes (P < 0.001). CMS3, which is characterized by metabolic dysregulations, displayed apparent higher amount of mucus tissues and higher ‘interactions’ (co-occurrence) with other types of tissues (P < 0.001). The more abundant mucus in CMS3 tumors might be due to their origin of goblet cells producing intestinal mucus and dysregulated interactions between gut microbiota and the mucus layer. Furthermore, CMS4 tumors showed higher stroma content (P < 0.001), which also echoes previous findings based on the deconvolution of transcriptomic profiles. Together, our findings revealed a strong linkage between spatial organization features quantified from histology slides and the characteristic molecular properties of CRC subtypes. 2. Establishing a novel CRC subtyping system based on histology-omics integrative analysis Focusing on regions of interest (ROIs), defined as within tumor and tumor-proximal regions, we calculated spatial diversity index (SDI) to quantify the heterogeneity of tissue types in the tumor microenvironment. Interestingly, stratifying CMS4 tumors into two subgroups by the median SDI, we found tumors belonging to the CMS4 SDI-high (CMS4-SDI+) group contained much more stroma and immune content than those classified to the SDI-low (CMS4-SDI-) group (both P < 0.05). Furthermore, the CMS4-SDI- group showed significantly higher tumor purity than the CMS4-SDI+ group (P = 0.0036). To investigate the clinical relevance, we performed stratified analysis using SDI within each CMS in the SYSU-CRC cohort. Notably, the SDI+ and SDI- subgroups were significantly associated with RFS only in the CMS4 (P = 1.44E-4), but not in CMS1-3 (P > 0.05). While the initial CMS showed a marginal association with relapse-free survival (RFS) (P = 0.033), the integrative taxonomy with five subtypes demonstrated a much more significant association (P = 7.82E-6). Together, we confirmed that CMS4 remains a heterogeneous subtype attributed by the tumor microenvironment. Refining the CMS subtyping system by SDI generated a five-class subtyping system (termed “CMSPlus” hereafter) with significantly increased clinical associations. Meanwhile, using hierarchical clustering on the GSVA (gene set variation analysis) scores calculated from the gene expression data in the SYSU-CRC cohort, CMS4 can be clustered into two subgroups with low and high immune infiltration (termed “CMS4-IF-” and “CMS4-IF+”), respectively. As expected, the CMS4-IF+ subgroup was significantly enriched for tumors assigned to the CMS4-SDI+ subtype, while CMS4-SDI- tumors were predominantly classified to the CMS4-IF- subtype. Compared with the other subtypes, CMS4-IF- displayed the poorest RFS (P = 4.46E-5). Furthermore, CMS4-IF+ tumors showed significantly higher stroma and immune content and much lower tumor purity based on deconvolution of gene expression profiles, which is highly consistent with the image-based analysis. Together, our results suggest a high concordance between the subtyping results based on image-derived spatial features and gene signatures characterizing tumor microenvironment. To make CMSPlus generally applicable, we employed a large gene expression dataset previously curated by CRCSC (n=1975) to train a robust classifier using Random Forest algorithm. Applying to the TCGA-CRC and MVRM cohorts for validation, the classifier achieved high accuracies of 0.855 and 0.861. Both cohorts showed consistent patterns of molecular and microenvironment signatures and significant associations with RFS, demonstrating the strong robustness and general applicability of the classifier. 3. Comprehensive molecular and clinical characterizations of CRC subtypes To obtain a landscape of subtype-specific molecular properties, we performed comprehensive analysis of multi-omics profiles in the TCGA-CRC cohort. Both CMS4-IF+ and CMS4-IF- tumors had generally low mutation counts and high SCNA counts. CMS4-IF- tumors had relatively lower mutation counts but higher SCNA counts compared to those classified to CMS4-IF+. The most frequent mutations are highly similar between the two CMS4 subtypes, including APC, TP53, KRAS and PIK3CA mutations. However, we did not find any mutation or SCNA specifically enriched in CMS4-IF+ or CMS4-IF- subtypes, suggesting that these two subtypes of CMS4 do not differ in the genetic variations. For pathway analysis, gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) was performed on patient subgroups stratified by the five CMS-TME subtypes. CMS1 showed higher immune activities, CMS2 displayed an epithelial phenotype, with activated Wnt and MYC signaling pathways, and CMS3 was featured with dysregulated metabolic pathways. Interestingly, the two subgroups of CMS4 both had upregulated epithelial-mesenchymal transition, matrix remodeling, and TGF-β pathways, as well as abundant stromal infiltration. However, consistent with the image-derived spatial features, CMS4-IF+ subtype was also associated with activated immune signatures, while CMS4-IF- showed an immune “cold” phenotype and significantly higher stroma content. Furthermore, using a network-based approach we identified VAV3 as the most significant master regulator of epithelial-mesenchymal transition in the CMS4-IF- subgroup of CRC (P = 7.00E-5). In addition to RFS, we also investigated the potential associations between CMSPlus and other clinical factors such as age, gender, differentiation grade, TNM stage, lymph node metastasis and distant metastasis. We found that patients assigned to the CMS4-IF- subtype tended to be younger in age (< 50), while the CMS4-IF+ subgroup was more enriched for stage IV patients and associated with a higher chance of distant metastasis (all P < 0.05). Interestingly, adjuvant chemotherapy was only effective in the patients assigned to CMS4 (P = 0.027), but not CMS1-3 (all P > 0.05). More strikingly, CMS4-IF- patients showed favorable response (P = 5.38E-3), whereas CMS4-IF+ patients did not receive significant benefit. Together, CMSPlus showed promising clinical values for prognosis and prediction of adjuvant therapy responses, which warrant large-scale investigations in the future.

11103921.label: Major findings and research outcome
11103921.value: 1. We performed comprehensive characterizations of CRC tumor microenvironment by multi-scale quantification of spatial organization features (SOFs) based on CRC-SPA, a deep learning framework we established for automated tissue classification of H&E-stained histology images (Wu T et al., under review). In both Caucasians and Chinese, we found that tumors assigned to CMS1-4 have consistently more abundant lymphocytes, tumor epithelium, mucus and stroma, respectively. Our findings revealed a strong linkage between SOFs quantified from histology slides and the characteristic molecular properties of CRC subtypes. Focusing on colorectal cancer liver metastases (CRLM), we developed a deep learning framework (CRLM-SPA) for fully automated tissue classification and quantification of clinically relevant SOFs in H&E-stained images of CRLM (Qi L et al, iScience 2023; 26:107702). A risk-scoring system derived from the SOFs demonstrated a strong and robust prognostic value that is independent of the current clinical risk score (CRS) system in independent clinical cohorts. 2. We developed a novel, five-class subtyping system (CMSPlus) for CRC with significantly increased clinical associations (Wu T et al., under review). The CMS4-IF+ subtype was associated with activated immune signatures, while CMS4-IF- showed an immune “cold” phenotype and significantly higher stroma content. Compared to CMS (P = 0.033), CMSPlus demonstrated a much more significant association (P = 7.82E-6) with patient survival. Adjuvant chemotherapy was only effective in Chinese patients assigned to CMS4, but not CMS1-3. More strikingly, CMS4-IF- patients showed favorable response (P = 5.38E-3), whereas CMS4-IF+ patients did not receive significant benefit. To make CMSPlus generally applicable, we developed and validated a subtype classifier using gene expression profiles based on machine learning, demonstrating strong robustness and accuracy across three independent cohorts. 3. Focusing on young-onset CRC, we dissected the age-dependent molecular heterogeneity and established a model for identifying high-risk young-onset patients (Ke J et al., ESMO Gastrointestinal Oncology 2025; 9:100181). More specifically, we found that young-onset CRC patients exhibited better overall survival, but worse relapse-free survival and higher metastasis rates compared with late-onset cases. Molecular subtyping analysis found that young-onset CRC also comprises the same four subtypes (CMS1-4), but the prevalence differs from late-onset CRC. Stratified analysis suggested that the poor outcomes in young-onset CRC were due to higher prevalence of the CMS4-mesenchymal subtype. To predict CMS4, we established an effective risk-scoring model (area under the curve = 0.87) combining molecular and histological markers, with multiple independent validations.

11103921.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11103921.value: Several findings in the project have the potential for clinical translation, pending future experimental and clinical validations. (1) We developed a novel subtyping system—CMSPlus, demonstrating promising clinical values for prognosis and prediction of adjuvant therapy responses; (2) We developed deep learning frameworks for fully automated tissue classification of H&E images of CRC and CRLM, which could significantly reduce assessment subjectivity and the workload of pathologists. (3) We developed a time- and cost-efficient risk-scoring model for the prediction of prognosis in patients with CRC liver metastases, which is independent of the current clinical risk score (CRS) system. (4) We developed a risk-scoring model by combining molecular and histological markers to predict young-onset CRC patients with high risk of recurrence. To translate these findings into the clinic, in-depth mechanistic studies and large-scale cohort studies are needed, which is beyond the scope of this project. However, during the project, we have established close collaborations with multiple research institutions such as the Sixth Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University, Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Hospital, and University of Amsterdam. We believe our further development and optimization of these models will advance precision oncology for CRC and eventually benefit patients in the future.

11103921.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11103921.value: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a highly heterogeneous disease with respect to clinical and biological features, making it hard to choose the right treatment for patients. The existing Consensus Molecular Subtype (CMS) system, based on bulk tumor omics profiles, effectively categorizes inter-tumor differences but fails to capture critical intratumor microenvironmental variation, limiting its predictive power for treatment. To bridge this gap, we quantitatively analyzed the tumor microenvironment using a deep learning tool (CRC-SPA) applied to standard histology images. We found that each CMS group has a distinct and consistent tissue architecture, establishing a direct link between computational pathology and cancer molecular biology. Building on this, we developed CMSPlus, a novel five-class system that splits the aggressive CMS4 subtype into two: an immune-active (CMS4-IF+) and an immune-silent, stroma-rich (CMS4-IF-) group. CMSPlus is far superior to CMS in predicting patient survival. Crucially, it identifies who benefits from chemotherapy: only patients in the CMS4-IF- subgroup showed a significant survival advantage from adjuvant chemotherapy. Finally, we translated this histology-based insight into a practical gene-expression classifier, validating its robustness across independent patient cohorts. Together, our work integrated histology images with molecular data to create a clinically actionable framework for personalizing CRC therapy.

11104321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11104321.value: 表观遗传学基因沉默是指在不改变DNA序列的情况下产生的可遗传的基因表达抑制。最新研究表明，原癌基因表观遗传沉默的丧失和遗传印记基因表达失调是癌症以及先天性人类疾病发生的重要原因。这使得表观遗传学调控在维持人类生命健康方面具有举足轻重的地位。X染色体失活(XCI)是表观遗传基因沉默的经典范例之一，它通过多种表观遗传机制随机灭活雌性哺乳动物中的一条X染色体，从而确保X染色体的基因表达水平在雄性（XY）和雌性（XX）之间保持平衡。 近期，我们报道了一种探究RNA相互作用蛋白的新方法：CARPID(CRISPR-assisted RNA–protein interaction detection method)，此方法无需化学或紫外线固定，而在活细胞中利用带有生物素标签的CRISPR识别特定RNA的相互作用蛋白。我们利用上述CARPID方法鉴定出54种与XIST存在相互作用的新型蛋白。Xist是哺乳动物X染色体上的非编码RNA，其在X染色体失活过程中起着重要作用。在鉴别出的54种新型XIST互作蛋白中，我们阐明了其中2种候选蛋白（SNF2L和TAF15）对X连锁基因的调控作用。 为了验证其他Xist相互作用蛋白质对基因沉默的影响，我们选择了10个候选基因来探索其在XCI过程中的作用。我们发现敲低凋亡拮抗转录因子AATF可以激活在失活的X染色体上的表观遗传沉默的GFP转基因表达。值得注意的是，利用单核苷酸多态性的差异，我们对具有两种不同遗传学背景的混种小鼠细胞进行了等位基因特性测序。测序结果显示Aatf基因的敲低使多个表观遗传沉默的内源性Xi基因重新表达。有趣的是，Aatf基因的敲低不会影响XISTRNA的表达，并且不影响包裹失活X染色体（Xi）的H3K27me3组蛋白修饰水平，这表明AATF是通过独立于PRC2复合体的机制驱动Xi连锁基因沉默。这些发现揭示了AATF在维持XCI的状态中具有十分着重要作用。 然而，AATF在调控基因转录过程中的作用及分子机制仍有待深入探究。在本项目中，我们提出假说：AATF在XCI的启动和维持过程中具有关键作用，并且其通过不同调控机制对常染色体的基因表达水平进行调节。我们旨在系统地阐述AATF的基因调控功能，并探究AATF调控Xi连锁基因表达沉默的分子机制。我们的具体目标是：1)探索AATF在XCI的启动和建立过程中的作用，2)揭示AATF调控基因表达的动态变化，以及3)通过蛋白质组学和遗传学方法，阐明AATF使Xi基因沉默的调控机制。通过完成这个项目，我们将得以阐述AATF在基因转录调控中的新功能，并进一步揭示XCI的建立和维持过程的新机制。因此，通过本项研究，有望为X连锁基因相关疾病的治疗提供新策略。

11104321.label: Realisation of objectives
11104321.value: Objective #1 (100% completed) Objective #2 (100% completed) For the maintenance of XCI, we first used a female mouse embryonic fibroblast cell line with a GFP transgene (♀MEF GFP-Xi) inserted into the inactive X chromosome (Xi) as a model (see attached figure in Part C: Research Output, manuscript prepared Fig1a). The GFP transgene is silenced by epigenetic mechanisms and is not expressed under normal condition. We treated the cells with 5’ -aza which is an inhibitor of DNMT1 to eliminate the effect of DNA methylation on XCI. Upon 5’-aza treatment we further knockdown AATF and our results demonstrated the reactivation of the silenced GFP in♀MEF GFP-Xi compared to non-targeting (NT) control (Fig1b), suggesting potential XCI maintenance role of AATF. To further investigate the significance of AATF on XCI, we employed another female mouse embryonic fibroblast cell line that harbour hybrid genetic background of Cast & Mus (♀MEF Cast/Mus). With the presence of single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) between Cast and Mus genome our bioinformatics analysis can differentiate the allelic expression of genes in autosomes and X chromosomes of the two parental origins (Xa, active X chromosome from Cast origin or Xi, inactive X chromosome from Mus origin) (Fig1c). To demonstrate the direct function of AATF on the maintenance of XCI, we knockdown AATF in (♀MEF Cast/Mus) in the absence of 5’-aza treatment and performed RNA-seq (Fig1d). Our allele specific RNA-seq revealed a significant allelic bias of Cast-specific expression of genes on the X chromosome compared to autosomes chromosomes 2 and 13, indicating the specificity of our assay (Fig1e). Interestingly, among the transcripts that can be differentiated by SNPs, while the majority of the Xi genes remained silenced, a significant number of genes (109 genes) showed reactivation by either shRNA and (45 genes) by two shRNAs against AATF (Aatf knockdown-reactivated, A KD-R**, Fig1f-h). These results revealed the significant role of AATF in the maintenance of XCI in female cells. In mouse, random XCI initiates when epiblast cells start to differentiate into different lineages, and XCI is established during post-implantation. To further explore the role of AATF in the initiation and establishment of XCI, we employed a female embryonic stem cell line with hybrid genetic background of Cast & Mus, with part of the X inactivation centre DNA region deleted in the X chromosome of the Mus origin (♀ES Cast/MusTsix∆). This will lead to skewed XCI and all the cells will have the XMus being inactived during ES cell differentiation (Fig2a). We knockdown Aatf in♀ES Cast/MusTsix∆ by two shRNAs (Fig2b) and assayed the cell proliferation and colony formation and our results demonstrated that depletion of Aatf significantly impaired the growth of ES Cast/MusTsix∆ (Fig2 c, d). To examine the effect of Aatf on the differentiation of mouse ES cells we induced ES cell differentiation by retinoic acid and our results showed that ♀ES Cast/MusTsix∆ depleted of Aatf failed to form embryoid body (Fig2e), indicating an impaired ES cell differentiation. To elucidate the underlying mechanism, we collected RNA from the differentiating ES cells for allele specific RNA-seq in a time course from day 0 (stem cell state, no XCI) to day 7 (differentiated into neuronal lineage, XCI established). Our RNA-seq data revealed dynamic changes of gene expression in autosomes and the two X chromosomes (XiMus and XaCast). In autosomes, we detected a global differential gene expression and identified pathways that correlate to ES cell differentiation upon Aatf depletion (Fig2f). In X chromosome, a dramatic change in the gene silencing on the two x chromosomes was detected (Fig2g). We found that more than 390 genes (referred to A KD-FS**) were failed to be silenced on Xmus in day7 after Aatf knockdown. The effect of AATF on the dynamics of X chromosome inactivation during ES cell differentiation was further demonstrated by stacked bars (Fig2h-i). These results collectively demonstrated the function of AATF in the initiation and establishment of XCI and elucidated the dynamics of gene regulation function of AATF. Objective #3 (100% completed) To elucidate how AATF impacts XCI, we first map the genomic localization of AATF in ♀MEF Cast/Mus and ♀ES Cast/MusTsix∆. Using antibodies against AATF, our ChIP-seq data revealed a preferential enrichment of AATF at 5’UTR and promoter-TSS (Fig3a). Intriguingly, we found that AATF is enriched in gene loci of A-KD-R compared to non-reactivated genes on Xi or the average of all gene loci on both the active and inactive X chromosomes (Fig3b). To our surprise, we found that the AATF enrichment pattern changed to 3’UTR and exons in ♀ES Cast/MusTsix∆ at Day 0 time point (Fig3c). The enhanced enrichment of AATF remained in A-KD FS than non KD-FS gene loci or x chromosomes gene loci in general (Fig3d). We correlate the AATF binding patterns of ♀MEF Cast/Mus and ♀ES Cast/MusTsix∆ and our data revealed a high correlation of gene set between the two cell lines (Fig3e). In addition, we identified de nono motif enrichment in AATF binding sites on the Xi (Xmus), Xa (Xcast), and autosomes in ♀MEF Cast/Mus (Fig3f). Together, our data demonstrated the binding specificity of AATF in mouse ES cells and the differentiated mouse embryonic fibroblasts (Fig3g). To investigate if AATF regulates XCI through modulating epigenetic gene regulation, we examined the histone modifications involved in Xi gene silencing. Interestingly, we found that the H3K27me3 repressive histone mark is reduced at A-KD R gene loci upon AATF depletion (Fig4a). In addition, AATF was significantly correlated with H3K27me3 but not the active histone mark H3K4me3 in ♀MEF Cast/Mus (Fig4b). In contrast, such correlation is not as significant as ♀MEF Cast/Mus in ♀ES Cast/MusTsix∆ (Fig4c-e), suggesting a distinct mechanism between maintenance and initiation of XCI. We further analysed the clustering of the H3K27me3 ChIP-seq data from both cell lines and identified overlaps between Xa-specific gene sets and AATF-dependent gene sets (eg. A-KD R, A-KD FS) from ♀MEF Cast/Mus in ♀ES Cast/MusTsix∆ models (Fig4f). Together, our omics studies demonstrated AATF participates in histone modifications and might regulates XCI via epigenetic mechanisms (Fig4g). Our previous study reported the potential interaction between AATF and Xist RNA. To validate this interaction, we first perform AATF immunofluorescence coupled with Xist RNA-FISH. We showed that the AATF co-localised with Xist RNA cloud in the nucleus of ♀MEF Cast/Mus (Fig5a). In addition, our X-chromosome-wide overlap analysis of AATF ChIP-seq and XIST RAP-seq signals revealed significant co-localization, indicating a potential interaction of AATF with XIST DNA sequence (Fig5b). To examine if AATF bind to Xist RNA, we developed a cell line depleted of endogenous AATF and reconstituted with FLAG-AATF in 293T, a female cell line that maintains regular XCI (Fig5c). We performed RNA-IP under both chemical fixation and UV cross link conditions and our results demonstrated a direct interaction between AATF and Xist RNA at the Repeat A region (Fig5d). Our work for the first time reveal modulator of Xist RNA in regulating the epigenetic regulation of H3K27me3 in silencing of genes on the inactive X chromosome (Fig5e).

11104321.label: Major findings and research outcome
11104321.value: Using female mouse embryonic fibroblast (MEF) with a mixed genetic background of Cast&Mus, our allele-specific RNA-seq results showed that AATF is required for the maintenance of X chromosome inactivation (XCI). Our date revealed the reactivation of dozens of genes on the inactive X chromosome (Xi) upon depletion of AATF by shRNAs. Importantly, AATF is not only important for the maintenance but also required for the initiation and establishment of XCI. Using the differentiation of female mouse ES cells with hybrid genetic background, our data revealed that the proliferation and embryoid body formation is significantly impaired after AATF knockdown. Importantly, our time course - allele specific RNA-seq results demonstrated the allelic switch of genes on the x chromosomes from the initiation to the establishment of XCI during the differentiation of female ES cells. We showed that the knockdown of AATF significantly altered the bi-allelic to mono-allelic expression pattern of Xi-genes. Moreover, our results also showed that the genes involved in ES cell stemness and survival pathways are severely affected by AATF depletion. To investigate the mechanisms by which AATF impacts XCI, we performed AATF ChIP-seq in both female hybrid MEFs and ES cells. Our data revealed that AATF preferentially binding at the 5’UTR and promoter-TSS regions. Our results also showed that the enrichment of AATF is significantly higher in autosomes than X chromosomes. Interestingly, the promoter-TSS enrichment of AATF is higher in genes that showed reactivation upon AATF depletion, suggesting a role of AATF in maintaining gene silencing on Xi. To elucidate how AATF impacts XCI, we examined the epigenetic factors important for gene repression by allele specific ChIP-seq. Intriguingly, in female MEF, while AATF depletion did not affect the global level of repressive histone mark H3K27me3, it significantly reduced H3K27me3 at loci at the inactive X chromosome but not the active X chromosome or autosomes. We further correlated our AATF and H3K27me3 ChIP-seq dataset and our results demonstrated significant positive correlation between AATF enrichment with H3K27me3 in X chromosomes but not imprinted genes or autosomes. These results collectively revealed the functional significance of AATF on XCI. Moreover, our immunofluorescence staining results showed significant co-localization of AATF and Xist (lncRNA essential for XCI). In addition, our RNA immunoprecipitation assays revealed a direct binding between AATF and Xist RNA, indicating a direct role of AATF in regulating XCI both on the chromatin and via modulating Xist RNA function.

11104321.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11104321.value: We have completed all the three proposed objectives and have the data shown in the PDF attached in Part C. As shown in our previous publication (Yi et al., 2020 Nature Methods), AATF is one of the candidates that demonstrated a gene silencing function of Xi. 11104321.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11104321.value: X chromosome inactivation (XCI) is a classic example of epigenetic gene regulation required for balancing the dosage of genes on the x chromosomes between male and female mammals. In this project, we show that the Apoptosis Antagonizing Transcription Factor (AATF) protein is a novel factor controlling XCI. Using female fibroblast cells with hybrid genetic background, our allele specific RNA-seq data reveal a significant role of AATF in maintenance of XCI. In addition, using the differentiation of embryonic stem cells as a model to investigate the initiation of XCI, our results demonstrate AATF as a critical factor for the growth and differentiation of stem cells as well as establishment of XCI. Moreover, we show that AATF is enriched at the 5’ untranslated and promoter regions of genes and importantly, its enrichment is elevated in genes that loss silencing upon AATF depletion. Furthermore, we show that the loss of repressive histone mark H3K27me3 is potentially a cause of the loss of silencing of genes on the inactive X chromosome after AATF depletion. Finally, we propose that the direct interaction of AATF with XIST lncRNA might be essential for proper development of gene repression signal alone the inactive X chromosome in female cells.

11104421.value: 關於通過微創性技術檢測體內膠質細胞源外泌體以作追蹤神經炎症的研究

11104421.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11104421.value: Neuroinflammation is one of important causatives promoting the neuropathogenesis of many neurological diseases, such as Alzheimer disease (AD), Parkinson’s disease (PD), and Multiple Sclerosis (MS), inducing abnormal motor and cognitive functions and behavior. Particularly, in traumatic brain injury (TBI) and spinal cord injury (SCI), neuroinflammation is involved in the nerve degeneration and regeneration. In neuroinfectious diseases, such as Coronavirus associated PD, inflammation is directly induced by the interaction between immune cells and glia cells, such as microglia and astroglia. However, the precise detection of brain inflammation is challenged because of lack of non-invasive biosensing tools and neuroinflammation biomarkers. Recent evidence has demonstrated that exosomes released from neurons and glia in healthy- or diseased- brain can cross the blood–cerebrospinal fluid barrier (BCSFB) and the blood-brain-barrier (BBB) into the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and the circulating blood, supporting the exosomal component from the CSF and the peripheral blood as potential biomarkers to track the molecular and pathological features of parental brain cells. Microglia and astroglia actively control the initiation and progression of neuroinflammation through the release of pro-inflammatory, or anti-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines, therefore, precise label-free detection of inflammation biomarkers in microglia- and astroglia- derived exosomes from the blood and the CSF can be a great biosensing method to dynamically track the inflammatory activity of parent microglia and astroglia in the brain with a time-dependent manner. Analysis of brain-derived exosomes in neurodegenerative diseases has done with RNA seq. and pretomics. However, it is complex, expensive, time-consuming, invasive, and non-translatable. Therefore, minimally invasive and sensitive detection method such as Localized Surface Plasmon Resonance (LSPR) - and Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM)- biosensors can be a simple, cost-effective, precise, sensitive, and translatable method. Label-free quantitative detection of exosomal inflammation biomarkers, such as CD86 and MHCII (M1 microglia-derived exosomes), CD206 and CD163 (M2 microglia-derived exosomes), MHCII (A1 astroglia-derived exosomes), and CD206 (A2 astroglia-derived exosomes), will be very informative to prevent, diagnosis, and treat neuroinflammation present in many neurological disorders as a liquid biopsy. Utilizing mouse models of neuroinflammation, PDGFR-alpha CreERT x MCT1f/f mouse model of chronic neuroinflammation and LPS- induced mouse model of acute neuroinflammation, LSPR and AFM-based detection of inflammation biomarkers in microglia- and astroglia- derived exosomes from the blood and the CSF of the mouse models will be a very effective way for the monitoring of neuroinflammation initiation and progression, and for the testing of the efficacy of drugs in treating neuroinflammation. 神經炎症是促進阿茲海默症 (Alzheimer’s Disease, AD)、帕金遜症 (Parkinson’s Disease, PD) 和多發性硬化症 (Multiple Sclerosis, MS) 等許多神經系統疾病發生的重要原因之一，運動及認知上均出現功能及行為異常。特別的是，在創傷性腦損傷 (Traumatic brain injury, TBI) 和脊髓損傷 (spinal cord injury, SCI) 中，神經炎症參與神經退化和再生。在神經感染性疾病中，如冠狀病毒相關的PD，炎症是由免疫細胞與神經膠質細胞（如小膠質細胞和星形膠質細胞）之間的相互作用直接誘發的。然而，由於缺乏神經炎症生物標記及辨識這些標記的非侵入性生物傳感工具，神經炎症的精確檢測備受挑戰。近來研究表明，從健康或患病的大腦中的神經元和神經膠質細胞釋放的外泌體可以穿過血腦脊液屏障 (blood–cerebrospinal fluid barrier, BCSFB) 和血腦屏障 (blood-brain barrier, BBB) ，進入腦脊液 (cerebrospinal fluid, CSF) 和血液循環中，提供了相關證據，支持來自 CSF 和外周血的外泌體成分作為潛在的生物標誌物來追踪腦細胞的分子和病理特徵。小膠質細胞和星形膠質細胞通過釋放促炎或抗炎細胞因子和趨化因子，積極控制神經炎症的觸發和發展，因此，精確及無標記地使用生物傳感工具，來檢測血液及CSF中小膠質細胞和星形膠質細胞衍生的外泌體中的炎症生物標記，是一種很好的方法，可以更實時動態地跟蹤大腦中小膠質細胞和星形膠質細胞的炎症活動。 目前，神經退行性疾病中腦源性外泌體的分析有採用核糖核酸測序(RNA sequencing, RNA seq.)及蛋白質組學(proteomics)。然而，這些技術較為複雜、昂貴、耗時、侵入性及不可醫學轉譯。微創和靈敏的檢測方法，例如局部表面等離子體共振 (Localized Surface Plasmon Resonance, LSPR) 和原子力顯微鏡 (Atomic Force Microscopy, AFM) 生物傳感器可以是一種簡單、經濟、精確、靈敏及可醫學轉譯的方法。辨識外泌體炎症生物標記的無標記定量檢測作液體活檢，例如 CD86 和 MHCII（M1 小膠質細胞衍生的外泌體）、CD206 和 CD163（M2 小膠質細胞衍生的外泌體）、MHCII（A1 星形膠質細胞衍生的外泌體）和 CD206（A2 星形膠質細胞衍生的外泌體），對於預防、診斷和治療許多神經系統疾病中存在的神經炎症將非常有用。利用神經炎症小鼠模型---慢性神經炎症小鼠模型(PDGFR-alpha Cre ERT x MCT1f/f )和 LPS 誘導的急性神經炎症小鼠模型，基於 LSPR 和 AFM技術，來檢測小鼠模型的血液及CSF中，由小膠質細胞和星形膠質細胞而來的外泌體之炎症生物標記，相信將是一種非常有效的方法去監測神經炎症的發生、進展及測試藥物治療神經炎症的療效。

11104521.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11104521.value: Precise regulation of excitation and inhibition (E-I) is crucial for cortical processing of sensory information. The anterior piriform cortex (APC) is instrumental to odor perception and learning as it processes odor properties at just one synapse downstream of the olfactory bulb (OB). Our previous results showed that deprivation of odor experience produces target-specific modulation of inhibitory transmission: naris occlusion (NO) selectively altered inhibitory transmission in superficial pyramidal (SP), but not semilunar (SL), principal neurons. However, it is unclear how odor experience modulates excitatory and inhibitory circuit properties in the APC. Here we obtained preliminary data that uncovered a new form of homeostatic plasticity: NO enhanced both EPSC and IPSC amplitude selectively in SP cells, but, ultimately, E-I ratio was maintained. What could be a molecular mechanism that regulates this form of E-I homeostatic balance in APC? Signaling molecules like retinoic acid and TNF-α have been shown to be instrumental in orchestrating plasticity in auditory and visual cortices. However, whether they play a role in olfactory cortical plasticity has not been explored. Here we propose that TNF-α orchestrates the balance of E-I in APC in an activity-dependent manner. I will use a combination of slice electrophysiology, optogenetics, mouse genetics, and immunofluorescent staining to probe the role of TNF-α on regulating excitation and inhibition of SL and SP neural activity. Objective 1 will determine how NO alters recurrent excitation and inhibition in APC principal neurons. Objective 2 will examine how NO regulates excitatory and inhibitory synaptic proteins in APC. Objective 3 will examine how TNF-α regulates the structural and physiological changes induced by NO. Elucidating the molecular mechanism of experience-dependent plasticity in the olfactory cortex will provide a new theoretical framework for homeostatic and target-specific modulation of E-I balance. 神經興奮和抑制平衡 (E-I balance)對於感覺信息的處理至關重要。前梨狀皮層 (APC) 在氣味感知和學習方面是不可或缺的。我們的研究表明，氣味剝奪在 APC 中產生特定神經元可塑性：鼻孔閉塞 (NO) 改變了淺錐體 (SP) 神經元的抑制性神經傳遞，但在半月 (SL) 神經元中卻沒有。然而，我們並不了解氣味體驗如何能調節 APC 中的 E-I 平衡。有見及此，我們的初步研究發現了一種新的穩態可塑性：NO 選擇性地增強了 SP 細胞中的 EPSC 和 IPSC 幅度，但最終保持了 E-I 比率。這種形式的 E-I 穩態平衡背後的分子機制是什麼？在此，我們假設 TNF-α 在氣味剝奪後調解 APC 中的 E-I 平衡。此項目將合用腦切片電生理學、光遺傳學、小鼠遺傳學和免疫熒光染色來研究 TNF-α 如何調節 SL 和 SP神經元的興奮和抑制性神經迴路。目標 1 將研究 NO 如何改變 APC 循環神經迴路的 E-I 平衡。目標 2 將研究 NO 如何調節 APC的興奮和抑制性突觸蛋白。目標 3 將研究 TNF-α 如何調節 NO 觸發的結構和生理變化。闡明APC中經驗依賴可塑性的分子機制將為 E-I 平衡的穩態調節提供新的理論框架。

11104521.label: Realisation of objectives
11104521.value: Balanced excitation–inhibition (E–I) interactions within local cortical networks are fundamental to neural computation. The anterior piriform cortex (APC), the largest olfactory cortical area, is central to odor perception, associative learning, and memory. Despite lacking clear longitudinal circuit organization, the APC exhibits strong laminar organization reminiscent of the hippocampus, a region rich in recurrent connections critical for memory. This dual identity—as both a primary sensory cortex and a recurrent associative network—raises the question of how the APC supports distinct modes of representation. Principal output neurons of the APC, semilunar (SL) and superficial pyramidal (SP) cells, form separate output channels distinguished by molecular markers, intrinsic properties, and excitatory connectivity. While excitatory inputs to these cells are well characterized, inhibitory inputs and their plasticity remain poorly understood. This project tested the hypothesis that TNF-α orchestrates activity-dependent, cell type–specific E–I homeostasis in the APC, focusing on unilateral naris occlusion (NO) as a model of sensory deprivation. Objective 1 — Circuit Physiology Goal: Determine how NO alters recurrent excitation and inhibition in APC principal neurons. • Approach: o Juvenile and young adult mice underwent unilateral NO (7–14 days). o Acute slice whole-cell recordings were performed from identified SL and SP neurons (Layer 2a and 2b, respectively). o Evoked and miniature EPSC/IPSC recordings were combined with optogenetic circuit mapping (CaMKIIα-ChR2 for recurrent excitation; PV- and SST-Cre opsins for interneuron-specific inhibition). • Findings: o NO selectively altered EPSC and IPSC amplitudes in SP neurons, while SL neurons were unaffected. o The E–I ratio remained increased in SP cells, suggesting homeostatic regulation. o Optogenetic mapping revealed enhanced recurrent excitatory recruitment onto SP cells, matched by decreased PV-mediated inhibition. o Detailed quantification included amplitude, frequency, kinetics, paired-pulse ratios, and short-term plasticity. • Limitations & Mitigation: • Early variability across animals was addressed by increasing cohort sizes, standardizing occlusion timing, and employing within-animal comparisons (occluded vs. contralateral APC). Objective 2 — Synaptic Protein Plasticity Goal: Map layer- and cell type-specific changes in excitatory and inhibitory synaptic proteins following NO. • Approach: o High-resolution immunofluorescence for postsynaptic (Homer1), inhibitory (GAD67, PV, SOM), and presynaptic (vGluT1, vGAT) markers. o Layer-specific localization distinguished SL (layer 2a) from SP (layer 2b) neurons. o Selected samples validated by Western blot. • Findings: o NO induced layer- and cell type–specific upregulation of excitatory and inhibitory synaptic proteins in SP-rich layers. o Increased Homer1 and vGluT1 expression, alongside reduced vGAT puncta density, aligned with electrophysiological scaling. o Correlations between protein changes and physiological measures were established. • Limitations & Mitigation: • Biochemical / tissue separation of SL vs. SP compartments proved challenging. • High-resolution confocal quantification and single-plane imaging were prioritized to overcome this limitation. Objective 3 — TNF-α Causality Goal: Test TNF-α’s necessity for NO-induced anatomical and physiological changes. • Approach: o Global TNF-α knockout mice were used. o Electrophysiology and immunostaining assays from Objectives 1–2 were repeated. • Findings: o TNF-α was necessary for coordinated EPSC/IPSC scaling in SP neurons after NO. o TNF-α loss disrupted matched increases in EPSC and IPSC amplitudes, altering the E–I relationship. o TNFR1 signaling emerged as the dominant receptor mediating synaptic scaling. • Limitations & Mitigation: • Global TNF-α manipulations risk systemic immune effects. • Genetic knockout was chosen over pharmacology to ensure direct causality. Publications and Dissemination • Guo & Lau, 2022, Frontiers in Neuroscience: TNF-α’s role in experience-dependent plasticity of excitatory and inhibitory synapses in APC (DOI: 10.3389/fnins.2022.824454). • Additional manuscripts on optogenetic circuit mapping and receptor-specific mechanisms are in preparation or under review. Overall Assessment All objectives were successfully achieved. Anticipated challenges—including variability in NO effects and systemic consequences of TNF-α manipulations—were mitigated through increased sample sizes, within-animal controls, cell type–specific labeling, localized genetic/pharmacological approaches, and orthogonal validation (electrophysiology, imaging, biochemistry). Conclusion: The project provides convergent physiological, molecular, and causal evidence that TNF-α mediates target-specific E–I homeostasis in the APC, advancing our understanding of how sensory experience shapes cortical output channels.
