11307121.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11307121.value: Since 1960s, organotin compounds (OTs), such as tributyltin (TBT) and triphenyltin (TPT), have been extensively used as active ingredients in antifouling paints on ship hulls, submerged marine infrastructures and mariculture cages, and as biocides in agricultural and textile industries. They are highly toxic and can cause morphological abnormalities in marine organisms at low concentrations (ng/L). The best-documented example is OT-mediated imposex (i.e., the superimposition of penis and vas deferens on females) in gastropods. In September 2008, the Marine Environment Protection Committee of the United Nations’ International Maritime Organization adopted a global prohibition on the use of OT-based biocides on sea-going vessels (i.e., the AFS Convention). The Hong Kong SAR Government eventually established the relevant legislation (Cap. 413N) for regulating the use of OTs on ships on January 1, 2017. While being a densely populated coastal city, Hong Kong serves as the 7th busiest container port in the world. Historically, our marine environment has received a large amount of OTs originated from shipping activities, surface runoff, partially-treated wastewater and discharge from the Pearl River. Our previous studies indicated that there were serious contaminations of OTs, especially TPT in our marine environment between 2010-2016. Extremely high concentrations of TPT were found in local coastal marine sediments. However, OT contamination situation after the implementation of the AFS Convention and the impact of TPT to benthic community remain largely unknown. Therefore, we will, first, examine the contamination status of OTs in the marine environment of Hong Kong post-implementation of the AFS Convention by examining imposex status in the marine gastropod Reishia clavigera and concentrations of various OTs in the gastropod, seawater and sediment samples during 2022-2024 and by comparing the results with relevant historical data. Second, we will conduct both laboratory and field studies to investigate the impact of TPT and OTs on the benthic community in sediments using the environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding approach. Through microcosm experiments, we will reveal the dynamic change of eDNA in sediment after spiking environmentally relevant concentrations of TPT or OTs, and identify the sensitive species. Concurrently, we will establish the relationship between the benthic biodiversity (as depicted by eDNA) and OTs contamination in sediments collected from the field. The results will enable us to evaluate the effectiveness of the management intervention and law enforcement on reducing OTs contamination in the marine environment, determine the effect thresholds of OTs, and assess their ecological risks to the benthic ecosystem. 自20世紀60年代以來，三丁基錫和三苯基錫等有機錫化合物已被廣泛用作船塢、水下海洋基礎設施和海水養殖網箱防污漆中的活性成分，以及農業和紡織工業中的殺菌劑。有機錫化合物含有劇毒，在低濃度（ng/L）時即可導致海洋生物形態出現異常，最典型的例子是有機錫化合物在腹足類動物中所導致的性畸變，即雌性個體身上出現雄性生殖器和輸精管。 2008年9月，聯合國國際海事組織海洋環境保護委員會通過了一項全球禁令，禁止在海船上使用有機錫防污漆（即AFS公約）。香港特區政府於2017年1月1日制定了相關法律（Cap. 413N），以規範船舶使用有機錫化合物。作為一個人口稠密的沿海城市，香港是世界上第七繁忙的集裝箱港口。歷史上，香港的海洋環境接納了大量源自航運活動、地表徑流、廢水和珠江排放的有機錫化合物。我們之前的研究發現，在2010至2016年間，香港海洋環境中存在嚴重的有機錫污染（尤其是三苯基錫），例如在海洋沉積物中發現了極高濃度的三苯基錫。然而，香港實施AFS公約後的有機錫污染現狀以及三苯基錫對底棲生物群落的影響仍然未知。因此，在本研究中，我們將首先通過調查2022至2024年期間，海洋腹足類動物疣荔枝螺的性畸變現狀，以及疣荔枝螺、海水和沉積物中的有機錫污染現狀，並將這些結果與歷史相關數據進行比較，來檢查實施AFS公約後，香港海洋環境中有機錫化合物的污染變化情況。其次，通過室內模擬和現場調查相結合，利用環境DNA條形碼方法，來研究三苯基錫等有機錫化合物對沉積物中底棲生物群落的影響。通過微宇宙實驗，我們將揭示在暴露環境濃度水平的三苯基錫等有機錫化合物後，沉積物中環境DNA的動態變化，並識別敏感生物物種。同時，基於環境DNA的現狀，我們將建立底棲生物多樣性與野外沉積物中有機錫化合物污染水平之間的關係。研究結果將使我們能夠評估管理干預和執法對減少海洋環境中有機錫化合物污染的有效性，確定有機錫化合物的影響閾值，並評估其對底棲生態系統的生態風險。

11307121.label: Realisation of objectives
11307121.value: Objective 1 To address objective 1, a comprehensive investigation was conducted using the rock shell Rashia clavigera as a biomonitor, together with seawater and sediment collected from Hong Kong’s coastal waters between 2022 and 2023. The results revealed significant spatiotemporal variations of OTs in seawater, sediment, and rock shell tissue. Concentrations of butyltins (BTs) in surface seawater samples collected during 2022-203 showed a marked decrease from the levels in 2015, primarily due to reduced mono-BT, while phenyltins (PTs) remained stable (Jiang et al. 2025, Environment International 199: 109486). A notable shift in OTs composition was observed, with TPT becoming the predominant residue in seawater. Sediment samples showed consistent OTs levels between 2014 and 2023, dominated by TPT. Rock shell tissue samples demonstrated a significant reduction in overall OTs contamination when compared to 2010 and 2015. However, a significant male bias in the rock shell population was observed. All females in the study exhibited imposex with high levels in shipping hotspots such as Sai Kung Pier and the lowest level in the remote rural sites like Po Toi. The ecological risk assessment of OTs burdens in rock shell tissue from 2004 to 2022 indicated minimal risk from TBT in most samples, except at specific sites with high marine traffic. Conversely, TPT posed substantial risks in 2010 and 2015, with improvements noted in 2022, although it still could cause endocrine disruption on 68% of gastropods populations in Hong Kong’s coastal waters. Overall, the results underscore the effectiveness of local regulation in mitigating OTs contamination and imposex in rock shells. However, the persistence of high levels of PTs, particularly TPT, necessitates continuous monitoring, source identification, and management measures to mitigate their long-term environmental impacts. The results have been published in a peer-reviewed journal, Environment International. In addition, we have also investigated the mechanisms of imposex formation in R. calvigera and published the results as two peer-reviewed articles. We have further examined if the OTs contamination has declined in local seafood after the legislation, and a manuscript has been submitted to a journal Marine Pollution Bulletin for publication. Overall, the project objective 1 has been fully achieved. Objective 2 To address objective 2, a six-week microcosm experiment was conducted using sediment spiked with OTs across an environmentally relevant concentration gradient (0–1000 ng/g dw). A total of 252 samples were collected over time. Combined with a field community study, the results elucidated structural shifts in the benthic bacterial community under OTs exposure, identified sensitive taxa, and derived a predicted no effect concentration (PNEC) for OTs. The influence of OTs on sediment bacteria was evaluated across seven timepoints using a Generalized Linear Model (GLM) with gamma distribution and logit link, using observed richness as the response. For the OTs mixture (TPT:TBT = 7:3), species richness was first significantly reduced at Day 28 in the 1000 ng/g dw treatment compared to the control. By Day 42, the lowest species richness occurred at 50 ng/g dw. In contrast, TPT alone caused an immediate response, with species richness in the 1000 ng/g dw group being significantly lower than at intermediate concentrations (100 and 250 ng/g dw) from Day 0 (p < 0.05) (Jiang et al., unpubl. data). Threshold Indicator Taxa ANalysis (TITAN) identified change points in relative abundance (averaged across timepoints) for each amplicon sequence variant (ASV), classifying them as “increasers” or “decreasers”. For the OTs mixture treatment, 278 decreasers (12.9%) and 32 increasers (1.5%) were identified, representing 14.4% of the prefiltered community (2151 ASVs). For TPT treatment, 286 decreasers (13.5%) and 21 increasers (1.0%) were noted, comprising 14.5% of prefiltered ASVs (2116 total). Community-level change points for decreasers were 375 ng/g dw (OTs mixture) and 250 ng/g dw (TPT), indicating concentrations of maximal synchronous decline. The greatest synchronous increase occurred at 100 ng/g dw for both exposures. Species Sensitivity Distributions (SSDs) were constructed using TITAN-derived change points as chronic endpoints, i.e., the lowest effect concentration (LOEC). A lognormal mixture model estimated values of hazardous concentration of 5% (HC5) as 43.1 ng/g dw (95% CI: 41.4–45.3 ng/g dw) for the OTs mixture and 43.3 ng/g dw (95% CI: 41.3–45.7 ng/g dw) for TPT. To account for uncertainty in the extrapolation from laboratory to field, and in the computation, applying an assessment factor of 10 to the lower 95% CI bound yielded PNEC values of 4.14 ng/g dw (OTs mixture) and 4.13 ng/g dw (TPT). In the field study, although observed species richness did not differ significantly among sites, community composition varied markedly (p < 0.05, PERMANOVA), with Site H showing the highest Bray-Curtis dissimilarity. Turnover rates exceeded 50% across all sites, indicating community instability. Field-based SSDs (F-SSDs) were developed by linking TITAN-identified responsive ASVs (872 for OTs mixture (41.7%), 853 for TPT (40.8%)) to in-situ OTs concentrations. Using adjusted community HC5 values (HC12 for both OTs mixture and TPT) as PNEC estimates, the safety threshold values were 10.4 ng/g dw (95% CI: 9.86–10.9 ng/g dw) for the OTs mixture and 4.93 ng/g dw (95% CI: 4.68–5.20 ng/g dw) for TPT. Notably, the PNEC for TPT aligned closely between lab and field studies, while the field-based PNEC for the OTs mixture was twofold higher. This discrepancy suggests either enhanced tolerance mechanisms in natural bacterial assemblages or the existence of co-stressors under controlled laboratory conditions. In summary, this study establishes a dose-response relationship between OTs exposure and structural changes in benthic bacterial communities, identifies taxon-specific ecological thresholds, and derives PNEC values of 4.13 and 4.14 ng/g dw for TPT and OTs mixture under controlled laboratory conditions, complemented by field-validated PNEC values of 4.93 and 10.4 ng/g dw, respectively. These findings provide scientifically robust benchmarks for sediment quality criteria and ecological risk assessment of organotin compounds, thereby fully accomplishing the project objective 2. We are preparing a manuscript based on this work for publication in early 2026. We trained one postdoctoral researcher, Dr. Mengyang Liu and one PhD student, Ms. Yan Jiang through this project. Dr. Liu has become an Associate Professor at Fuzhou University in China since September 2025, while Ms. Jiang has won the Outstanding Academic Performance Award for Research Degree Students at CityUHK and Best Presentation Awards in three International Conferences.

11307121.label: Major findings and research outcome
11307121.value: Post-regulation monitoring data from 2022 to 2023 provide robust evidence of ecosystem recovery, observed five years after Hong Kong’s implementation of organotins (OTs) regulations in 2017. The concentration range of total OTs was found to be 9.35–527 ng/L in seawater, 16.2–361 ng/g dw in sediments, and 13.0–2.26 × 10⁴ ng/g dw in the tissues of the rock shell Rashia clavigera, respectively. Temporal trend analysis revealed significant declines in total OTs and butyltins (BTs) concentrations in seawater and rock shells. In contrast, OTs in sediment exhibited no significant decreasing trends, suggesting the persistence of OTs contamination in sediment. Furthermore, a notable shift in OTs composition profiles was identified, with triphenyltin (TPT) emerging as the predominant compound across all environmental matrices. Elevated TPT concentrations exhibited a strong positive correlation with maritime and shipping activities, indicating these as major sources of ongoing contamination. A significant reduction in imposex severity in R. clavigera was observed in 2022 when compared to those sampled in 2010 and 2015. This reduction was quantified through marked decreases in both the Vas Deferens Sequence Index and the percentage of sterile females, providing direct biological evidence of declining OTs exposure in the environment. The results of a probabilistic tissue-residue based risk assessment indicated that current TBT tissue concentrations in R. clavigera have largely fallen below critical effect thresholds, suggesting that this legacy contaminant no longer poses a significant risk to its local populations. However, the assessment highlighted a concerning scenario for TPT, with current tissue concentrations predicted to induce adverse effects in approximately 68% of the studied R. clavigera populations. These findings indicated that the local ecosystem is undergoing measurable recovery from the historical "TBT nightmare", yet the persistent and significant contamination of TPT constitutes an emerging threat, necessitating sustained regulatory attention and mitigation efforts. Integrated laboratory and field investigations further demonstrated that OTs exposure significantly alters sediment bacterial community structures. TITAN identified sensitive bacterial taxa and their response thresholds, leading to the derivation of predicted no effect concentrations (PNECs). Laboratory-based PNECs were determined to be 4.13 ng/g dw for TPT and 4.14 ng/g dw for OTs mixtures, while field-validated PNECs were slightly higher, at 4.93 ng/g dw for TPT and 10.4 ng/g dw for OTs mixtures. These findings provide a scientifically robust basis for regulatory agencies to develop evidence-based strategies for the regulation of OTs and mitigation of their ecological risks.

11307121.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11307121.value: Although a reduction of imposex status has been observed after the legislative ban of the use of organotins (OTs) on vessels, long-term studies on the change in the population dynamics of local rock shell communities will be needed to confirm their full recovery. The persistent dominance of TPT highlights the need to continuously monitor and identify its specific ongoing sources for control. Advanced chemical fingerprinting techniques, such as compound-specific isotope analysis, could be employed to accurately trace TPT origins. This would enable targeted regulatory actions and support the development of effective source control strategies, ultimately promoting the full recovery of marine ecosystems from organotin contamination. The observed discrepancy between laboratory- and field-validated PNEC values for the OT mixture underscores the potential influence of complex environmental factors in the field. This highlights the need to systematically investigate the role of multiple stressors, such as organic carbon content, hypoxia, co-existing contaminants and warming, in modulating OTs bioavailability and toxicity. Utilizing the most sensitive bacterial taxa identified through TITAN analysis, a quantitative real-time PCR based assay could be designed to rapidly detect community-level responses to chemical contamination like OTs. This tool would provide a cost-effective and efficient approach for monitoring ecosystem health.

11307121.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11307121.value: This study evaluated the effectiveness of Hong Kong's 2017 legislation on banning the use of organotin compounds (OTs) as antifouling paints on ship hulls. The findings of this study demonstrated clear and encouraging evidence of the regulation's positive impact on marine ecosystem recovery. Monitoring data revealed significant reductions in OTs levels in seawater and in the tissue of rock shells following the regulation's implementation. Using the rock shells as biomonitors, the results showed a remarkable decline in imposex status (i.e., superimposition of male organs in female gastropods), indicating improved health of their populations. These results provide strong scientific validation that the legislative measures have successfully alleviated historical organotin pollution. In addition, the research established scientifically derived safety thresholds of OTs for ecological risk assessment and sediment quality management based on benthic microbial diversity. The study also identified sensitive microbial indicators that can serve as early warning signals for future monitoring. Overall, this research not only revealed the effectiveness of current regulations but also provided robust scientific support for government efforts in protecting marine biodiversity. The findings demonstrate how science-based policy can drive environmental recovery while promoting sustainable development of Hong Kong’s marine ecosystems.

11307421.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11307421.value: This is a chemistry proposal focusing on design, synthesis characterization of multi-functionalized two-photon caging platforms and their applications to neurotransmitter photorelease. Recently, the development of two-photon photocleavable molecules is emerging because using two-photon excitation light source is beneficial to biological systems and provide a fine intrinsic 3D localization. Unfortunately, the majority of photolabile protecting groups synthesized nowadays are designed for one-photon applications. Although some of the PPGs were designed to absorb near-infrared light, they still exhibit low two-photon sensitivity. To address these problems, we propose to 1) to design and synthesize a series of multi-functionalized two-photon caging molecules using a modular approach via typical chemical reactions such as Heck and Sonogashira coupling reactions; 2) to conjugate a large variety of bioactive molecules functionalized with carboxyl-, amine-, azide-, and/or bromide groups to mask their bioactivity; 3) to employ these 2P caging platforms as useful tools for photorelease of neurotransmitters in intact brain tissue. As expected, these newly synthesized organic molecules will exhibit large two-photon photolysis cross-section values and high photocleavage efficiency. They become caging tools for protecting bioactive molecules by covalent bond formation and then restoring their biological functions by reversible bond breaking upon near infrared irradiation. As compared to other stimuli-responsive tools, the proposed photon uncaging system is highly biocompatible and non-toxicity. The regulation of bioactive molecule release by two-photon light is in a clean, remote-control, non-toxic and non-invasive manner. This would result in a new paradigm of inputs which allows for spatial and temporal control with high specificity and vanquishing the drawback of chemical inputs such as delivery kinetics and waste accumulation. This newly developed tandem system for two-photon uncaging provides an instantaneous and remote control of quantitative photorelease of bioactive molecules in which it will be beneficial to the community of human healthcare in strengthening therapeutic activity, reducing the side effects, diminishing the needed drug dosage during treatment in addition to the neurophysiologists for the study of receptor functions and synaptic integration with subcellular precision. Additionally, facile design of synthetic pathways and synthesis of a new series of effective two-photon photocleavage molecules are beneficial to synthetic chemists and photochemists for the development of new caged compounds that will enable to integrate to other materials as light-triggered carriers for targeted drug delivery. We envision that these two-photon photoactive molecules can be adopted to revolutionize cell physiology and neurosciences, and hold promise toward use in clinical settings in near future. 最近，雙光子裂解分子的發展是由於使用雙光子激發光源有利於生物系統並提供精細的內在 3D 定位。然而，大多數現在合成的光不穩定保護基團是為單光子設計的應用程序。儘管一些 PPG 被設計為吸收近紅外光，它們仍然表現出低的雙光子靈敏度。為了解決這些問題，我們建議 1)設計和合成一系列多功能雙光子裂解分子通過典型的化學反應使用模塊化方法，例如 Heck 和 Sonogashira偶聯反應； 2) 結合多種功能化的生物活性分子具有羧基-、胺-、疊氮基-和/或溴基團以掩蓋其生物活性； 3) 到使用這些雙光子裂解平台作為神經遞質光釋放的有用工具在完整的腦組織中。正如預期，這些新合成的有機分子將表現出大的雙光子光解截面值和高光解效率。它們成為通過共價鍵形成保護生物活性分子的裂解工具然後通過可逆鍵斷裂恢復其生物學功能紅外線照射。與其他刺激響應工具相比，所提出的光子解籠鎖系統具有高度的生物相容性和無毒性。生物活性調節雙光子光釋放分子清潔、遙控、無毒、無創。這將產生一種新的輸入範式，允許空間具有高特異性和時間控制，克服了化學方法的缺點輸入，如傳遞動力學和廢物積累。這個新開發的串聯雙光子裂解系統提供了對生物活性分子定量光釋放的即時和遠程控制，這將有利於人類保健社區在加強治療活動，減少副作用效果，減少治療期間所需的藥物劑量，除了神經生理學家研究受體功能和突觸整合亞細胞精度。此外，合成途徑的簡單設計和合成新系列有效的雙光子光裂解分子有利於合成化學家和光化學家開發新的籠狀化合物能夠集成到其他材料中作為靶向藥物的光觸發載體交貨。我們設想這些雙光子光敏分子可用於徹底改變細胞生理學和神經科學，並有望用於臨床在不久的將來設置。

11307621.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11307621.value: 用於高效有機光伏之新型非富勒烯受體以及相匹配聚合物給體材料之設計與合成

11307621.label: Project Objectives
11307621.value: We will design and synthesize new generations of inherently luminescent electron donor and non-fullerene acceptor (NFA) species, focusing on the optimization of their intramolecular charge transfer character, molecular symmetry, and conformational rigidity. This new class of NFAs and matching donor polymers should provide minimized non-radiative recombination in donor/acceptor blends and enhanced hole injections from acceptors to donor polymers. We will pursue structural control over non-radiative recombination in blends by controlling electron-phonon coupling via tailoring of the solid-state morphology and suppressing their electronic tail states, achieving both a better fundamental understanding of how solid-state morphology controls non-radiative losses, and how to reduce such losses. Our synthesis and characterization efforts will proceed in a tandem feedback loop to establish detailed structure/property relationships for achieving optimized molecular structures and film morphologies. We will use these model systems to test the fundamental limits of OPV efficiency. Specifically, we will explore pathways to circumvent Marcus-theory-based limits on non-radiative losses by leveraging our synthetic efforts described in objectives (1) and (2) to study and tailor intermolecular interactions between components in the solid-state to minimize non-radiative recombination in donor/acceptor blends from electron-phonon coupling, and achieve a better understanding of how excitons delocalize over acceptor network and how blend morphology affects non-radiative losses in order to mitigate them. We will demonstrate high-performance organic solar cell with power conversion efficiency (PCE) > 20% (area: 0.1 cm2) at the end based on the NFAs and donor polymers developed in this project.

11307621.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11307621.value: 有機光伏(OPV)具有優異的功率/重量比、良好的彎曲性和適形性、不含重金屬、並且可通過溶劑法大規模加工，極具潛力成為低成本太陽能電力的來源。在OPV活性層中，具有混合的給體和受體以促進光子的吸收，以及電荷的產生、傳輸和收集，進而將光能轉換為電能。近期新型非富勒烯受體(NFA)的發展，令OPV的能量轉化效率顯著提高，在單節器件中已超過17%。儘管如此，此一數值仍然遠低於光電能量轉化效率的理論值。 OPV面臨的主要挑戰來自於光伏電壓的損失，即實驗上量測得到的開路電壓(Voc)與基於材料帶隙計算所得的Voc理論值二者之間的差異。除了引入新型的NFA材料外，探究影響共混材料中非輻射激子衰變的因素，藉以抑制吸收尾態，並藉由不同策略來調控共混膜形貌，可以進一步提高光電轉化效率。據目前的理解，OPV的電壓損失，有相當的部分是因為延伸到帶隙以下的吸收尾態和非理想形貌的存在導致，進一步造成載流子俘獲在這些非理想態和缺陷中，使它們的遷移率降低，並增加雙分子復合的機率。NFA吸收尾態的顯注程度，以及其分子堆積的有序性，與其固態的構象剛性和均勻性有關。因此，通過抑制吸收尾態和增強給共混膜的結晶性，將有助於電荷載流子的傳輸並減少電荷俘獲。此外，器件的性能還受到空穴注入和受體激子衰變之間的動力學競爭的限制。 在此研究提案中，我們將開發一類可以與給體聚合物匹配的新型NFA，這些材料具有最小化的吸收尾態，並通過合理的結構修飾增強分子間相互作用。此外，這些NFA將具有提升的激子離域能力，增進其空穴注入到給體聚合物的速度。我們將與光譜學和微觀結構研究的世界專家--華盛頓大學的David Ginger教授團隊合作，對材料的光學、電化學和光物理性質將與進行系統研究。為了瞭解電荷傳輸與分子結構之間的相關性，我們也會一併研究給受體共混膜的形態學與分子組分的晶體學之間的關係。通過搭配新型NFA和給體聚合物，我們致力於增強OPV的光學吸收並提高開路電壓，使OPV器件能夠實現超過20%的高能量轉化效率。這項研究成果將大幅促進下一代 OPV 和其他有機電子應用的發展。

11307621.label: Realisation of objectives
11307621.value: Realisation of Objective 1: We have designed and studied several series of inherently luminescent OPV materials to understand the photophysical properties in them to establish a comprehensive structure-property-performance relationship. Particularly, we studied D18, a very efficient polymeric donor used in state-of-the-art OPV systems. The photo-excitation of D18 forms a delocalized intermediate with high radiative efficiency, giving a photoluminescence quantum yield of >20% in neat films. In single-component OPV cells based on D18, these delocalized excitons support the generation of free carriers to reach a peak internal quantum efficiency >30%, while in blends with acceptor Y6 they provide a pathway to free charge generation that partially bypasses performance-limiting charge-transfer states at the D18:Y6 interface (ref: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-58352-x). We observed similar phenomenon in acceptors with strong delocalization and high radiative efficiency, where selective photoexcitation of the acceptors in donor/acceptor blends with D18 results in anion formation on the same timescale as in neat acceptor films, suggesting that D18 is a bystander to charge generation after photoexcitation of the acceptors (ref. https://doi.org/10.1021/jacs.5c08244). These works show the possibility to lessen the dependency of carrier generation over formation of charge-transfer states, which also act as a site for recombination of free carriers at donor/acceptor interfaces that limits OPV performance. Realisation of Objective 2: We have carefully engineered the chemical structures and utilized the “dilution effect” that we reported previously to overcome the severe non-radiative recombination in blends through controlling electron-phonon coupling via tailoring of the solid-state morphology and suppressing their electronic tail states. We found the concept of dilution effect can be widely applicable to multiple-component OPV systems, where two highly miscible components (e.g., two acceptors derived from Y6) are molecularly intermixed. Contrary to the aggregation-induced non-radiative decay, the dilution effect enables higher luminescence quantum efficiencies and open-circuit voltages (VOC) in multiple-component OPVs via suppressed electron–vibration coupling (ref: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41565-021-01011-1). We further studied how acceptor molecules with similar chemical moieties can form a miscible blend to minimize the evolution of subgap broadening in the bulk heterojunction active layer, mitigating non-ideal radiative losses. As a result, the model systems demonstrate a non-radiative loss down to 180~190 meV, without sacrificing photocurrent generations, reaching that of inorganic counterparts (ref: https://doi.org/10.1002/aenm.202304558). Realisation of Objective 3: While the works associated with Objectives 1 and 2 provided the fundamental understandings into the critical issues related to non-radiative recombination in OPVs, we further adopted the concepts to rationally regulate the chemical structure of small-molecule acceptors by incorporation of asymmetric side chains for realizing efficient exciton dissociation and mitigated non-radiative recombination. We designed and synthesized two biaxially conjugated acceptors, C9BO and 2BO, through delicate modification of structural symmetry. We found that the incorporation of symmetric side chains on 2BO results in a blue-shifted absorption spectrum and a reduced ESP compared to those of C9BO bearing asymmetric side chains. Besides, a unique aggregate mode with diverse stacking orientations is observed in the symmetric 2BO, which helps form multiple charge transfer channels in its blend with D18, whereas that cannot be found for the blend comprising the asymmetric C9BO. Moreover, a slower rate and lower ratio of the spin-triplet state are formed in the D18:2BO blend, resulting in a significantly reduced non-radiative voltage loss in relevant OSCs. Consequently, the 2BO-derived OSCs achieve a superior PCE of 19.01% with a much lower non-radiative energy loss of 0.201 eV (ref: https://doi.org/10.1002/aenm.202403121). Moreover, we expand the scope of our study into dimer acceptors. Two dimeric acceptors, DY-FT and DY-IDT, with varied π-linker were developed to evaluate the influence of linker-induced conformation lock on the molecular packing modes and non-radiative voltage loss in OPVs. We found that the twisted helically lapped O-shaped DY-FT is more likely to deliver better intermolecular packing than the planar S-shaped DY-IDT. This is primarily attributed to the larger steric hindrance for the inter-moiety packing of both two blocks in DY-IDT. However, the planar blocks of DY-IDT are more favorable for forming a compact and ordered stacking with the host acceptor, BTP-eC9. This feature possibly enables it to more easily generate exciton delocalization, therefore reducing the non-radiative decay of traditional charge-transfer states. Additionally, the relatively longer exciton lifetime of DY-IDT could provide additional charge-transfer channels in the ternary blend. These contributions effectively minimize the non-radiative Voc loss of the resulting ternary devices to 0.195 eV. As a result, the DY-IDT-based device achieves an efficiency of 19.90%, among the highest values so far obtained for the dimer systems (ref: https://pubs.acs.org/doi/full/10.1021/acsenergylett.4c02429). Realisation of Objective 4: Based on the efforts spent in material design and device engineering, we developed dimeric acceptors (PYO-IT) showing local structure-induced selective interaction that achieves 20.1% efficiency with a negligible burn-in loss against physical aging to fulfill the project objective (ref: https://doi.org/10.1002/anie.202418439). Furthermore, a novel inorganic lacunary-structure metal-oxo framework, BSiW9 which serves as electron-transporting layer based on D18:L8-BO OSCs, helped improve the efficiency to a remarkable 20.5% while also giving outstanding long-term stability (ref: https://doi.org/10.1002/anie.202514941).

11307621.label: Major findings and research outcome
11307621.value: In this project, we have developed OPV materials with (a) improved luminescent properties to alleviate the severe non-radiative loss in organic materials, (b) capability to reach an optimized morphology when blended to form a composite of photoactive layer, and (c) lower exciton binding strength to enable more efficient delocalization of excitons and charges carriers. The outcome of the project has enabled OPVs with high efficiency (>20%; ref: https://doi.org/10.1002/anie.202418439, No. 8.38 in Part C), very low non-radiative Voc loss (<0.2 V; ref: https://doi.org/10.1021/acsenergylett.4c02429, No. 8.35 in Part C), and decent long-term stability (T90 >1,000 h; ref: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.joule.2024.03.009, No. 8.30 in Part C).

11307621.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11307621.value: The outcome of this project has also enabled the development of efficient perovskite-organic tandem solar cells (ref: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41560-024-01451-8), and large-area printable OPVs with high potential in scalable production (ref: https://doi.org/10.1039/D4EE04479G). Furthermore, the project team has also investigated the causes of OPV non-radiative recombination in a more in-depth manner through extensive collaborations with Prof. David Ginger (University of Washington), Prof. Chunfeng Zhang (Nanjing University), Prof. Hongzheng Chen (Zhejiang University), and Prof. Yongsheng Chen (Nankai University). These efforts have fostered several ongoing works covering different aspects from fundamental photophysics to industrialization, further advancing the OPV technology.

11307621.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11307621.value: This project aims to develop organic semiconductor materials that can efficiently convert light into electricity, rather than heat. The major objectives of the project include (a) improving luminescent properties to alleviate the severe non-radiative loss in organic materials, (b) realizing an optimized morphology when blended to form a composite of photoactive layer, and (c) lowering the exciton binding strength to enable more efficient delocalization of excitons and charges carriers. The outcome of the project has enabled OPVs with high efficiency (>20%), very low non-radiative Voc loss (<0.2 V), and decent long-term stability (T90 >1,000 h).

11307721.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11307721.value: 利用超分子聚合物的非共價相互作用操縱液態金屬

11307721.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11307721.value: Gallium-based liquid metals (LMs) are an emerging class of materials which possess a conductive liquid interface with access to free ions and electrons that offer extraordinary potential for electronic, mechanical, catalytic, and biomedical applications. Unlike conventional solid additives, the fluidic LMs are capable of deforming and reconfiguring under stress in response to external stimuli applied to the polymer composites. However, there are two critical issues for most LM-polymer composites: (1) LMs could not form high-quality percolation pathways with many elastomers through solution processing; (2) LMs network would be severely damaged when high strains are applied on the composites. In this project, we propose that supramolecular polymers with well-designed backbone and noncovalent bonding motifs could have enhanced interactions with the gallium oxide layer of the LMs and thus ensure the mechanical modulation of the LM-polymer composites in a wide range. Two sets of oligomers would be synthesized for the fabrication of supramolecular LM-polymer composites. The molecular mechanism on the manipulation of LMs in supramolecular polymers would be systematically studied. We expect that the dynamic nature of supramolecular network and the fluidity of LMs would bring synergistic effect on the manipulation of the LM-polymer composites. The outcome of this project will not only advance our fundamental understanding on the molecular engineering of supramolecular polymers, but also provide new insights into the design of LM-polymer composites which will benefit their potential applications in robotics, flexible electronics, and biomedical applications. 镓基液态金属材料由于其独特的液态界面和物理化学性质，在电子、机械、催化和生物医学应用等领域取得了广泛的关注。不同于其他固体材料，液态金属材料具有典型的液体特性，因而能很好的适应外界的刺激并产生可重构的形变。但是，对于液态金属/聚合物复合材料而言，存在两个尚未解决的问题：（1）在溶液法制备的复合材料中，液态金属难以在聚合物弹性体中形成高质量的渗流网络。（2）复合材料中的液态金属网络往往无法承受材料发生较大的形变，限制了材料的拉伸性能。 本项目中，我们提出通过在超分子聚合物中构建合适的骨架和非共价相互作用基团，来增强聚合物网络与镓基液态金属的氧化层的相互作用，进而实现对复合材料的机械性能等在较大的范围内的调控。我们会制备两种不同的寡聚体，用于液态金属/聚合物复合材料的制备，并系统研究液态金属与超分子网络的相互作用的分子机制。我们期待，超分子网络的动态特性与液态金属的流体特性，能产生独特的协同相互作用，实现对材料性能的调控。如若成功，本项目的成果将有助于加深我们对超分子复合材料设计的理解，并为设计和制备用于机器人、柔性电子等领域的柔性可拉伸导电材料提供新的思路。

11308021.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11308021.value: 二次表面粗糙度對城市湍流和通風影響的數值模擬

11308021.label: Project Objectives
11308021.value: Quantify the dependence of urban turbulence and pollutant ventilation on surface roughness perturbations of different size, shape and location; assess sensitivity to external wind direction and bottom heating. Parameterise the effects of different types of surface roughness (e.g. balconies, tiles and channels) on velocity statistics. Elucidate ventilation pathways and mechanisms for representative secondary surface roughness and determine values of the roughness parameters at which transitions occur.

Parameterise the effects of different types of surface roughness (e.g. balconies, tiles and channels) on velocity statistics.

11308021.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11308021.value: Much of our knowledge about urban boundary layers and pollutant dispersion assumes obstacles with smooth walls. This is a simplification because most buildings include envelope features such as balconies, i.e. multiscale rough walls. Numerical and experimental studies of flow over rough walls indicate that mean flow and turbulence statistics in the near-wall region are sensitive to the geometry of the surface perturbations; however, relatively little is known about the implications for pollutants. Several envelope features have been investigated, but a general understanding of the influence of surface perturbations or secondary roughness is lacking. This proposal will use large-eddy simulation to quantify the effects of secondary surface roughness on urban turbulence and ventilation and elucidate the associated physical mechanisms. Preliminary calculations indicate that surface perturbations can have a significant effect; for example, the mean pollutant concentration inside the canopy may decrease even when the depth of the perturbations to the sidewalls is not negligible. An outstanding issue, therefore, is the relationship between turbulence and ventilation and the surface perturbations. It is hypothesized that, for representative surface perturbations, mean flow, turbulence and ventilation statistics can be related to morphological parameters that characterise coarse- and fine-grained features of the surface roughness. By analogy with other rough-wall boundary layers, it is expected that the effect of small surface perturbations on the turbulence exceeds that on the mean flow, thereby promoting partial decoupling between the interior and the secondary roughness. The effects on the Reynolds stresses in the interior will be parameterised using the unperturbed flow and the turbulent fluctuations in the vicinity of the secondary roughness. Ventilation pathways, mechanisms and transitions will be determined using Lagrangian diagnostics such as the residence time and tracer age. The importance of turbulence generation by the surface perturbations will be clarified using tools like two-point covariances and conditional averaging of quadrant events. This project addresses an important gap in our understanding of urban pollutant dispersion and boundary layers. It will clarify the means by which secondary surface roughness affects urban air pollution and quantify the effects of simplified building representations. It may also inspire new strategies for mitigating air pollution through intelligent urban design. 關於城市邊界層和污染物擴散的大部分模型都是假設建築物的壁面是光滑的。這是一種簡化處理，但大多數建築物都包括陽台等圍護結構，即多尺度粗糙牆。粗糙壁面流動的數值模擬和實驗研究表明，造成壁面擾動的幾何形狀對近壁面區域的流場和湍流對的影響非常大；然而，其對污染物濃度的了解卻知之甚少。雖然有學者已經研究了少數幾個圍護結構特徵，然而對造成表面擾動的二次粗糙度的影響的知識甚是匱乏。 因此本項目將使用大渦模擬來量化二次表面粗糙度對城市湍流和通風的影響，並闡明相關的物理機制。初步計算表明，表面的擾動會產生顯著影響；例如，即使壁面擾動結構的高度不可忽略，城市內的平均污染物濃度也可能降低。因此，一個值得研究的問題是城市湍流和通風與壁面擾動元素之間的關係。對於表面擾動結構，平均流量、湍流和通風統計數據可能與表徵表面粗糙度的形態參數有關。與其他粗糙壁邊界層類比，預計小表面擾動對湍流的影響超過對平均流場的影響，從而促進城市內部和二次粗糙的壁面之間的部分解耦。內部雷諾應力的影響將使用未受擾動的流場和二次粗糙壁面附近的湍流波動進行參數化。通風路徑、機制和轉換將使用拉格朗日診斷方法確定，例如污染物逗留時間和示踪劑年齡。我們也將使用兩點協方差和象限分析等工具來闡明表面擾動的產生對湍流的重要性。 該項目能夠解決我們對城市污染物擴散和邊界層的理解中的一個重要空白。它將闡明二次表面粗糙度對控制城市空氣污染的新方式，並量化其影響。它還可能激發通過智慧城市設計來減輕空氣污染的新策略。

11308021.label: Realisation of objectives
11308021.value: All stated objectives have been achieved, resulting in the six publications and training of two students. The research was performed predominantly using numerical simulations (the PALM model), with some calibration against observation data in HK urban canyons as appropriate. The secondary roughly was modelled as additional cuboids within the PALM simulations, and the statistics obtained from those simulations were parameterised and compared with models without the secondary roughness modelled explicitly. Some improvements were found, and may form subjects of further study. The methodology may be adapted to other study cases, such as modelling of flow within/over forests, mangroves and/or coral reefs. Beyond academic publications, the algorithms in code form and created models as files have been made publicly available in line with open access policies.

11308021.label: Major findings and research outcome
11308021.value: Major findings of the project include showing and quantifying that the mean flow and turbulence statistics within the interior show strong dependence on roughness, and is an extension of the standard classification for urban roughness. On the other hand, the collapse of passive scalar statistics with respect to roughness parameters is poorer than mean flow statistics on account of turbulent mixing. Since the secondary roughness exerts a relatively small effect on the flow, the effective aspect ratio is the most important parameter for describing the mean flow and turbulence statistics, while the normalised separation represents a correction. For sufficiently deep balconies, there is pollutant trapping within the balconies while the basic ventilation mechanism within the interior (i.e. advection by the mean canyon circulation) to a first approximation. A total of seven articles (six published, one in preparation) has resulted from the present project.

11308021.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11308021.value: The parameterisation effects represent a leading order first attempt, and there is further work in refining the parametersations that can form a next step in improving model responses, and its eventual adoption for quantification studies.

11308021.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11308021.value: As a city with numerous high rise buildings such as Hong Kong, the buildings themselves serve as a canyon that has various consequences for pollutant dispersion, impacting on community health for example. The present studies considers the issue of how extra "roughness" in the representation of the buildings beyond the pure rectangular shapes (e.g. having balconies) can lead to important consequences in the dispersion of pollutants, and how these effects might be represented in cheaper models. The work has the potential to lead to better policies for city design for the betterment of societal health.

11308121.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11308121.value: Deep learning has been widely applied to processing big data from many practical domains. Its success stems from various families of deep neural networks with network architectures and structures designed adaptively according to different applications. Compared with its power in practice and discussions on computing issues, it lacks a solid mathematical foundation and enough theoretical understanding of the structured networks in representing and approximating functions. This project is concerned with approximation theory of two important families of deep neural networks, deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and deep recurrent neural networks (RNNs). Our first purpose is to study further the superiority of deep CNNs in approximating structured functions and functionals, with structure features induced by filters and sparsity in the time-frequency domain. Our second purpose is to consolidate the theory of deep RNNs in approximating sequence-to-sequence maps with explicit rates of approximation when various activation functions are used. Our last purpose is to consider some deep learning problems in practical applications and some related theoretical questions. For the multi-class classification arising from readability of Chinese texts, we propose a new framework of adjacent-level accuracy and conduct error analysis together with readability assessments. For some deep RNNs processing sequential data in finance, we consider a gated activation consisting of filter and gate parts, and plan to study the efficiency of the induced deep learning algorithms. 深度學習已被廣泛應用於處理來自許多實際領域的大數據。它的成功源於具有根據不同應用自適應設計的網絡架構和結構的各種深度神經網絡系列。與其在實踐應用中的威力和對其計算問題的討論相比，我們缺乏其紮實的數學基礎和對結構化網絡在表示和逼近函數方面足夠的理論理解。該項目涉及深度神經網絡的兩個重要類別，深度卷積神經網絡 (CNN) 和深度循環神經網絡 (RNN)， 的逼近理論。我們的第一個目的是進一步研究深度 CNN 在逼近結構化函數和泛函方面的優越性，其結構特徵由濾波器和時頻域中的稀疏性導出。我們的第二個目的是加強由各種激活函數導出的深度 RNN 在逼近序列到序列映射的理論並得到顯式逼近階。我們最後的目的是考慮一些來自實際應用的深度學習問題和相關的理論課題。針對中文文本可讀性分析的多分類問題，我們計劃提出一種新的針對鄰級準確度的理論框架，並結合可讀性評估進行誤差分析。對於處理金融序列數據的一些深度 RNN算法，我們考慮一個由濾波器和門函數誘導的深度學習算法，並討論其學習效率。

11308121.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11308121.value: This research focuses on understanding and improving how artificial intelligence (AI) systems, specifically deep learning models, learn and process information. Deep learning uses networks inspired by the human brain to solve complex problems, and we aim to make these networks more effective and efficient. First, we explore how a type of AI model called convolutional neural networks (CNNs) can better handle tasks involving patterns, images, or structures by using specialized techniques that mimic human vision and perception. This can make AI better at analyzing things like images, sounds, or signals. Second, we study another AI model called recurrent neural networks (RNNs), which are designed to process sequences, such as language or time-based data. Our work develops new ways to make these models more accurate and reliable when remembering and processing sequences, which is important for tasks like text analysis or predicting trends over time. Lastly, we apply these ideas to practical problems, like improving how well AI can judge the readability of texts or process financial data. This could lead to advancements in education, helping people understand complex texts, or in finance, where AI could better analyze market data. This research combines theory and real-world applications to push AI innovation forward, benefiting industries and society.

11308321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11308321.value: As the most successful electrochemical energy storage devices to date, lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) have substantially facilitated the advances of consumer electronic devices and revolutionized our lives in the past 30 years. Nowadays, the applications of energy storage devices are shifting to the ever-growing large-scale energy storage systems, such as passenger electric vehicles and smart stationary grids. Nonetheless, the energy densities of state-of-the-art LIBs based on the intercalation energy storage mechanism have reached their theoretical limitation, and thus, novel electrode materials with high energy density are required. As an emerging alternative, lithium–sulfur (Li-S) batteries are considered one of the most promising next-generation batteries because of their high theoretical energy density, eco-friendliness, and low cost. However, the poor conductivity of sulfur and Li2S, high solubility and shuttling effect of lithium polysulfides (LiPSs), and sluggish interconversion kinetics of LiPSs to Li2S have severely impeded the practical applications of Li-S batteries. In the proposed project, we will synthesize hybrid nanosheets comprising MOx/MNx (M: Fe, Co, and Ni) heterojunctions on a carbon cloth (MOx/MNx@cc) by using microwave plasma-enhanced nitridation, and study their application as a sulfur host in Li-S batteries. This project is based on the following concepts. 1) The combined high polarity and catalytic activity of MOx/MNx heterostructures enable enhanced adsorption and conversion of LiPSs. 2) The plasma-enhanced nitridation allows control of the chemical composition and defects (e.g., oxygen and nitrogen vacancies) in the heterostructures, and defect engineering can further tune their adsorption and catalytic capability toward LiPSs. 3) The direct growth of hybrids on carbon cloth, as well as the networked structure and porous nature of nanosheets, are merited with high conductivity, enlarged surface area, and intimate contact with the electrolyte, which are favorable for improving the sulfur loading efficiency and rate performance. In the proposed project, a series of MOx/MNx heterostructures will be synthesized and the impacts of chemical composition, morphology, porosity, microstructure, and defect states on suppressing the shuttling effects of LiPSs will be systematically investigated and optimized to improve the energy density and cycling stability of Li-S batteries. Meanwhile, various in situ characterizations and theoretical simulations will be performed to identify the active sites/paths of MOx/MNx heterostructures for the immobilization and conversion of LiPSs. The implementation of the proposed project will provide further understanding of, and insight into, the design and development of new sulfur host materials for Li-S batteries. 作為迄今為止最成功的電化學儲能設備，鋰離子電池 (LIB)在過去30年中極大地促進了消費電子產品的進步，並徹底改變了人們的生活。目前，電化學儲能設備的應用正在向更大規模的儲能系統轉移，例如電動汽車和智慧電網。但是，基於插層儲能機制的LIBs的能量密度已接近其理論極限，因此需要開發具有更高能量密度的新型電池。鋰硫（Li-S）電池因具有高理論能量密度、低成本和環境友好等特徵而被認為是最有希望取代LIBs的下一代電池之一。然而，硫和Li2S的低導電性、多硫化鋰 (LiPSs)的高溶解度和穿梭效應以及LiPSs與Li2S緩慢的轉變動力學嚴重阻礙了Li-S電池的性能和實際應用。 在本課題中，我們擬通過微波等離子體增強氮化技術在碳布基底上製備包含MOx/MNx（M：Fe、Co和Ni）異質結的復合納米片陣列，並研究它們作為Li-S電池中高效硫載體的應用。本課題的提出主要有以下依據。第一，MOx/MNx異質結構的高化學極性和催化活性，可以同時促進其對LiPSs的吸附和轉化。第二，通過等離子體增強氮化技術可以實現對MOx/MNx異質結構化學成分和缺陷（例如氧和氮空位）的調控，進一步提高它們對LiPSs的吸附和催化能力。第三，直接生長在碳布基底上的MOx/MNx異質結構納米片，具有高電導率、大表面積和良好的電解液接觸等優點，有利於提高硫活性材料的負載效率和電池的倍率性能。我們將製備一系列的MOx/MNx 異質結構，並系統研究其化學成分、形貌、孔隙率、微觀結構和缺陷狀態對抑制LiPSs穿梭效應的影響。同時，我們還將進行多種原位測試和理論模擬，分析MOx/MNx異質結材料對於LiPS固定和轉化的活性位元點/反應路徑。本項目的實施將為Li-S電池領域中新型高效硫載體的設計和製備提供實驗基礎與理論指導。

11308321.label: Realisation of objectives
11308321.value: 1. Synthesis of heterojunction materials on carbon cloth. CC@Co3O4/Co4N heterojunction: We have successfully synthesized defect-rich Co3O4/Co4N heterojunctions on carbon cloth (CC) using a two-step process. The CC substrate was cleaned ultrasonically in acetone, ethanol, and deionized water, dried under nitrogen, and then treated with hydrogen plasma for 30 min in a microwave plasma chemical vapor deposition (MPCVD) system without external heating. This treatment rendered the CC surface hydrophilic. For the synthesis of CC@Co3O4/Co4N heterojunctions on CC, uniform ZIF-67 nanosheet arrays were grown in situ on the CC surface (denoted as CC@ZIF67) via coordination reactions of cobalt ions and 2-methylimidazole (C4H6N2) in aqueous solution. The heterojunction was then formed by the direct nitridation of CC@ZIF67 using electron cyclotron resonance (ECR)-enhanced microwave plasma at 700 ℃. The treatment time was varied from 1 to 10 minutes to optimize morphology. It was revealed that, after 5 min of plasma nitridation, vertically aligned nanosheet arrays decorated with uniformly distributed heterojunction nanoparticles were obtained. In contrast, extending the treatment to 10 min led to near-complete etching of the nanosheets due to prolonged energetic particle bombardment. The optimized CC@Co3O4/Co4N architecture not only facilitates efficient electron conduction and ion diffusion but also effectively immobilizes sulfur and promotes the rapid conversion of sulfur species during cycling. CC@NiCo-N-O nanosheet hybrids: Porous nickel‑cobalt nitride‑oxide (NiCo-N-O) nanosheet networks were also synthesized on carbon cloth. In the experiments, nickel‑cobalt layered double hydroxide (NiCo-LDH) nanosheets were electrodeposited onto the activated CC in a three‑electrode cell. The resulting CC@NiCo-LDH precursor was converted into CC@NiCo-N-O hybrids via nitrogen‑plasma nitridation at 300 oC with varying treatment times. The same approach was successfully extended to synthesize NiFe-N-O and FeCo-N-O hybrids from their corresponding LDH precursors, demonstrating the versatility of this plasma‑nitridation method. 2. Assessment of the electrochemical performance of CC@ heterojunction materials as Li-S battery catalysts. The synthesized CC@ heterojunction materials were employed directly as sulfur‑host cathodes in Li–S batteries, eliminating the need for binders or additional processing steps. Static adsorption test revealed that a Li2S6 solution became nearly colorless within 10 minutes after introducing either CC@ Co3O4/Co4N or CC@ NiCo-N-O, indicating their superior adsorption capability towards polysulfides. Among all heterojunction materials, the CC@ Co3O4/Co4N electrode exhibited the best electrochemical performance. In cyclic voltammetry (CV) measurements, it displayed the highest current response and the smallest voltage polarization compared to other heterojunction‑based electrodes and pure CC. Moreover, Furthermore, Li–S cells using this electrode delivered outstanding rate capability, with initial discharge capacities of 1520, 1092, 983, 884, and 771 mAh g−1 at 0.2, 0.5, 1, and 2 C (1 C = 1672 mA gS−1), respectively, much higher than those of other electrodes. The CC@ Co3O4/Co4N electrode also enabled remarkable cycling stability, showing a low capacity‑fading rate of only 0.041% per cycle over 1100 cycles at 1 C. Moreover, the electrochemical performance under harsh conditions of ultrahigh sulfur loading and a lean electrolyte/sulfur (E/S) ratio was also substantially improved. The superior performance of the CC@ Co3O4/Co4N electrode is attributed to the following factors. 1) Optimized electrode architecture: The vertically aligned nanosheet arrays on carbon cloth provide efficient electron conduction and ion‑diffusion pathways while effectively accommodating cathode volume changes, especially under high sulfur loading. 2) Strong polysulfide adsorption: The Co3O4/Co4N heterojunction interacts chemically with lithium polysulfides (LiPSs), confining sulfur species within the cathode and mitigating polysulfide shuttling as well as lithium‑anode corrosion. 3) Enhanced catalytic activity: The abundant active sites on the Co3O4/Co4N heterojunction lower the energy barriers of sulfur‑conversion reactions, particularly for the rate‑limiting steps from Li2S4 to Li2S2 and then to Li2S, thus accelerating reaction kinetics and improving sulfur utilization. 3. Elucidating the catalytic mechanism of CC@Co3O4/Co4N in Li-S chemistry. A multi-technique investigation combining in situ XRD, in situ electrochemical analysis, and density functional theory (DFT) calculations was conducted to probe the catalytic mechanism of the CC@Co3O4/Co4N composites. The results demonstrate that its exceptional electrochemical performance originates from a spatially resolved, stepwise catalysis of LiPSs, driven by the built-in electric field at the Co3O4/Co4N heterojunction interface. The difference in work functions between metallic-like Co₄N and semiconducting Co₃O₄ induces a spontaneous electron transfer from Co4N to Co3O4, establishing a built-in electric field at their interface. This field directs the migration of negatively charged LiPSs from Co3O4 toward Co4N, which not only avoids the outward diffusion of LiPSs into the electrolyte but also achieves a spatially optimized distribution of active sulfur species. Furthermore, DFT calculations reveal a complementary catalytic synergy between the two phases across the sulfur redox process: 1) Co3O4 surfaces exhibit lower free energy barriers for the initial solid-to-liquid conversion (S8 to Li2S8/Li2S4), making them optimal for these stages. 2) Co4N surfaces show significantly lower barriers for the critical liquid-to-solid conversion steps (Li2S4 to Li2S2 and further to Li2S), which are typically rate-determining steps during the discharging processes. This spatial division of catalytic labor enables an efficient stepwise conversion pathway: S8(solid) → Li2S4(liquid) → Li2S(solid)) on Co3O4/Co4N heterojunctions. Consequently, the Co3O4/Co4N heterojunctions ensure continuously enhanced reaction kinetics throughout the entire redox process, leading to high sulfur utilization and improved battery performance.

11308321.label: Major findings and research outcome
11308321.value: In this project, we successfully fabricated free-standing CC@heterojunction to promote efficient sulfur conversion in Li-S batteries, using an ECR-enhanced microwave plasma technique. After a comprehensive performance assessment, we demonstrated that the CC@Co3O4/Co4N electrode delivers outstanding performance, achieving high initial discharging capacities of 1520, 1092, 983, 884, and 771 mAh g−1 at current densities of 0.2, 0.5, 1 and 2 C, respectively, along with superior cycling stability, exhibiting a low capacity decay rate of only 0.041% per cycle over 1100 cycles. This remarkable performance stems from a synergistic combination of an optimized electrode architecture and a built-in electric field-driven spatial stepwise catalysis mechanism. The vertically aligned nanosheet arrays grown on carbon cloth provide efficient ion/electron transport pathways while physically confining sulfur species, thereby mitigating polysulfide shuttling and lithium anode corrosion. More importantly, the heterojunction interface between Co3O4 and Co4N creates a built-in electric field that directs the migration of polysulfides from Co3O4 to Co4N. This enables a catalytic division of labor: Co3O4 facilitates the rapid reduction of S8 to Li2S4, whereas Co4N promotes the efficient nucleation and growth of Li2S. These results underscore the potential of heterojunction materials as high-performance catalysts in Li-S chemistry and highlight the importance of structure–activity relationships in catalyst design for practical battery applications. Overall, this work not only demonstrates a high-performing sulfur host but also provides a design strategy (i.e., through leveraging interfacial electric fields and spatially resolved catalysis) that can inspire the development of advanced catalytic materials for energy conversion and storage systems.

11308321.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11308321.value: The development of efficient catalysts represents a promising pathway to high-performance Li-S batteries. The proposed CC@heterojunction electrodes demonstrate exceptional catalytic activity, markedly enhancing sulfur conversion kinetics and delivering outstanding rate capability and long‑term cycling stability. This performance is attributed to the synergistic integration of a rational electrode architecture and a built‑in‑electric‑field‑driven, spatially stepwise polysulfide conversion mechanism. To further advance this field, future research should focus on several key areas: 1) Electronic and Structural Tuning: Deeper investigation into the electronic structure, bulk phases, and exposed crystal facets of heterojunction catalysts is needed. Strategies such as applying d-band theory to correlate the d-band center position with activity, or engineering defects (e.g., vacancies, dislocations, grain boundaries, or single atoms) to modulate local electronic states, offer promising avenues for enhancing performance. 2) Mechanistic Understanding: A multi‑perspective, machine‑learning‑assisted framework could be essential to decode the complex atomic‑level interactions and cooperative effects across the multiple active sites within heterojunction catalysts. 3) Practical Evaluation: Assessing the scalability, processability, and long‑term stability of these heterojunction‑based cathodes under realistic battery conditions will be critical for determining their commercial viability.

11308321.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11308321.value: Advancing energy storage technologies is critical for achieving sustainable resource use and supporting the long-term progress of society. Among emerging systems, lithium-sulfur (Li-S) batteries hold exceptional promise due to their high theoretical energy density (2,600 Wh kg−1) and low material cost. However, their practical application is hindered by sluggish sulfur redox kinetics and complex multi‑phase conversion processes. Developing efficient electrocatalysts is therefore essential to accelerate reaction rates and enhance cycling stability. In this project, we developed an innovative plasma-enhanced surface engineering strategy to fabricate freestanding CC@heterojunction electrodes, promoting sulfur conversion in Li–S batteries. The resulting cells exhibit outstanding electrochemical performance, including high initial discharge capacities across a range of current densities and superior long‑term cycling stability over 1100 cycles. Our findings underscore the significant potential of heterojunction‑based catalysts to improve the electrochemical performance of Li–S batteries. More broadly, the design principles demonstrated here, particularly the use of interfacial engineering to tailor catalytic properties, can inform the development of high‑performance catalysts for a wide range of energy conversion and storage applications beyond sulfur electrochemistry.

11308721.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11308721.value: Bismuth-based photocatalysts offer great potentials in harvesting, converting, and storing solar energy in the form of chemical fuels. These photocatalysts enable the visible light absorption (can be activated by indoor illumination) and are capable of splitting water into hydrogen as clean energy carrier. Although promising, these photocatalysts are currently suffering from poor photocharge transportation, in which kinetics and thermodynamics of the photocharges are limited. Hence, their practical applications are yet to be achieved. In this project, innovative methods to improve the photocharge transportation of bismuth-based photocatalysts will be developed via the principles of defect and structural engineering. Defect and structure-engineered photocatalysts could potentially overcome the current bottleneck. The photocharge transportation will be investigated using a combination of the state-of-art time-resolved spectroscopy techniques. Successful execution of this project will lead to the expansion of new knowledge in regulating charge movement in semiconductors with application not limited to photocatalysis. The ultimate goal in efficiently using solar energy in the form of chemical fuels (such as clean hydrogen) is achievable through careful design and thorough understanding of photoactive semiconductors. This project will contribute to the development of novel and functional photocatalysts with higher efficiency and performance than has been possible in the past. Given the strategic solar-geographical position of Hong Kong, utilization of sunlight in the form of clean solar fuels (via water splitting) is a promising option to overcome the issue of energy insecurity. 鉍基光催化劑在以化學燃料的形式收集、轉換和儲存太陽能方面具有巨大的潛力。這些光催化劑能夠吸收可見光（可以通過室內照明激活），並且能夠將水分解為氫作為清潔能源載體。但這些光催化劑目前的光電荷傳輸較差，其中光電荷的動力學和熱力學是有限的。因此，它們的實際應用還有待實現。在這個項目中，我們將通過缺陷和結構工程的原理開發改進鉍基光催化劑光電荷傳輸的創新方法。缺陷和結構工程光催化劑有可能克服當前的瓶頸。我們將使用最先進的時間分辨光譜技術來研究光電荷傳輸。這項目的成功執行將擴展調節半導體導電荷運動的新知識，其應用不僅限於光催化。 這項研究的目標是以通過精心設計和透徹了解光敏半導體，實現以化學燃料形式有效利用太陽能。這項目將有助於開發具有比過去更高效率和性能的新型功能性光催化劑。這項研究將可提升香港對於能源挑戰的能力。

11308721.label: Realisation of objectives
11308721.value: In this Completion Report, the PI and his research team have investigated comprehensively the elements covered in all four project objectives with measurable success. The details are as follows: 1. Objective 1: Development of alternative doping and structural modulation methods for bismuth-based photocatalysts (method development). First, the doping method will have emphasis on the low temperature-induced insertion of elemental dopant with controllable sites and amount. Second, the structural modulation will focus on hierarchical porous photocatalyst with crystalline ultrathin thickness. Both methods offer regulation of photogenerated charges. We have investigated doping strategies that will modulate the structure and defects of bismuth-based photocatalyst. The defects can be structural distortion and in the form of vacancies. For instance, we reveal that intrinsic oxygen vacancies (OVs) of BiVO4 photoanodes are detrimental to PEC water oxidation to H2O2. The superabundant OVs of the BiVO4 photoanode are passivated by a thermal treatment in a pressurized O2 atmosphere by a Parr reactor. The passivated BiVO4 photoanode with the least OV concentration achieves ca. two times H2O2 selectivity enhancement than the BiVO4 photoanode with introduced OVs, resulting from the weakened band bending, the positively shifted quasi-Fermi level, and the suppressed decomposition of as-formed H2O2. In particular, the photoexcited electrochemical impedance spectra demonstrate a hole distribution rearrangement of the OVs-passivated BiVO4, which eliminates the OER-related surface states and steers the water oxidation reaction pathway toward H2O2 formation. This work reveals the importance of interfacial energetics induced by regulating intrinsic OVs in selective PEC water oxidation. 2. Objective 2: Fabrication of optimized bismuth-based photocatalysts with unique structure and fine-tuned stoichiometry for efficient photocatalytic water splitting (materials development). Controlled phosphorus-doped and hydrogen-doped bismuth vanadate (BiVO4), bismuth tungstate (Bi2WO6) and bismuth molybdate (Bi2MoO6) with three-dimensional ordered macroporous (3DOM) structure will be introduced to enhance the transportation of photocharges upon illumination. Optimized bismuth-based photocatalyst with fine-tune stoichiometry has been investigated thoroughly. For instance, we show a decreased charge transport barrier upon mildly hydrogenating the nanoporous BiVO4 photoanode, as evidenced by the thermally activating photocurrent responses. Monochromatic light photoelectrochemical performance, temperature-dependent conductivity, proton nuclear magnetic resonance, and density functional theory calculation disclose that the external hydrogen atoms occupy the intrinsic OVs in the BiVO4, reducing the hopping activation energy and facilitating electron small polaron transport. The resulting BiVO4 photoanode with NiFeOx cocatalyst achieves an applied-bias photon-to-current efficiency of 1.91% at 0.58 V vs RHE with front-illumination. This study extends the common understanding of the beneficial role in conventional donor density/surface chemisorption mediations of hydrogen doping to now include small polaron hopping. 3. Objective 3: Improvement of overall photocatalytic water splitting performance through the promotion of photoexcited charge transportation. Charge transportation properties to be boosted include the charge diffusion length (distance), charge lifetime (duration) and charge mobility (speed). The charge properties will be probed using a combination of advanced and time-resolved spectroscopy techniques. Charge transportation of bismuth-based photocatalyst has been optimized and investigated. For instance, ZnO passivator-coated BiVO4 photoanode is reported for selective PEC H2O2 production. Both the H2O2 selectivity and production rate increase in the range of 1.0–2.0 V versus RHE under simulated sunlight irradiation. The photoelectrochemical impedance spectra and open-circuit potentials suggest a flattened band bending and positively shifted quasi-Fermi level of BiVO4 upon ZnO coating, facilitating H2O2 generation and suppressing the competitive reaction of O2 evolution. The ZnO overlayer also inhibits H2O2 decomposition, accelerates charge extraction from BiVO4, and serves as a hole reservoir under photoexcitation. This work offers insights into surface states and the role of the coating layer in manipulating two/four-electron transfer for selective H2O2 synthesis from PEC water oxidation. 4. Objective 4: Mechanistic understanding of the relationships between photocatalytic performance and photocharge properties of the defect- and structure-engineered photocatalysts. Mechanistic studies revealing the relationships between performance and photoelectrodes have been documented in a number of journal output in this project. For instance, we have achieved significant advances to improve the front-illumination performance of optically thick BiVO4 photoanodes and attempted to revisit the mediated charge transport dynamics of hydrogenated BiVO4. We have reversed the originally inferior front-illumination system of an optically thick BiVO4 photoanode into a system superior to that under back-illumination. The findings in this study suggested that the electrons with high mobility produced by the front-illumination on the hydrogenated BiVO4 photoanode can be efficiently transported to the conductive substrate, resulting in a significant enhancement in photocurrent generation in comparison to the pristine BiVO4 photoanode. Monochromatic light PEC performance, temperature-dependent conductivity, 1H NMR, and DFT calculation studies revealed that the external H atoms occupied the OVs in the BiVO4 lattice facilitating the electron small polaron hopping, thus suppressing the nonradiative recombination loss of photoinduced electrons and facilitating their transport in BiVO4. The observed small polaron hopping phenomenon in this work has extended the understanding of the beneficial role of hydrogen doping on metal oxides, inspiring the future development of polaronic materials in solar energy conversion.

Improvement of overall photocatalytic water splitting performance through the promotion of photoexcited charge transportation. Charge transportation properties to be boosted include the charge diffusion length (distance), charge lifetime (duration) and charge mobility (speed). The charge properties will be probed using a combination of advanced and time-resolved spectroscopy techniques.
Mechanistic understanding of the relationships between photocatalytic performance and photocharge properties of the defect- and structure-engineered photocatalysts.

11308721.value: Throughout this project, we have published a total of 13 peer-reviewed papers. All these papers were focused on the photocharge investigation of photoelectrodes prepared with electrochemical treatment process. 11308721.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11308721.value: The successful execution of this research project has served as the solid foundation for more rapid development of photocatalytic science and technology. It has enabled the PI-Ng and CityU to attract attentions from governmental department (including EMSD, HKPC) and industrial sectors (including EPRO Advance Technology, and SHK) on the potential usefulness of photocatalysis. Sparkled by this project, PI-Ng is now actively involved in the development of solar fuels project in Hong Kong (both fundamental research and applied-driven application) via multiple funded platforms. Exploration of water treatment other than water splitting is underway using bismuth-based photocatalyst.

11308721.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11308721.value: Photoactive semiconductors are promising candidates for harnessing solar energy for chemicals or fuels conversion. Bismuth-based photocatalyst is highly promising but some weaknesses of the materials should be solved in order to maximise its usefulness. This research project has enabled the design of novel photoactive materials through innovative materials modification methods to improve charge transportation properties and product selectivity from water splitting. Fundamental knowledge attained on charge interaction at electrolyte-semiconductor interfaces has helped to expand the existing boundaries of understanding and is crucial for further development of solar fuels in Hong Kong. The project has brought the community to approaching the ultimate goal in converting and storing solar energy approaching reasonable robustness and efficiency.

11500321.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11500321.value: 动态交互、信息传递和资产价格：实验

11500321.label: Project Objectives
11500321.value: We would like to implement dynamic interactions among investors and information percolation in experimental asset markets. To do that, we plan to design asset market experiments with agents exchanging private information in random, bilateral private meetings over time and across several time periods. Trading, however, takes place at a centralized marketplace. We seek to investigate the impact of information percolation on asset price dynamics and trading strategies. Specifically, we focus on the effect of the interplay of public channel of learning through market prices in a centralized marketplace and a private channel of learning through bilateral meetings on asset prices over time. In line with the prediction provided by the theory, we intend to ask the following set of questions. Can the information percolation framework generate both short-term momentum and long-term reversal? Can we relate investors’ implemented strategies to their acquired heterogeneous amount of information over time? We intend to vary the intensity of dynamic interactions and analyze the subsequent effect on asset price volatility. If the frequency of the bilateral meetings is time-varying, can a transitory period of such intense communication produce a long-lasting effect on volatility? Academic significance: The relationship between nonmarket interpersonal interactions, information percolation and dynamics of asset prices is an important topic for today's inter-connected world. We believe that our proposed research will contribute to a broader research agenda that aims to understand the impact of different types of social communication on asset market outcomes. These types include static information exchange, social trading including the knowledge of peers’ past performance, copy trading and delegation of wealth to top performing investors, and the proposed dynamic information percolation framework. In today’s world, which is becoming more interconnected than before, it is important to understand the relationship between different types of social communication and human behavior in financial decision making. Educational significance: The proposed research is in an area full of new research problems, which provides excellent training opportunities for research students. Undergraduate students can participate in various components of the project like experimental design, data analysis etc. Dissemination of results: The results from the research of the proposed study will be disseminated through publication in top-tier academic journals in Economics/Finance and presentations in international conferences.

11500321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11500321.value: 传统的金融模型假设投资者只能通过交易订单和交易价格来学习。然而，由于投资者之间有多种沟通渠道，因此很自然地推测交易者也会通过这些非市场人际会议来学习。这种类型的人际交流允许投资者直接相互传播信息，并且经常出现在股票市场行为的非正式账户中。新兴的社会经济和金融领域认识到人们相互观察和交谈。 最近的几项实证研究表明，投资者之间的交易决策存在很强的正相关关系，这些投资者更有可能彼此直接接触。然而，关于这一非市场互动的重要渠道如何影响资产市场背景下的价格流动动态的系统研究仍然有限。在这种人际交流与资产价格之间建立因果关系的一个关键挑战是，投资者之间的信息交换过程并不总是可以观察到的。我们建议使用实验室实验来研究动态相互作用、信息渗透和资产价格波动之间的关系，从而抽象出所有其他因素。 拟议研究的主要目标是探索一方面通过交易订单和观察集中市场中的市场价格的非个人公共学习渠道，另一方面通过私人学习渠道之间的相互作用投资者之间的个人动态互动。在更基本的层面上，我们打算通过双边随机会议将投资者之间动态社会互动的元素整合到实验资产市场中。这种整合代表了实验资产市场的一个新元素，据我们所知，尚未对其进行研究。 我们相信，我们提议的研究将有助于更广泛的研究议程，旨在了解不同类型的社会交流对资产市场结果的影响。这些类型包括静态信息交换、社交交易（包括对同行过去表现的了解）、跟单交易和将财富委托给表现最佳的交易者，以及提议的动态社交互动和信息渗透。在当今世界变得比以往更加相互关联，了解不同类型的社会交流与财务决策中的人类行为之间的关系非常重要。我们的结果将对旨在规范影响投资者之间社会交流强度的机制的政策制定产生影响。

11500421.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11500421.value: 如何促進求職者和聘請者接受人工智慧主導的招聘系統

11500421.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11500421.value: Prof Aquino, Karl Dr Claudy, Marius

11500421.label: Project Objectives
11500421.value: The overarching objective of Study 1 is to examine how to increase job applicants’ acceptance of artificial intelligence (AI)-led recruitment systems’ decisions. The first of the five objectives of Study 1 is to examine whether applicants will report more positive attitudes toward the organization if recruitment decisions are made by human resources professionals (HRPs) compared with an AI. Study 1’s second objective is to evaluate if applicants perceive recruitment decisions differently in terms of the various dimensions of organizational justice (i.e., distributive, procedural, informational, and interpersonal) when they are made by an AI as opposed to HRPs. We likewise aim to assess whether such perceived differences in organizational justice mediates the effects of hiring deciders on the attitudinal and behavioral responses of both decision-makers. The third objective is to study if the design features of an AI recruitment tool will alter applicants’ informational justice perceptions and attitudinal and behavioral responses to recruitment decisions made by an AI (vs. HRPs). To this end, we propose the design features of explanations (i.e., input, process, outcome) and degree of anthropomorphism of an AI system. The fourth objective is to examine if applicants’ actual and perceived social power impacts their justice perceptions and acceptance of AI-led recruitment tool (vs. HRPs). Lastly, Study 1 likewise aims to evaluate whether such perceptions vary depending on applicants’ belief on whether human decision-makers are likely to be biased for or against them. Study 2 differs from Study 1 because the latter focuses on job applicants’ perspective in accepting AI-led recruitment systems’ decisions, whereas the former approaches the issue from HRPs’ perspective. Accordingly, the overarching objective of Study 2 is to examine how to persuade HRPs to use AI for confirmation, as a hiring aid, or delegation. In particular, Study 2’s first objective is to verify if HRPs’ procedural and distributive justice perceptions toward AI partially explain their resistance to AI usage. Given that increased process and outcome transparency (explanations) may hamper HRPs’ ability to detect an AI’s mistake (Poursabzi-Sangdeh et al., 2018), the second objective is to evaluate whether a detailed input explanation can help address this issue and alert HRPs on the potential inequality of the data source for biased AI. Study 2’s third objective is to examine the role of bias forewarning and explanation features (i.e., input, process, and outcome) on persuading HRPs to accept AI’s hiring decision. One reason for HRPs’ resistance to AI adoption is the potential bias, similar to Amazon’s automated recruitment system, which did not rate job applicants for technical posts in a gender-neutral manner (Dastin 2018). Therefore, Study 2 examines whether a forewarning to HRPs on various potential biases can help adjust their usage of AI and integrate AI with a different degree of reliance on the recruitment process.
