To pave the way methodologically and paradigmatically for further research on the treatment of ethnic minorities and migrant workers within Hong Kong's criminal justice system.

11607921.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11607921.value: Migrant Domestic Workers (MDWs) are well-known as a vulnerable population. Separated from their families, overworked, underpaid, and frequently the subject of violent or sexual abuse from their employers, it is little wonder that MDWs are drawn into the world’s criminal justice systems both as victims and perpetrators. Hong Kong is a jurisdiction in which MDWs (locally: Foreign Domestic Helpers, or 'FDHs') play a critical economic role, contributing an estimated 3.6 percent of GDP. Given the prominent cases of FDHs being victimised by and committing crimes against their employers in recent years, this research project proposes an empirical study of Hong Kong trial court sentencing in cases involving FDHs, using a mixed-methods approach. Drawing from the substantial existing academic literature on differential treatment in sentencing due to race, ethnicity and immigration status, the Investigators’ effort to code and analyse the sentencing practices in Magistrates' Courts, District Court and Court of First Instance trials involving FDHs from 2009-2022 aims to assess whether FDHs (and their employer victimisers) are treated any differently from other offenders in punishment decisions. The Investigators’ hypotheses are that, as an otherwise stigmatised and under-resourced population, FDHs as defendants have received harsher sentences from magistrates and judges than defendants in comparable cases, whereas the employers who victimise domestic helpers have received less severe sentences than comparable offenders, given their elevated social status vis-à-vis their victims. Although the Hong Kong judiciary have a fair and impartial reputation, there are sound theoretical reasons to interrogate whether cases involving FDHs are treated distinctly from comparable cases. Foremost among these is the fact that sentencing decisions tend to reflect the values of the society in which they are made. Never has a systematic study of sentencing decision-making by Hong Kong District Court and Court of First Instance judges been carried out before. Indeed, as Ulmer (2012) states, ‘almost all of the research on sentencing is limited to the contemporary North American – particularly the US – context… very little research exists on sentencing in non-western contexts, particularly, in Asian countries’. The present research project, if it finds differential treatment for FDHs on a widespread scale, has the potential to effect broader policy changes by serving as the basis for advocacy by migrant worker NGOs and legal bodies. If it finds no differential treatment, this study instead has the potential to reaffirm the competence and impartiality of the Hong Kong judiciary in sentencing decision-making. 移民家務工 (MDW) 是眾所周知的弱勢群體。在與家人分離、過度工作、工資過低，並且經常遭受雇主的暴力或性虐待的情況下，也難怪MDWs 會作為受害者和肇事者而被捲入世界刑事司法系統。香港是一個 MDW（本地：外籍家庭傭工，或“外傭（FDH）”）發揮著關鍵經濟作用的司法管轄區，估計其佔本地生產總值 的 3.6%。鑑於近年有一些突出的案例是關於外傭受雇主侵害及對雇主犯下罪行，本研究計劃擬以混合方法的方式，對涉及外傭的案件量刑的香港審判法庭進行實證研究。調查人員參考現有大量關於因種族、民族和移民身份而導致刑罰區別對待的學術文獻，並為了評估外傭（及其雇主的施害者）在處罰決定中是否受到與其他罪犯的區別對待，編寫和分析裁判法院、區域法院、以及高等法院原訟法庭從2009年至2022涉及FDH的審判。 調查人員的假設是，在原已受到污名化和資源不足的情況下，裁判官和法官對身為被告人的外傭所判的刑罰比類似案件的被告更為嚴厲；而傷害家庭傭工的雇主，鑑於他們相對於受害者較高的社會地位，則比類似的罪犯受到較輕的刑罰。雖然香港司法機構享有公平公正的聲譽，但理論上，是有充分的理由質疑涉及外傭的案件是否受到區別性的對待。其中最重要的是，量刑決定往往能夠反映出每個社會的價值觀。 以往並沒有一個系統研究是針對香港地區法院和原訟法庭法官的量刑決策來進行的。事實上，正如 Ulmer（2012）所述：「幾乎所有關於量刑的研究背景都僅限於當代北美洲——尤其是美國……非西方國家中的量刑研究少之又少，尤其是在亞洲國家。」如果這個研究項目發現對有著普遍對外傭的差別待遇，此項目有可能通過作為移民工人的非政府組織以及法律機構倡議的基礎而帶來更廣泛的政策變化。若然沒有發現任何差別待遇，這項研究也可以重申香港司法機構在量刑決策方面的能力和公正性。

11608121.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11608121.value: 皮質醇作為本科生心理恢復力的生物標誌：增長曲綫模型的應用

11608121.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11608121.value: Dr Chen, Hui-Fang Dr Ko, Cheng Hung Prof Tai, James Prof Yee, Benjamin

11608121.label: Project Objectives
11608121.value: To examine the relationship between resilience and physical health in Chinese undergraduates. The progress in research on resilience and health has led to the emergence of conceptual and methodological issues that require increased attention. The absence of a widely accepted definition of resilience and the resulting multiplicity of measures developed for the construct have been a major concern (Ahern, Kiehl, Sole & Byers, 2006; Windle, Bennett & Noyes, 2011). This issue will be addressed by using the Chinese version of the Brief Resilience Scale (BRS) to operationalize the construct of resilience in the proposed study. Operationalizing resilience as the perceived ability to emerge from stress (Smith et al., 2008), the BRS has been shown to be one of the most reliable and valid measures of this construct (Windle et al., 2011). The scale was successfully adapted to the Chinese context and showed significant associations with self-reported health outcomes in Chinese undergraduates (Lai & Yue, 2014). The use of a reliable and valid measure of resilience will ensure the credibility of the findings to be generated by the proposed study. In addition to a self-reported measure of general physical health, a measure of symptomatology specific to upper respiratory tract infection, which has been shown to be associated with the diurnal cortisol rhythm, will also be administered to substantiate the link between resilience and physical health. To characterize the diurnal cortisol profiles in resilient vs. non-resilient participants, defined by their scores on the BRS, using piecewise linear growth curve models. Cortisol exhibits a diurnal rhythm characterized by two independent components: the cortisol awakening response (CAR) and the diurnal cortisol slope (DCS) (Miller et al., 2016). The CAR refers to the increase in cortisol levels from waking to about 30 to 45 minutes after waking (Clow, Thorn, Evans & Hucklebridge, 2004), whereas the DCS is the decline in cortisol levels from waking or the post-awakening peak to late evening or bedtime (Adam et al., 2017). Issues related to the predominant use of these two indices to delineate the diurnal cortisol rhythm (CAR: Stalder et al., 2016; DCS: Adam et al., 2017) have emerged recently. To address this limitation, piecewise growth curve models appear to be a viable solution because this analytic method models the diurnal variation in cortisol with three splines associated with the CAR, early decline from the peak to post-lunch levels and the late gradual decline from post-lunch to late evening levels, respectively (e.g., Friedman, Karlamangla, Almeida & Seeman, 2012). These three slopes should be able to capture changes in diurnal cortisol levels that are most sensitive to psychosocial factors. Although cortisol has been studied extensively in relation to psychopathology (e.g., Juruena et al., 2018), relatively little is known about the associations between positive psychosocial factors and cortisol. The proposed study will attempt to fill this gap. To examine the mediating effects of different components of the diurnal rhythm of cortisol in the link between resilience and health outcomes. The paucity of data on the relationship between resilience and physical health outcomes has created a gap in the understanding of the biological mechanisms that facilitate adaptive coping with and recovery from adversity (e.g., Lai & Yue, 2014). Research on mechanisms translating resilience into better health has lagged behind. In other words, the mechanisms explaining the health benefits of resilience are still elusive. We will address this gap by examining the role of diurnal cortisol rhythms in mediating the link between resilience and health outcomes. Recent evidence demonstrating (1) ethnic differences in the diurnal cortisol rhythm (Boileau, Barbeau, Sharma & Bielajew, 2019; Samuel, Roth, Schwartz, Thorpe & Glass, 2018) and (2) the moderating effect of ethnicity and culture on the relationship between cortisol and health (e.g., Allen et al., 2019; Park, Kitayama, Miyamoto & Coe, 2020) has called into question the continued reliance on Western norms of diurnal cortisol rhythms in studies with Chinese populations. The PI and his associates recently found that resilient Chinese undergraduates, compared to their non-resilient peers, exhibited a greater increase in cortisol levels in the morning and a steeper decline in cortisol levels over the course of the day (Lai et al., in press). This “dynamic” cortisol profile has also been observed in better-adjusted Chinese seniors (Lai & Lee, 2019). The findings reported by the PI in different Chinese populations further intensify the need to establish Chinese norms for the diurnal cortisol rhythm using a standardized protocol.

The progress in research on resilience and health has led to the emergence of conceptual and methodological issues that require increased attention. The absence of a widely accepted definition of resilience and the resulting multiplicity of measures developed for the construct have been a major concern (Ahern, Kiehl, Sole & Byers, 2006; Windle, Bennett & Noyes, 2011). This issue will be addressed by using the Chinese version of the Brief Resilience Scale (BRS) to operationalize the construct of resilience in the proposed study. Operationalizing resilience as the perceived ability to emerge from stress (Smith et al., 2008), the BRS has been shown to be one of the most reliable and valid measures of this construct (Windle et al., 2011). The scale was successfully adapted to the Chinese context and showed significant associations with self-reported health outcomes in Chinese undergraduates (Lai & Yue, 2014). The use of a reliable and valid measure of resilience will ensure the credibility of the findings to be generated by the proposed study. In addition to a self-reported measure of general physical health, a measure of symptomatology specific to upper respiratory tract infection, which has been shown to be associated with the diurnal cortisol rhythm, will also be administered to substantiate the link between resilience and physical health.

11608121.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11608121.value: The challenges inherent in the higher education environment and emerging adulthood make undergraduates a suitable target population for the study of resilience factors and health outcomes. However, so far, only a limited number of studies have examined the relationship between psychological resilience and physical health outcomes in healthy populations such as undergraduates. Moreover, although substantial evidence has demonstrated an association between higher levels of resilience and better health, the mechanisms translating resilience into better health are still elusive. The PI and his associates addressed these issues in a recent study with Chinese undergraduates, using salivary cortisol as the health outcome measure (Lai, Leung, Lee, Lam & Berning, in press). Despite the limitation of a small sample size, the finding of an association between higher resilience and a greater increase in morning cortisol and a faster drop in cortisol over the course of the day is inspiring, as this diurnal cortisol rhythm has been observed in better-adjusted or healthier individuals in prior studies. This “dynamic” cortisol rhythm may explain the well-documented association between resilience and better health. These findings and their implications provide a sound justification for extending the findings reported by Lai et al. (in press) using a larger sample and more vigorous analytic strategies. The potential impact of studying resilience and cortisol in a Chinese context is more apparent in light of recent findings showing for the first time the moderating effect of ethnicity and culture on the relationship between diurnal cortisol rhythms and health outcomes. This calls into question the continuing use in Asia of norms of diurnal cortisol rhythms established in studies with Western samples. In response to the aforementioned issues, the proposed study will examine the relationship between resilience, diurnal cortisol rhythms, and health outcomes in Chinese undergraduates from Hong Kong and Taiwan using a more vigorous method to model the diurnal cortisol rhythm. We expect that the proposed study will have the following long-term impacts. 1. Stimulating research on resilience and cortisol by arriving at a more precise characterization of the diurnal cortisol rhythm in better-adjusted individuals. 2. Highlighting the mechanisms translating resilience into better health or reduced morbidity. 3. Providing a reliable biological criterion for evaluating the effectiveness of interventions designed to promote resilience or well-being in Chinese undergraduates. 4. Serving as the first step in establishing Chinese norms for diurnal cortisol rhythms in the long run using a standardized protocol. 面對高等教育環境與即將成年的挑戰，本科生是一個很適合用作研究心理恢復力和健康的群體。雖然有大量的科學證據支持心理恢復力與健康的關係，但學者對這個關係的居間機理，仍然所知不多。有見及此，本研究方案的主要研究員，曾於一篇近期出版的論文中報告了心理恢復力與皮質醇晝夜節律在本科生中的密切關係。心理恢復力較強的本科生，比恢復力弱的同學有較強及明顯的皮質醇節律。由此推算，皮質醇節律的活躍程度，有可能是心理恢復力和健康的居間機理。由於這個發現有重要的含義，本研究方案便以鞏固這發現為主要目標。另外，因為有證據顯示皮質醇節律與健康的關係有種族的差異，研究中華學生的心理恢復力與皮質醇，是可作為建立中華皮質醇數據集的長遠目標的初步。從科學的角度，這可以減少對以西方發現為基礎的數據集的依賴，有重大長遠的意義。

11608721.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11608721.value: 問卷答案與反應時間的多元處理模型

11608721.label: Project Objectives
11608721.value: To examine empirical evidence to identify a suggested RT distribution by considering outlier statistics, then formulate a general RT model for normal and aberrant respondents. To meet this research objective, study 1 will include two axes: examining the impact of outlier procedures on various RT distributions and developing a general RT framework for survey questionnaires. To formulate an IRT model that can describe the cognitive process of choosing a specific response category by considering the impact of item design and response behaviors. To achieve this research objective, study 2 will adopt the idea of a multiprocess IRT model and integrate both the ideal-point and the dominance approaches into a two-decision tree model, in which the ideal-point approach is used in the first step and the dominance approach is used in the second step of the two-decision model. We will examine two hypotheses: (a) the proposed model fits the data better than the other IRT models; and (b) adopting the ideal-point approach in the first step works better than using the dominance approach in the first step. In addition, to accommodate aberrant respondents who do not pay attention to questionnaires during web surveys, we will extend the proposed tree-like model to include a class of random respondents and evaluate model performance using data from a survey of attitudes toward the Peace Wall in 2012. To examine the relationship between response behaviors and RT to positively worded (PW) items and a mixed-format design (a combination of PW and negatively worded [NW] items, commonly used in personality and attitudinal scales). We will adopt a two-level mixture model for this purpose. The first level will include a two-measurement model, in which the intended-to-be-measured latent attitude/ability is estimated using the UDtree model from study 2 and speed is estimated using the suggested RT model from study 1. A relationship between ability and speed will be estimated at the second level. The proposed integrated model will be applied to two datasets to examine the relationship between the measured latent attitude, response tendency, and RT. These applications will enhance our understanding of the impact of scale design in survey questionnaires, and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model for monitoring response styles and aberrant responses to survey questions, leading to valuable suggestions for practical use.

11608721.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11608721.value: 隨著科技的進步，測驗與問卷的施測已經逐漸轉往電腦或網路施測。因此，在過去的十年裡，研究者將電腦所記錄的測驗作答時間納入能力測驗的分析裡，以提高對於受試者能力評估的準確性。然而以能力測驗為主的分析方式，受限於問卷調查與能力測驗本質上的不同，研究者仍在研究開發，冀望能將反應時間模型有效地延伸至問卷調查中。 目前大多數反應時間的模型假定：由於時間有限，受試者答案的準確性受反應速度的影響，且潛在能力與反應時間呈現線性關係。但實證研究認為，人格或態度量表的回答時間與能力之間可能存在倒U型關係，必非線性關係。此外，現有反應時間模型通常假設所有考生使用相同的策略來回答項目，但受訪者回答問卷時可能受到自身反應偏好（例如，選擇或避免選擇極端答案）甚或是缺乏作答動機而隨便選答，以至於現有反應時間的模型並不能直接套用在問卷量表中。 本研究旨在為開發一個新的反應時間模型以用於問卷量表中。計畫將包括三項研究：制定新的反應模型來監控的各種反應行為、開發非主導性的多元處理模型，以及非主導性的多元處理模型與反應時間結合。此新類型的模型將可同時估計受訪者的潛在能力和反應傾向，並考慮正反向題設計所造成的影響，結合反應時間等訊息，可用以了解受試者回答問卷時，選擇特定選項的認知過程、反應偏好，以及能力和反應時間之間的關係。研究結果將有利於實務上精進問卷量表的使用與評估。

11608821.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11608821.value: 合同履行障碍对策研究：香港及中国大陆合同法比较

11608821.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11608821.value: Prof Chen, Lei Prof McKendrick, Ewan

11608821.label: Project Objectives
11608821.value: • Develop a sound theoretical framework and a body of critical data for ascertaining and understanding Chinese contract law (particularly its judicial application) in respect of impediments or hardship to contract performance and the various forces and ideas that continue to shape its course of development; • Identify and assess differences in ideologies, techniques and arguments about legal policies and rules relating to supervening events in Hong Kong and Mainland China and evaluate the implications of such differences for decision-making in a wide range of business, legislative and judicial contexts; • Facilitate a critical reflection on the common law system of contract in Hong Kong, particularly its inner logic and concepts, based on evolving government policies and using Chinese contract law as an alternative reference and a counterbalance to common law discourses and value-systems, and provide suggestions for legal reforms with a view to coping more effectively with present and future challenges; • Encapsulate a body of common rules on the basis of similarities between Hong Kong and Chinese contract law to achieve greater harmonisation between the two systems; • Ascertain and formulate the best contract drafting practice for parties conducting business with their counterparts in Hong Kong or Mainland China; • Provide an authoritative guide to businesses, lawyers and policy-makers in Hong Kong and Mainland China about legal responses to unexpected impediments or hardship to contract performance through the form of research publications, reports, conferences and workshops.

• Ascertain and formulate the best contract drafting practice for parties conducting business with their counterparts in Hong Kong or Mainland China;

11608821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11608821.value: This project deals with the problem that the performance of a wide range of contracts is affected by unexpected events such as the regional/global financial crisis, the US-China economic decoupling, the COVID-19 pandemic, through a comparative study of the common law of Hong Kong and the contract law of Mainland China. Such events are governed by disparate doctrines of frustration, force majeure and change of circumstances under the two legal systems, which are further informed by different cultures, policies and customs in their application in practice. In particular, the lack of a clear analysis into the true status and jurisprudential basis of Chinese judicial decisions precludes a full understanding of the Chinese law. The gap in the understanding between the two systems is large and a program of research is required to determine areas in which they may benefit from learning from each other and even integrate workable solutions. The legal differences also present a significant barrier to cross-border trade and commerce and cause confusion to contracting parties, lawyers and policy-makers from both systems who are left without credible guidance, with increases in their costs in obtaining information about and complying with the other’s law. As a result, cross-border business tends to become risky and unpredictable and threatens the bilateral economic ties vital to each jurisdiction’s economic future. This project seeks to respond to this urgent need by filling the gap and providing such guidance. It will identify and compare differing judicial solutions under the two systems to the problem of unexpected events in contract law, assess the advantages and disadvantages of such solutions comparatively, provide reform suggestions to law and policy-makers from both sides, and promote best contract negotiation and drafting practice to counter events such as the COVID-19 pandemic. The findings from this research will facilitate mutual understanding and economic competitiveness, strengthen sustainable economic ties, inform legal decision-making in both Hong Kong and Mainland China, enhance each system’s capacity to engage with the other, and provide common lawyers, businesses and policy-makers in Hong Kong and elsewhere with a definitive and authoritative guide. The research will be novel in its comparative and practical dimensions, timely in the global context and unique in the background of the PI and Co-Is. 本课题通过对中国大陆法与香港普通法的比较、研究合同履行因意外事件（如金融危机、中美贸易战、新冠疫情等）而致阻碍的问题。该问题在两种法律制度下分别由迥然不同的合同落空、不可抗力及情势变更规则所调整，并体现了两地在法律文化、政策及习惯上的差异。尤其是，中国法上司法判决的地位和法理基础一直缺乏清晰解读。对诸如此类的领域展开研究将有利于中国法与香港法的互相学习乃至融合。除此之外，两地的法律差异也构成经贸壁垒、对商事主体、律师及政策制定者造成困惑、并增加了获取相关信息的成本，由此对两地经贸的稳定有序发展构成威胁。本课题针对目前研究上的空白，为相关人士提供清晰的法律比较指南。其主要内容为找出两地对共同问题的不同的法律解决方案并加以比较、分析其利弊得失、为两地决策者提供改革建议、提倡针对类似新冠疫情事件的最优合同商议及起草规范。本课题的研究成果预期将增强两地的相互了解和信任、提升各自竞争力及经贸纽带、优化两地相关法律决策，并为香港的律师、商事主体及政策制定者提供权威性的法律指南。本课题的研究将采用新颖的比较法和实在法的方法、因应当前全球格局发展的要求，并依托各调查人的专业背景和特长。

11609221.label: Project Objectives
11609221.value: To understand the role of gesture as a form of interactional competence in English L2 group interaction. To identify the forms, linguistic organizational properties, and discursive functions of gestures that support interactive language functions in English L2 group interaction, especially: disagreeing, agreeing, asking for opinions/information, challenging, supporting, modifying, persuading, developing, and negotiating meaning. To establish the first corpus-based typology of 'recurrent gestures' - form-function pairings whose usage remains relatively stable across speakers in a particular speech community - in this case in English L2 group interaction activities among Chinese students at a British university in China. To develop a multimodal model of interactional competence based on a view of language and interaction as fundamentally embodied, and likewise, to confront contemporary theories of gesture with empirical findings from the context of English L2 group interaction, where certain types of gestures have not yet been studied. To provide the theoretical and empirical basis for badly needed educational resources required to teach and assess the role of gesture as a form of Interactional Competence during English L2 group interaction, as currently assessed but poorly represented in the criteria of major national and corporate English language proficiency exams.

11609221.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11609221.value: Students of English as a second language may acquire excellent pronunciation, vocabulary, and grammar, but still lack basic skills needed to interact socially in groups, such as turn-taking, staying on topic, making eye-contact and gesturing, and negotiating communication breakdowns. These skills are essential to effective English language communication in a range of academic, professional, and social settings. Consequently, Interactional Competence is now taught and assessed on high stakes English language proficiency exams worldwide in the form of ‘group interaction’ activities. Group interaction activities are designed for students to present, challenge, support, and modify each other's ideas and opinions as they practice interacting socially in English. In addition to well-documented linguistic structures, students accomplish these interactive strategies with a vast array of embodied actions and gestures. The topic of gesture has gained increasing attention in the fields of second language acquisition and language testing, but our understanding of interactional competence remains insufficiently informed by the results of empirical research in gesture studies and multimodal interaction. Second language acquisition scholars have found that spontaneous and idiosyncratic gestures offer a window onto the collaborative learning process, however, the role of gestures that are known to routinely associate with certain pragmatic and interactive functions (often called 'recurrent gestures') have not yet been studied in the L2 group interaction format. This is despite such functions (a) being directly relevant to our understanding of the interactional competence construct and (b) having implications for teaching and assessing students' performance in L2 group interaction. Building on the work of a research team at City University of Hong Kong, this project will investigate the forms and functions of gesture in a twelve-hour multimodal corpus of advanced student group interactions recorded on the campus of a British university in China. The corpus will be processed and transcribed using software for multi-tiered analysis of naturally-occurring interaction data (ELAN). The spoken language transcriptions will be annotated for interactive language functions to provide the starting point for a data-driven analysis of gestures, which can be identified and analyzed following the Linguistic Annotation System for Gestures (LASG). The results will contribute detailed descriptions and micro-interactional analyses of gestures supporting interactional competence in L2 group interaction. The overall goal is to better understand students' gestures and develop a multimodal model of interactional competence, which will provide the basis for educational resources that will help students who might otherwise be destined for impoverished English language interactions. 以英語為第二語言學習的學生可能已經習得了出色的發音、詞匯的表達和語法的應用，但仍缺乏社交互動的基本技能，例如如何輪流發言、持續話題、眼神交流，運用手勢以及協商解決溝通障礙。這些技能對於學生在一系列學術、職場和其他社交場合中開展高效的英語語言交流至關重要。因此，現在全球範圍內有很多重要的英語語言能力考試，都會以“小組互動”的形式來教學和評估學生的互動能力。 小組互動的形式旨在讓學生練習如何在社交場合中用英語來提出自己的想法，在小組中與其他成員互相質疑、支持和修正彼此的想法和意見。除了許多文檔所記載的語言學結構外，學生還可以通過很多肢體語言和手勢來實現這些互動策略。“手勢”這一話題在二語習得和語言測試領域越來越受到關註，但目前我們對互動能力的理解仍然局限於手勢和多模態互動的實證研究的結果。盡管二語習得的學者們發現，自發和特殊的手勢可以為合作學習提供一個窗口，有關於小組互動中與某些常用的語用和互動功能相關聯的手勢（通常稱為“反復出現的手勢”）的研究。這些功能不僅 (a) 與我們對互動能力結構的理解直接相關，而且 (b) 影響學生在二語習得小組互動中的學習和考評表現。 本項目以香港城市大學一個研究團隊的工作為基礎，將在中國的一所中英合辦大學內研究高年級學生的小組互動手勢的形式和功能，並且會記錄在一個多模態語料庫中，一共有12小時的數據。該語料庫將使用一個名為ELAN的軟件來處理和轉錄師生自發互動的數據，以進行多維度分析。口語轉錄會根據互動中體現的語言功能進行註釋，從而為手勢數據驅動分析提供起點，同時能被手勢語言註釋系統 (LASG) 所識別和分析。該研究結果將有助於詳細說明手勢和從微互動角度分析手勢，以此提高二語學習小組中成員的互動能力。總體目標是更好地理解學生的手勢並開發出一個關於互動能力的多模態模型。這將為豐富教育資源提供基礎，幫助那些可能本身英語語言互動能力不足的學生。

11609321.label: Project Objectives
11609321.value: Cultural Transfer: To investigate ceramic craftsmanship, identifying ceramic craft methods, materials, and cultural context of artifacts in the collection of the UMAG for a transfer to 3D printing. We plan to interview ceramic artisans and the director of the UMAG, Dr. Florian Knothe, himself a scholar on Chinese Ceramics. Due to the current pandemic and reduction in funding, we will only work with local ceramic artists and thus will have a reduced amount of interviews. We aim to interview 2-3 Hong Kong based ceramicists. Digital Objects: To test and evaluate the fidelity of the developed 3D prints to transfer ceramic craft methods with a variety of gradually increasing geometrical complex 3D printed objects. We will demonstrate this through the design and fabrication of a series of 3D printed prototypes and document processes and results. We will retain the objective but will reduce the sample size and aim to work solely with SLA 3D printed substrates, reducing the complexity of various 3D print materials, not the museum objetcs. We feel that this limitation will still enable us to fulfill the objective while saving cost, due to the reduced funding. Digital Ceramics: To test and evaluate the fidelity of the developed Ceramic 3D printing tooling methods and thus to establish transfer protocols for tools and materials of the Chinese Ceramics. We will demonstrate this through the design and fabrication of a series of 3D printed prototypes based on the 3D scanned ceramics and document process and results. We retain this objective. However, we will focus on SLA 3D printed process with ceramic particles. We feel that extrusion-based clay printing will only increase cost, and not deliver new research. This is partially due to the limitations of extrusion-based clay printing and partially due to the reduction in funding. We are confident to deliver the research with the much more cutting-edge technology of ceramic SLA 3D printing. Comparative Conservation/Preservation: To comparatively analyze traditional craft knowledge and 3D printing as a method for innovation and active engagement in museology. This will be achieved through a public exhibition and symposium dissemination of the prototypes, and their making together with the original Chinese Ceramics. We will retain this objective. Interdisciplinary Research: To establish interdisciplinary research in the field of applied arts and ceramic crafts and digital design. This will be achieved through an invited symposium with guests from cultural heritage, material science, and ceramic artisans and museologists, resulting in an edited publication of the symposium. We will retain the objective. However, due to the global travel restrictions and the reduced budget, we will predominantly invite local artisans and experts in their respective fields.

11609321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11609321.value: 2018年7月，中國科學家成功在微重力環境下使用月塵對陶瓷進行3D打印——這延續了10000年以來中國陶瓷發展過程中對新材料，新工藝和技術創新的探索。 相反，在文物保護與保存的領域，3D打印不是用於創新，而是用於復原。根據文物原件的3D掃描數據，3D打印可以複製文物損毀的部分或者整件文物，但由此技術產生的物件往往因不能反映原作的獨創性而受到批評。如果僅作爲一種復原的技術，3D 打印目前似乎無法傳遞文物本身在材料和工藝上的本質屬性，例如工具標記、材料質感或鏽跡——而這些就是所謂的手工製作獨有的藝術風采。 不久之前，我們與香港大學美術博物館（UMAG）一同對陶瓷的釉料及其在3D打印表面上的應用進行了研究。這項研究的目的是探索如何將中國陶瓷的製造技術加以遷移，並如何與科學，歷史，文化和技術上的考量結合在一起，從而分析並發掘3D打印的原創性，進而將3D打印創新地融入到博物館館藏的運用和手工藝的技術中。 這項研究將基於對傳統陶瓷生產流程的分析和調整，闡述 3D 打印的新形式和材料的新表達。它包括對3D打印機的生產路徑加以修改，以及一種在傳統工藝品與3D打印物件之間進行遷移的新方式，即對傳統工藝品進行3D 掃描，從而將它們轉換爲3D模型，並最後利用3D打印時保留並展現這些工藝品的獨特性。這將允許我們將傳統工藝遷移到新的技術環境之中。我們將可以對UMAG的藏品進行3D掃描，並且建立數據庫，從而對其進行分析，並更進一步地運用其傳統工藝的質感進行新陶瓷的生產。 該研究將於 2021/22 年在 UMAG 公開展覽，並展示使用的開發工具、材料應用、設計方法和與館藏相關聯的新陶瓷產品。我們將舉辦一個學術研討會，匯集不同領域的研究人員、藝術家和設計師, 以及來自陶瓷藝術、材料科學、工藝和計算機輔助製造領域的嘉賓。我們將編輯研討會的記錄作為出版物，並在學術期刊上發表研究成果，充分實踐科技與藝術的結合。

11609321.label: Realisation of objectives
11609321.value: Objective 01 - Cultural Transfer: We have since the start of the project worked with Dr. Florian Knothe, Director of UMAG, to document traditional techniques and cultural contexts. Notably, ceramic artist MOK Hoi Ching has joined the laboratory as a PhD candidate under Professor Tobias Klein’s supervision, focusing on digital clay 3D printing. His embedded research enhances the project’s capacity for cultural documentation and technical innovation. Please see supplementary material for more information. . Objective 02 - Digital Objects: Contrary to the revised plan limiting fabrication to SLA, we expanded this objective by developing a novel dual-material clay 3D printer (Vector Clay Printer) with a nozzle-in-nozzle mechanism. This system enables the printing of geometrically complex objects using multiple clays, surpassing the initial SLA-only approach while still achieving cost efficiency. The Vector Clay Printer—a novel system featuring a nozzle-in-nozzle mechanism for multi-material extrusion enables unprecedented control over material deposition and surface patterning, surpassing the limitations of SLA. Technical details are documented in the supplementary materials. Please see supplementary material for more information. . Objective 03 - Digital Ceramics: We pivoted from the planned SLA focus to extrusion-based printing by developing the Vector Clay Printer. The Vector Clay Printer represents a significant evolution beyond the revised objective. Its concentric extrusion system facilitates multi-material capabilities (e.g., graded textures, encapsulation), effectively addressing the core aim of material/tool transfer. This innovation supplants the initial SLA-focused approach, as substantiated in the supplementary documentation. This system establishes new protocols for transferring traditional ceramic methods through multi-material capabilities, documented in our SIGGRAPH 2025 paper and supplementary materials. Please see supplementary material for more information. . Objective 04 - Comparative Conservation/Preservation: While the planned symposium was not held, we disseminated our research via SIGGRAPH 2025's Emergent Technologies. This international forum will demonstrate the printer’s capabilities to a global audience, fulfilling the objective through scholarly dissemination and contextualizing conservation within digital fabrication discourse. Please see supplementary material for more information. Objective 05 - Interdisciplinary Research: While the symposium was unrealized, interdisciplinarity was embedded in the project’s structure. The team spans physics (Prof. Cassinelli), architecture/robotics (Prof. Leung), and ceramic arts (MOK Hoi Ching). This convergence enabled the Vector Clay Printer’s patent-pending technology. The SIGGRAPH 2025 acceptance (paper and demonstration) delivers peer-reviewed, globally accessible outcomes that transcend the initial publication format, validating the objective’s core intent. Additionally, the conference contribution at ISEA 2025, together with Daniel Stempfer is a direct result of the research into multi-nozzle printer set-ups. Please see supplementary material for more information. . Summary of Evolved Outcomes The project’s trajectory demonstrates adaptive scholarship through: 1. Methodological Shift: Initial SLA focus was superseded by extrusion-based innovation (Vector Clay Printer), yielding higher-impact outputs. 2. Strategic Dissemination: SIGGRAPH 2025 and ISEA 2025 replaces local symposia, amplifying reach within international academic/industrial networks. 3. Interdisciplinary Integration: Cross-domain collaboration (physics/architecture/ceramics) enabled patentable advances in ceramic Additive Manufacturing. 4.Cultural Synthesis: The PhD research by MOK bridges traditional craftsmanship and technical Research and Development and is a direct result of this research. . This reorientation achieves the objectives’ original intent while exceeding their scope through globally significant research outputs.

11609321.label: Major findings and research outcome
11609321.value: The main research result is the establishment of a Vector Clay Printer. This is an innovative 3D clay printing system featuring a dual-nozzle design where an inner nozzle moves within an outer nozzle. This steerable inner nozzle functions like a precision joystick, allowing artists to control material placement during printing. It can hide one clay completely inside another or create intentional surface patterns—such as smooth color transitions or sharp geometric contrasts—directly in the printing process. The nozzle’s movement also mixes materials during extrusion, strengthening the final ceramic structure. Two practical versions were developed: one with separate material containers and a streamlined model using layered reservoirs. This technology unlocks new creative possibilities, from artistic surface designs to functional ceramics with embedded channels for liquids or air, and even future applications like conductive ceramics for electronics. We have successfully handed in a paper to the world-leading Conference SIGGRAPH and have been accepted to be featured in August 2025 in Vancouver. After that, patents are in the planning with the Knowledge Transfer Office of City University of Hong Kong. This innovation directly advances our museum partnership with Dr. Florian Knothe at UMAG across several key objectives. First, for cultural transfer, the printer’s ability to replicate traditional surface patterns, like gradient effects seen in Qing Dynasty glazes from UMAG’s collection—creates a direct bridge between historical craftsmanship and digital fabrication. By using materials Dr. Knothe has documented, such as Dehua porcelain, we achieve authentic reproductions that honor cultural heritage. Second, regarding digital objects, the system’s precision allows us to print geometrically complex UMAG artifacts with integrated textures, surpassing conventional methods. For example, we can recreate lattice vases with embedded color motifs in a single print, eliminating post-processing. We have tested the research work in a small exhibition held with students of CityU at the University Museum and Art Gallery in 2024. Please see the full documentation of the outcomes in the supplementary materials.

11609321.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11609321.value: The Vector Clay Printer's SIGGRAPH 2025 debut showcases its capacity to expand ceramic artistry through unprecedented material control. Future work advances three pathways: First, substrate diversification explores porcelain slurries and glass composites to create hollow structures for lightweight architectural forms or specialized conservation storage. Second, patent development protects the nozzle mechanism while refining algorithms to automate pattern generation from museum artifact scans, democratizing historical motifs. Third, interdisciplinary integration embeds functional elements: conductive pathways enable touch-responsive museum displays, while graded translucency recreates Qing Dynasty lighting effects documented in UMAG collections. This trajectory transforms the technology into an artistic-conservation catalyst, where material innovations and intellectual property expand ceramic possibilities beyond traditional boundaries.

11609321.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11609321.value: We've developed a new kind of 3D clay printer called the Vector Clay Printer that works like a precision tool for artists. It has two nozzles - one inside the other - where the inner nozzle can be steered during printing, similar to how a joystick controls direction. This lets artists hide one clay inside another or create beautiful patterns like smooth color blends or sharp geometric designs right as the piece is being printed. The nozzle's movement also mixes the clays as it works, making stronger finished ceramics. We've built two practical versions: one with separate clay containers and a more compact model with layered reservoirs. This technology opens up exciting possibilities, from artistic surface designs to functional pieces with built-in channels for liquids, and could even lead to electronic ceramics in the future. Our work has been accepted to SIGGRAPH 2025, a top tech conference in Vancouver, and we're planning patents through City University of Hong Kong. We've also partnered with Dr. Florian Knothe at UMAG museum to recreate historical pieces like Qing Dynasty glazes using authentic materials.

11609621.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11609621.value: 口述影像通過對動作、肢體語言、場景環境及其他細節進行口頭描述，提供輔助服務,幫助視障人士使用視聽產品。口述影像可在劇院由專業人員現場即時提供，也可預先錄製，植入音像製品的聲軌中。近年來，口述影像研究越來越受到人們的關注。口述影像研究通常歸屬於視聽翻譯領域。在翻譯和口述影像研究者通常會對比原文和譯文，比較不同版本的譯文，以及分析跨模態的意義轉換。研究發現，口述影像員和專業翻譯人員非常相似， 因為兩者都必須精通他們所從事的領域、相關概念及相對應的詞、技巧、語言、以及客戶的需求和偏好。此外，口述影像和口譯之間有許多共同之處，例如，口述影像員和同聲傳譯在現場即時服務所提供的均為即時翻譯，口述影像訓練所培養的技能與口譯相似，兩者在質量評估中也有許多相似之處。 儘管越來越多的翻譯研究者開始探究口述影像所涉及的各種問題，但口述影像的學科地位仍不清晰。口述影像該在翻譯研究領域中佔有一席之地呢，還是說它鳩占鵲巢了？為了給口述影像研究描繪一個清晰的圖景，研究者將對過去20年的口述影像研究進行文獻計量分析。本研究將建立一個口述影像的期刊文獻資料庫。資料庫中文獻的選擇將依照以下標準：理論重要性、與口譯研究的相關性、地區覆蓋範圍、讀者規模以及期刊排名。研究者將分析這些文章，並從語言學、社會學、認識論或文化研究的角度厘清口述影像與翻譯研究及其他領域之間的關係。進行主題分析後，資料將生成主類別和子類別，各年各類別的文章分佈情況將展示出來，研究人員和研究背景的數據會統計出來。預計這些發現將呈現口述影像的研究現況，並將作為精確且全面的“地圖”為該領域的研究人員提供指導。

11609621.label: Realisation of objectives
11609621.value: This report formally documents the completion and major findings of the Project GRF No. 9043268 (or CityUHK 11609621), undertaken between 1 January 2022 and 30 December 2024. All major objectives outlined in the initial proposal have been satisfactorily addressed. This report provides a comprehensive overview of major findings. All the objectives have been achieved. Breakthroughs have been made in the research. Foremost, we constructed a comprehensive bibliometric database analyzing global audio description (AD) research from 2004 to 2022. Building on this foundation, the research pioneered the conceptualization of national AD capability by adapting and expanding the theoretical framework of national translation capacity, establishing evaluation pathways for AD capacity. Methodologically, the project implemented innovative data-driven approaches, leveraging AI and big data analytics, to quantify AD development across key dimensions (management, practice, dissemination, and development). This facilitated a groundbreaking empirical comparison between Mainland China and Hong Kong, revealing a 5:1 capability differential and identifying critical regional disparities in governance infrastructure and sectoral focus. Crucially, these analytical frameworks were applied to advance translator and interpreter training research. More and more researchers in Translation Studies (TS) have started to investigate various problems in audio description (AD). However, the role of AD is still unclear. In order to provide a clear picture of AD studies, I conduct a bibliometric review of the research on AD from 2004 to 2022. As of 2022, the majority of AD articles have been published in the TS field, and AD is mainly studied and discussed as a subordinate topic in TS. However, AD research in its nascent period was not recognized and claimed by scholars in a specific academic field. AD research papers were first published in 1996 in non-TS journals. Between 1996 and 2003, only five AD-related articles were published worldwide, and they were all published in non-TS journals. Since 2004, when AD came to prominence in the TS field, the cumulative total number of AD-related articles published in other fields is only 59. Between 2004 and 2022, the cumulative number of AD-related articles published in TS journals was approximately twice the number of AD-related articles in other fields combined. Thus, AD research is largely concentrated in the field of TS, and TS scholars have made the greatest contribution to AD research. This situation inspired our examination of the development and state of AD in TS through a bibliometric review of the research on AD from 2004 to 2022. The thematic research map shows the four major dimensions of AD studies in TS. The distribution of the primary category of studies leans toward AD practice. The product category received the most attention from scholars in the sample period, with research focuses including content selection, description strategies, description styles, sound, and linguistic features of scripts. Reception studies of AD serve as an important tool for collecting users’ feedback and understanding how visually impaired people (VIP) react to AD service. By investigating receptors’ emotional engagement, experience, and accessibility quality, scholars attempt to determine users’ various preferences concerning the AD product, such as its vocal delivery, description style, and content. However, compared with the previous two sub-categories, research on the production progress of AD takes up the smallest proportion. AD training is another category particularly worth noting. AD training has been incorporated into interpreting courses in many universities in recent years (Matamala & Orero, 2007; Remael & Vercauteren, 2010). Students have acknowledged that training audio describers improves their interpreting ability (Yan & Luo, 2022). As AD courses are offered by only a few academic institutions, mainly at the postgraduate level (Fryer, 2016), the possibility of accessing such training is restricted by limited pedagogical praxis. However, the didactic potential of AD should not be ignored, as it better prepares students for their future careers. The author analysis shows that co-authorship is slightly dominant over single authorship. This is especially evident in articles categorized in AD practice and AD training, whereas the numbers of single authored and coauthored articles are the same in the other two categories. This shows that AD researchers need to collaborate with other researchers when undertaking relatively practical AD projects or fulfilling pedagogical programs. The geographic analysis shows that Spain is the leading country in AD research, contributing 7 out of the 17 most active authors and 3 out of the 12 most active institutions in our database. The most productive institution, the Autonomous University of Barcelona, is also the leading university in each of the four sub-datasets. The review of the geographic distribution suggests that the major center for AD studies is Europe. There are also contributions from North American and South African researchers. Other regions, however, have not yet participated in researching AD in connection with TS. On top of that, I also explore and conceptualize the concept and evaluation pathways of national AD capacity. I quantitatively compare the development of AD services in Mainland China and Hong Kong, and demonstrate the feasibility of assessing national AD capability. The research findings indicate that Mainland China’s comprehensive AD capability exceeds that of Hong Kong by a factor of five. Mainland China leads in terms of the quantity of AD-related management, practice, dissemination, and development initiatives. While the proportional AD capabilities and industry maturity levels between the two regions are relatively well-matched, enabling potential collaboration to jointly enhance national AD capability. Both regions exhibit a severe deficiency in AD management capacity, with its proportion being notably low. The AD development capability ratio between the two regions is the second lowest. The proportion of AD-related academic publications by scholars is similar in both locations. Hong Kong’s highest proportional strength lies in the number of higher education institutions offering AD courses, with more universities integrating AD into their elective curricula. Practical capability constitutes the second-highest proportion within the comprehensive AD capability of both regions. Mainland China primarily focuses on providing AD for films, often offering multiple AD versions per film across diverse film genres, thereby expanding choices and empowering people with visual impairments. In contrast, Hong Kong pursues a balanced development of AD for film, theatre, museums, and sporting events. By publicly uploading AD audio tracks online, Hong Kong reduces barriers for people with visual impairments to participate in various activities, which also constitutes empowerment and contributes to strengthening national soft power. Dissemination capability represents the highest proportion within comprehensive AD capability, largely due to institutions’ effective use of social media for promotion. However, a significant portion of Mainland China’s AD-related social media posts originate from reposting accounts, posing copyright infringement risks and potentially hindering the overall development of the AD industry. Hong Kong’s AD social media posts, predominantly written in colloquial Cantonese, face challenges in effectively promoting Chinese culture internationally.

11609621.label: Major findings and research outcome
11609621.value: Major findings and research outcome: (400 words) 1) A database was built for journal articles on AD from 2004 to 2022. The selection of journals in the database used the following criteria: theoretical importance and relevance to interpreting research, geographical coverage and size of readership, and journal rankings. Here is the link to the database. https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sUDirrAK-HIE4bNGpj3P5jb7VUFFXLkc/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=116097795096377212797&rtpof=true&sd=true 2) In order to provide a clear picture of AD studies, the researchers conducted a bibliometric review of the research on AD. The articles were analyzed, and the relationship between AD, Translation Studies and other fields were identified from linguistic, sociological, epistemological or cultural perspectives. Based on thematic analysis of the data, categories and subcategories were generated, distribution of categories of articles each year were shown, and statistics of researchers and research background were generated. It is expected that the findings will provide a current overview of the studies in AD, which will serve as precise, comprehensive ‘maps’ to guide researchers in the field. An article is submitted to a top SSCI journal (Please refer to Item 2 in Part C_8), and international conferences (Please refer to Item 5, 9, 10, 12 &13) in Part C_9). Other studies on AD has been published in SSCI journals (Please refer to Item 4 & 5in Part C_8) 3) A further development of the present study is the identification of research methods on national audio description capability (NADC), and the some preliminary results on the NADC of Hong Kong and mainland China have been published in a top CSSCI journal (2025) (Shanghai Journal of Translators 上海翻译) (Please refer to Item 8 in Part C_8) and international conferences (Please refer to Item 8, 14 &15) in Part C_9) 4) The methods developed in this study have been applied in various studies with fruitful research outcomes in academic journals (Please refer to Item 1 in Part C_8) and international conferences (Please refer to Item 1-4, 6, 7) in Part C_9) 5) Various activities and training programs have been conducted (Item 1 to 9 in Part C_11) 6) Efforts have been made to compile a book on my audio description studies to be published this year (Please refer to Item 4 in Part C_8) and publish a book "IPA Guide for Visually Impaired Learners" (视障人士英语音标学习指南）， which were partially supported by this grant (Please refer to Item 3 in Part C_8) in order to complete the extra work from previous research projects.

11609621.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11609621.value: Building upon this project’s foundation, subsequent research will significantly expand the geographical and methodological scope. First, I will incorporate comparative AD capacity data from across Greater China and benchmark these against Western models (e.g., EU, US, UK). This cross-continental analysis will validate the universality of the national AD capability framework and reveal culturally specific accessibility pathways. Furthermore, while this project employed AI and big data methodologies to process a vast amount of collected data, it is inevitable that some data might have been missed. Future research will explore additional methods for cross-verification to minimize the possibility of omissions. Concurrently, the proven data-driven methodology developed here will be systematically adapted to investigate interpreter and translator training.

11609621.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11609621.value: Audio description (AD) provides accessibility service for people who are visually impaired by rendering images into words. More and more research in Translation Studies (TS) have started to investigate various problems in AD. However, the role of AD is still unclear. What is the position of AD in TS? In order to provide a clear picture of AD studies, the researcher conducted a bibliometric review of the research on AD from 2004 to 2022. A database of journal articles on AD were included. Based on thematic analysis of the data, categories and subcategories were generated, and statistics of researchers and research background were generated. AD practice, research and training have developed rapidly in Mainland China and Hong Kong. However, their discussions of AD often focus on the competence of individuals and institutions, few studies, if any, have measured and compared the broader AD capacity of the two regions. This study examines the overall capacity of AD in the two regions. The results contribute to the understanding of AD development gaps between the two regions in the hope that AD could be developed according to the advantages and disadvantages to enhance national strength and global influence.

11609821.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11609821.value: 評估改良版WELLFOCUS及CBSST-SCIT綜合治療的成效

11609821.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11609821.value: Dr Chiang, Chung Lim Vico Mr Chu, Hon Wai Prof Mo, Phoenix Kit-han Prof Wong, Daniel Fu Keung Prof YOUNG, Kim-Wan, Daniel

11609821.label: Project Objectives
11609821.value: To develop and evaluate an enhanced WELLFOCUS positive psychotherapy PPT (adding elements of meaning centered therapy to WELLFOCUS) and a hybrid CBSST-SCIT intervention (integrating Cognitive Behavioral Social Skills Training and Social Cognition and Interaction Training) for people with schizophrenia in half way houses in Hong Kong. Schizophrenia is a mental disorder that impacts individuals, family, and society. There is limited number of locally validated interventions that comprehensively target various psychosocial domains essential for the recovery of people with schizophrenia (PWS). In Hong Kong, WELLFOCUS and SCIT have been piloted to PWS in hospitals. However, the sampled used in those studies was small and the studies only involved quantitative analyses. Assessment was only conducted in pre-and post-intervention, while no maintenance effect was assessed. No studies have been conducted for PWS in half way houses (HWHs). Hence, we will enhance two existing psychotherapies: WELLFOCUS Positive Psychotherapy (PPT) that is more positive psychology oriented, SCIT that is more recovery oriented; and develop two modified interventions: an enhanced WELLFOCUS PPT (adding elements of meaning-centered therapy), and a hybrid CBSST-SCIT intervention (integrating CBSST with SCIT) and examine its effectiveness for PWS. To examine the effectiveness of the enhanced WELLFOCUS PPT in improving primary outcomes (self-efficacy and perceived personal meaning) and increasing secondary outcomes (quality of life, wellbeing, recovery) for people with schizophrenia in half way houses. Deficits in the ability to make sense of the experience of self and to create a coherent narrative are found to impede recovery of PWS. Adopting a positive psychology and strength-oriented approach, WELLFOCUS focuses on a positive identity for recovery that emphasizes values, strengths and resources. However, PWS also show deficits in meaning making, which has not been emphasized in WELLFOCUS. To fill this gap, meaning centered therapy (based on existential theory) can help PWS to develop new insights through self-narratives, ascribe a new meaning to their illness, and develop their purpose in life. Its effectiveness on PWS will be examined by a randomized waitlist- control trial. The primary outcome variables are self-efficacy and perceived personal meaning, while the secondary outcome variables are recovery, wellbeing, and quality of life. To examine the effectiveness of the hybrid CBSST-SCIT intervention in improving primary outcomes (communication skills, emotion perception, social cognition) and increasing secondary outcomes (quality of life, wellbeing, recovery) for people with schizophrenia in half way houses. Schizophrenia is a mental disorder that alters a person’s social cognition and communication skills, thus aggravating individuals’ interpersonal relationship and social functioning. Adopting a recovery approach, SCIT (based on social cognitive theory) was developed to address deficits in social cognition. Based on cognitive behavioral therapy and social skills training, CBSST was developed to address social communication skill deficits. As SCIT focuses more on the “receiving” and “processing” social functioning stages, while CBSST emphasizes more on the “sending” stage, the two interventions are integrated to form a hybrid CBSST-SCIT intervention. Its effectiveness on PWS will be examined by a randomized waitlist-control trial. The primary outcome variables are communication skills, emotion perception, and social cognition, while the secondary outcome variables are recovery, wellbeing, and quality of life. To examine the mechanisms involved in the change in outcomes in the two modified interventions for people with schizophrenia in half way houses. This is addressed by a qualitative study that may contribute to mediation model building in the future. Understanding mechanism of change is important because this information not only suggests directions for optimizing treatment effects but also points out the critical features of the interventions that should be maintained. We adopt qualitative research to investigate mechanism of change because: (1) Qualitative research enables us to understand the participants’ feelings and thoughts during the intervention and explore the factors that are crucial for them to benefit from the intervention based on their first-person experiences. (2) This is the first study to examine the effectiveness of two innovative programs, thus there is not sufficient evidence to build up the mediation model to be tested by quantitative methods. Significance: Knowledge and skills can be transferred from the research team to the healthcare professionals. The validated interventions can be incorporated as routine activities in half way houses to facilitate recovery of PWS. The interventions can be translated into English and uploaded to the websites so that they benefit PWS all over the world. As PWS improve and recover, more places in hospitals and half way houses can be freed up for those in waiting lists, thus decreasing medical and welfare costs in the long run. With evidence accumulated regarding the intervention effectiveness, we can urge the Government to promote recovery and positive psychology oriented interventions for PWS that supplement and enhance the medical approach. It also facilitates a paradigm shift from a medical, problem-focused orientation to a recovery, strength-based positive psychological orientation that emphasizes on the recovery and wellbeing of PWS.

It also facilitates a paradigm shift from a medical, problem-focused orientation to a recovery, strength-based positive psychological orientation that emphasizes on the recovery and wellbeing of PWS.

11609921.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11609921.value: 元代南方醫者與地方社會

11609921.label: Project Objectives
11609921.value: 本計畫探討元代南方醫者與地方社會關係，這是元代醫學史尚未開墾的課題。 本計畫研究南方醫者參與社會事務的動機、方式和帶來的影響，並以建置三皇廟、地方建設 、與地方政府關係為討論中心。 本計畫分析元代中央和地方制度與醫者參與地方事務關係，特別是地方縣政、監察制度、財 政制度、醫學教育制度，以及元廷對南方的政策。 本計畫採用個案方式，深入分析元代南方醫者的社會網絡，包括儒者、地方官員。醫者在社 會活動及其對地方事務參與，是理解醫者地位及其在社會上角色的重要途徑。 本計畫將元代南方醫者置入元代對南方地區統治歷史大背景下去考察。元滅南宋後，原屬南宋領土成為元朝一個部分。從元廷對南方醫者吸納與管理，透視元廷對南方地區的管治方式，並與已有關研究成果相對比，分析元廷對待南人政策。再進一步，由此窺探一個更大課題：南方地區如何整合於元帝國。

11610021.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11610021.value: 不健康的民粹主義：COVID-19 在東南亞

11610021.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11610021.value: Dr Thomas, Nicholas David Prof Thompson, Mark Richard

11610021.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11610021.value: 擁有有效機構、強大的國家能力和民主政治制度的國家通常被認為更有能力管理突發公共衛生事件。然而，COVID-19在東南亞的經驗表明，只關注政權類型和機構能力是有問題的。越南等低收入專制國家一直是成功的案例，而擁有民主制度的國家（例如印尼）或功能強大的官僚機構（例如新加坡）則一直在努力打破傳染模式。這些事實對任何政權類型本質上都更有能力管理流行病的論點提出了挑戰，並表明需要以新觀點來解釋對 COVID-19 的反應的跨國差異。 如果不是政權類型，那麼對 COVID-19 的反應變化的原因是什麼？在現有研究的基礎上，我們認為民粹主義言論削弱了一個國家有效應對公共衛生危機的能力。這種言辭塑造了國家和社會對 COVID-19 的反應。首先，民粹主義論述侵蝕了公眾對民主制度和（醫學）專家知識的信任。反科學主義和機構信任度下降損害了政府應對公共衛生挑戰的能力，因為它們破壞了社會對旨在遏制病毒傳播的政策措施的支持和遵守。其次，民粹主義會導致黨派兩極分化，從而破壞問責機制。兩極分化的選民不太可能因為現任政客表現不佳而懲罰他們，從而使政客們可以輕視健康危機的嚴重性或將責任推卸給政治對手。這降低了各個參與者實施嚴格政策的積極性，從而損害了公共衛生。 因此，我們將關注民粹主義政治可能加劇傳染病爆發影響的關鍵機制。憑藉該研究團隊在公共衛生、調查方法、民粹主義和東南亞政治方面的專業知識，我們將在政權類型、民粹主義政治程度和對COVID-19 的政策反應差異很大的六個國家（印尼、菲律賓、新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國和越南）調查上述論點的有效性。我們將開展大規模調查，理清民粹主義態度和對大流行病的看法之間的關係，並通過對衛生官員和其他知情受訪者的定性訪談對調查資料進行三角測量。 該專案將通過闡明一般政治動態，特別是民粹主義在制定應對傳染病的社會和公共政策方面的作用，為我們理解東南亞及其他地區的公共衛生治理做出實質性貢獻。

11611021.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11611021.value: 平衡威权创新和问责制：中国专利知识产权保护双轨实证(1986-2020)

11611021.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11611021.value: Dr Chen, Shi Dr Ding, Waverly

11611021.label: Project Objectives
11611021.value: To survey the landscape of patent invalidation requests and administrative adjudication decisions by China’s National Intellectual Property Administration (CNIPA) from 1987 to 2020. Patent invalidation request and review is an administrative procedure to protect patent intellectual property rights in China. By collecting all decision documents issued by CNIPA’s Patent Review Adjudication Board (PRAB) from 1987 to 2020, we will explore the landscape of patent invalidation requests and the PRAB’s decisions over years, and gauge the capacity of institutional protection of innovation in China’s national innovation system. To contour the outlook of patent-invalidation-related administrative litigation against Patent Review Adjudication Board (PRAB) from 2013 to 2020. Administrative lawsuits against the PRAB is a legal mechanism to hold the PRAB accountable in reviewing patent validity. We match the administrative adjudication decisions by PRAB (in objective 1) with the administrative litigation decisions by courts, aiming to investigate if the courts can hold administrative agencies accountable and what factors have contributed to the courts’ decisions. To minimize the impacts of the missing data problem before 2013, we focus on the matched cases between 2013 and 2020. To create map of patentees’ features, patent quality, patent technological fields and the results of the PRAB’s decisions on patent validity. By matching these factors, we aim to identify patterns of patent invalidation requests and to investigate what factors shape the PRAB’s administrative review decisions. To match patentees’ features, patent quality, patent technological fields with the courts’ judiciary decisions on the administrative lawsuits against the PRAB. By matching these factors, we aim to investigate if and how the courts hold PRAB accountable. To investigate mechanisms that shape the dynamic between administrative and legal institutional infrastructure of patent IPR protection and its implications on China’s national innovation system and evolving innovation paradigms. China operates a dual-track patent IPR protection system: both administrative (patent invalidation procedure via PRAB) and legal (patent infringement litigation and administrative litigation against PRAB via courts). We focus on two sets of possible mechanisms that may have contoured such dual-track system: developmental economic protectionism and selective administrative accountability, as elaborated in the main text in detail. To discuss the implications on policies and regulations to enhance China’s IPR system and to improve quality-innovation in the coming wave of global technological competition. This study will offer unique and rich empirical data to help understand China’s path to improve its technological innovation system. Such evidence might stimulate another round of discussion and debate on China’s strategical planning in the coming waves of global technology competition and China’s future model of innovation and economic development.

11611021.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11611021.value: 为了推动创新成为未来经济增长的引擎，中国投入了大量资源来鼓励专利创新。截止2016年，中国专利申请量已超过美国、日本、韩国和欧洲的专利申请总和。与此同时，专利纠纷也急剧增加。从 2008 年到 2019 年，中国的专利诉讼增加了 343%，成为世界上知识产权诉讼最多的国家。乐观者认为，专利申请和侵权诉讼的增加，是中国在追赶技术领先者，加强知识产权保护；而悲观人士则将中国低质量的“专利泡沫”视为中国与技术领先者之间的差距正在扩大的表现。这个争论反映了专利知识产权保护的制度困境：低质量专利的纠纷可能会浪费社会的法律和制度资源，而高质量的专利可能会引发战略性专利诉讼。换言之，中国必须在发展创新型经济与构建国家创新体系的制度公平和问责制之间取得平衡。 为此，专利诉讼的实证研究呈增长趋势，特别是在 2013 年司法透明度改革使法院的裁判文书向公众开放之后。然而，中国实行专利知识产权保护双轨制，行政程序往往先行于法律救济。发生专利侵权诉讼时，当事人往往先向中国国家知识产权局提出专利无效请求。法院必须等待专利审查裁决委员会 (PRAB) 就争议专利的有效性做出决定后才能判决。因此，很大一部分专利纠纷要么通过行政机制解决，要么在它们甚至出现在诉讼数据库中之前就已解决。其次，并非所有的专利诉讼判决在中国都公开。中国法院在认为有必要时往往会拒绝做出某些专利诉讼决定。因此，对专利诉讼的单独调查即使有见地，也无法捕捉到专利纠纷的全部范围，也无法评估双轨专利知识产权制度的影响。 因此，本研究着眼于专利知识产权制度的行政法律二元性，通过分析过去 40 年专利审查裁决委员会对专利无效请求的行政裁决和相关行政诉讼的独特数据集，提出了衡量专利创新制度保护的新视角。通过将这两个数据集与争议专利的特征、涉及的争议主体的特征以及区域经济统计数据进行匹配，本研究旨在：1）探索影响中国专利有效性行政裁决的因素以及行政决定如何变化； 2) 调查行政机关是否作出公正的决定，以及司法审查是否可以追究行政官僚机构的责任； 3) 探讨这种行政法律双轨制对中国在全球竞争中的创新战略的影响。 上述调查对政策制定者和创新从业者来说意义重大。自从过去两年美国开始对中国科技公司施加压力以来，中国科技供应链面临的压力激发了对自主创新的渴望。在2020 年座谈会上，习近平敦促中国在下一个五年计划期间减少对外国技术的依赖，特别是对核心技术领域的依赖。中国能在多大程度上超越简单地向科学家投入资金以刺激创新，同时推动更健康、更广泛的国家创新环境对中国的未来至关重要。鉴于中国在全球发展和政治中的地位，我们的研究结果不仅有助于深入了解中国如何在创新道路上驾驭经济发展、官僚问责和司法公正，还将为各种政策制定者和利益相关者、外国和国内，在全球技术创新竞争中制定相关战略。

To examine whether and how auditor labor market mobility constraints imposed by NCCs affect audit quality and audit pricing. 11613721.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11613721.value: The audit industry is characterized by both high human-capital-intensity and high labor mobility. Audit firms have commonly used non-compete covenants (NCCs), i.e., employment contract provisions that prohibit departing employees from joining or forming a competing firm. In fact, the usage of NCC in audit firms is a particularly relevant issue nowadays given the COVID-19. A recent article in the Thomson Reuters Westlaw Today entitled "Employees Laid Off As A Result Of COVID-19 Ask Courts To Find Their Non-Compete Agreements Unenforceable" directly reports an exemplary case. Kyle Blessinger, a certified public accountant, filed a lawsuit on June 18, 2020, against his former employer Wipfli, LLP, a large audit firm. He is seeking a declaratory judgment that the non-competition and non-solicitation covenants he signed are invalid and unenforceable under Montana law and public policy. NCCs have been widely used in the United States, especially among skilled and highly-paid workers. However, the enforceability of NCCs is governed by state laws and thus may vary across states and over time. For instance, while California virtually bans the enforcement of NCCs, Florida allows NCCs to be easily and broadly enforced. Extant research examining the effects of NCCs mainly focuses on the CEO labor market, although other labor markets, such as financial advisor, mutual fund manager, physician, and technician labor markets have been investigated also. However, research on the impacts of NCCs is still lacking in the accounting literature. The review article by Lennox and Wu (2018) explicitly suggests that a study on the question “What are the effects of non-compete clauses?” could be a fruitful avenue of research. To fill the gap and answer the call from Lennox and Wu (2018), this proposal examines whether and how auditor labor market mobility constraints imposed by NCCs affect a range of issues pertinent in the audit industry: i.e., the audit client poaching, audit market structure, audit quality, and audit pricing. Specifically, our research adopts a generalized difference-in-differences approach by exploiting the staggered state-level exogenous changes in NCCs enforceability from 2000 to 2020, recently collated by Ewens and Marx (2018). This project could enrich the archival audit research on how supply-side factors determine the audit quality (DeFond and Zhang, 2014). Furthermore, this project adds to the growing literature on the effects of NCCs. Finally, the results can provide novel insights into the costs and benefits of NCCs, and valuable guidance to audit practitioners in the U.S. and Hong Kong. 审计行业的特点是人力资本密集度高，劳动力流动性大。审计公司通常使用竞业禁止契约 (NCC)，即禁止离职员工加入或组建竞争公司的雇佣合同条款。事实上，自新冠疫情以来，在审计公司中使用 NCC 是一个特别相关的问题。 Thomson Reuters Westlaw Today 最近发表的一篇题​​为“员工因 COVID-19 被解雇要求法院认定其竞业禁止协议无法执行”的文章直接报道了一个典型案例。注册会计师凯尔·布莱辛格 (Kyle Blessinger) 于 2020 年 6 月 18 日对其前雇主大型审计事务所 Wipfli, LLP 提起诉讼。他正在寻求一项宣告性判决，即根据蒙大拿州法律和公共政策，他签署的非竞争和非招揽契约无效且不可执行。 NCC 在美国已被广泛使用，尤其是在技术熟练和高薪的工人中。但是，NCC 的可执行性受州法律管辖，因此可能因州和时间而异。例如，虽然加利福尼亚实际上禁止执行 NCC，但佛罗里达允许 NCC 轻松而广泛地执行。现有的关于 NCC 影响的研究主要集中在 CEO 劳动力市场上，尽管也对其他劳动力市场，如财务顾问、共同基金经理、医生和技术人员劳动力市场进行了分析。然而，在会计文献中仍然缺乏对 NCC 影响的研究。 Lennox 和 Wu (2018) 的评论文章明确建议对“竞业禁止条款的影响是什么？”这一问题进行研究。可能是一个富有成效的研究途径。为了填补空白并响应 Lennox 和 Wu（2018 年）的呼吁，本提案研究 NCC 施加的审计师劳动力市场流动性限制是否以及如何影响审计行业的一系列相关问题：即审计客户挖角、审计市场结构、审计质量和审计定价。具体而言，我们的研究通过利用 2000 年至 2020 年 NCC 可执行性的交错国家级外生变化，采用了广义的差异化方法，最近由 Ewens 和 Marx（2018 年）整理。该项目可以丰富关于供给侧因素如何决定审计质量的档案审计研究（DeFond and Zhang，2014）。此外，该项目增加了关于 NCC 影响的越来越多的文献。最后，结果可以为 NCC 的成本和收益提供新的见解，并为美国和香港的审计从业人员提供宝贵的指导。

To investigate the biocompatibility of UCNPs in vivo

12100121.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12100121.value: The main objective of this proposal is to develop a minimally invasive method to stimulate selective neuropathways located within the motor cortices. We intend to use a non electrical, non electromagnetic, and non electrode-based implantation approach to depolarize targeted neurons in the motor cortices. We have three objectives. First, we intend to replace a conventional approach to emit visible light by stimulating dye-sensitized upconversion nanoparticles (UCNPs) using our Near Infrared - Light Emitting Diodes (NIR-LED) illumination system with a broadband excitation wavelength range (800 nm). We will optimize the visible light emission of newly engineered upconversion nanoparticles in order to activate light sensitive ion channels, Channelrhodopsin-2 (ChR2), in transfected neuropathways. In addition, UCNPs will be modified and will be up taken by ChR2 expressing neurons through endocytosis. The endocytosed nanoparticles will be in much closer proximity to the membrane bound ChR2s, which enhances energy transfer efficiency between the UCNPs and ChR2s. Hence, less NIR irradiation power is sufficient to drive the neural activities. Second, we will investigate the biocompatibility of transplanted UCNPs and NIR-LED illumination system. Third, the feasibility and efficacy of UCNPs - NIR-LED system to activate specific ChR2-transfected cortical motor-neurons will be investigated in an in vivo rodent model. To this end, a miniaturized NIR-LED irradiation system will be implanted on the skull of rats for activation of UCNPs-ChR2. We hypothesize that a minimally invasive NIR-LED illumination approach can be used to depolarize selective cortical motor-neurons with spatiotemporal precision, using our innovative UCNPs adjacent to ChR2s. This will also provide us with a powerful tool to target deeper neural pathways in the brain selectively. The novelty of our proposal lies in the construct of an advanced generation of UCNPs. The significance of this project lies in our ability to selectively and semi-invasively depolarize and induce action potential in neurons located in motor cortices. This presents a powerful tool for functional recovery and it could be exploited for rehabilitation and improvement of motor behavior. This technology also has the potential for further development and future applications, for example, in the deeper structure of central, peripheral and visceral nervous systems for neuromodulation. The application of UCNPs – NIR-LED will enable safer access to regions beyond conventional intervention such as invasive electrode implantation and electrical or electromagnetic based stimulation. Success in this proposal will pave the way for scientists and physicians in diverse fields of Neuroscience and Neuromodulation.

12100221.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12100221.value: 惡性黑色素瘤是最致命的癌症之一。大約一半的黑色素瘤患者攜帶BRAF（V600E；第600位的缬氨酸被谷氨酸取代）突變。用選擇性BRAF(V600E)抑制劑（BRAFi），如維羅非尼，治療BRAF（V600E）突變的黑色素瘤有很好的效果，但是大部分患者8個月內對治療產生耐藥。E3泛素-蛋白連接酶RNF125是泛素蛋白酶體系統的一個組成成分。它的過度表達已被證明可以減緩BRAFi耐藥黑色素瘤細胞的生長。從人類蛋白圖譜中檢索RNF125的TCGA數據顯示，RNF125表達水平較高的黑色素瘤患者生存時間更長。因此，上調RNF125是治療BRAFi耐藥黑色素瘤的一種潛在策略。然而，目前尚無關於RNF125上調劑的報導。中草藥和多靶點天然黃酮類化合物在抗耐藥性方面具有優勢。通過篩選，我們發現木犀草素(一種天然的黃酮)降低了獲得性維羅非尼耐藥黑色素瘤細胞A375- VR和Colo829- VR的存活率，並誘導細胞凋亡。重要的是，木犀草素的預防性給藥可顯著抑制小鼠A375-VR腫瘤的生長，而不影響小鼠體重。並且，木犀草素還能延長荷A375-VR黑色素瘤小鼠的生存期。為了解木犀草素克服維羅非尼耐藥的機制，我們進行了RNA-seq分析，發現在A375- VR細胞中RNF125的mRNA水平比在不耐藥的A375黑色素瘤細胞中低，而木犀草素消除了伴隨耐藥的RNF125下調。我們還發現，與A375細胞相比，多個RNF125下游基因的mRNA水平在A375- VR細胞中發生了改變，而木犀草素逆轉了大部分基因的改變。RNA-seq的結果已通過RT-qPCR驗證。並且，木犀草素能夠上調A375-VR細胞和小鼠A375-VR異種移植瘤中RNF125的蛋白水平。因此，我們假設木犀草素通過上調RNF125表達來克服黑色素瘤對維羅非尼的耐藥。本研究的目的如下： 1) 在荷黑色素瘤小鼠模型上確認木犀草素克服維羅非尼耐藥的作用，並監測木犀草素的毒性; 2) 建立RNF125在木犀草素克服黑色素瘤細胞對維羅非尼耐藥中的角色; 和 3) 確定木犀草素是否能克服黑色素瘤細胞對其它BRAF(V600E)靶向治療藥物耐藥。 本研究將首次證明木犀草素通過，至少部分通過，上調BRAF(V600E)突變型黑色素瘤中的RNF125表達以克服維羅非尼耐藥; 並首次證明用藥物上調RNF125是治療BRAFi耐藥黑色素瘤的一種策略。這一貢獻將是重要的，因為它是系統研究的一個步驟，它將促進開發木犀草素和其它可能的RNF125上調劑作為治療BRAFi耐藥黑色素瘤的新藥物。
