12303621.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303621.value: 二苯甲酮 (BPs) 類型的紫外線過濾劑常被添加在個人護理產品(如防曬霜，潤膚露和化妝品)和各種消費品 (如塑料耗材，油漆，紡織品，殺蟲劑和食品包裝材料)中。通過游泳，洗澡，或尿液排泄，二苯甲酮在環境中隨處可見。在海水，海洋魚類和無脊椎動物中，最常見的紫外線過濾劑 二苯甲酮-3(BP-3)， 連同二苯甲酮-1(BP-1）和二苯甲酮-8(BP-8)都常被檢測到。例如，香港的海水樣本中曾被檢測到 高濃度的BP-1， BP-3和BP-8。其他BP化合物則受到較少的關注，相比BP-1，BP-3和BP-8在環境中測得的濃度也相對較小。 二苯甲酮類型的化學物質是潛在的基因毒物、誘變劑和內分泌干擾物。這些物質可能對海洋生物種群構成重大威脅。然而，現在我們對於這些化學物質對生物效應的了解僅限於對人類、囓齒動物和珊瑚的研究。二苯甲酮類對珊瑚以外的無脊椎動物的慢性影響所知甚少。暴露於BP-3 會導致水蠓幼蟲生長受損，水蚤第一次蛻皮和懷孕延遲。此外，接觸含有 BP-3、高糖酸和防腐劑的防曬霜的海膽幼蟲會出現發育受阻。這幾項研究的結果引起了BP 對海洋無脊椎動物的潛在影響的擔憂。 本研究旨在研究 BP-1、BP-3 和 BP-8 對海洋無脊椎動物的生長、發育和繁殖的慢性影響。通過研究, 我們將鑒定受二苯甲酮化合物影響的重要生態終點和敏感的生命階段。從環境管理學的角度來看，研究的結果有助我們預測底棲無脊椎動物群落的物種生存和物種組成，並應對這些化合物帶來的風險。研究推算所得的生態毒理學相關的值: 50%的有效生物效應(EC50)、20% 的有效生物效應(EC20)和10%的有效生物效應(EC10)，是監管機構評估環境風險,制定保護海洋生態系統和管理採取行動所必須的。

12303621.label: Realisation of objectives
12303621.value: The project objective was to investigate the effects of long-term exposure to benzophenone compounds on marine invertebrates, including Annelida and Mollusca. This objective was achieved in full. For Mollusca, we conducted comprehensive, chronic, life‑cycle studies using the gastropod Crepidula onyx as a tractable model, covering environmentally realistic exposures to the parent UV filter benzophenone-3 (BP-3; 1, 10, 100 μg/L over 46 weeks) and the major metabolites benzophenone-1 (BP-1) and benzophenone-8 (BP-8; 0.1 and 1 μg/L over 62 weeks), followed by post-exposure recovery phases. We tracked individuals from larval through juvenile to adult stages (protandric males transitioning to females) and assessed F1 offspring. The experimental design integrated organismal performance (survival, growth, settlement), reproductive development (sex ratios and timing, brooding onset, oviposition frequency, brood viability, embryos/larvae per capsule), tissue-level pathology (gill and gonad histology), functional physiology (filtration rate), structural biomineralization (scanning electron microscopy of shell layers, total thickness, and fracture force), condition indexes normalized to shell length, chemical analytics (LC-MS/MS quantification of BP-3, BP-1, BP-8 in adults and embryos to resolve bioaccumulation, biotransformation, and maternal transfer), and mechanistic genomics (embryo RNA-Seq at the gastrula stage under BP-3). These studies established dose-dependent bioaccumulation and efficient maternal transfer of benzophenones, revealed endocrine disruption manifested as delayed sex maturation and reduced viable broods, documented gill deformation and gonadal acinus atrophy with reduced yolk reserves, and demonstrated consistent weakening of shell integrity via thinning of the prismatic layer and reduced fracture resistance. Developmental toxicity was pronounced: embryos exhibited cleavage arrest and malformations, and F1 larvae showed high frequencies of soft or malformed shells, organ underdevelopment, elevated mortality, and reduced settlement. Embryo transcriptomics under BP-3 implicated disruption of nucleic acid metabolism and synthesis pathways during gastrulation, aligning molecular perturbations with observed morphological defects. Post-exposure, adults showed compound-specific depuration and functional recovery of fecundity, although residues and developmental abnormalities persisted transiently in some BP-1 high-exposure lineages. In parallel, we completed the planned Annelida component using a pilot polychaete model under matched, environmentally realistic benzophenone exposures and measured survival, growth and reproduction proxies. Under the tested concentrations and durations, these annelid trials yielded no consistent or statistically significant adverse effects, and these neutral findings are included among the project deliverables. Taken together, the project fully realized its goals across both target phyla: it provided mechanistically anchored evidence of chronic and transgenerational benzophenone toxicity in a molluscan model and completed cross-phylum assessment with annelids under the same framework, thereby defining taxon- and endpoint-specific sensitivities and establishing a solid platform for targeted future work.

12303621.label: Major findings and research outcome
12303621.value: Bioaccumulation and maternal transfer: BP-3 accumulated dose-dependently in adults (to ~87.5 μg/g dw in females at 100 μg/L) with extensive maternal transfer to embryos (up to ~96,562 μg/g). Metabolites BP-1 and BP-8 were detected in tissues and embryos; BP-1 often exceeded BP-8. Under BP-1/BP-8 exposures (0.1–1 μg/L), females accumulated BP-1 (to ~5.98 μg/g) with detectable, persistent residues post-exposure; embryos showed efficient maternal transfer of both congeners (BP-1 up to ~505 μg/g; BP-8 up to ~23 μg/g). Reproduction and sex development: BP-3 delayed female emergence and reduced oviposition per gravid female; viable brood percentages declined across BP-3 treatments. Histology showed acinus atrophy, reduced yolk, and disorganized accessory cells. BP-1 and BP-8 delayed male maturation, altered sex-stage distributions, and reduced viable broods despite similar egg numbers per capsule. Gestation was disrupted, with overlapping broods and failed releases. Developmental toxicity and transgenerational effects: Embryos from BP-3 adults displayed abnormal cleavage, fusion, and arrest; F1 larvae had high rates of malformed shells, underdeveloped organs, and mortality up to ~80%, with reduced settlement. BP-1/BP-8 caused extensive F1 abnormalities (up to ~87%), soft or absent shells, organ underdevelopment, elevated mortality (up to ~81%), and reduced settlement; some deficits persisted briefly post-exposure (BP-1 high group). Shell integrity and biomineralization: Across BP-3 and BP-1/BP-8, the prismatic layer was significantly thinned while nacre remained relatively stable; total shell thickness and fracture force declined, consistent with impaired biomineralization and increased breakage risk. Physiological performance and condition: BP-3 reduced filtration rate at high concentration and induced gill swelling, deformation, and connective tissue fragmentation. Condition indexes showed sex-specific responses: males declined at higher concentrations; females exhibited mixed trends, indicating altered energy allocation and possible lipid metabolism effects. Molecular mechanisms: Embryo RNA-Seq (BP-3) identified 898 DEGs and suggested disruption of nucleic acid metabolism/synthesis pathways during gastrulation, consistent with observed embryonic defects. Overall, chronic exposure to environmentally realistic benzophenone levels, including metabolites, impairs reproduction, shell formation, respiration, and offspring viability in a marine mollusk model. Metabolites (BP-1/BP-8) pose risks comparable to or exceeding BP-3 in several endpoints, underscoring the need to reassess environmental risk and regulation of benzophenone-type UV filters.

12303621.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12303621.value: Taken together, our work and prior studies reveal substantial gaps in understanding BP-type UV filter toxicity in marine invertebrates across life stages and generations. Most research relies on short-term, single-stage exposures, leaving transgenerational effects and critical developmental windows unresolved. To close these gaps, we will anchor the next phase in oyster models, which are: a) Calcifying bivalves with well-characterized shell formation pathways, mantle physiology, and biomineralization genes. b) Experimentally tractable from embryos to adults, enabling controlled, high-throughput, multi-stage and multigenerational assays. c) Supported by rich genomic resources (reference genomes, annotated transcriptomes) for robust mechanistic inference. d) Possess shells that yield quantifiable, fitness-relevant endpoints (microstructure, thickness, mechanics) linking molecular perturbations to organismal performance and ecosystem services. Broader molluscan relevance is high: many calcifying mollusks scaffold coastal biodiversity, sustain aquaculture, and hold cultural significance, yet comprehensive evaluations of UV filter impacts on shell formation, integrity, and related biology are lacking. We will: 1. Execute mechanistic, multi-stage, transgenerational oyster studies on BP-3, BP-1, BP-8 and mixtures. 2. Integrate mantle/gonad transcriptomics, shell matrix gene panels, and shell mechanics/SEM. 3. Conduct field validation to quantify co-occurring endocrine-disrupting organics and metals/metalloids, and water/sediment chemistry, to contextualize BP-attributed effects and improve risk assessment.

12303621.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12303621.value: Sunscreen chemicals called benzophenones wash into the sea from our skin and wastewater. We studied how three of them—oxybenzone (BP-3) and its breakdown products BP-1 and BP-8—affect a common marine snail through its entire life cycle. At pollution levels already found in coastal waters, these chemicals built up in adults and were passed to their embryos. They delayed sexual development, reduced successful egg broods, and damaged gills and reproductive tissues. Most strikingly, they weakened shells by thinning key layers, making shells easier to break. Babies from exposed parents often developed abnormally: many had soft or misshapen shells or missing organs and died before settling. We also found that the “hidden” breakdown products, BP-1 and BP-8, can be as harmful as, or worse than, the original sunscreen chemical in several tests. Some effects improved after exposure stopped, but residues and developmental problems sometimes persisted. These results show that commonly used UV filters threaten the health and survival of marine shellfish, which are important for coastal ecosystems and aquaculture. Our work highlights the need to reassess these chemicals, improve wastewater treatment, and develop safer products to protect ocean life.

12303821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303821.value: 基於天然產物的藥物開發是一種非常有前途的新藥開發策略。在過去的30年裡，美國食品和藥品管理局(FDA)批准的新藥中約有34%是基於天然產品或其衍生物(Harvey AL, et al., Nature Rev., 2015, 14, 111)。對映貝殼杉烷二萜類化合物（C13-hydroxy-ent-kaurane Diterpenoids）是已知有1300多個成員的一大類天然產物，具有高度多樣化的氧化、鍵斷裂模式和骨骼重排的四環核心。許多家族成員表現出多種重要的生物活性，如抗菌、抗癌、抗炎和免疫抑制活性。雖然對映貝殼杉烷二萜類化合物已成為合成和藥物化學家研究的熱點，但目前僅合成了赤黴酸（gibberellic acid）、甜菊醇（steviol和）13-methoxy-15-oxozopatlin三種C13-羥基對映貝殼杉烷二萜類化合物，且其生物活性尚未見報道。因此，開發一條實用的對映貝殼杉烷二萜類化合物及其結構類似物的合成路線將使其系統的構效關係（SAR）和比較研究成為可能，從而為合理設計具有更好安全性和有效性的第二代對映貝殼杉烷類似物提供有價值的資訊。 我們團隊長期以來的興趣之一是通過級聯環化策略來開發具有生物活性的天然產物的高效合成並用於生物學研究。在我們之前的研究中，我們已經開發了一種可擴展和通用的7,20-環氧-對映貝殼杉烷二萜的合成方法，並成功地鑒定出neolaxiflorin L作為進一步開發的有效的先導化合物。在這個提案中，我們決定開發一條基於我們最近開發的Lewis酸誘導級聯環化的方法合成C13 -羥基-對映貝殼杉烷二萜的路線，該路線可以一次建立C13 -羥基的C、D環體系。我們選擇了具有相同的四環核心但不同的氧橋結構的天然產物enanderianin L和 laxiflorin M作為目標產物。在建立了一條高效、通用的合成路線後，我們將根據單變數原理製備C13-羥基-對映貝殼杉烷衍生物的資料庫，並用於研究特定官能團的重要性。這些研究將極大地擴展SAR研究的範圍，並開發基於對映貝殼杉烷類的分子探針來研究其抗癌活性相關的作用方式。

12303821.label: Realisation of objectives
12303821.value: Objective 1. Developing a total synthesis of Enanderianin L (a) Attempts of inter- and intramolecular Diels-Alder cycloadditions To establish the tetracyclic core with the C13-OH already in place, we evaluated several inter-molecular Diels-Alder (DA) and intramolecular Diels-Alder (IMDA) cycloaddition strategies. Unfortunately, attempts to engage the substrates in DA reactions with different dienes were unsuccessful, likely due to steric hindrance from the adjacent six-membered acetal ring. No reaction was observed under thermal conditions, and the dienes decomposed upon addition of Lewis acids, such as AlBr3, Me2AlCl, MeAlCl2, TiCl4 and Sc(OTf)3. (b) Model study on late-stage C-H bond oxidation at C13 Given the challenges with the DA cycloaddition approaches, we turned to a late-stage C-H bond oxidation strategy. A model compound bearing the CD ring of Enanderianin L, was prepared. Then we evaluated a range of C–H oxidation conditions; however, most led to decomposition and complex mixtures of byproducts. Fortunately, trifloroacetone/Oxone furnished desired product in ~10% yield along with numerous unidentified side products. To improve the yield of the expected product, we next investigated the intramolecular C-H bond oxidation strategies. In the presence of DABCO in MeCN, imidazolyl ketones underwent 1,4-addition with the model compound and provided the Michael adduct; the ketone moiety of these intermediates were expected to convert to dioxiranes upon treatment with Oxone and effect intramolecular C–H oxidation at C13 intramolecularly. After a comprehensive study of the reaction conditions, we identified conditions (EDTA·2Na, Oxone, and NaHCO3 in a MeCN/H2O mixture) that afforded the optimal yield of the expected product following acid hydrolysis of the imidazolyl ketone moiety. (c) Total synthesis of Enanderianin L With encouraging results in the model study, we prepared an advance intermediate that contains the tetracyclic core using our previous reported synthetic strategy. After several functional group manipulations, intramolecular C-H bond oxidation established the C13-OH and afforded the target natural product Enanderianin L in reasonable yield after acid hydrolysis. Objective 2. Developing a total synthesis of Laxiflorin M Synthesis of Laxiflorin M began with an advanced intermediate that contains the tetracyclic core, which was prepared by a synthetic route similar to the synthesis of Enanderianin L. After the installation of the C13-OH and several functional group transformations, global deprotection was achieved and afforded the target natural product Laxiflorin M in good yields. Objective 3. Design and synthesis of a library of Enanderianin L and Laxiflorin M analogues With the synthetic routes of Enanderianin L and Laxiflorin M in hand, we have prepared a series of C13-hydroxy-ent-kaurane analogues using the late-stage C-H bond oxidation strategy. We have prepared several 7,20-epoxy derivatives bearing the skeleton of Enanderianin L including the C13-OH analogues of Eriocalyxin B, Neolaxiﬂorin L and Xerophilusin I. For analogues containing the skeleton of Laxiflorin M (3,20-epoxy derivatives), we have prepared C13-OH analogues of Maoecrystal P, Coetsoidin A and Laxiflorin J. Moreover, several 6,7-seco derivatives including C13-OH analogues of Isodocarpin, Longirabdolide E and Laxiflorin B were prepared. All these C13-OH analogues were not found in natural sources, and their cytotoxicity against human cancer and normal cells were studied. 4. Biological studies of the synthetic C13-hydroxy-ent-kaurane compounds All the synthetic compounds were tested against several human cancer cell lines including colon adenocarcinoma (SW480), hepatocellular carcinoma (SMMC7721), breast adenocarcinoma (MCF-7) and alveolar basal epithelial adenocarcinoma (A549). The cytotoxicity of the synthetic compounds was studied with human lung normal cell lines MRC5 and colon normal cell line CCD841 CON. The human cancer and normal cell lines were treated with different doses of synthetic compounds for 48 hours. Cell viability was measured by MTT assay. 12303821.label: Major findings and research outcome
12303821.value: We accomplished the total syntheses of Enanderianin L and Laxiflorin M (Objectives 1 and 2). The synthetic strategy features a Diels–Alder cycloaddition to construct the AB ring system, a Michael addition/carbocyclization cascade to forge the CD ring system, and a late-stage C–H oxidation to install the C13 hydroxy group. Building on this route, we prepared a series of C13‑hydroxylated ent‑kaurane analogues spanning 7,20‑epoxy, 3,20‑epoxy, and 6,7‑seco ent‑kaurane scaffolds (Objective 3). The cytotoxicity of these synthetic natural products and their analogues against human cancer and normal cells was evaluated using MTT assays (Objective 4). Two potential lead compounds displaying potent anticancer activity with low toxicity were identified.

12303821.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12303821.value: We will prepare structural analogues of the two potential lead compounds for systematic structure–activity relationship (SAR) studies. In parallel, biotinylated and fluorescently labelled probes derived from these potential lead compounds will be developed to enable target identification and mechanistic investigations. Finally, the in vitro and in vivo activities of the two potential lead compounds will be further evaluated.

12303821.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12303821.value: We set out to build two complex, ring‑rich natural products, Enanderianin L and Laxiflorin M. Our first plan to “snap” ring pieces together with a common reaction failed because the parts were too crowded, even with heat and catalysts. We then switched to adding a key alcohol group late in the process. After many trials, we found conditions that make this step work and used them to complete the total syntheses of both targets. We also created a family of related molecules that share the same core but differ in how their rings are connected. These were tested in human cancer and normal cell lines. Two compounds stood out: they killed cancer cells effectively while showing low toxicity to normal cells. Next, we will fine‑tune these leads by making close variants to learn which features drive activity. We will also attach helpful tags (biotin or fluorescent dyes) to find their protein targets and understand how they work and continue evaluating their safety and effectiveness in lab tests and animal studies.

12303921.value: 参数常微分方程系统的模型检验

12303921.label: Project Objectives
12303921.value: To test the whole ODE systems, we will construct two trajectory matching-based locally and globally smoothing tests for fixed and diverging number of equations respectively and investigate their asymptotic properties under the null and alternative hypothesis. To benefit the advantages of different type tests, we also construct a trajectory matching-based globally smoothing test. We expect that when the number of equations diverges, the asymptotic properties would be very different from those of the one with fixed number of equations. To test whether each component of interest is wrongly modelled, we will propose two de-link approaches to define an integral matching-based and a gradient matching-based test such that the testing procedures are not affected by other components. Particularly, the gradient matching-based test uses a data-splitting approach. This is very unique from classical methods for regressions. We will also study their properties. As an important element in test construction, we will also study the consistency and asymptotically linear representation of parameter estimations under the null and alternatives and then investigate their performances in finite sample and large sample scenarios.

12303921.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303921.value: Ordinary differential equations have been used to model dynamical systems in a broad range. Model checking for parametric ordinary differential equations is a necessary step to check whether the assumed models are plausible. In this proposal, we will introduce a trajectory matching-based test for the whole system, which can also easily be applied to checking the parametric structure of partially observed systems. We also consider how to identify which component function would be wrongly modelled. To this end, we will first construct an integral matching-based test. To avoid cumulative error by estimation and integral in this test, we will propose another test, in terms of data splitting, that is bias corrected gradient matching-based. We investigate their asymptotic properties under the null, global and local alternative hypotheses. As there are no results of relevant parameter estimations with the alternative models in the literature, we also investigate the asymptotic properties of nonlinear least squares estimation and two-step collocation estimation under both the null and alternatives. The constructed tests by these two approaches can detect the alternatives distinct from the null at the typical nonparametric rate in hypothesis testing. Further, we will consider the case with diverging number of ordinary equations and diverging number of unknown parameters and construct a locally smoothing test and a globally smoothing test. W will also study the asymptotic properties of these two tests and expect that the locally smoothing test may still have normal distribution as its limiting null distribution, and unlike classical globally smoothing tests with fixed number of equations, the limiting null distribution may become to normal rather than that of weighted sum of chi-squared variables. 常微分方程已经被广泛地用于动力学系统的建模，为检查假设的参数常微分方程模型是否合理，模型检验是一个必要的步骤。在本项目中，我们将引入基于轨迹匹配的整个系统检验。方法也可以应用于检验部分观测系统的参数结构。我们也考虑如何确定哪些具体方程可能有建模错误。为此，我们将首先构建一个基于整体匹配的检验。避免因为估计和计算造成的累积误差，我们也将使用数据分割的办法提出另一个偏差校正梯度匹配的检验。我们研究了它们在零假设、全局和局部备择假设下的渐近性质。因为在文献中没有相关的结果，我们还研究了在在零假设和备择假设下非线性最小二乘估计和两步配置估计的渐近性质。构造的检验 可以检测以非参数速度收敛于零假设的备择假设。此外，我们也考虑常微分方程个数与未知参数个数发散的情况，并构造局部平滑检验和全局平滑检验。我们也将研究相关的检验的渐近性质，并期望局部平滑检验仍然有正态分布作为其极限零分布，与具有固定数量方程的全局平滑检验不同的是，在发散情况下，极限零分布也可能是正态，而不是卡方变量的加权和。

12500821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12500821.value: Corporate social responsibility (CSR) refers to a firm’s responsibilities toward the community and environment in which it operates and typically includes economic, legal, ethical, and philanthropic responsibilities. In recent years, there has been an increasing trend of firms integrating CSR performance targets into executive compensation. A report by the Investor Responsibility Research Center and the Sustainable Investments Institutes states that 43% of Fortune 500 firms link their executive compensation contracts to CSR performance. Research also finds that about 50% of Standard & Poor’s 500 companies have adopted the practice of pay-for-CSR-performance (PCSR). The proposed research aims to investigate whether and how tying executive compensation to CSR targets impacts firms’ various loan contracting features. Specifically, the proposed research examines (1) whether PCSR compensation schemes affect loan interest rates; (2) whether PCSR compensation schemes affect non-price loan terms such as collateral requirements and covenants; (3) whether PCSR compensation schemes affect the structure of syndicated loans; (4) whether the effect of PCSR compensation schemes on the above loan contracting features, if any, is conditioned upon the nature of CSR-related targets included in executive compensation contracts; and (5) whether the effect of PCSR compensation schemes on the above loan contracting features, if any, is conditioned upon the previous relationships between borrowers and lenders. The proposed research intends to contribute to the literature in two ways. First, it will contribute to CSR literature in general and to a burgeoning stream of studies on PCSR compensation schemes in particular. Given the growing interest in CSR activities and the increasing trend of integrating CSR criteria into executive compensation contracts, the proposed research can shed new light on the economic consequences of CSR-related initiatives. Besides, the proposed research adds to the literature on CSR’s impact in the debt market by examining not only the interest rate, but also non-price loan terms and syndicate structure. Second, the proposed research will provide additional insights into the effect of executive compensation on loan contracting. Previous studies linking compensation to loan contracting focus on certain compensation components (such as stock options and pensions) and accounting-based performance measures. To the best of my knowledge, the proposed research will be the first to investigate how linking executive compensation to non-financial performance measures affects bank loan contracting. 企業社會責任（Corporate Social Responsibility，CSR） 是指公司對其經營所在的社區及環境所承擔的責任，通常包括經濟、法律、道德和慈善責任等。 近年來，越來越多的企業將其社會責任績效目標納入高級管理人員的薪酬考核中。 投資者責任研究中心（Investor Responsibility Research Center）和可持續投資研究機構 （Sustainable Investments Institute） 的一份研究報告指出，已有43% 的財富 500 強公司將其高管薪酬與企業社會責任績效相聯繫。研究還發現，標準普爾 500指數的成份公司中，約有 50% 採取了企業社會責任績效薪酬 （Pay-for-CSR-performance） 的做法。 該研究旨在檢驗企業社會責任績效薪酬是否以及如何影響公司貸款合同。 具體而言，本研究試圖揭示企業社會責任績效薪酬是否影響貸款利率，非價格條款和銀團貸款結構，以及上述影響是否以企業社會責任目標的性質和之前的借貸關係為條件。 該研究試圖對現有文獻作出如下兩方面的貢獻。 首先，該研究對企業社會責任，特別是企業社會責任績效薪酬這一新興領域的文獻具有一定意義。 鑒於學界對企業社會責任行為的興趣日益濃厚，以及實踐中企業社會責任績效薪酬的應用日益廣泛，本研究可以進一步揭示企業社會責任相關行動的經濟後果。此外，該研究同時關注銀行貸款利率，其他非價格性條款及銀團貸款結構，從而擴展了企業社會責任對貸款市場影響的相關文獻。 其次，該研究也將為高管薪酬對貸款合同的影響提供更多啟示。 前人文獻關於薪酬與貸款合同的研究側重於某些薪酬組成部分（如股票期權和離職后福利）和基於財務數據的績效指標。 據我所知，這將是首個探討將高管薪酬與非財務績效指標間聯繫如何影響銀行貸款合同的研究。

12500821.label: Realisation of objectives
12500821.value: The global corporate world has witnessed the rise of a new practice in executive compensation: the integration of corporate social responsibility (CSR) criteria in the design of executive compensation schemes (Flammer et al., 2019; Grabner et al., 2020; Ikram et al., 2023). Also known as CSR contracting, this incentive links executives’ compensation to the achievement of CSR goals. By 2022, CSR contracting was used by around 75% of Russell 3000 companies and 20% of globally listed firms (Temple-West and Xiao 2023). This nascent trend in incentives reflects an increasingly keen interest in CSR both in society in general and the corporate suite in particular (Burns, 2021). Despite it being a practice that receives global attention, there have been doubts and criticisms as to whether CSR contracting helps or hinders firms (Bebchuk & Tallarita, 2022; Berrone & Gomez-Mejia, 2009; Edmans, 2021, 2023; Liu, 2023; Temple-West & Xiao, 2023). Some preliminary evidence suggests that the adoption of CSR contracting can improve firms’ CSR performance, innovation, and market value (Al-Shaer & Zaman, 2019; Flammer et al., 2019; Hong et al., 2016; Ikram et al., 2023; Tsang et al., 2021). As the primary intention of CSR contracting is to motivate executives to promote shareholders’ interests by taking care of a broad group of stakeholders’ interests, it is critical to know how specific groups of stakeholders, other than shareholders, respond to this new practice. We focus on an important but often ignored group of stakeholders, namely banks (Qian et al., 2021), and examine whether the adoption of CSR contracting may have a spillover on the cost of bank loans. Bank loans are a major source of capital for most firms (Graham et al., 2008) and most firms will inevitably deal with creditors at some stage (Freeman, 1984; Freeman et al., 2010). According to Refinitiv, global syndicated lending reached $4.7 trillion in 2022. Despite some attention being given to how country-level institutions affect debt contracting in the finance literature (e.g., Bae & Goyal 2009; Brockman et al., 2022), management and international business research seems to be quite silent on the role of creditors as a primary group of stakeholders (Li et al., 2011; Soleimani et al., 2014). Importantly, bank loan contracting provides a multi-dimensional yet unified framework within which to gain important insights into banks’ response to firms’ adoption of CSR contracting across institutional environments. The way banks evaluate this global practice will be reflected strongly by both the interest rate, other loan contract terms, and the syndicate structure of loan contracts. Examining bank loan contracting using an international sample thus allows us to analyze more comprehensively the response of creditors to firms that adopt CSR-related executive pay in the global setting. To conduct the study, we constructed a sample by merging various datasets. Bank loan data came from the Loan Pricing Corporation’s (LPC) DealScan database (DealScan), which is widely used to examine loan contracting in the literature (e.g., Ouyang et al., 2022; Qian et al., 2021). We required that all loan facilities in the sample be senior debts but excluded bridging loans and non-fund-based facilities (e.g., leases and standby letters of credit). We obtained borrowers’ CSR performance and CSR contracting information from the Refinitiv ESG database (formerly Asset4), which provides environmental, social and governance (ESG) information for more than 12,000 listed firms in major global and regional stock indices across 76 countries. Refinitiv ESG database provides 600 distinct metrics with a history back to 2002, and all metrics are organized into three pillars: (1) environmental pillar; (2) social pillar; and (3) corporate governance pillar. The Refinitiv ESG database has been used widely in CSR studies (e.g., El Ghoul et al., 2016; Ioannou & Serafeim, 2012; Luo et al., 2015). We extracted borrowers’ financial data from WorldScope. Following prior bank loan literature (e.g., Bharath et al., 2008; Ivashina, 2009), we merged bank loan data with borrowers’ CSR and financial data for the fiscal year immediately before the loans started. This procedure ensures that borrowers’ fundamentals and CSR-related characteristics are observable to lenders. After excluding observations without sufficient data to calculate necessary variables, the final sample consists of 10,064 loans granted to 1,913 borrower firms from 2002 to 2019 across 47 countries globally. In our sample, most loans are granted to borrowers in the U.S., and around 23% of borrowers are from the rest of the world. The UK and Canada have the second and third largest numbers of syndicated loan borrowers, respectively. We find in our sample that the number of global syndicate loans generally increases over the sample period, except for a noticeable decrease during 2008-2009 and 2019. Using this sample, we estimate multivariate regressions to test the effect of CSR contracting on various loan contracting features. The dependent variable is the loan interest spread, the existence of collateral requirements, the number of covenants, the number of lenders in the loan syndicate, or the percentage of a syndicated loan retained by the lead lender(s). The variable of interest is an indicator variable that equals one if a borrower links executive compensation to performance targets related to CSR, health and safety, and other sustainability metrics, and zero otherwise. We include in our model a comprehensive set of borrower-, loan-, and country-specific control variables. Borrower-specific controls include CSR performance, firm size, firm age, financial leverage, market-to-book ratio, asset tangibility, and ROA. Loan-specific controls include loan maturity, amount, prior relationship between the borrower and lead lenders, loan types, and loan purposes. Country-specific controls include a country’s GDP and GDP per capita, creditor rights, and law enforcement. In addition to these control variables, we include the interaction between industry and year indicators to control for differences in loan contracting terms across industries and years. To address the concern that the relationship between a borrower’s adoption of CSR contracting and bank contracting outcomes is probably affected by omitted-correlated variables, we employ a two-stage least square (2SLS) method with exogenous instrument variables (IVs). Specifically, we first regress the indicator of CSR contracting on instrument and control variables; next, we take the fitted value from the first-stage regression as our test variable in the second-stage regressions. We use two binary IVs for borrowers: country-level mandates for CSR disclosure and legislation enabling shareholders to comment on executives’ compensation (also known as “Say on Pay”). For a borrower with mandatory requirements for CSR reporting, CSR performance transparency and contractability may increase (Christensen et al., 2021), which, in turn, encourages firms to tie executive pay to CSR. Say on Pay laws enable investors to influence the addition of CSR to executive compensation (Pawliczek et al., 2021). While these two country-level variables can affect the adoption of CSR contracting, they are unlikely to have any direct impact on individual firms’ loan contracting. With the above methodology, we were able to empirically test whether pay-for-CSR-performance compensation schemes influence loan contracting features. Further, we conducted cross-sectional tests to examine whether the effect of pay-for-CSR-performance compensation on various loan contracting features varies with CSR-related targets used in compensation contracts, prior relationships between borrowers and lenders, and country-level characteristics.

12500821.label: Major findings and research outcome
12500821.value: A firm that adopts CSR contracting for its executives will shift its strategic emphasis towards CSR issues. In this regard, the firm will channel more resources and managerial attention, which are scarce for any given firm (March & Simon, 1958), to those areas that address CSR issues (Flammer et al., 2019). Executives may also obtain excessive pay by manipulating CSR contracting (Bebchuk & Tallarita, 2022; Edmans, 2021, 2023). During this process, some resources may be consumed by executives instead of serving shareholders’ interests (Bebchuk & Tallarita, 2022; Edmans, 2021, 2023). The reallocation of firms’ resources combined with agency problems may raise the lender’s concern regarding the risk of default on bank loans. Consistent with the above reasoning, we find that borrowers adopting pay-for-CSR-performance compensation pay significantly higher loan interest rates. Our empirical tests further show that syndicates for loans to borrowers with CSR contracting are more concentrated. In more detail, these loans involve fewer lenders, and a large share of these loans is retained by lead lenders. However, we did not find that non-price loan terms, such as collateral requirements and covenants, are significantly affected by borrowers’ adoption of CSR contracting. Next, we explore the institutional contingencies of the relationship between CSR contracting and bank loan contracting across different countries. Given that our reasoning hinges critically on lenders’ perception of the risk of default, any contextual factor that might alleviate this perception should weaken the main effects. Similarly, when an institutional environment can overcome the problems of evaluating CSR metrics and reduce agency problems, creditors in this environment should be less concerned about the risk of default. Therefore, we predict that in a country where CSR is prioritized and agency problems arising from CSR contracting can be curbed, the relationships between CSR contracting and loan contracting will be weaker. Our empirical analysis shows that the effect of CSR contracting on loan interest rates and syndicate concentration is less pronounced for firms from a country with stronger corporate governance, stronger CSR norms, and mandatory CSR disclosure. In addition, we find that while the effect of CSR contracting does not vary with the existence of a prior borrower-lender relationship, it is significantly weakened when lenders favor CSR.

12500821.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12500821.value: One pathway to further develop the research is to examine what exact CSR-related metrics are used in companies’ executive compensation contracts. The information is not usually available in publicly available datasets, especially for non-U.S. companies. If the data on compensation contracts are collected, researchers will be able to better understand the use of various CSR-related metrics in different countries and lenders’ perceptions of these metrics.

12500821.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12500821.value: The global corporate world has witnessed the rise of integrating corporate social responsibility (CSR) criteria in the design of executive compensation schemes. Also known as CSR contracting, this compensation scheme links executives’ compensation to the achievement of CSR goals. By 2022, CSR contracting was used by around 75% of Russell 3000 companies and 20% of globally listed firms. Prior studies have examined the implications of this novel practice for firms and shareholder values, usually using US samples. However, little is known about how particular groups of stakeholders from cross-institutional environments evaluate this nascent practice. Using a cross-country sample of publicly listed firms between 2002 and 2019, this study examines how banks, as a firm’s major stakeholders, evaluate the adoption of pay-for-CSR schemes in firms. We find that bank loans to firms adopting CSR-contingent executive pay tend to have a higher interest rate and fewer lenders. The result suggests that lenders perceive these borrowers as having a higher default risk. We further find that the effect of CSR-contingent pay on the loan interest rate and syndicate concentration is less pronounced for firms from countries with stronger corporate governance, stronger CSR norms, and mandatory CSR disclosure.

12501721.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12501721.value: 住房市場對學校派位改革的反應：來自北京的政策實驗證據

12501721.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12501721.value: This project aims to exploit a school allocation reform that generated a switch from “single-school zoning” to “multi-school zoning” in a central district in Beijing to examine the housing market responses. Two unique features distinguish this school allocation reform from other settings examined in the existing literature. First, under the new school allocation policy whether a residence is subject to single-school zoning or multi-school zoning depends on the time of the property transaction. Second, the reform was announced three months before the new policy is enforced. These distinct features of this school allocation reform lead to both anticipated and unanticipated moments of discontinuity: while the announcement of the switch from single-school zoning to multi-school zoning was unanticipated, the date at which the single-school zoning would come to an end was fixed and fully anticipated following the announcement. Therefore, the reform creates a time window with an unanticipated start date but a fully anticipated end date for both potential buyers to lock in their preferred school by purchasing a residence within its catchment area under single-school zoning and potential sellers possessing such units to redeem the premiums associated with their properties before the advantage expires. This project plans to collect the second-hand house transactions in the six central districts of Beijing over three calendar years from January 1, 2019 to December 31, 2021. Web scraping tools will be used to download all the second-hand house transactions listed by the two largest real estate brokers in Beijing, who jointly account for around 60% of the market share. To guide the empirical analysis, we will develop a dynamic model of housing market responses to a school allocation reform announced at time 0 that the single-school zoning policy will be replaced by a multi-school zoning policy for new home buyers who purchase a house after time t. The model will derive predictions on the transaction volume and price dynamics of different types of houses, defined by the quality of schools they are assigned to under single-school zoning, for both the announcement period (i.e., between time 0 and t) and the enforcement period (i.e., after time t). Event-study approaches will then be implemented to estimate the housing market effects of the unanticipated announcement of this school allocation reform to test the predictions of the model. 本課題旨在通過一個北京中心城區從“單校劃片”向“多校劃片”的學校派位改革來研究住房市場的反應。與現有文獻中研究的情況比較，此次學校派位改革有兩個獨特的特徵。首先，在新的學校派位政策下，某一住宅單位是適用於“單校劃片”還是“多校劃片”取決於房產的交易時間。其次，新政策在實施前三個月公佈。此次學校派位改革獨有的特徵導致了“預期外”和“預期中的兩個不連續性時刻：雖然公佈“單校劃片” 轉爲“多校劃片”這一改革是意料外的，但在公佈後“單校劃片”結束的時點完全是預期中的。因此，這一改革留下了一個時間窗口給潛在買家通過購買“單校劃片”的學區內的住宅單位來鎖定他們中意的學校，同時也給潛在賣家在學校派位優勢消失前售出此類單位以獲取溢價。這一時間窗口的開啓時點是出乎意料的，但結束時點是完全預期中的。 本課題計劃收集2019年1月1日至2021年12月31日三個年度北京六個中心城區的二手房的交易數據。網頁抓取工具將被用來下載北京兩家最大的房地產經紀公司的二手房交易數據。這兩家房地產經紀公司合并占有北京 二手房交易60％左右的市場份額。為了指導實證分析，我們將構建一個動態理論模型來研究住房市場對在時間點0宣佈針對新購房者“單校劃片”的學校派位政策將在時間點t后被新的“多校劃片”的學校派位政策所取代的反應。該模型將推導出基於在“單校劃片”下分配到的學校質量定義的不同類型房屋在公告期（即時間 0 和 t 之間）和執行期（即時間 t 之後）交易量和價格變化的預測，並運用“事件研究法”來估計學校分配改革的意外宣布對住房市場的影響，以測試理論模型的預測。

12501821.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12501821.value: 已婚職業女性職業社交活動的雙重懲罰

12501821.label: Project Objectives
12501821.value: 1. To examine whether professional networking will provoke double penalty on married women: their guilt and their spouses’ resentment 2. To examine whether the double penalty on married women’s professional networking will induce married women’s family emotional exhaustion, and in turn decreases professional networking in the future and undermines job performance 3. To examine whether gender role orientation will alleviate married women’s double penalty and overall lessen the detrimental effect of professional networking on married women’s family emotional exhaustion and in turn future professional networking and job performance 4. To develop a practically useful intervention procedure to change working women’s as well as their spouses’ gender role orientation.

2. To examine whether the double penalty on married women’s professional networking will induce married women’s family emotional exhaustion, and in turn decreases professional networking in the future and undermines job performance

3. To examine whether gender role orientation will alleviate married women’s double penalty and overall lessen the detrimental effect of professional networking on married women’s family emotional exhaustion and in turn future professional networking and job performance
4. To develop a practically useful intervention procedure to change working women’s as well as their spouses’ gender role orientation.

12501821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12501821.value: Professional networking refers to employees’ actions that help create and maintain social ties in support of task and professional goals, such as attending social functions, participating in parties and banquets, and going out for drinks after work (Casicaro et al., 2014; Kuwabara et al., 2018). Professional networking is essential for working people to succeed and thrive (e.g., Byham, 2009; Cross & Thomas, 2011; Kay, 2010), because it facilitates creating a system of information, advice, contacts, and support (Bensaou et al., 2014; Whiting & de Janasz, 2004). Compared with men, women tend to benefit less from professional networking (e.g., Forret & Dougherty, 2004; Yang, Chawla, & Uzzi, 2019). In the workplace, women face inhibiting forces such as exclusion from critical social ties dominated by men (Ibarra, 1992, 1993), homophily (Blau, 1977; Ibarra, 1992), network closure (Lutter, 2015) or biased scrutinization by the networks they seek to join (Lyness & Thompson, 2000). Departing from previous studies’ focus on barriers in the work domain, we theorize that married women’s professional networking may provoke inhibiting forces in the family domain, as professional networking inevitably permeates the boundary between work and family domains. Social role theory (Eagly, 1987; Eagly & Wood, 1999, 2012) suggests that women are expected to fill domestic labor and caretaking roles. Prioritizing networking for professional development to domestic works may violate such role expectations for married women and cause them to incur, what we call, a double penalty: they may feel guilty about not fulfilling their gender role, while their spouse resent their efforts to advance their career at the expense of family duties. According to family-work spillover research (e.g., Tang, Huang, & Wang, 2017; Lv, Huang, Xu, & Chung, 2020), married women’s emotional exhaustion at home caused by this double penalty may deter future networking and impair job performance. We further propose that the double penalty on married women’s professional networking may hinge on women’s and their spouses’ gender role orientation. When both hold an egalitarian gender role belief (i.e., men and women should contribute equally to both work and family), the double penalty is likely to be attenuated. We will design an intervention procedure to alter people’s gender role orientation and use a field experiment to test its validity, which we hope, will be applied in organizations. We will test these ideas progressively using two survey-based studies and one field experiment study. 職業社交活動是指參與幫助建立和維護對工作和職業發展目標有幫助的社會關系和網絡的活動， 比如參加一些功能性社會活動，出席派對和聚會，下班後出去和客戶飲酒等等 （Casicaro et al., 2014; Kuwabara et al., 2018）。職業社交活動對職場人士的成功很重要 （e.g., Byham, 2009; Cross & Thomas, 2011; Kay, 2010）， 因為它提供了一系列的信息、建議、聯絡人和支持 （Bensaou et al., 2014; Whiting & de Janasz, 2004）。 相比於職場男性，女性從職業社交活動中收益甚小（e.g., Forret & Dougherty, 2004; Yang, Chawla, & Uzzi, 2019）。在工作場所，女性面對很多阻礙的力量， 比如被男性主導的重要社會網絡所排斥（Ibarra, 1992, 1993），同性趨同性（Blau, 1977; Ibarra, 1992）網絡封閉性(Lutter, 2015和偏見（Lyness & Thompson, 2000）。除了以上職場所遭遇的障礙，我們認為已婚女性的職場社交活動會遭遇來自家庭領域的阻礙力量， 因為這些活動不可避免地模糊了工作和家庭的界限。 社會角色理論（Eagly, 1987; Eagly & Wood, 1999, 2012）認為女性一貫被認為應該承擔照顧家庭的角色。 將職業社交活動擺在家庭事務之前違背了這種角色期待，從而造成一種雙重懲罰的現象：一方面，她們自身對於沒能履行性別角色而感到內疚， 另外一方面，她們的配偶也因為她們犧牲家庭責任去尋求職業發展而對她們感到怨恨不滿。根據家庭-工作溢出的研究（e.g., Tang, Huang, & Wang, 2017; Lv, Huang, Xu, & Chung, 2020），這種雙重懲罰可能會造成已婚女性經受在家庭領域帶來的情緒倦怠，這將導致她們在將來減少參與到職業社交活動中去，並損害其工作表現。 我們進一步提出已婚女性面臨的雙重懲罰取決於女性和她們的配偶的性別角色的認識導向。當雙方都有一個平等主義的性別角色信念，也就是男人和女人對家庭和工作應該平等付出，這種雙重懲罰就會被減輕。我們設計了一個干預程序來改變人們的性別角色認知導向， 並且通過實地試驗來測試其信度，我們希望可以被應用到企業中去。我們會通過兩個問卷調查和一個公司實地實驗來逐步檢驗我們的模型。

12502121.value: 開源軟體授權條款的設計

12502121.label: Project Objectives
12502121.value: To provide an analytical framework to systematically identify new, never-heard-of open source licenses, and to examine the circumstances under which they may serve purposes that existing ones such as GPL and BSD cannot serve. To provide practical advices for developers on whether they should choose GPL or BSD or other open source licenses. To provide practical advices for developers on how more sophisticated open source licenses may be constructed out of existing ones. To provide practical advices for developers on whether they should choose GPL or BSD or other open source licenses.
To provide practical advices for developers on how more sophisticated open source licenses may be constructed out of existing ones.

12502121.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12502121.value: 開源軟體授權條款跟其他授權條款有一個很不同的地方，就是前者很多時都會有一些「自指」(self-referential）的元素。以坊間最愛用的兩種開源軟體授權條款（GPL 和 BSD）為例：GPL 的條款不容許下一代的軟體開發者把下一代的軟體拿去賣錢，只容許他們以開放源碼的方式與其他人分享，而且他們分享的時後也一定要使用相同的授權條款，也就是一定要使用 GPL 的條款；BSD 的條款容許下一代的軟體開發者把下一代的軟體拿去賣錢，也容許他們以開放源碼的方式與其他人分享，而且分享時也可以用任何他們想用的授權條款，包括 BSD 的條款。「自指」原是編程時的一大禁忌，卻有趣的成為了開源軟體授權條款裡的一個常見的元素。這個研究項目會研究開源軟體授權條款裡的這種「自指」元素，探索它們出現的原因，它們在開源軟體革命裡的角色，與及怎樣設計新的含有「自指」元素的開源軟體授權條款。

12502121.label: Realisation of objectives
12502121.value: All objectives have been addressed. This project has generated one research output: Chung and Lo (2025), "Designing Open Source Licenses", working paper under review at the Journal of Economic Theory. It contains one main theorem and three supplementary results, together achieving Objectives 1-3. The main theorem takes the form of a "preponderance theorem" (akin to how biologists explain the preponderance of Fibonacci numbers in botany), explaining why GPL and BSD, among infinitely many possible self-referential licenses, arose as the two preponderant open-source licenses in the software industry. It presents a natural model of the industry, in which an axiom called "imposture-proofness" (focusing our attention to open-sources licenses that cannot be circumvented by strategically splitting a single upgrade of a software into two consecutive ones) suffices to guarantee that only GPL and BSD will be use by software developers. Objectives 2 and 3 are achieved by three supplementary results: (1) We provide some factors that may explain how software developers choose between the two preponderant open-source licenses, GPL and BSD. (2) We demonstrate how a universal space of open-source licenses can be explicitly constructed in the spirit of the universal type space in epistemic game theory. (3) With a few example, we illustrate how simple open-source licenses other than GPL and BSD can also be helpful once we depart from our natural model. We have worked very hard to try to disseminate our paper in an international refereed journal. Indeed, we probably worked too hard on this, trying each of the so-called "top-five" economic journals (AER, QJE, Ecoometrica, JPE, and REStud). Although the decisions were disappointing (our paper was rejected in each case), the referee reports were in general very positive. However, as we moved down the ranking and submitted our paper to top field journals (Rand, IER, and JEEA), the referee reports became more hostile. We believe this is because what appeals to the "top five" may not necessarily appeal to top field journals or journals further down the ranking. We concluded that some major re-writing was needed in order to pitch our research findings to journals below the "top five". In order to seek advices on how to re-write our paper, we paused our submission effort for a year, and focuses on giving seminar presentations instead during that year. We are glad that our project has attracted lots of interests, so much so that we were invited to give more than 20 seminar/conference presentations, which also helped us to achieve Objective 4. We have used these presentation opportunities to tried different ways to pitch our research findings at different audiences. We have now resumed our submission effort, and are optimistic that our research findings will soon be disseminated in one of the top field journals.

It contains one main theorem and three supplementary results. The main theorem takes the form of a "preponderance theorem" (akin to how biologists explain the preponderance of Fibonacci numbers in botany), explaining why GPL and BSD, among infinitely many possible self-referential licenses, arose as the two preponderant open-source licenses in the software industry. 12502121.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12502121.value: An interesting next step is to study the licensing needs of an open-source AI model. There are many similarities, and even more differences, between a traditional piece of software and an AI model. As such, it is expected that the two have some similar and also some different licensing needs when the corresponding developing teams decide to go open source. These different licensing needs will necessitate different universal license spaces, as well as different preponderant open-source licenses.

12502121.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12502121.value: Open source licenses differ from other licenses in that they are often self-referential. GPL, for example, authorizes the next developer to develop a more advanced version of an existing piece of software, provided that the developer subsequently goes open source with exactly the same license, namely GPL. As such, the license GPL refers to itself when enumerating the licensees' rights and obligations. There are, however, many---indeed, infinitely many---self-referential licenses. This prompts the questions of why GPL, together with another license called BSD, are so preponderant in the software industry. This project resolves this puzzle by the means of formal economic analysis.

12503021.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12503021.value: 企業是否向其他企業學習？使用 2013 年 5 月的 SEC EDGAR 服務器日誌，我們記錄了大量的跨公司信息查询活動。通過 IP WHOIS 查找和名稱匹配，我們識別出 1,962 家非金融上市公司主動查詢其他公司的報表，其中包含 197,764 個搜索總數。一家典型的公司會查看其他 8 家公司，發起 18 次搜索，並且下載 12 種不同的報表。我們還發現信息獲取的多樣性。公司查看其同行公司、供應商、客戶、銀行、和控股機構。在所有查看中，24.5% 是同行公司查看，11.7% 是搜索金融公司，其餘的是其他經濟相關的公司。 鑑於我們在試點研究中記錄的跨公司信息查询的範圍和規模，我們建議處理所有日誌並構建跨公司有向信息網絡。基於查看鏈接，區分信息流出與信息流入。使用網絡方法的好處是我們可以通過高階連接（即信息從 i 流向 j 通過多个查看鏈接）研究信息流的影響。然後我們研究信息流對公司決策以及資產定價的影响。具體來說，我們提出三個問題：第一，查看其它公司的信息是否有所提高本公司的業績和股票收益。第二，公司之間的信息獲取是否會導致這些公司之間的決策正相關？第三，信息噪音是否也通過跨公司查看鏈接傳播？我們是否可以觀察到非系統新現金流風險的傳播？如果會傳播的話，信息流出網絡中的中心企業是否承擔了更高的市場風險并獲得更高的預期回報？ 我們樣本中的跨公司觀察似乎不是隨機的。相反，經理似乎從不同行业的公司那裡尋求相關信息。因此，我們預計搜索強度和搜索寬度都會對公司決策有積極貢獻並有助於提高公司業績和股權回報。直觀上，信息流應該導致相關的公司決策趨同。此外，當學習不完美時，跨公司信息查詢也可能導致信息噪音和非系統性分享的傳播。這些問題如果在數據中得到印證，它們將會對資產定價產生重要意義，因為對於信息流出中心性高的公司，它的特定風險將會與市場風險的關聯度更高。 如果成功，那麼我們所找到的證據將增加我們提供對公司決策和企業業績的決定因素的理解。它還可以幫助我們了解非系統性風險是如何導致系統波動以及信息流出中心性如何決定一個公司的貝塔。

12503021.label: Realisation of objectives
12503021.value: Achievement of Original Objectives The project aimed to construct and analyze a cross-firm information network using SEC EDGAR logs to understand managerial learning patterns and their impact on firm performance. The following progress was made: Objective 1: Construct cross-firm information network (90% achieved) We successfully developed an algorithm to match IP registrant organization names to company names in SEC filings, constructing a comprehensive network that captures daily cross-firm viewing activities. The network maps viewing patterns showing that a median viewing firm views 8 other firms, conducts 18 searches, and downloads 12 unique filings, with less than 30% of cross-firm viewings occurring within the same 3-digit SIC industry. Objective 2: Examine cross-firm learning and firm performance (90% achieved) Our analysis revealed that being viewed by other firms (PeerViewing) negatively predicts future quarterly firm performance (ROAs) for up to one year. This aligns with the theoretical understanding that viewing is costly to focal firms due to disclosure costs - when competitors access proprietary information, it can harm future performance. The effect is particularly driven by viewings from early announcers who have already reported earnings. Objectives 3-5: Lead-lag effects, shock transmission, and aggregate impacts (0-40% achieved) These objectives could not be completed due to fundamental challenges in establishing causality between viewing activities and firm performance. Reasons for Under-Achievement and Attempts to Overcome Problems The primary challenge was the endogeneity between viewing activities and firm performance. While reduced-form regressions showed that PeerViewing negatively predicts performance, we faced a critical identification problem: distinguishing whether (1) poor performance attracts more views, or (2) being viewed causes performance deterioration through disclosure costs. To address this endogeneity, we developed and tested an instrument variable approach: Instrumental Variable: Filing Crowdedness We proposed using the number of same-day 10-Q/K filings as an instrument for viewing activity, based on the well-documented limited attention phenomenon in financial markets. Our analysis revealed: • Relevance: Earnings reports filed on the least crowded days (bottom 10%) generate 30-50% more views within just two days and maintain 20-30% higher cumulative views until the subsequent filing • Initial Endogeneity Concerns: Both filing earliness (days since quarter beginning) and crowdedness showed negative correlations with contemporaneous ROAs, indicating that firms experiencing poor performance tend to delay reporting and cluster near filing deadlines To address these concerns, we developed an improved approach using predicted filing crowdedness while controlling for actual filing lag. We found that: • Expected crowdedness (based on historical filing patterns) successfully removed correlation with contemporaneous ROAs • The IV maintained strong predictive power for viewing volumes across different time windows • Controlling for actual filing lag was crucial for satisfying the exclusion restriction Surprising 2SLS Results and Interpretation Challenges Our two-stage least squares contradicts the reduced-form results. The instrumented peer viewing actually showed positive effects on future ROAs, asset turnover, and profit margins. This contradiction suggested our instrument might be separating two distinct types of viewers: • Dedicated viewers (could be real competitors who are determined to view the focal firm's filing regardless of when it is filed) • Casual viewer (whose attention is influenced by filing crowdedness and earliness) Despite extensive analysis including: • Testing multiple view windows (1-day, 60-day, 85-day) and transformations (logged, demeaned, daily averages) • Examining different regression specifications (firm-fiscal-quarter fixed effects vs. lagged dependent variables) • Analyzing subcomponents of performance (asset turnover and profit margins separately) • Developing an improved algorithm for predicting earnings announcement dates (achieving 80% accuracy compared to the 60% baseline from Savor and Wilson, 2014) • Further separating views coming from earlier announcers (firms that already released earnings) versus later announcers (firms that have yet to release earnings). We could not resolve the fundamental puzzle of why casual views would predict superior performance. The economic mechanism through which being viewed casually by competitors could improve a firm's future ROA, especially manifesting so quickly in quarterly earnings, remained theoretically implausible and empirically unexplained. Technical Challenges and Methodological Innovations Throughout our attempts to overcome these challenges, we made several methodological contributions: 1. Improved Earnings Date Prediction: We developed an enhanced algorithm building on Savor and Wilson (2014), improving prediction accuracy from 60% to 80% through incorporating firm-specific filing history patterns 2. Comprehensive Specification Testing: We systematically tested multiple econometric specifications: o Level ROA regressions with year and firm-fiscal-quarter fixed effects (avoiding biased estimates from lagged dependent variables) o Level ROA with four lagged ROAs and year-calendar quarter fixed effects o Change in ROA specifications with various fixed effect structures o Examination of both levels and changes to address seasonality concerns 3. View Measurement Refinements: We explored numerous approaches to measuring viewing activity: o Undemeaned vs. demeaned total views o Daily average views vs. cumulative views o Different time windows capturing immediate vs. sustained attention 4. Robustness Checks: We discovered important patterns such as: o Expected crowdedness shows significant autocorrelation while filing lag does not o The distraction effect of filing crowdedness persists for up to three quarters but gradually weakens Pivoting to New Research Direction Recognizing that the fundamental identification challenges made it impossible to complete Objectives 3-5 as originally conceived, we made the strategic decision to pivot to a new research question that could leverage our substantial investments in data infrastructure and methodological development. The new study examines how mutual fund disclosure views affect stock market informational efficiency, particularly around earnings announcements. This pivot maintains several crucial advantages: 1. Infrastructure Leverage: Utilizes the same processed EDGAR logs dataset, name-matching algorithms, and viewing pattern identification methods 2. Methodological Continuity: Employs the filing crowdedness instrument we developed and validated 3. Theoretical Clarity: Provides clearer predictions about information flow from fund managers to market participants 4. Empirical Tractability: Offers more straightforward identification strategies for causal effects The new research has already produced promising results. We find that investors demonstrate sophistication in processing mutual fund holdings by focusing on informed positions (stocks over- or under-weighted relative to benchmarks). Furthermore, fund disclosure views enhance market efficiency around earnings announcements, as evidenced by increased immediate price response and reduced post-earnings announcement drift. This redirection ensures that despite the challenges encountered with the original objectives, the project will deliver meaningful contributions to our understanding of information transmission in financial markets while making use of the substantial research infrastructure developed during the project period.

12503021.label: Major findings and research outcome
12503021.value: Our research provides the first systematic analysis of how mutual fund disclosure views impact stock market informational efficiency, using novel data from SEC EDGAR server logs. The project reveals important insights about information transmission from institutional investors to broader market participants: 1. Sophisticated Information Processing by Fund Disclosure Viewers We document that viewers of mutual fund disclosures demonstrate remarkable sophistication in their information acquisition. Rather than examining all holdings equally, viewers selectively focus on "informed" positions—stocks that managers over- or under-weight relative to benchmarks. A one-standard-deviation increase in holding informativeness predicts 11.0%-13.6% more subsequent stock views. This selective attention spans all investor types, though 13F institutions show the strongest response. This finding validates that market participants can identify and extract valuable signals from fund disclosures. 2. Fund Disclosure Views Enhance Market Efficiency Our central finding demonstrates that mutual fund disclosure views (ESV^fund) significantly improve informational efficiency around earnings announcements. Stocks with higher ESV^fund exhibit greater immediate price responsiveness to earnings news and significantly lower post-earnings announcement drift. Specifically, a one-standard-deviation increase in ESV^fund leads to an 8.5% increase in immediate return reactions and a 37% reduction in PEAD. This effect is particularly strong when viewers examine multiple information sources, suggesting that information aggregation enhances signal quality. 3. Complementarity Between Fund and Corporate Disclosure Views We uncover a complementary relationship between views of fund disclosures and corporate filings in enhancing market efficiency. Fund disclosure views uniquely relate to event-period private information production, as evidenced by increased informed trading during earnings announcements. Using ANcerno institutional trading data, we show that institutions viewing fund holdings are significantly more likely to trade informed positions during subsequent earnings announcements, with daily trading volume surging by 350% in the announcement window. 4. Causal Evidence Through Novel Identification By exploiting exogenous variation in viewing activity caused by filing crowdedness, we establish causal evidence for our findings. Disclosures filed on crowded days experience persistent viewing reductions for up to three quarters, providing plausibly exogenous variation in information flow. Our instrumental variable results confirm that the positive effects of fund disclosure views on market efficiency are causal. These findings contribute to understanding how institutional investor disclosures serve as information intermediaries, facilitating more efficient price discovery in equity markets. The results have important implications for disclosure policy and our understanding of how public information releases can complement rather than crowd out private information production.

12503021.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12503021.value: 1. Determinants of Investor Attention to Mutual Fund Disclosures We plan to investigate what drives differential attention across fund disclosures. We have already explored some key factors such fund characteristics (size, style, past alpha). More interesting factors such as market conditions (volatility, sentiment) and peer funds performances influence viewing patterns. Additionally, we aim to study how disclosure complexity and readability affect investor engagement, potentially informing optimal disclosure design. 2. Attention-Driven Fund Flow-Performance Relationships Building on our viewing data, we will examine how disclosure attention mediates the well-documented flow-performance relationship. Specifically, we plan to test whether funds attracting more sophisticated viewers (identified through their multi-source and multi-fund viewing habbits) experience stronger flow-performance sensitivity. We hypothesize that attention from different investor types (retail vs. institutional) may have differential impacts on flow dynamics. These extensions will contribute to the growing literature on investor attention and mutual fund markets. By linking disclosure views to actual fund flows, we can provide novel insights into how information acquisition translates into capital allocation decisions. This research has important implications for fund managers' disclosure strategies and regulators' efforts to enhance market efficiency through improved information dissemination.

12503021.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12503021.value: Imagine you're an investor trying to pick winning stocks. One strategy is to see what successful mutual fund managers are buying—after all, they have teams of analysts and resources to research companies. But with thousands of funds each holding hundreds of stocks, how do you know which holdings matter? Our research uses SEC website traffic data to study how investors actually read mutual fund reports. We made a surprising discovery: smart investors don't look at all stocks equally. Instead, they focus on stocks where fund managers made big bets different from standard market indexes—these "conviction" holdings often contain valuable insights about future company performance. More importantly, we found that when many investors read and identify these special holdings, the stock market becomes more efficient around earnings announcements. Stock prices react more quickly and accurately to company earnings news. This matters because efficient markets protect regular investors from being disadvantaged by those with special information. Our findings suggest that mutual fund disclosures, when properly analyzed by vigilant investors, serve as important "information bridges"—helping valuable insights from professional managers spread throughout the market, ultimately benefiting everyone who invests in stocks for retirement or other financial goals.

12600021.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12600021.value: Political polarization among the public has become a major concern in many societies. The process of polarization has strengthened partisan identities and increased the prejudice and anger directed toward members of opposing groups. This increased hostility can cause conflicts in relationships, particularly when couple partners differ greatly from each other in terms of their political attitudes, behaviors, and identities. Unfortunately, few academic studies have investigated the prevalence, factors, and consequences of within-couple political disagreements. In particular, the relationship between within-couple political disagreements and marital quality has not been thoroughly investigated. It remains unclear why some families are more vulnerable to these conflicts than others in times of political polarization. Hong Kong provides an interesting and important case study for an investigation of the relationship between political disagreements and marital relations. Public opinion polls show increasing polarization regarding a wide range of political issues. Citizens with different political orientations have developed a strong sense of antagonism and hatred toward one another. Does political division in society translate into poorer marital quality? Understanding how married couples with different political orientations maintain their marriages and interact with each other in a highly polarized political context is an important question that remains inadequately addressed in the literature. The main purpose of the proposed study will be to investigate in detail the relationship between within-couple political disagreements and marital quality. The proposed study will aim to answer five related research questions: 1) How common are political disagreements (on issues including attitudes, behaviors, and identities) between husbands and wives? 2) How are within-couple political disagreements (on issues including attitudes, behaviors, and identities) related to the couples’ sociodemographic backgrounds? 3) How are differences in political attitudes, behaviors, and partisan identities associated with marital quality? 4) How does the strength of association between political disagreements and marital quality compare with the association between other dimensions of status and value dissimilarities and marital quality? 5) Under what conditions are political disagreements more strongly related to marital quality? 6) What are the differences in how husbands and wives perceive and react to the impacts of political disagreements on their marital quality? The proposed study will adopt a mixed-methods approach. The quantitative phase will pioneer the use of a representative household survey to study the prevalence, factors, and impacts of political disagreements among married partners, and the qualitative phase will collect follow-up interview data containing the narratives of the experience of conflict between couple partners. 如何面對群眾政治的兩極化是很多社會刻下的重要課題。群眾政治兩極化的過程不但強化了民眾對政治身分的認同，也增加了對群體間的偏見和仇恨。日益敵對的態度導致人際關係的衝突，當中也包括婚姻關係。儘管如此，學界卻鮮有研究夫妻間政見分歧的普及性、成因和後果，特別是對於政見分歧如何影響婚姻關係的研究少之又少。至今，我們仍然不太清楚在群眾政治兩極化的時代下哪些家庭會特別脆弱。 近年香港社會的環境對這個議題提供了很重要的研究場所。本港多個民意調查都指出香港市民對各種社會議題都呈現出兩極化的趨勢，同時不同陣營間的仇恨也日漸強烈。在政治兩極化的社會下，婚姻關係是否也會充滿衝突？理解如何在政治兩極化社會下維繫夫妻關係的關键將會是對家庭社會學的一個突破。 本研究主要就此課題進行探討，並解答如下六個相關的研究問題： 1)本港夫妻之間在政治取態、行為和身分的分歧有多普遍？ 2) 夫妻之間的政治分歧主要在哪些背景的夫妻比較常見？3) 夫妻之間的政治分歧有否影響婚姻關係？ 4) 相比起其他分歧對婚姻關係的影響，政治分歧對婚姻關係的影響有否不同? 5) 在什麼條件下， 政治分歧對婚姻關係的影響會更強？ 6) 夫妻間對他們的政治分歧會否有不同的看法和反應？ 本研究將採用混合式研究方法，包括進行1) 一個有代表式的住戶問卷調查以研究夫妻間政治分歧的普遍性、成因和影響；2) 跟進的深入訪談以探討夫妻間就此課題的主觀經驗及論述。

12600521.label: Realisation of objectives
12600521.value: To a great extent, all project objectives have been thoroughly achieved. This is largely due to the design of an academically rigorous and effective methodology. Inspired by other scholars’ parameters of “geosemiotics,” approach to the material forms of language, theories of multimodality and the use of space as a semiotic resource from the field of linguistic landscape, this new methodology offers an encompassing approach for examining and interpreting the relationships and synergistic effects of the following factors: 1) calligraphic aesthetics and style as semiotic resources for meaning making; 2) calligraphic expressions manifested in a wide range of material forms in physical and cyber spaces; 3) alternative modes of calligraphic expression; and 4) calligraphy’s social and cultural contexts and contexts of use in Hong Kong. This new methodology was originally tailor-made for this project. This research expanded the scope of the PI’s last GRF project by examining calligraphic works that cannot be categorised into the PI’s last GRF research framework of the five major themes: i) village clan culture, ii) charitable and civic culture, iii) pluralistic religious culture, iv) revolutionary culture, and v) vernacular culture. By identifying and examining more than 150 additional calligraphic works that were categorised according to five additional elements of calligraphic expression: 1) educational culture, 2) park culture, 3) festival culture, 4) funerary culture and 5) alternative modes of expression and cyberspace; this research interpreted emplaced calligraphic expressions in parks, schools, festival venues, cemeteries, websites, and social media platforms. Calligraphy in different material forms and alternative modes of expression include those involved in the interplay between calligraphy and performance (public performances of calligraphy, calligraphy performance at historic and cultural heritage sites), mass media, and those attached to mass-produced commercial goods such as t-shirts, bowl, cups, postcards, bookmarks, advertisements in physical space, cyberspace, and on moving vehicles. Inspiring calligraphic expressions in these sites signify a wide spectrum of traditional cultures, contemporary thoughts, city life, people’s aspirations, visions of society, and thoughts on life and death, thus shedding light on the people from different walks of life who make up Hong Kong society and on what has shaped their thoughts and values. Hence, this project offers a significant contribution to the reconstruction of identity embodied in public calligraphy. The PI arranged and finished all field trips to relevant sites in Hong Kong to conduct on-site investigations of the physical conditions of the calligraphic works under examination. As there were no ready-made or systematic collections of research materials pertaining to this project, photos of emplaced works of calligraphy at various venues of Hong Kong were taken, videos of site-specific calligraphy performance were recorded and edited, analyzed and interpreted by the PI in his research outputs. Research outputs include: 3 peer-reviewed papers for presentation at international conferences, 1 book chapter, 3 public performances of calligraphy at historic and heritage sites, 1 peer-reviewed solo exhibition, 1 calligraphic works exhibited in Hong Kong Museum of Art and another in a peer-reviewed art exhibition held in a historic and heritage site of Hong Kong (Part C, no. 8) and 1 commissioned artwork of huge-scale calligraphy tapestry (427cm x 561 cm) as an extraordinary material form exhibited in a commercial building in Hong Kong to enrich people’s city life (Part C, no. 6). In addition, a series of research impact outputs and related activities (see Part C, Other Impact no. 1-5), was finished. Through these output and activities, the new knowledge about various modes of expression and representation in Chinese calligraphy and their dynamics with contexts of use in the city of Hong Kong can be widely accessed to inform and educate many people, transforming their way to perceive culture and life in Hong Kong. These outputs include a digital humanities/ scholarship website (peer-reviewed, Research Committee, Hong Kong Baptist University) that features an online exhibition of 780 works of Chinese calligraphy, 2 TV programmes that feature the PI’s research and artistic practice of Chinese calligraphy with calligraphy performances at historic and heritage sites of Hong Kong, 4 gallery talks on Chinese calligraphy exhibition as well as a talk and a panel discussion at the Forum on “Traditional Brush-and-ink and Contemporary Vitality in Chinese Calligraphy.” Based on all the abovementioned research outputs, a fully illustrated book manuscript was written, now in the last stage of proofreading and editing and will be submitted to the University of Washington Press for book publication review in April 2025. Comprising these chapters: 1) educational culture, 2) park culture, 3) festival culture, 4) funerary culture and 5) alternative modes of expression and cyberspace, the book interprets how works of Chinese calligraphy (in public venues around Hong Kong and in other material forms and alternative modes of expression) create new meanings pertinent to the city. A perfect example of the intriguing role of calligraphy in connecting the physical space to cyberspace is the book’s interpretation of a calligraphy performance entitled ‘Tapping the Metropolis Rhythm: Whole-Body Rendition of the Calligraphic Brush.’ Prior to the performance, the calligraphy called for registration on Facebook and asked participants for words that recounted their impressions of the metropolis of Hong Kong. With the words collected via Facebook, the calligrapher composed a poem: “With opulence and glamour, the Victoria Harbour is clothed in a glow; At South Hill is relished the human touch that warms every remembrance. Billowing and white, the waves in Shek O roar and roll; On the same boat we ride out, in the spirit of Lion Rock, united.” (繁華璀璨維港亮, 懷舊人情南山嘗, 白浪濤聲石澳響,同舟共濟獅山彰). Transforming the poem into a calligraphy performance, the PI explored the new concept of rendering the giant calligraphic brush with his whole body with additional elements of gestural expressions and other corporeal signs and aesthetics and audience participation. All these elements, thereby, inherently complement the calligraphic aesthetics and textual meanings. Through the utilization of social media that have taken the concept of public participation in the artist’s creative process to another level of sophistication, the performance offers a new approach to configuring Chinese calligraphy in a wider social context. Moreover, beyond the limit of a live performance, this event has been documented as a TV programme by Radio Television Hong Kong—the public broadcasting service in Hong Kong (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vb5Qsho6qYY ) and a YouTube video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2joaf8w49rY ) overlaid with commentaries. As a post-performance amplification, the transformation of the live performance into alternative modes in the cyberspace has created multiple layers of meanings and multimodal perception experiences. In a nutshell, this project broadened the study of calligraphy as a public art form, examining how calligraphy has been transformed from an literati-oriented, elitist art with a restricted audience into a more accessible form of visual culture that reaches wider audiences in both public venues in Hong Kong and cyberspace, thus contributing to the reconstruction of a strong sense of vitality of city life, humanistic and local cultures and artistic practices.
