To elucidate the mechanism of photo-assisted production of RBS from coal burning;
To investigate the spatial extent of the RBS and products of halogen chemistry, and their impact on radical production in heavily polluted northern China.

15207421.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15207421.value: Halogen atoms (Cl and Br) are the key chemical ingredients in the formation of the “ozone hole” which allows the harmful ultraviolet radiation to reach Earth’s surface. In urban and industrial areas, halogen atoms can aggravate air pollution such as photochemical smog and haze, and affect the lifetime of methane, an important greenhouse gas. In the past decade, there has been growing interest in the effect of Cl atoms over populated continental areas because man-made chloride can be activated to form the highly reactive Cl atoms. However, little is known about the abundance and the role of bromine compounds in the continental atmosphere. During a recent winter field study in the heavily polluted North China Plain (NCP), we observed surprisingly high concentrations of bromine chloride (BrCl), which provides a new and significant source of Br and Cl atoms and accelerates the production of secondary pollutants. We found evidence that intense coal burning and photochemical reactions are responsible for the observed BrCl and other reactive bromine gases. The present proposal will further investigate some of the outstanding questions, including (1) to what extent does the coal burning exist as a significant source of air pollutants after the implementation of the “Coal to Gas and Electricity” campaign in rural areas? (2) what is the spatial distribution of the reactive halogen in the NCP, and (3) how much primary radicals do reactive halogen contribute? The present proposal will address the above questions through laboratory measurements of coal burning emissions and chemical reactions on field-collected particles and field measurements with improved instruments in coal-burning areas. The study will provide significant insights into the sources and processes of reactive halogen originated from coal burning. The study will provide new scientific evidence to strengthen the impetus to reduce and replace the use of dirty coal in China and other countries where uncontrolled coal burning is prevalent. 鹵素原子（例如氯和溴）是造成臭氧層空洞的關鍵化學成分，臭氧層空洞使得有害的紫外輻射到達地表。在城市和工業化地區，鹵素原子會使空氣質素惡化，引致光化學煙霧和灰霾，並且影響甲烷氣（一種具有氣候效應的介質）在大氣中的存留時間。在過去的十年中，氯原子在污染的內陸地區的環境效應引發廣泛關注，因為人類活動產生的氯離子可以被活化用以形成高活性的氯原子。然而，人們對含溴化合物在污染的內陸地區的豐度和作用卻知之甚少。在近期於華北平原開展的一項野外觀測中，我們觀測到了令人驚奇的高濃度的氯化溴，這構成了一個新的溴和氯原子的重要來源。我們發現高強度的煤燃燒和光化學反應是氯化溴和其它活性溴氣體的成因。本次提出的研究計劃將進一步探討一些尚未解決的問題，包括：（1）自從2018年"煤改氣"工程在華北平原實施以來，燃煤做为大氣污染物來源有何種程度的变化？（2）來自偏遠地區民用燃煤產生的活性鹵素的空間分佈如何？（3）活性鹵素貢獻了多少自由基？本研究計劃將由如下方法來闡述以上問題：在實驗室中測量燃煤排放；使用野外採集的大氣顆粒物進行化學實驗；在燃煤區域的幾個站點用改進過的儀器開展野外觀測。本研究將對活性鹵素成為大氣污染來源的過程及其重要性提出深入見解。本研究將提供新的科學依據來推進在中國取代劣質燃煤的使用。相關發現對其他廣泛使用燃煤而不加以控制的國家也有意義。

15207421.label: Realisation of objectives
15207421.value: This project commenced on 1 June 2022 and completed 30 November 2024. We conducted measurements of atmospheric pollutants in one heavily polluted area (Wangdu, Hebei) and one less polluted area (Jimo, Qingdao) of North China winter 2022/2023 and in-depth data analysis. The project’s three objectives were realized with the following activities. Objective 1 (100% achieved) Feld measurements in North China: We optimized our chemical ionization mass spectrometry (CIMS) to improve its performance for reactive bromine species (RBS) and halogen-VOC species measurements. The optimization works included (a) development of halogen-VOC calibration module, (b) development of auto-background module, and (c) tuning the voltages and pressure of Tof-CIMS to achieve a better m/z resolution and signals suitable for RBS measurement. Following the optimization works, we conducted two comprehensive field studies and a coal combustion experiment with the improved instrument. Reactive halogen halogen-VOCs, normal gases and aerosol parameters were obtained to analyze the halogen production mechanism and implication. The composition of effluents from coal burning, solid waste combustion and biomass burning were investigated. (a) Jimo and Wangdu field study The Jimo and Wangdu field studies were conducted in December of 2022 and February of 2023, respectively, covering two months during cold seasons. The Jimo site is located at Qingdao Research Center of Northwestern Polytechnical University in Shandong province, which is at the edge of North China Plain (NCP) and can be regarded as a suburban site. The Wangdu site is at the center of NCP where very high RBS concentrations were observed during a heavy coal burning period in 2017. The two sites were selected to assess RBS in a once heavily polluted inland area and a relatively clean coastal environment of the NCP. The improved Tof-CIMS was deployed at both sites to measure ClNO2, Cl2, Br2, BrCl, N2O5, HONO, Cl-VOCs, Br-VOCs and other OVOCs. The conventional gaseous pollutants (e.g., NOx, O3, SO2, CO, NH3 and VOCs), meteorological parameters and aerosol compositions were concurrently measured by using commercial instruments during the studies with the help of our collaborators from Shandong University at Jimo site and Chinese Academy of Science at Wangdu site. To determine the composition of reactive halogen species in the effluents of combustion, we collected two types of coals (brown and white coal), solid waste (plastic bags, paper boxes, plastic bottle and ground cover) and biomass waste (poplar, straw and cornstalk) for combustion experiments. A reversely-burning stove was used to burn each kind of materials and the reactive halogen, halogen-VOCs and reactive nitrogen species in the effluents from stove vent were measured by using the Tof-CIMS. NOx and SO2 were also measured by Thermo 42i and 43i concurrently with Tof-CIMS. Objective 2 (100% achieved) We developed a multiphase chemical box model and applied it to Wangdu to assess the role of multi-phase chemical reactions for production and fate of reactive bromines. The model included both gas phase and aqueous phase chemistry and transfer between the two phases. Specifically, we developed three chemistry modules to assess the impact of aerosol-related multiphase processes on bromine chemistry. All modules were based on the Master Chemical Mechanism (MCM) v3.3. but differed in their treatment of halogen chemistry. The first module considers existing polar study-based mechanisms, incorporating gas-phase reactions and heterogeneous uptake of chlorine and bromine species. In this module, heterogeneous uptake reactions were implemented as first-order gas-phase loss reactions. The second module extends the previous one by incorporating Br2 production through nitrate photodissociation. The third module add further the heterogeneous loss of each bromine species (e.g., Br2, BrNO2, BrNO3, BrO, BrCl, HOBr, and HBr) on aerosol surfaces. Five sets of simulations were conducted to assess different production and loss pathways. Additionally, we implemented an iron catalytic scheme to a chemical transport model to assess the role of this chemical pathway in halogen activation which can simulate regional impact. Objective 3 (100% achieved) A zero-dimensional chemical box model was used to investigate the potential impacts of the observed reactive chlorine and bromine compounds on atmospheric oxidation. The model includes gas-phase chemistry, heterogeneous reactions, and dilution/dry deposition. The gas-phase chemistry module is constructed based on MCM v3.3.1 with additional chlorine and bromine chemistry compiled in our previous works. The heterogeneous reaction related to reactive halogens is treated as a pseudo-first-order reaction with fixed uptake coefficients in the heterogeneous reaction module. Moreover, the dilution and dry deposition of each species are treated as a first-order reaction with rate constants varying with the height of the planetary boundary layer, which is obtained from the ERA5 reanalysis database. The simulations were run with the constraint of the observed species and meteorological parameters. Four scenarios were performed to separately quantify the impacts of different RHS in 2017 and 2023. The spatial extent of RBS was examined by comparing the RBS from the center (Wangdu) and the edge (Jimo) of the NCP.

15207421.label: Major findings and research outcome
15207421.value: Field observations in 2023 revealed reactive bromines (Br2 and BrCl) observed in winter 2017 at one site (Wangdu, Hebei) largely disappeared indicating the success of the “Coal to Electricity” policy implemented after 2018 in the heavily polluted North China Plain (Chen et al., 2025). We discovered a new industrial source of reactive bromines in a high-tech park near Qingdao, likely from fugitive emissions from pharmaceutical facilities (Jiang et al., 2025). Coal burning emissions were measured for coals used in the region (objective 1). Reactive chlorine (ClNO2) was present at elevated levels (up to 2 ppb) at both sites due to the persistence of chlorine sources from biomass burning and fertilizer use (Chen et al., 2025). As to the photochemical processes (objective 2), we developed a multiphase chemical box model and applied it to Wangdu and found important role of multi-phase chemical reactions for production and fate of reactive bromines (Zhang et al., 2024). We also implemented an iron catalytic scheme to a chemical transport model which showed considerable role of this chemical pathway in halogen activation (Chen et al., 2024). Analysis of data in 2023 and 2017 at Wangdu revealed shifting chemistry to favor ClNO2 production over Cl2 due to increasing ozone and decreasing aerosol acidity (Chen et al., 2025). The impacts of reactive halogens (objective 3) were assessed using chemical box model which reveal still notable contributions of reactive halogens to atmospheric oxidative capacity in the North China Plain despite emission controls in recent years (Jiang et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2025). But the impact sharply reduced from that in 2017. Other findings from this project include the utility of trace metals to assess coal contribution to winter haze (and co-production of HONO with halogens from particulate nitrate (Jiang et al., 2024). We also contributed to critical review of reactive halogens on the global atmospheric chemistry and climate with world’s leading halogen researchers (Saiz-Lopez, et al., 2025). Altogether, our project’s research led to 7 journal papers including 3 EST, one ESTL, one JGR, one EST-Air, and one review paper in Nature. One PhD student was trained.

15207421.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15207421.value: This study suggests that future research should address anthropogenic halogen sources in addition to combustion of coal, biomass and solid waste. Recent research has shown potential important contributions from disinfectants, oil and gas production, and magnesium production from salt lakes. Our study also shows pharmaceutical industry and fertilizer as potential halogen sources. We are continuing to find new halogen sources by analyzing recent field measurements in other regions of China. Moreover, previous research focused on chlorine and bromine, the role of iodine in continental region has received little attention. We have proposed to investigate iodine chemistry and impact on atmospheric chemistry and air quality.

15207421.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15207421.value: Halogen atoms (Cl and Br) can aggravate air pollution and affect the lifetime of an important greenhouse gas (methane). During a study in winter 2017 in the heavily polluted North China Plain (NCP), we measured surprisingly high concentrations of bromine chloride (BrCl), which provides a significant source of Br and Cl and accelerates the production of secondary air pollutants. We found evidence that intense coal burning and photochemical reactions are responsible for the observed BrCl and other bromine gases. To assess the impact of the ‘Coal to Gas and Electricity’ campaign implemented after 2018, we conducted measurements again at the same site and another site at the edge of the NCP during winter 2022-2023. We found that the clean energy policy successfully reduced bromines, but chlorines still exist due to increase in biomass burning and fertilizer use. We also discovered a new source of bromine from pharmaceutical industry. Overall, the halogen impacts on air quality have been reduced by the clean energy policy, but other sources of halogens should be given attention. Our study provides new scientific evidence to strengthen the impetus to replace the use of dirty coal in China and other countries where uncontrolled coal burning is prevalent.

15207521.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15207521.value: The applications of multi-scale complex three-dimensional(3D) surfaces have been more widespread in various industries including semiconductor,bio-medical, energy,automotive,aerospace,etc. These surfaces usually possess different scales of geometrical features. Although there are some research studies that can measure different scales independently and asynchronously, the research on measurement of multi-scale complex 3D surfaces is still far from complete. Significant progress has been made in the development of various precision metrology and instruments for measuring 3D surfaces. However, most of them focus on the traditional measurement process of certain measuring scales. With the increasing geometrical complexity and functional requirements of complex 3D surfaces, this imposes a lot of challenges for the precision manufacture of these surfaces with high accuracy. From the point of view of in-situ measurement, this is important for feeding back the measurement data to the compensation machining process. As a result,this project aims to develop a smart multichannel super-resolution autostereoscopic measurement(SMSRAM) method and system to perform in-situ measurement of multi-scale complex 3D surfaces under different measuring scales simultaneously. The measurement scale spans from macroscopic to microscopic level. Compared with other measurement systems, the proposed SMSRAM method not only has widely variable measuring scales, but also realizes certain multiple measuring scales based on measuring requirements at the same time within a single snapshot data acquisition process with sub-micrometer form accuracy. In this study, a SMSRAM method and system will be established for in-situ measurement of multi-scale complex 3D surfaces. A novel multi-route optical scheme using advanced optical design theory will be developed to realize multiple optical routes with various imaging functions and different scales simultaneously. To provide super-resolution 3D measurement results,a novel hybrid autostereoscopic measuring module will be developed within optical routes with the aid of machine learning-based data processing algorithms. The SMSRAM system is compact enough to be incorporated into the ultra-precision machine to realize in-situ measurement. The SMSRAM system will be verified through a series of experiments conducted for in-situ measurement of various artefacts of multi-scale complex 3D surfaces with multi-scale features and intercommunication with experts in precision manufacturing worldwide. The research is expected to realize a novel optical measurement system that is used for in-situ measurement of multi-scale complex 3D surfaces with necessary accuracies. It will have a great impact over a wide range of industries requiring multi-scale complex 3D surfaces. The novel optical measurement method will impact the area of measurement science and technology, optical engineering and precision manufacturing. 复杂三维表面在半导体、生物医学、能源、汽车、航空航天等领域的应用越来越广泛，这些表面通常具有不同尺度的几何表面特征。虽然已经有一些研究已经能够实现针对复杂三维表面的独立且离线的不同尺度测量，但对这些复杂三维曲面的多尺度在线/在位测量的研究工作还远远没有完成。近年来，各种三维自由曲面的精密测量仪器的研制取得了长足的进展，这些仪器大多是面向某一固定测量尺度的传统测量过程。随着复杂三维曲面的几何复杂性和功能要求的不断提高，给曲面的高精度精密制造带来了很大的挑战。从原位测量的角度来看，这对于将测量数据反馈到补偿加工过程是非常重要的。因此，本项目旨在开发一种智能多通道超分辨率自动视差式测量(SMSRAM)方法和系统，实现多尺度复杂三维表面在不同测量尺度下的同时原位测量，测量范围覆盖宏观尺度到微观尺度。与其他测量系统相比，本项目所提出的SMSRAM方法不仅具有更加广泛的测量尺度变化，而且可以根据测量要求针对某些预先指定的多个测量尺度在单次拍照的数据采集过程中实现具有亚微米形状精度的原位测量。利用先进光学设计理论，本研究提出了一种新的多路径光学方案，可同时实现多个具有不同成像功能和不同尺度的成像光路。为了提供超分辨的三维测量结果，本研究将基于机器学习的数据处理算法在每条光路内开发一种新型的混合型自动视差式测量模块；这也使得SMSRAM系统非常紧凑，可以集成到超精密加工设备中实现原位/在位测量。不仅如此，SMSRAM系统将通过一系列针对具有多尺度特征复杂三维表面工件的原位测量实验以及与全球精密制造专家的深度交流而进行验证。据此，本研究有望实现一种新型的面向多尺度复杂三维表面，且具有必要的测量精度的原位光学测量系统。这将对需要多尺度复杂三维表面的众多行业产生巨大的影响，而且这种新的光学测量方法将影响测量科学与技术、光学工程和精密制造领域。

15207521.label: Realisation of objectives
15207521.value: During this reporting period, a review was conducted to study the key issues, science, and technology of the multi-scale measurement of complex 3D surfaces, in-situ/on-machine metrology, as well as the state-of-the-art methods in the field of autostereoscopic 3D measurement technology, light field technologies, advanced optical system design, machine learning-based inhomogeneous data fusion, and machine learning super-resolution technology. For Objective 1, it is found that complex 3D surfaces have a wide range of applications in various fields, and the measurement of complex 3D surfaces has long been an important issue of great interest in a wide range of academic and industrial fields. Compared with other vision-based measuring systems, light field measuring systems have the potential to provide more perspectives and greater flexibility. However, traditional single-channel autostereoscopic systems suffer from inherent bottlenecks, including the trade-off between spatial and angular resolution, small baseline, and limited field of view (FOV). These issues lead to depth maps with blurring, discontinuities, and unnatural transitions at object boundaries, which severely affect measurement accuracy. This study confirms that relying solely on single-channel data (either elemental images/EIs for angular information or high-resolution/HR 2D images for spatial detail) cannot fully meet the precision requirements of micro-structured surface measurement. For example, the 3D channel alone has a maximum absolute error (MaxAE) of 0.83 μm, and the 2D channel alone has a MaxAE of 0.80 μm, both failing to achieve high-precision depth estimation. Advanced multichannel autostereoscopic systems and artificial intelligence (AI)-based data processing methods have great potential to deal with the limitations in traditional light field measuring systems. The results of the review and the experimental work provide an important means for formulating the smart multichannel super-resolution autostereoscopic measurement (SMSRAM) principle, and hence the measuring system has been developed (Objective 2). The working principle of the SMSAM system is developed based on multi-channels which are composed of 2D and 3D optical channels. The 3D optical channel provides rich angular information, while the 2D optical channel acquires HR images with high spatial resolution. These two types of data are inherently complementary: the 3D channel excels in depth cue extraction through multi-perspective information, and the 2D channel contributes fine-grained structural details (Objective 2). Optical components have been identified and used to establish the hardware for this SMRAM measuring system which includes two parts, i.e., 2D cage system and 3D light field system, and zooming system. The zooming system includes a group of LED light bars, an objective lens, a zoom tube, and a beam splitter. This part can be used for zooming. The 2D cage system includes a group of plates, tubes, rods, and a CCD sensor which is used to obtain high-resolution 2D images. A 3D light field system includes a MLA, a relay lens, and a COMS sensor which is used to obtain multi-perspective light field images. The developed system has the advantage of multiple views and a high resolution. The light field system can provide multiview images which can help to determine the depth of complex 3D surfaces. The relay lens of the 3D system can help to adjust the distance and significantly reduce testing costs and use of space. The cage system in 2D and 3D systems makes it easy to modify the position of optical components. Experimental results show that fusing dual-channel data mitigates the limitations of individual channels, and the 2D channel’s lack of angular information is supplemented by the 3D channel’s EIs. This complementarity lays a solid foundation for improving depth map quality and measurement robustness. For the software related to the algorithm of the system (Objective 4), AI technology has been used to process the measurement data, with neural networks designed which can be used in depth estimation. However, in order to deal with the issue that there are not very many datasets concerning complex 3D surfaces to train this model, Blender is used to generate a synthetic dataset. In this dataset, we created about eight categories of complex 3D surfaces such as curved frustum, frustum, sphere freeform, and so on. Each category includes about 625 images and a mapping depth map. As for neural networks, an Encoder–Decoder model is designed which can extract the features swiftly and generate depth maps accurately. In this project, a convolution neural network (CNN) has been developed for estimating depth from a single image, and the dataset to train the model has been built. The encoder of networks can be used to extract features from the input images, and the decoder of the networks can be used to map different features into different depths. The network is trained by using three different loss functions. Smooth L1 loss can restrict the gradient. By using this loss function, the gradient value is not too large when the difference between the predicted value and ground truth is not too large. Perceptual loss can compare two different images that look similar, like the same photo but with some shifted pixels. This loss function can greatly help us to modify the features of the predicted value. The image smooth loss function can smoothen the surface features of the predicted value. Two different image gradients (x-direction and y-direction) of the predicted value and ground truth are determined, they are combined into a tensor, and the MSE of two different tensors is determined. The custom-developed UniDepth deep learning model (encoder–decoder architecture with attention mechanisms) achieves breakthrough performance in depth estimation from 2D HR images. Compared with existing advanced methods (StructDepth, MiDaS, DPT, LeReS), UniDepth displays significant advantages in both quantitative and qualitative metrics. The proposed fusion strategy based on Gaussian–Laplacian pyramid decomposition effectively integrates dual-channel depth information. By decomposing data into high-frequency (HF) and low-frequency (LF) components, comparing similarity with an all-in-focus reference image (via SSIM), and retaining optimal features, the fusion process addresses issues such as noise, edge discontinuities, and resolution disparities in single-channel depth maps. In Objective 5, a prototype of a smart multichannel super-resolution autostereoscopic measurement (SMSRAM) system has been built and experimentally evaluated. Compared with the traditional autostereoscopic measuring system, the system has an additional 2D channel which provides high-resolution 2D images. These images can work in inhomogeneous data fusion, which can obtain more accurate measuring results (Objective 5 and Objective 6). Compared with traditional single-channel autostereoscopic systems using established methods (EPI-shift, Laplacian-based Shape-from-Focus (SFF), FastLFnet, SSA), the proposed SMSARM system exhibits comprehensive advantages. The project’s core outcomes lie in developing a novel MAM system that integrates dual optical channels, a high-performance UniDepth model, and a multi-scale fusion strategy. It fundamentally addresses the limitations of traditional single-channel autostereoscopic systems, achieving breakthroughs in measurement accuracy (MaxAE = 0.49 μm), robustness (low standard deviation in repeated measurements), and efficiency (synchronized dual-channel data capture). These findings not only advance the theoretical and technical development of micro-structured surface metrology but also provide a high-precision, non-destructive measurement solution for critical fields such as advanced manufacturing and biomedical engineering. On the whole, the research results have been disseminated in seven refereed journal papers and presented in a refereed international conference. A PhD student named Mr. Yang Yongqiang has been trained.

15207521.label: Major findings and research outcome
15207521.value: The major findings and research outcome of the project include the establishment of a smart multichannel super-resolution autostereoscopic measurement (SMSRAM) principle and hence develop a prototype measuring system based on SMSRAM for on-machine and in-situ multi-scale measurement of complex 3D surfaces. The project is of prime importance in building up the research capability for measuring complex 3D surfaces without any contact along with the manufacturing process with different measuring scales simultaneously. In the proposed SMSRAM system, a novel multi-route optical scheme (Conference paper 1) has been developed for compatible combination of various imaging systems with different measuring scales and extendibility for additional optical routes incorporated into the SMSRAM system for further measuring requirements. Within a certain optical route of an imaging module, a hybrid autostereoscopic measuring module has been built which provided super-resolved 3D measuring results by constructing the sharing optical path for an autostereoscopic 3D measuring system and a supplementary 2D imaging system (Journal paper 6). Other than the novel hardware-level optical system developments of the proposed SMSRAM system, artificial intelligence (AI) technologies provide compelling support to the proposed system in terms of super-resolution (Journal papers 1 and 4), defect detections (Journal papers 2 and 3), 3D information reconstruction (Journal paper 5), and inhomogeneous data fusion (Journal papers 6 and 7), which act as the adhesive that keeps each optical route with different measuring resolution and scales of this advanced measurement system working together normally to provide super-resolved multi-scale comprehensive 3D measurement data. On the whole, the first innovative aspect of this proposal is the development of a novel optical scheme from the integration of multiple optical routes with different imaging systems with various functions for multi-scale complex 3D surface measurement under the SMSRAM principle (Conference Paper 1 and Journal paper 6). The second innovative aspect is the development of an AI-assisted novel data processing scheme for providing super-resolved multi-scale comprehensive 3D measurement data (Journal Papers 1 to 7). The developed SMSRAM principle and hence the system not only enable multi-scale 3D surface measurements within a single snapshot data acquisition process but also provide super-resolved comprehensive 3D measurement data for complex 3D surfaces. The SMSRAM system has the advantages of high measurement accuracy, fast measuring speed and multi-scale measurement capability. The research outcome of the project will contribute significantly to the scientific advancement of measurement science and the technology for complex 3D surfaces.

15207521.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15207521.value: The smart multichannel super-resolution autostereoscopic measurement (SMSRAM) system has laid a solid foundation for high-precision micro-structured surface metrology. Some suggestions for further work are given below: (i)The current dual-channel (2D+3D) design will be enhanced by integrating additional optical routes to address bottlenecks such as the 3D channel’s narrow field of view (FOV) and limited adaptability to complex surface topographies. A micro-zoom optical channel (magnification 12–20×) will be integrated to further enhance the spatial resolution for ultra-fine micro-structures, complementing the existing 10× imaging system. A wide-angle optical channel (FOV > 500 μm) will be incorporated for the 3D module, paired with a high-pitch microlens array (MLA, pitch 300–400 μm) to expand measurement coverage without sacrificing angular resolution. The common-path optical architecture will be optimized with a multi-beam splitter to ensure synchronized data capture across all routes,minimizing optical aberrations via adaptive lens calibration. (ii)An enhanced model with multi-modal feature fusion will be developed to reduce noise in low-texture regions,using vision transformers to replace partial convolutional layers for better global context capture. (iii)A lightweight version of the fusion algorithm will be developed to reduce computational latency,enabling in-line measurement in ultra-precision manufacturing lines.

15207521.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15207521.value: The applications of multi-scale complex three-dimensional (3D) surfaces have been more widespread in various industries including semiconductor, bio-medical, energy, automotive, aerospace, etc. Motivated by the demand for high-precision surface metrology methods for complex 3D surfaces with multi-scale features that can perform the super-resolved multi-scale measurements through a 3D non-contact measurement method. From the point of view of in-situ measurement, this is important for feeding back the measurement data to the compensation machining process. As a result, this project has successfully developed a smart multichannel super-resolution autostereoscopic measurement (SMSRAM) method and system to perform in-situ measurement of multi-scale complex 3D surfaces under different measuring scales simultaneously within a single snapshot data acquisition process with sub-micrometer form accuracy. The SMSRAM system has been successfully verified through a series of experiments. The performance of the system is found to be fast and non-destructive, with super high resolutions enabling reliable quality control for ultra-precision manufacturing, pushing progress in the fields needing high-precision and high-performance components. The outcome of the research has significant impact in advancing measurement science and technology, optical engineering, and precision manufacturing which is substantiated by the publication of a number of high-quality refereed journal papers and trained PhD students.

15207721.value: With the advance in Artificial Intelligence (AI), the development of bionic systems has become a hot research topic to harness the features of animals, such as locomotion, actuation, sensing, mechanics, manipulation, control, and dynamics, for improving the robotics capabilities. Therefore, such research shall involve collaborations across multiple disciplines like materials, biology, mechanics, power electronics, and aerodynamics. The prosperous results have emerged in the last five years, especially Robot bug by the University of California, RoboBee by Wyss Institute and Harvard University, and Bat Bot by University of Illinois, Urbana-Champaign, and Caltech. They are intended for utilization in assisted pollination, surveillance, weather and environmental monitoring, and rescue operations such as fire scenes and archaeological sites. It has certain breakthroughs however, still in an embryonic stage until the problem of energy storage, power processing, driving micro-actuator could be resolved. A more powerful and applicable flying robot is an intelligent autonomous robotic bat which can both fly and dive, suitable for complicated situation potentially used for the pollination, dispersing seeds and killing pests, rescue, monitoring or exploring, building information modeling, indoor or outdoor construction mapping both from sky or underwater. The model is now being developed by our team with success, however, the energy demand is high. The present work is to focus on the power source development using the power needed for the actuators used in the robotic operation. Because of the extensive power requirement for the robot, the battery and charging share the main concern for all robots. The present project is to make use of the former experience in the battery, charging, wireless power transfer, machines, and actuators to research a new form of power transfer to the robot in a wireless manner. The key research work will focus on the 3D wireless power transfer which could provide the charging of the battery even when the robotic bat under different types of terrains. The research also focuses on the multiple emitters, transfer field space analysis, multidirectional wireless transfer model, and design of a novel smart body-integrated energy storage for high energy storage as well as electromagnetic nanoabsorbent/coating for electromagnetic interference reduction and electromagnetic stealth. The energy storage is programmed to adapt to any transient actuation power. The project provides a future application in security, farming, bionics, energy management 3D wireless for robot and energy systems. 15207821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15207821.value: It is a common practice and an effective way for human to obtain desired information through communication by asking and answering questions. This process is a typical multi-round conversation involving a series of relevant questions and answers, especially when information need is complex (or vague) and cannot be fully expressed in a single question. When developing machines to support human information-seeking needs, it is necessary to endow them with the capabilities to understand and answer conversational questions based on the relevant context. Driven by its promising application prospects and rapid development of question-answering and human-machine conversation technologies, conversational question-answering becomes an emerging research topic in natural language processing very recently. The tremendous interests quickly bring in new models that directly combine existing question-answering and conversation approaches, e.g., by concatenating conversation histories and current questions together to enrich question formulations and then employing off-the-shelf question-answering models to find answers. These models are inadequate or even incapable of capturing multi-round information interaction, and thus cannot take full benefit of conversation to successfully achieve the complex information-seeking goal. This project aims to develop innovative deep interaction approaches to conversational question understanding and answer reasoning. In support of this objective, we are dedicated to exploring the following three key problems: (1) how to model dynamic interaction of conversation content and communication intent to capture the global context of a conversation process, in which the complex information need is gradually exposed and fulfilled; (2) how to identify the relevant context to accurately interpret and formulate the current question, and how to determine and clarify an ambiguous question; (3) how to infer the content that answers the current question and meanwhile relates to answers in previous rounds. Conversational question-answering is an integrated task. It is bound to consume large amounts of data and computational resources if a model is trained from scratch. Humans are good at transferring knowledge from previous experience when facing with new problems. In addition to tight integration of question-answering and multi-round conversation technologies, we are also very interested in investigating how to obtain and transfer prior knowledge, including both human knowledge and machine knowledge, to enhance machine learning efficiency. We are confident to say that our research achievements and findings will provide insights for many applications that require training machines to accomplish complex tasks via integration of multiple skills and continuous learning from prior knowledge. 通過提問和回答問題進行交流，是人們獲取所需信息的一種常見做法，也是一種有效的方式。這個過程是一個典型的多輪對話，涉及一系列相關的問題和答案，尤其是當信息需求復雜（或模糊）並且不能用一個問題完整表達時。當開發機器以支持人類信息搜索需求時，有必要賦予它們基於相關上下文理解和回答對話問題的能力。 在其廣闊的應用前景以及問答和人機對話技術快速發展的推動之下，會話問答成為近年來自然語言處理領域的一項新興研究課題。广泛的興趣迅速帶來了直接結合現有問答和對話方法的新模型，例如，通過將對話歷史和當前問題連接在一起以豐富問題表述，然後使用現成的問答模型來尋找答案。這些模型都不足以甚至無法捕捉多輪信息的交互，因此無法充分利用對話來成功實現複雜的信息搜索目標。 該項目旨在開發用於對話問題理解和答案推理的創新深度交互方法。為支持這一目標，我們致力於探索以下三個關鍵問題：（1）如何對會話內容和交流意圖的動態交互進行建模，以捕捉會話過程的全局上下文，逐漸揭示並滿足復雜的信息需求； (2) 如何識別相關語境，準確解釋和表述當前問題，以及如何確定和澄清模棱兩可的問題； (3)如何推斷出回答當前問題且同時與前幾輪答案保持一致相關的內容。 會話式問答是一項綜合任務。如果從頭開始訓練模型，必然會消耗大量數據和計算資源。人在面對新問題時善於從以前的經驗中轉移知識。除了問答和多輪對話技術的緊密結合，我們也非常有興趣研究如何獲取和轉移先驗知識，其中包括人類知識也包括機器知識，以提高機器學習效率。我們有信心，我們的研究成果和發現將為許多其他需要訓練機器通過集成多種技能和不斷學習先驗知識來完成複雜任務的應用提供新穎見解。

15209021.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15209021.value: Road transport consumes huge amount of energy and produces enormous emissions. The eco-driving technology can effectively reduce vehicles’ energy consumption and emission. Specifically, eco-driving aims to optimize the vehicle’s speed along a road, and provide the drivers with optimal driving advice on speed and acceleration. By following such advice, the vehicle can reach the destination on time with minimum energy consumption. Eco-driving has become an especially popular research topic in recent years, due to the emergence of autonomous vehicles which can follow the advice quickly and precisely. Early research in eco-driving considered a vehicle travelling on a given road segment without interference from signals or other vehicles. Recent research has extended to urban networks with intersections, which includes eco-driving on a whole vehicle journey across several intersections, and eco-driving of multiple vehicles passing one intersection with conflicting movements. To maximize the benefit of eco-driving, a desirable eco-driving method/algorithm should consider practical road conditions (such as varying speed limits and varying road gradient) and practical energy consumption models, and be able to obtain globally optimal solutions in real time. However, no current methods can satisfy all these requirements. This project will propose eco-driving models which can incorporate practical road and vehicle conditions and obtain globally optimal solutions in real time. The first part of the project will set up a novel optimization formulation for eco-driving on a freeway without intersections. The formulation is a convex optimization problem which can be solved efficiently with guaranteed global optimality. This lays the foundation for the second and third parts. The second part considers the eco-driving for a complete journey over several signalized intersections, and optimizes the time of the vehicle passing all intersections and its trajectory. The third part focuses on the eco-driving of multiple vehicles at intersections. It will first consider an isolated intersection to optimize all vehicles’ passing time and trajectories, and then extend to the case involving multiple intersections. The eco-driving problems in the second and third parts are formulated as mixed integer convex programming problems, which can be solved by standard solvers or tailored algorithms that can find globally optimal solutions efficiently. This project will improve the applicability of eco-driving on urban road networks and enhance their performance especially in complex conditions involving intersection control. The project can benefit countries and regions in achieving their target of improving energy efficiency and reducing carbon emissions in the transportation sector. 道路運輸消耗大量能源，產生大量排放。節能駕駛技術可以有效地減少車輛的能耗和排放。具體來說，節能駕駛旨在優化車輛在道路上的行駛速度，為司機提供最優的速度和加速度建議。司機按這些建議駕駛汽車，可以以最小的能耗準時到達目的地。近年來，由於自動駕駛技術的出現，節能駕駛成為一個熱門的研究課題，因為自動駕駛車輛能夠快速準確地執行節能駕駛建議。早期的節能駕駛研究的是車輛在沒有信號燈或其他車輛幹擾的情況下的駕駛策略。最近，節能駕駛研究已經擴展到具有交叉口的城市道路，包括車輛在整個行程過程中經過多個交叉口，以及行駛方向相互沖突的多輛車輛通過同一個交叉口。為了達到最佳的節能效果，一個理想的節能駕駛方法/算法應該考慮實際的道路條件（如限速和道路坡度）和實際的能耗模型，並且能夠實時地求得全局最優解。然而，現有的節能駕駛方法/算法還無法同時滿足所有這些要求。本項目將提出一個能考慮實際道路和車輛狀況並能夠實時求得全局最優解的節能駕駛模型。項目的第一部分將建立一個新的優化模型以求解經典的（沒有交叉口或其他車輛幹擾的）節能駕駛問題。這個新的優化模型是一個凸優化問題，因此可以高效地求得全局最優解。此凸優化模型是項目的第二和第三部分的基礎。第二部分研究一輛車通過多個帶信號燈的交叉口的節能駕駛問題，以優化車輛通過每個交叉口的時刻和整個行程的速度曲線。第三部分研究多輛行駛方向相互沖突的車輛通過交叉口時的節能駕駛：它將首先考慮單個交叉口以優化所有車輛的速度曲線和通過交叉口的時刻，然後擴展到多個交叉口的情況。第二和第三部分中的節能駕駛問題可以被建模為混合整數凸優化問題；這些問題可以通過通用求解器或定製算法來高效地求得全局最優解。本項目將提高節能駕駛技術在城市路網中的適用性和應用效果，尤其是包含交叉口的復雜情況。本項目將有助於各個國家和地區提高能源利用效率和減少交通運輸的碳排放。

15209021.label: Realisation of objectives
15209021.value: Objective 1 has been addressed. By using the Comprehensive Modal Emissions Model as the fuel consumption model, we developed a new and tractable formulation for the eco-driving problem of road vehicles through discretization, convexification and approximation, leading to a linear program which can be solved efficiently. Computational results indicated that our new formulation yielded significant reduction in the solution time as compared to alternative formulations and algorithms. We then further applied our developed method to the eco-routing-and-driving problem which jointly optimizes the route and the speed profile of a vehicle from a given origin to a given destination; numerical experiments demonstrated that our eco-routing-and-driving formulation afforded further reduction in fuel consumption than other eco-routing methods. The results have been published as a journal paper. Objective 2 has been addressed. Based on the new eco-routing-and-driving formulation proposed in Objective 1, we considered a more practical scenario in an urban road network for eco-routing-and-driving: we assumed all intersections are controlled by traffic lights, where each traffic light is actuated or adaptive, leading to uncertainty in signal state and intersection delay at each intersection. To handle such uncertainties, we formulated the eco-routing-and-driving problem as a stochastic optimization problem; a solution algorithm based on sample average approximation was developed to solve the proposed formulation. The results were previously submitted to a journal but rejected. The paper is now under further revision for future submission. Objective 3: This objective is to extend the intersection scenario in Objective 2 from one vehicle to multiple vehicles, where the key consideration is the need to maintain safety distance between vehicles. Since the results of Objective 2 have not been published yet, we turned to a similar but more complex problem, which is the eco-driving of multiple trains. The train eco-driving is more complex than that of road vehicles as: (i) the traction and braking capacity of trains is speed-dependent, while that of road vehicles is usually assumed constant; and (ii) the safety-distance restriction of trains has multiple forms, such as fixed-block signaling and moving-block signaling, while that of road vehicles is usually similar to moving-block. For the multi-train eco-driving problem, we first followed our idea in Objective 1 to construct a new and more tractable mathematical optimization formulation for single-train eco-driving that can be solved to exact solutions more efficiently, and then extended the formulation to multiple trains under fixed-block signaling. The numerical case studies demonstrated that our new formulations can solve the train eco-driving problems to exact solutions more efficiently than state-of-art methods. The results have been published as a journal paper.

15209021.label: Major findings and research outcome
15209021.value: 1. We developed a new and tractable linear program formulation for the eco-driving problem of a single road vehicle, and extended the formulation to the eco-routing-and-driving problem which simultaneously optimizes the route and the speed profile of a vehicle from a given origin to a given destination for further energy saving. The numerical case studies showed that our new linear program formulation for eco-driving can achieve significantly shorter computing time than state-of-art methods, and that our eco-routing-and-driving formulation can achieve lower energy consumption than other existing eco-routing methods. The results have been published as Paper #1. Paper #1: Wu, F., Ye, H., Bektas, T., Dong, M., 2025. New and tractable formulations for the eco-driving and the eco-routing-and-driving problems. European Journal of Operational Research 321 (2), 445-461. 2. We considered the eco-routing-and-driving problem in an urban road network with signalized intersections, where the signal states are uncertain, leading to uncertain delays at the intersections. We constructed a stochastic optimization formulation for the eco-routing-and-driving problem, and proposed effective solution algorithms for the proposed formulation. The paper is now under preparation. Paper #2: Wu, F., Ye, H., Bektas, T., Dong, M. Eco-routing-and-driving with intersections of signal uncertainty. Under preparation. 3. We constructed a new optimization formulation for the single-train eco-driving problem that can be effectively solved to exact solutions, and proposed valid inequalities to enhance the computational efficiency. We then extended the formulation to two other more practical but complex eco-driving problems, including the single-train eco-driving problem with intermediate time-window constraints, and the eco-driving problem for a fleet of trains under the green-wave policy of fixed-block signaling. Numerical experiments showed that our proposed method outperformed benchmark methods in solving the single-train eco-driving problem, and can deliver exact solutions for the two more complicated eco-driving problems within reasonable computing time. The results have been published as Paper #3. Paper #3: Xiao, Z., Ye, H., Chung, E., 2025. New formulations and solution approaches for train eco-driving problems. Transportation Research Part B 195, 103210.

15209021.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15209021.value: The eco-routing-and-driving problems studied in Objectives 1 and 2 can be further extended by incorporating more practical scenarios for an urban road network: on one hand, we can consider that not all traffic lights are actuated or adaptive, i.e., some signals are actuated or adaptive, while others have fixed signal plans; on the other hand, we can consider that the traffic speeds on the road links are uncertain. While formulation wise, we can use both stochastic optimization and distributionally robust optimization, which can suit the needs or preferences of different potential users. We can further develop tailored solution algorithms to speed up the solution of the proposed formulations. The eco-driving methods for trains investigated in Objective 3 are suitable to be extended to scenarios such as under power restrictions from substations (for current engineering practise) or under virtual coupling signaling system (for future cases). Since our methods showed better computational efficiency than previous methods, they are more suitable to be deployed in real systems for online application; we will try to disseminate our results to the train operators for possible collaboration (or knowledge exchange) and real-world implementation.

15209021.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15209021.value: We developed new eco-driving methods for vehicles in road networks, aiming to provide drivers with optimal driving advice on speed and acceleration along a road, to reduce vehicle energy consumption and reach destination on time. Specifically, we constructed new formulations for the eco-driving of a single vehicle via a series of reformulations, enabling a faster computation for obtaining the exact eco-driving solutions, facilitating the application of eco-driving technology in real world. We also extended our new formulation to the eco-routing-and-driving problem, optimizing both the route and speed profile of a vehicle from a given origin to a destination, further improving the energy-saving performance. Enlightened by the above-established reformulation, we applied similar techniques to the eco-driving problems of trains. Via proper reformulations and rigorous mathematical proofs, we reformulated the single-train eco-driving problem to an equivalent but more tractable form, significantly reducing the computing time of getting the exact solutions. We further extended such reformulations to two more practical but complex train eco-driving problems, including the single-train eco-driving with intermediate time-window constraints, and the coordinated eco-driving of a train fleet. This improves the practicality of train eco-driving technologies in real-world railway systems.

15209121.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15209121.value: Ride-sourcing service offered by transportation network companies (TNCs), such as Uber, Lyft and DiDi, has been disruptively reshaped the way we travel. Although it brings convenience to passengers and offers many job opportunities to drivers, ride-sourcing service has aroused some debatable issues, e.g. making traffic congestion worse, which call for the need of government regulations. The objectives of TNCs and the government are generally in partial conflicts with each other. TNCs are interested in their own profits, while the government is concerned with a wide variety of social welfares, including, but not limited to, welfare of passengers and drivers, levels of traffic congestion, transit usage. To avoid TNCs from compromising benefits of other stakeholders by using selfish operating strategy, some cities are now imposing some regulatory schemes, such as fleet size control, fare regulation, wage guarantee, for ride-sourcing services. However, due to the complexity of ride-sourcing markets, it remains a challenge to understand the aggregate implications of these regulatory schemes on different stakeholders’ interests, and it is still unclear whether these regulations can effectively strike a good balance between these partially conflicted concerns. In addition, it is also interesting and important to explore some other effective regulatory schemes that have never been implemented but can potentially lead to a socially desirable outcome. To address these intriguing issues, in this project, we first develop an aggregate model that can well characterize the stationary equilibrium state of ride-sourcing markets. With the model, we are able to evaluate the regulatory outcomes of a variety of government regulations, including fare-cap regulation, fleet size control, wage regulation, utilization regulation, and commission charge regulation, etc. Some of these regulations are already imposed in some cities, and others are proposed by us or other researchers but have not yet been utilized. Asides from looking into the impacts of these regulations on benefits/interests of different relevant stakeholders, we are also interested in investigating whether these regulations can successfully induce the platform to voluntarily choose a strategy leading to Pareto-efficient outcomes desired by the government. Moreover, real-world mobility datasets will be utilized to calibrate the developed models while empirical studies will be conducted to verify analytical findings about the regulatory outcomes of different regulations. These theoretical and empirical results will offer valuable managerial insights that can assist governments in designing appropriate and effective regulatory schemes for ride-sourcing markets under various situations. 随着移动互联网的普及与发展，以“滴滴出行”、“优步”为代表的网约车平台正在重塑人们的出行方式。与此同时，网约车的出现也带来了许多新的问题和挑战。众所周知，作为私人资本，网约车平台是逐利的，其设计的最优运营策略往往不能最大化社会效益，却可能损害乘客、司机的效益，并带来不良的外部影响，如增加交通拥堵、减少公交使用、造成大量出租车司机失业等。为了保障其他市场参与者的权益，及减少共享出行的负外部性，政府和监管者可以通过设计不同的监管政策规制网约车平台的决策，如管制网约车服务的价格和佣金、提高网约车司机的准入门槛、限制网约车平台的抽成比例等。因此，如何通过合理的运营和监管，提升共享出行系统的效率、公平性、可持续性，并平衡网约车市场各主体的利益，是当前共享出行管理中一个重要课题。 本课题拟建立一个完备的数学模型，以精确刻画共享出行市场不同参与者的博弈策略，并求解出平台运营策略的帕累托边界。基于此模型，课题将研究平台不同运营策略对共享出行市场不同参与者的权益的影响，及对交通拥堵和其他交通模式（如公交）的影响，同时探索如何通过合理的监管政策，诱导平台采取兼具效率、公平与可持续性的运营策略，达到帕累托最优。本课题拟研究的监管政策既包括一些常见的监管政策，如价格管制、车队数量限制、司机最低工资设定、车辆利用率限制等，也包括一些当前仍未被城市监管者使用的创新型监管政策，如平台最高抽成限制。本课题将利用真实数据和仿真实验对理论模型进行校准和检验，以保证模型的真实性、准确性与实用性。此模型与相关实验将有助于城市管理者针对不同类型和规模的城市设计最优的监管政策组合，对提高城市交通管理的水平有着重要的理论和实践意义。

15209321.label: Project Objectives
15209321.value: To propose and explore the multi-dimensional optical spectrum response measurement method based on linear frequency modulation (LFM) to achieve ultrafast and ultrahigh-resolution multi-dimensional optical spectrum responses characterization for advanced photonic devices and components. A breakthrough of frequency resolution up to 100 kHz (2,000 times beyond commercial instruments) and a measurement speed up to 1 ns/point (50,000 times beyond commercial instruments) are potentially achievable. To build a comprehensive model and then perform the analytical analysis and the numerical simulation to estimate the potential performance and limitation of the LFM-based method. Furthermore, the influence of the linewidth of the laser, bias point control stability, signal-noise ratio (SNR) of the probe signal, etc. on the measurement performance will be detailly investigated in theory and simulation. To extend the measurement range by optical channelization based on the optical frequency comb (OFC), wherein the interested measurement range is first channelized and then the channel-by-channel optical spectrum responses measurement and the precise optical spectrum responses stitching are performed. 15209321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15209321.value: Photonic technologies, taking advantage of ultra-broad bandwidth of lightwave, enable optical communication and play a crucial role in the modern “information age”. Nowadays, the explosive growth of data and Internet traffic in communication (doubled every two years) highly desire high-efficiency optical spectrum utilization. The promising solution is to manipulate the multi-dimensional optical spectrum, including magnitude, phase, polarization, etc. However, the key photonics devices and components, being able to handle the optical spectrum with high fineness, are hard to make innovations and breakthroughs, which further place a restriction on the upgrading and updating of the optical communication system. As we know, the research & development (R&D) of the photonic devices and components are determined by not only the design and fabrication techniques but also the measurement and analysis. Hence, characterizing the multi-dimensional optical spectrum responses, including magnitude, phase and polarization response, are essential and crucial. However, limited by the imperfections of the now available methods (e.g. poor frequency resolution, low measurement speed or small dynamic range), the detailed problems occurred in the design and fabrication of the high-performance photonics devices and components could barely be reflected, which consequentially slows the innovation and breakthrough of optical communication now and in the future. In this project, we propose a systematical research plan to explore ultrafast and ultrahigh-resolution optical spectrum response measurement method based on linear frequency modulation (LFM). Firstly, the basic theory of the LFM-based measurement method will be explored and established to achieve the Jones transmission matrix of an optical device-under-test (DUT). The analytical analysis and the numerical simulation to estimate the potential performance and limitation are performed. Then, the key techniques are developed to boost the measurement performance of the LFM-based method, including measurement range extension using optical-frequency-comb-based channelization, dynamic range enhance based on balanced photodetection and accuracy improvement based on comprehensive calibration. The proposed LFM-based method potentially has not only a breakthrough of frequency resolution up to 100 kHz (2,000 times beyond commercial instruments) but also an ultrafast measurement speed up to 1 ns/point (50,000 times beyond commercial instruments). It is believed the success of this project will promote and accelerate Hong Kong’s innovation and breakthroughs in optical communication and the photonics-related fields. Furthermore, it will bring significant advances for the information related strategic and frontier fields. It will also offer a broad spectrum of research and educational opportunities for students and postdocs. 光子技術利用光波的超寬帶寬，使光通信系統在當今“信息時代”中發揮著至關重要的作用。現代通信中數據和互聯網流量的爆炸式增長（每兩年翻一番）非常需要高效的光譜利用。可行的解決方案是多維操縱光譜，包括幅度、相位、偏振等。 但是，用以高精細度處理光譜的關鍵光子器件和組件的研發很難取得突破，限制了光通信系統的升級和更新。 眾所周知，光子器件和組件的研發不僅取決於設計和製造技術，還取決於測量和分析。因此，測量光譜多維響應，包括幅度、相位和偏振響應，是必不可少的關鍵技術。然而，受限於現有測量方法的不足（例如頻率分辨率差、測量速度慢或動態範圍小），高性能光子器件和組件的細節問題很難反映出來，減緩了光通信的創新和突破。 在本項目中，我們提出系統的研究計劃，探索基於線性調頻（LFM）的超快速超高分辨率光譜響應測量方法。首先，將進行基於 LFM 的測量方法的理論探索，取得被測光學器件 (DUT) 的瓊斯傳輸矩陣。分析和數值模擬其性能和限制。然後，開發關鍵技術，提高基於LFM的方法的測量性能，包括基於光頻率梳的測量範圍擴展、基於平衡光電檢測的動態範圍增強、以及基於綜合校準的精度提高。所提出的基於 LFM 的方法不僅有可能突破高達 100 kHz 的頻率分辨率（比商用儀器高 2,000 倍），而且具有高達 1 ns/點的超快測量速度（比商用儀器高 50,000 倍）。相信這個項目的成功將推動和加速香港在光通信和光子學相關領域的創新和突破，為信息相關的戰略和前沿領域帶來突破，還將為學生和博士後提供相關的研究和教育機會。

15209421.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15209421.value: Structural steels with a yield strength at 355 N/mm2, or S355 steels, are widely adopted in construction worldwide since the 1970s, and their mechanical properties are well understood through many years of research and applications in structural engineering. Since the 1990s, high-strength steels with yield strengths ranging from 690 to 960 N/mm2, or S690 to S960 steels, are readily produced in many countries, and many engineers are eager to exploit applications of these steels in high-rise buildings and long span bridges. Despite deflection control may be critical in some of these structures, the use of S690 steels is able to reduce steel tonnages due to reduced self-weights, when compared with S355 steels. There are also associated savings in materials and time in construction of their supporting structures and foundations. Despite of huge potential benefits offered by these S690 steels, there are challenges to promote their wide adoption in construction. Significant reductions in mechanical properties of their welded-sections are reported from times to times. As modern seismic resistant design always assumes a high level of resistances and ductility available in various structural members and systems built with S355 steels, it is essential to provide experimental evidence to demonstrate that there are similar levels of resistances and ductility in these S690 structures with properly-controlled welding processes. In this project, it is proposed to examine adequacy of resistance and ductility of typical S690 welded-sections and moment joints in which robotic welding will be adopted to control the welding processes with specific welding procedures and parameters. It is important to establish that these S690 welded-sections and moment joints are able to perform satisfactorily under those cyclic actions due to seismic loadings. A number of coordinated structural tests, numerical modelling and development will be carried out i) to examine structural responses of welded-sections and moment joints under different types of low-cycle-high-strain cyclic actions, and ii) to develop constitutive models of welded-sections and moment joints under cyclic actions of constant as well as varying strain amplitudes for accurate prediction of their structural behaviour. This is a scientific investigation to qualify and quantity whether these high-strength S690 welded-sections and moment joints possess sufficient resistances and ductility for seismic resistant construction. With properly designed welding procedures and parameters, no or small reductions on resistances and ductility of these S690 welded-sections and moment joints are attained, and technical guidelines on qualifying welding procedures and parameters will be provided. 自 1970 年代以來，屈服強度為 355 N/mm2 的結構鋼或 S355 鋼在全球建築中被廣泛採用，通過多年的結構工程研究和應用，它們的機械性能得到了很好的理解。20世紀90年代以來，屈服強度為690～960 N/mm2的高強度鋼，或S690～S960鋼，在許多國家已經很容易生產，許多工程師急於開發這些鋼在高層建築和建築中的應用。大跨度橋樑。儘管撓度控制在其中一些結構中可能很關鍵，但與 S355 鋼相比，由於自重降低，使用 S690 鋼能夠減少鋼噸位。還可以節省相關的材料和時間來建造支撐結構和基礎。 儘管這些 S690 鋼具有巨大的潛在優勢，但要促進它們在建築中的廣泛採用仍面臨挑戰。不時有報導稱其焊接部分的機械性能顯著降低。作為現代地震抗性設計始終假定使用 S355 鋼構建的各種結構構件和系統具有高水平的抗性和延展性，因此必須提供實驗證據以證明存在相似的抗性水平和這些 S690 結構的延展性通過適當控制的焊接工藝。 在本項目中，擬採用機器人焊接，通過特定的焊接工藝和參數來控制焊接過程，對典型的S690焊接截面和彎矩接頭的電阻和延展性進行檢測。重要的是要確定這些 S690 焊接截面和彎矩接頭能夠在由於地震載荷引起的循環作用下令人滿意地運行。將進行一系列協調的結構試驗、數值建模和開發 i) 檢查焊接截面和彎矩接頭在不同類型的低周高應變循環作用下的結構響應，以及 ii) 開發本構模型焊接截面和彎矩接頭在恆定和變化應變幅度的循環作用下，以準確預測其結構行為。這是對這些高強度 S690 焊接型材和彎矩接頭是否具有足夠抗震結構的抗力和延展性進行質量和數量的科學調查。通過正確設計焊接工藝和參數，這些 S690 焊接截面和彎矩接頭的電阻和延展性沒有或很小的降低，並且將提供合格的焊接工藝和參數的技術指南。

15209421.label: Realisation of objectives
15209421.value: Objective 1 To investigate experimentally mechanical properties and structural behaviour of the S690 welded sections and moment joints under cyclic actions with i) constant magnitudes, and ii) varying magnitudes. • A total of 72 standardized coupons of S355 and S690 steel plates and their welded sections were carried out under cyclic actions of different loading frequencies and amplitudes, and their cyclic deformation characteristics were measured. It should be noted that these welded sections were prepared using a robotic welding system strictly according to specific welding procedures specifications. Coupons were carefully machined to provide consistent test specimens for cyclic tests. • All these coupons were tested successfully. In all these tests, the applied loads and corresponding axial elongations and shortenings for all these coupons were measured continuously in every cycle for data analyses. • Based on the measured test data, deformation characteristics of these coupons in terms of cycle stress-strain curves were obtained, and key deformation parameters were established to quantify these deformation characteristics. These included: - steel grades and heat energy input during welding, - cyclic actions with different loading frequencies and amplitudes, - maximum tensile and compressive stresses and corresponding strains, - numbers of cycles completed before failure, and total energy dissipated before failure, - degradation in ‘resistance and ductility’ after specific numbers of cycles. In general, it was found that the total numbers of cycles completed before fracture in coupons of S690 welded sections were smaller than those of the S355 welded sections. However, the corresponding total energy dissipated before fracture in coupons of S690 welded sections were similar to those of the S355 welded sections, in particular, for those loading amplitudes at 5% or above. Hence, these S690 welded sections were considered to have enhanced cyclic resistances, when compared with those of the S355 welded sections. Objective 2 To develop a cyclic constitutive material model of the S690 welded sections under cyclic actions with varying magnitudes. • A finite element was developed to simulate the cyclic deformation behaviour of S355 and S690 steel plates and their welded sections, and a complementary constitutive material model was established after careful calibration against the measured cyclic deformation characteristics obtained from cyclic tests. • It should be noted that the constitutive material model was formulated according to a kinematic hardening model with back stresses. Based on the use of three back stresses, a set of cyclic deformation characteristics was generated after calibration to give the same energy dissipation up to fracture. The use of the proposed formulation of the kinematic hardening model with back stresses of suitably selected values for various loading amplitudes were considered to be highly effective. Hence, the cyclic constitutive material model was demonstrated to be able to simulate the cyclic deformation characteristics of these S690 welded sections in a highly satisfactory manner. Objective 3 To develop a tool for accurate prediction of the structural behaviour of moment joints between the S690 welded sections under cyclic actions with varying magnitudes. In order to establish the structural behaviour of S690 welded steel sections and moment resisting T-joins between S690 structural hollow sections under cyclic actions, systematic investigations were conducted together with complementary numerical simulations. These investigations provided essential data to demonstrate structural performance of these S690 welded sections and joints under cyclic actions. It should be noted that • A comprehensive test programme on cyclic actions of S690 welded steel sections was conducted, and a total of about 14 standardized coupons were tested under a practical range of loading frequencies and amplitudes. Detailed data analyses on their cyclic deformation characteristics in terms of degradation in resistances was performed carefully. Test results were also presented in a manner consistent to prevailing design methodology for practical use. • Moreover, a comprehensive test programme on cyclic actions of moment resisting T-joints between S690 structural hollow sections was also conducted, and a total of 10 typical T-joints were tested under a practical range of loading frequencies and amplitudes. It should be noted that these tests were conducted under displacement control to allow for determination of strength degradation for easy interpretation of test results. Deformation characteristics of these T-joints were carefully analyzed to determine their strength degradations against cyclic actions of different amplitudes. In general, all these S690 welded sections and joints were considered to perform in a highly satisfactory manner that their cyclic deformation characteristics were comparable to those of the S355 welded sections and joints. Hence, all those S690 welded sections and jointed covered in the current project were shown to be ready for application in construction projects.

15209421.label: Major findings and research outcome
15209421.value: Despite of huge potential benefits offered by these S690 steels, there are challenges to promote their wide adoption in construction. Besides significant reductions in mechanical properties of their welded-sections, it is important to establish these S690 steel have a high level of resistances and ductility in various structural members and systems, similar to those built with S355 steels. Hence, it is essential to provide experimental evidence to demonstrate that these S690 structures fabricated with properly-controlled welding processes are ready to be used in seismic resistant structures. In this project, it is demonstrated that • S690 welded sections, in the forms of standard coupons with properly designed heat-affected zones, were tested systematically under cyclic actions with various strain levels of a wide range of practical loading frequencies and amplitudes. They were found to behave in a highly satisfactorily manner, exhibiting a high level of resistances and ductility when compared with those of the parent plates under similar loading conditions. Refer to Conference Paper 1 reported in Part C. • In addition, these S690 welded-sections with different welding processes were found to be able to perform satisfactorily under cyclic actions with a wide range of loading frequencies and amplitudes, i.e. similar to those fatigue actions commonly found in bridge structures under road traffic, and those seismic actions found in structures under earthquake attacks. Refer to Journal Paper 1 reported in Part C. • Moreover, cyclic behaviour of moment resisting T-joints between S690 circular hollow sections were found examined in a systematic manner over a wide range of loading conditions with displacement controls. Deformation characteristics of these T-joints were obtained, and their gradual reductions in their resistances were obtained and analyzed to provide practical guidance on typical cyclic behaviour of these T-joints for applications. Refer to Journal Paper 2 reported in Part C. This was a carefully executed scientific investigation to qualify and quantity whether these high strength S690 welded sections and moment resisting T-joints possessed sufficient resistances and ductility for cyclic actions under a wide range of practical loading frequencies and amplitudes. With properly designed welding procedures and parameters, these welded sections and moment joints were demonstrated to have little or even no reduction in resistances and ductility. Technical guidelines on welding of these S690 steel were also provided, and appropriate welding procedures and parameters were also presented.

15209421.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15209421.value: In order to further promote use of S690 high strength steel in construction, it is proposed to carry out the following investigations to generate technical data on the cyclic deformation characteristics of moment resisting T-joints between structural hollow sections: a) To carry out cyclic tests of moment resisting T-joints between S690 hollow sections of various sizes and combinations, i.e. i) T-joints between S690 CHS and CHS, ii) T-joints between S690 SHS and SHS, and iii) T-joints between S690 SHS and CHS where CHS denotes circular hollow sections and SHS denoted square hollow sections. b) To appraise the structural behaviour of these moment resisting T-joints according to current design methodology against i) fatigue actions, and ii) seismic actions in terms of reductions in resistances and ductility over specific ranges of loading frequencies and amplitudes. c) To propose modified design methods and rules compatible to Structural Eurcodes for these moment resisting T-joints in practical conditions.

15209421.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15209421.value: This project provided essential experimental evidence to demonstrate that S690 high strength steel structures possessed excellent resistances and ductility under cyclic actions when they were fabricated with properly-controlled welding processes. Based on systematic experimental investigations, S690 welded sections, in the forms of standard coupons with properly designed heat-affected zones, were found to behave in a highly satisfactorily manner, exhibiting a high level of resistances and ductility when compared with those of the parent plates under similar loading conditions. With different welding processes, both the S690 welded-sections and the moment resisting T-joints between S690 circular hollow sections were found to be able to perform satisfactorily under cyclic actions with a wide range of loading frequencies and amplitudes, similar to those fatigue actions commonly found in bridge structures under road traffic, and those seismic actions found in structures under earthquake attacks. Consequently, it was demonstrated that S690 high strength steel structures with properly welded sections and joints were readily adopted in construction, and they were expected to behave satisfactorily under cyclic actions, as those welded sections and joints built with the commonly normal strength S355 steel.

15209621.label: Project Objectives
15209621.value: Investigate the thermal sensation and thermal comfort of people staying in the cooling spot provided by radiant cooling panels in typical outdoor settings of hot and humid climate. Typical scenarios include hotel entrance, bus stop, and sitting-out area. The air temperature, humidity, air flow, and solar radiation tested will be chosen to represent local weather conditions. The investigation will answer the first key question when using radiant cooling, that is, to what extent the radiant cooling can improve people’s thermal comfort in some outdoor environmental conditions. Develop convincible methods for calculating the cooling load of the radiant panel in outdoor environments. The heat transfer mechanism between the radiant cooling surface and people, between the radiant cooling surface and the outdoor environment and through the long-wave transparent membrane, and the connection between the membrane and ambient air, and conduction and possible convection heat transfer between the membrane and panel surface will be fully taken into account. The calculation will answer the second key question, namely, the energy efficiency of the cooling panel in terms of the percentage of heat removal from the human body in terms of the percentage of the total cooling load of the panel. It is also recognized that the radiant cooling panel may work more effectively when combined with solar shading and enhanced movement of air by mechanical fans, and there is a limit of the range of environmental temperature and humidity conditions under which the technology will be effective. The third objective is to provide general criteria for designing radiant cooling systems in outdoor environment. This will be investigated by using the thermal comfort modeling approach developed over the years by the PI. The UC-Berkeley human thermoregulation model combined with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) / Numerical heat transfer (NHT), which will be validated with the human subject test results in Task 1 mentioned above.

15209621.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15209621.value: Global warming may happen faster than we think, and the resulting impacts on cities may be more serious, especially in those densely populated urban areas in a hot and humid climate. How to improve thermal comfort of local outdoor environment is becoming an imminent issue. Unlike indoors, the outdoor air is widely connected with the atmosphere, which means that the air temperature and humidity and the surrounding radiant temperatures are unlikely to be artificially controllable via the conventional air-conditioning approach, which would be too energy-wasteful and ineffective due to the high convection heat exchange rate with the open air. Radiant cooling can remove heat from the human body via direct thermal radiation, thereby creating a sense of thermal comfort for people, thus providing the possibility of artificially creating comfortable micro-climate in outdoor areas in combination with solar shading and wind amplification. One of the obstacles is the surface convection from the panel to the adjacent air, which does not have cooling effect on the human body in open or semi-open environments and is a pure waste of energy. The other technical problem is the condensation on the radiant panel surface in a hot and humid climate, which must be dealt with properly. However, recent progress in thermal radiation transparent membrane, and PI’s ongoing research in nano-engineered condensation-free panels, provide the possibility of solving these two problems. In this project, we aim to answer three basic key questions in applying the radiant cooling with minimal convection for spot-cooling in open and semi-open environments. Firstly, to what extent thermal comfort can be improved for people staying outdoors; secondly, what will be the energy use or system efficiency; and thirdly, to fulfill thermal comfort requirements, how to design a suitable radiant cooling system considering solar shading and ambient wind in a typical hot and humid climate in Hong Kong. The research will be conducted using human subject testing and thermal environment modeling approach. 全球變暖可能比人們想像的要更快，由此帶來的對城市的影響可能更嚴重，特別是人口密集的亞熱帶城市區域。如何改善當地的室外環境， 正成為一個嚴峻的議題。和室內不同，室外的空氣和大氣環境廣泛連通，空氣的溫度、濕度和流速不可調節，太陽輻照、周圍的物體溫度都處於不可控的狀態，因此難以利用空氣調節，通過對流作用來營造一個舒適的戶外熱環境。 輻射冷卻系統通過輻射傳熱來吸收人體表面的熱量，從而營造熱舒適感，避免了對空氣的作用，可以通過結合與遮陽和引風，在室外區域人為地創造熱舒適的微氣候。然而，在高溫高濕地區，輻射板與周圍空氣的對流換熱對人體的冷卻效果甚微， 只會帶來很大程度的能量浪費；大氣露點溫度較高，凝露問題需要妥善的工程解决方法。最近的一系列研究，如利用選擇性透過短波輻射的薄膜來隔離户外空氣和冷輻射面，以及本團隊正在進行的納米工程超疏水表面來阻止宏觀上的凝露等，都為解決對流熱損失與凝露問題提供了可能性。因此可以在上述技術的基礎上，利用輻射冷卻系統，在戶外環境中營造出舒適的微區域。對於這個新的研究課題，本項目旨在回答三個關鍵問題：首先，輻射製冷系統在戶外將帶來多少熱舒適；第二，營造熱舒適微環境需要的輻射冷量與能效的計算；第三，如何根據當地的氣候情況和舒適性需求設計一個適用於戶外環境的輻射冷卻系統。

15209921.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15209921.value: Parametric optimization problems are important in the study of nonlinear optimization theory. Their applications appear in engineering design, financial management and operations research modeling. In practical application problems, basic data in the models such as demands, resources, market frictions, technical parameters etc. are often not estimated accurately. Stability analysis is to establish verifiable optimality conditions to guarantee that the accuracy of the solutions obtained increases with the degree of approximation of the initial data. The Lipschitz-like property is at the core of stability theory. By virtue of coderivative, Mordukhovich criterion provides a necessary and sufficient condition of the Lipschitz-like property of set-valued mappings and has widely been applied in the study of solution mappings of various parametric optimization problems. However one important assumption of the Mordukhovich criterion is that the candidate point need to be in the interior of the domain of set-valued mappings. This is in general a very restrictive assumption. Recently a projectional coderivative of a set-valued mapping has been introduced and applied to establish a generalized Mordukhovich criterion for characterizing the Lipschitz-like property relative to a closed and convex set. The study of the Lipschitz-like property relative to a set is important in twofold: practical applications consideration and minimum constraint qualification requirement. In this project we will establish the chain rule and the sum rule of the projectional coderivative for the compositions of set-valued mappings by virtue of variational analysis tools including properties of projections. We will investigate necessary and sufficient conditions for the solution mapping of a parametric generalized equation to be Lipschitz-like relative to a closed and convex set and apply them to study that of a parametric linear constraint system under a regularity assumption. We will investigate the Lipschitz-like property of the solution mapping relative to its convex cone domain for a parametric linear complementarity problem with a Q_0 matrix. We will obtain a generalized critical face condition for characterizing the Lipschitz-like property relative to a polyhedral convex set for the solution mapping of a parametric affine variational inequality problem over polyhedral convex sets. We will investigate the strong regularity of a parametric nonlinear variational inequality problem. 参数优化问题在非线性优化理论研究中非常重要。他们的应用出现在工程设计、金融管理和运筹学模型中。在实际应用问题中，模型中的基本数据如需求、资源、市场摩擦、技术参数等往往无法准确估计。稳定分析是建立可验证的最优条件，以保证获得的解的准确性随着初始数据的近似程度增加而增加。利普希茨性质是稳定性理论的核心部分。莫尔杜霍维奇准则提供了集合值映射的满足利普希茨性质的充分必要条件并已被广泛应用于研究各种参数优化问题解映射的利普希茨性质。然而，莫尔杜霍维奇准则的一个重要假设是候选点需要在集合值映射定义域的内部。这通常是一个非常严格的假设。近来一个集合值映射的投影上导数已被引入并应用于建立验证集合值映射的相对于闭凸集的拟利普希茨性质的广义 莫尔杜霍维奇准则。研究相对于集合拟利普希茨属性的重要性有两方面：实际应用考虑和最低约束条件要求。 在这个项目中，我们将借助包括投影性质的变分分析工具建立投影上导数的集合值映射复合的链式法则和求和法则。我们将研究解决参数广义方程解映射为相对于闭凸集的拟利普希茨的充分必要条件将并在正则条件下应用它们来研究参数线性约束系统。我们将研究具有 Q0 矩阵的参数线性互补问题解映射相对于闭凸锥域的拟利普希茨性质。我们将获得多面凸集上参数变分不等式问题解映射相对于多面体凸集的拟利普希茨性质的广义临界面条件。我们将研究参数非线性变分不等式问题的强正则性。
