15507421.label: Realisation of objectives
15507421.value: Objective one: To examine the impact of supply chain contracts on audits, especially with the implementation of ASC 606 which imposes additional burdens of contract examination on auditors. Achievement: The primary data source for this study is the Federal Procurement Data System (FPDS). The FPDS contains information on all US government contracts and contract modifications beginning in the fiscal year 2000. The US government discloses detailed information on government contracts that are above $25,000. FPDS data must be hand and machine-matched with Compustat identifiers. A research assistant matched the FPDS dataset with Compustat and cleaned the ASC 606 dataset. Using the FPDS and ASC 606 datasets, I examined the impact of US government contracts on audits; however, I was unable to find results for the association between ASC 606 and US government contracting. Consequently, the objective with regards to how ASC 606 affects audits of US government contractors was dropped in the current manuscript which was presented in June 2024 at the EURO conference and is in the submission process at the European Journal of Operational Research. To accomplish Objective one, due to the lack of results related to ASC 606 and audit outcomes for US government contractors, I have an additional project with the ASC 606 data with two co-authors who have expertise in regulatory changes. In the ASC 606 context, we investigate the effect of revenue disaggregation on management revenue forecasts. This study has been presented at the 2024 Journal of Accounting, Auditing and Finance Conference. It currently has a revise and resubmit decision at the Review of Accounting Studies. Objective two: To identify how the unique risks that supply chain contract characteristics expose audit clients to affects auditors decision-making. Achievement: I identified a significant increase in audit fees for government contractors above that of non-contractors. I measure US government contracting as an indicator variable equal to 1 if the company is a government contractor, and 0 otherwise. Audit fees are positively and significantly related to government contracting (p-value<0.01). This result suggests that US government contractors are subject to unique risks that auditors price in their audits. Objective three: To investigate (1) the effect of contract and enforcement complexity and additional audit requirements on audit risk; (2) the effect of financial risk that clients are exposed to through their supply chains on client business risk; and (3) the existence of litigation for breach of contract on auditor’s business risk. Achievement: Having shown that auditors charge higher fees to government contractors, I investigate the channels through the lens of engagement risk to determine which components represent an increase in risk: audit risk (the risk that a material misstatement in the audit is not detected by the auditor); business risk (the risk associated with the audit client’s survival); and auditor’s business risk (the auditor’s exposure to loss arising from the audit of a firm). Audit Risk: Two theories explain whether government contracting will lead to an increase in audit effort or whether or a decrease in audit effort. Audit effort may increase because of compliance requirements under GAGAS and the need to include audit reports on internal control over financial reporting under US Government standards and on compliance with provisions of laws, regulations, contracts, and grant agreements that have a material effect on the financial statements (GAO 2018, p. 1.17a). Government contracts often involve “mind-numbing bureaucracies, unintelligible contracts and regulations from multiple sources, unrealistic obligations, counterintuitive ethical standards, and lobbying restrictions, and payment delays” (Millman 2019). Conversely, complying with regulations may increase the quality of government contractors’ internal information and reduce the work required of auditors to certify the financial statements. He (2021) and Samuels (2017) find evidence suggesting that government contractors have better reporting quality than other firms. To test these theories, I investigated audit report lag for government contractors. If having a government contractor allows the auditor to rely in part on the government’s due diligence, I expect audit report lag will be shorter in comparison with firms that have no government contracts. Conversely, if auditing government contracts increases the auditor’s risk and effort, then I expect audit report lag to be longer. The results suggest that government contractors have lower audit report lag than firms without government contracts, indicating that the rigor of US Government requirements increases the quality of internal information and lowers audit effort required to timely file financial reports. Client Business Risk: Client business risk could affect audit fees. First, government contractors may have more stable income streams as compared to commercial contractors due to the predictability of operating cash flows from government contract revenues as well as greater profitability (Cohen and Li 2019). However, government contractors may be at greater financial risk due to the government’s unilateral right to change or terminate the contract. The results suggest that government contractors have lower client business risk than firms without government contracts, indicating that compared to firms with no government contracts, auditors are less likely to assess significant doubts about a government contractor’s ability to remain in business. This finding supports the argument that, despite the US Government’s unilateral ability to change or terminate a contract, auditors perceive government contracts to be a stable source of funds. Auditor Business Risk: Litigation risk is the final channel that could explain an increase in audit fees. Government contractors are at a greater risk for litigation, which extends to auditors through the False Claims Act. This risk could lead to an increase in audit fees as auditors compensate for the additional risk related to potential litigation from their government contractor clients. My results indicate that government contractors have greater litigation risk than non-government contractors, suggesting that auditor business risk is greater for audits of government contractors and serves as a plausible channel for my finding that government contractors pay higher audit fees than non-government contractors. Objective four: To identify how audit outcomes (e.g., audit effort, audit fees, propensity to issue a going concern opinion, and incidence of material weaknesses over internal control) may be influenced by the economic importance of supply chain relationships, contract type, presence of contract enforcement clauses, contract length, owner characteristics, and political associations of the client firm. Achievement: Using a continuous measure of contract award size scaled by total sales to identify the economic importance of supply chain relationships, results suggest that US government contractors with larger contracts have fewer internal control material weaknesses (ICMWs) and restatements. Results also show that longer US government contracts are associated with fewer ICMWs. Larger contracts are also associated with higher audit fees and lower likelihood of going concern opinion. I was unable to find results for the proposed tests associated with contract enforcement and owner characteristics. Objective five: To identify how supply chain contract characteristics are associated with auditors’ decisions and audit outcomes (e.g., audit effort, audit fees, propensity to issue a going concern opinion, and ICMW). Achievement: This objective shares the same outcome as Objective four. Larger and longer US government contracts are associated with higher audit fees, lower going concern opinions, and fewer internal control weaknesses.

15507421.label: Major findings and research outcome
15507421.value: As detailed in Section 5.3, Realisation of objectives, my research identifies an increase in engagement risk for auditors of US government contractors. I also identify litigation risk associated with the False Claims Act as the determinant of this risk. Empirical results suggest that complying with US Government regulations may increase the quality of government contractors’ internal information and reduce the work required of auditors to certify the financial statements. Contract characteristics such as length and size are associated with fewer material weaknesses over internal control and lower likelihood of receiving a going concern opinion. The research results have been presented at a recognized international conference, the EURO Conference in Copenhagen, Denmark and are in the submission process at the European Journal of Operational Research. In a separate, off-shoot, study related to ASC 606, I and my co-authors examine whether a mandated change in the quantity of revenue information, which is driven by the adoption of ASC 606, leads to a change in management’s voluntary disclosure of revenue information. Specifically, we examine whether managers are more likely to provide revenue forecasts following ASC 606. On the one hand, the greater detail provided by ASC 606 may enrich the information environment, reducing the need for voluntary disclosure. On the other hand, the complexity and additional disclosures of ASC 606 may lead to divergent investor opinions, increasing the need for guidance from management. Our main findings suggest that firms that disaggregate their revenue following the adoption of ASC 606 are more likely to provide management sales forecasts. Additionally, the effect is stronger for firms whose revenue attracts more investor attention and for firms with a poor information quality, and weaker for firms with high proprietary cost concerns. We provide new information about the impact of accounting standards adoption on investors’ and managers’ information requirements. The study also adds to the broader understanding of the effects of ASC 606, showing that the impact of the standard extends beyond financial reporting changes and has implications for the evolving information requirements of investors and managers. Overall, we provide novel insights into the interplay between mandatory and voluntary disclosure. The research results have been presented at recognized international conferences (Journal of Accounting, Auditing and Finance Conference), and the manuscript has a revise and resubmit decision at The Review of Accounting Studies (RAST).

15507421.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15507421.value: Following the conference presentation at the EURO Conference, I refined the empirical results and exposition of the primary study, The Influence of Supply Chain Contract Characteristics on Audit Outcomes, to incorporate comments from conference participants. The paper was well-received at the EURO Conference, and is now in the submission process at the the European Journal of Operational Research. The second study, Mandatory Revenue Disaggregation and Voluntary Management Sales Forecasts: Evidence from ASC 606, is in the first round of revisions at RAST. I hope to submit the revision by the end of July. Further development of these research areas would include investigation of US government contract modifications following ASC 606. Preliminary tests indicate some items of interest in this context.

15507521.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15507521.value: The introduction of an “innovation shock” for which there is a sudden surge in demand in the market can cause firms in the industry to respond by making strategic decisions to resolve a so-called “follower's dilemma”. Followers (incumbents) have to make decisions regarding when they should adopt a new innovation. Some of the extent literature tends to focus on the benefits of adopting a new innovation earlier rather than later, while some of the extent literature espouses the benefits of adopting a new innovation later rather than earlier. In other words, the existing literature posits that there are benefits to both early adoption timing and late adoption timing. However, scholarly research on this matter is both conflicting and contradictory. Comparatively, this study groups the timing of the adoption of a new innovation into “three” different categories – early, middle, and late adoption. This study argues that middle adopters are the least likely to survive an innovation shock, compared with early and late adopters. That is why we have titled this study project as “Stuck in the Middle of Time”. By demonstrating that middle adopters are less likely to survive than early and late adopters, this study suggests that the tripartite categorization of adoption timing into early, middle, and late classifications may be useful in explaining inconsistencies found in the broader entry timing literature. 15507721.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15507721.value: The firm-hosted online chat group (OCG) is one of the emerging strategies for businesses to organize online activities and engage customers through social networking tools. Leveraging the instant messaging technology, firms can track customers’ feedback, provide immediate consultancy, and encourage customer interactivities in group conversations. A firm-hosted OCG is deemed to enable real-time conversations, provide a private and small communication environment, and ensure the anonymity of customers’ identities in the group. Therefore, customers are more likely to exchange personal experiences, opinions, and feelings in this context. Motivated by the unique features of OCG, this project attempts to investigate the role of information exchange, particularly from the perspective of self-disclosure from multiple parties in groups, in business outcomes such as customer engagement and product sales. Drawing upon the theory of information disclosure, we look into the disclosure in two directions (a focal customer’s self-disclosure and others’ reversed disclosure). Both disclosures can facilitate liking and intimate feelings and are mutually correlated. It thus warrants further study to understand their mechanisms separately. Moreover, we delve into the disclosure content and focus on the interplay between self-disclosure and reversed disclosure regarding content consensus from both sides. We breakdown the content as cognitive and emotional disclosure, corresponding to the different intimacy levels of disclosure. We also separate the roles of others in the OCG into peer customers and brand managers to understand their different effects on a focal customer’s behaviors. We will conduct the project by two studies using the data provided by an e-retailer who provides customer services and promotes marketing activities over OCGs built on WeChat. In study 1, we aim to understand the impact on customer engagement in OCG conversations. In study 2, we will extend the analyses to product sales to explore the influence on business conversion. This project contributes to the literature by explicitly differentiating the effects of mutual disclosure from different parties in online group conversations. The findings unveil the importance of disclosure reciprocity and imply multifaceted influences from customers and from brand managers regarding disclosing content consensus. This project sheds insights on the interactivities among group members and extends our understanding of how personal information exchange in online conversations will affect user engagement and business outcomes. The findings will help firms develop marketing strategies by managing disclosure interactivities and customer relationships via leveraging the tool of OCGs. 公司運營的在線聊天組 (OCG) 是企業組織在線活動和通過社交網絡工具吸引客戶的新興策略一。 利用即時通訊技術，公司可以跟踪客戶的反饋，提供即時諮詢，並鼓勵客戶在群組對話中進行互動。這類OCG 可以實現實時對話，提供私密的小型溝通環境，並確保客戶在群組中的身份匿名。 因此，客戶更有可能在這種情況下交流個人經驗、意見和感受。 基於 OCG 的獨特功能，該項目試圖從團體中多方的自我披露的角度研究信息交流對於客戶參與和產品銷售等業務成果的作用。 根據信息披露的理論，我們打算從兩個方向（焦點客戶的自我披露和他人的反向披露）來研究信息披露的作用。 這兩種披露都可以促進喜歡和親密的感覺，並且相互關聯。 因此，需要進一步研究以分別了解它們的機制。 此外，我們會深入研究披露內容，關注自我披露和反向披露之間關於內容共識的相互作用。 我們將內容分為認知和情感披露，對應於披露的不同親密程度。 我們還將 OCG 中其他人的角色分為同行客戶和品牌經理，以了解他們對核心客戶行為的不同影響。 我們將使用在微信建立OCG的電子零售商提供的數據，通過兩項研究來開展該項目。在研究 1 中，我們旨在了解對客戶參與 OCG 對話的影響。 在研究 2 中，我們將分析對業務轉換的影響。 該項目通過明確區分在線群組對話中不同方的相互披露的影響，為文獻做出了貢獻。 調查結果揭示了披露互惠的重要性，並揭示了客戶和品牌經理在披露內容共識上的多方面影響。 該項目將深入了解組成員之間的互動，並擴展我們對在線對話中的信息交換將如何影響用戶參與度和業務成果的理解。研究結果將為公司通過利用 OCG 工具管理披露交互和客戶關係提供營銷策略。

15507721.label: Realisation of objectives
15507721.value: This project investigates personal information disclosure in online chat groups (OCGs). To achieve the project objectives, we collected data from a retailer that utilizes OCGs for customer service, facilitating prompt communication with its customers. Specifically, we examined how conversation patterns within OCGs motivate customer engagement, focusing on response promptness, positivity, and length. Using machine learning techniques and econometric models, we quantified the degree of self-disclosure among group users and assessed the effects of mutual disclosure (both self-disclosure and receiving others' disclosures) on subsequent engagement. Additionally, we conducted a controlled experiment to validate the underlying mechanisms and establish causal relationships. For objective two, we differentiated and compared the roles of group hosts and peer users in fostering engagement within OCGs. Furthermore, we explored the interplay between mutual disclosures, focusing on the consistency and intimacy of content. Our findings reveal multifaceted effects of content intimacy consistency in mutual disclosures. All three project objectives have been fully addressed, providing a comprehensive understanding of the role of mutual disclosure and its impact on customer engagement in OCGs.

15507721.label: Major findings and research outcome
15507721.value: The major findings reveal that disclosures sent to and from focal users were associated with faster response, more positive messages, and greater effort in subsequent conversations. We also found positive interactions between mutual disclosures. In addition, we found multifaceted influences from the content intimacy consistency of mutual disclosures. Overall, our findings suggest that users prefer being understood in interpersonal relationships and that mutual disclosures with consistent cognitive and emotional content can encourage quicker, more positive, and greater future engagement. Regarding situations involving inconsistent content intimacy, the relationships were not completely negative. Others' positive disclosures in conjunction with focal user's cognitive content appeared to encourage further engagement from the focal user, and the focal user appeared to use cognitive disclosures to help them recover from negative emotions. Interestingly, our results revealed that group hosts typically shared minimal personal information and their disclosures were sometimes even detrimental to user engagement. On the other hand, peer users, who often have common experiences and concerns, were more likely to elicit empathy and foster discussion among themselves. The research paper has been published at MIS Quarterly, Dec 2024.

15507721.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15507721.value: The current research was designed to understand the effect of disclosure on subsequent user engagement in OCGs, using content generation in the subsequent period as the dependent variable. While we incorporated past engagement in the models to account for historical influences, we did not explicitly model the dynamic process of disclosure; however, earlier disclosure may prompt further disclosure and the intimacy level of the disclosure may evolve over time. An interesting extension could be to employ a dynamic panel model to capture the progression of disclosure changes. Additionally, we considered disclosures from other members in conversations as a homogenous entity. Future research could examine the effects of dyadic disclosures between OCG users, taking into account their awareness of the presence of others.

15507721.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15507721.value: This research project investigates the role of disclosing personal information in online chat groups (OCGs), which serve as a communication channel situated between public platforms and private live chats. Our investigation delves into the effects of mutual disclosures, originating from other members and focal users, on user engagement in terms of promptness, positivity, and effort. We also explore the disclosure content and the interplay between mutual disclosures regarding consistency in content intimacy. Our findings reveal that mutual disclosures are positively associated with user engagement through the mechanism of liking and uncover multifaceted influences from content intimacy consistency between mutual disclosures. This research broadens our understanding of how self-related information exchange in online group conversations promotes meaningful engagement. Our fine-grained analysis of disclosure interactions provides clear guidance for firms to strategically manage customer relationships through OCGs and sheds new light on conversational commerce.

15508021.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15508021.value: On-demand vehicle sharing is a prominent application of the sharing economy that emerges in recent years. It differs from traditional vehicle rental in that the service is provided on an on-demand basis and with more flexibility. Customers only rent the vehicles on a short-term basis as their need for service arises, and vehicles can be returned to a location different from where they are rented (referred to as one-way rental). While such flexibility popularizes the services, it also makes the operations of these systems more challenging than that of traditional rental systems where vehicles are rented for a longer time period (thereby capacity allocation can sometimes be planned in advance) and are always returned to the location where they are picked up (referred to as roundtrip rental). In the presence of one-way service, the size of the fleet must account not only for the randomness in demand and rental duration but also for the randomness in the number of vehicles that are available at each location due to vehicle roaming (vehicles not returning to the same location from which they were picked up). In this project, we will study the management of on-demand vehicle sharing systems while accounting for the distinctive operational features implied by the underlying queueing dynamics. Specifically, we model the vehicle sharing system as a closed-queueing network where the items moving through the network correspond to vehicles. By deriving closed-form approximations of key system performance, we reveal important insights into the determining factors that affect its operations. We then utilize the results and insights to study various problems in the management of the system including fleet sizing, service pricing, vehicle repositioning, and service region design. Our study sheds light on the challenges of operating an on-demand service system. The results of the project (confirmed in our preliminary work) will highlight the fact that one-way vehicle sharing systems may be substantially more expensive to operate than systems that require round trips. The economic viability of the one-way model crucially depends on the strategy to control the operations cost and the additional revenue from the increased convenience of one-way service. The outcomes of our project will help firms to make decisions in terms of the design, planning, and operation of vehicle sharing systems, which can not only bring economic benefit for the firm but also lead to improved quality and coverage of service, thereby increasing customer welfare. 按需車輛共享是近年興起之共享經濟領域中的一個惹人注目的應用。它與傳統汽車租賃的不同之處在於，該服務是按需提供的並具有更大的靈活性。客戶僅在需要服務時短期租用車輛，而車輛可歸還至與租用地點不同的地點（此模式可簡稱為單程租用）。而傳統租賃系統所設定之租賃期及預約期一般較長（因此有時可以提前計劃容量分配）並要求歸還車輛至取車地點（此模式可稱為往返租用）。相對而言，按需車輛共享的單向租用靈活性在使得其更受歡迎的同時，也使其系統的運營比傳統租車系統更具挑戰性。在存在單向租用的情況下，在決定車隊的規模時，決策者不僅要考慮需求和租賃時間的隨機性，還要考慮由於車輛漫遊（車輛未歸還至原租用地點之現象）而導致在每個租車點可用車輛數量發生隨機變化之情況。 在此項目中，我們將透過分析所涉及系統之潛在排隊模型，揭示所隱含的獨特運作特徵，以此去研究按需車輛共享系統的管理。具體來說，我們將車輛共享系統建模為一個封閉的排隊網絡，車輛則視爲此網絡中的移動物品。通過推導出關鍵系統性能的解析近似值，我們揭示了影響系統運營的決定因素，並提供關於各因素之管理見解。然後，我們利用結果和見解來研究此類系統管理中的各種問題，包括車隊規模、服務定價、車輛調運、和服務區域設計。 我們的研究揭示了運營按需租車服務系統所面臨的挑戰。該項目的成果將向大家特別地指示出單向租用車輛共享系統的運行成本遠高於往返租用系統之事實。故此，單向租用模式的經濟可行性取決於所采取的控制運營成本的策略以及單向租用服務的便利性所帶來的額外收入。我們項目的成果將幫助企業在車輛共享系統的設計、規劃和運營方面做出決策。這不僅可以為企業帶來經濟效益，還可以幫助提高服務質素和覆蓋範圍，從而增加整體客戶利益。 關鍵詞：按需車輛共享，封閉式排隊網絡，共享經濟，容量優化

15508421.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15508421.value: Under Accounting Standards Update 2016-13, publicly listed banks that are SEC filers have been required to adopt the current expected credit losses (CECL) model since the fiscal year beginning after December 15, 2019. The previous incurred credit losses (ICL) model requires banks to incorporate incurred loan losses only. Upon adopting CECL, banks must incorporate both incurred loan losses and future expected losses into their current recognition of loan losses. Thus, banks adopting CECL must consider the potential impact of macroeconomic conditions on credit losses. Since March 2020, the global COVID-19 pandemic has substantially impaired business operations and supply chains. Households and companies face great debt payment pressure. The unpredictable spread of the virus and the complexity of vaccine development make an economic recovery extremely uncertain. Considering the negative impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the economy, banks that adopt the CECL model should recognize more loan losses in response to the COVID-19 pandemic, compared to banks that kept the ICL model. This proposal is motivated by anecdotal evidence that banks are facing joint pressure from the pandemic and the CECL transition and by the increasing number of studies on the economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. First, we intend to examine whether banks that adopt the CECL model recognize more loan losses in response to the pandemic, compared to banks that delay adoption. Second, we plan to investigate how banks’ loan loss recognition timeliness under the ICL regime and the strictness of their external monitoring impact the above effect. Finally, bank regulators issued an interim final rule allowing CECL adopters to delay the transition impact on regulatory capital for up to two years and then phase in the impact over the next three years. We thus intend to discuss whether this transition relief affects loan loss provisions among CECL adopters and how regulatory capital affects the above relation. This research may help to clarify how CECL adopters incorporate the health crisis into their loan loss provisioning. It also may contribute to a better understanding of the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the aggregate banking system and even on the whole economy. Finally, the interaction between the Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security (CARES) Act and the CECL transition rules provide interesting and important scenarios for exploring how politicians and bank regulators work together to mitigate the real effects of loan loss accounting in response to unprecedented adverse economic shocks.

15508421.label: Major findings and research outcome
15508421.value: The mandatory switch from the incurred credit loss model to the more forward-looking current expected credit loss (CECL) model was scheduled to begin in 2020. However, when the COVID-19 pandemic started in early 2020, U.S. regulators made the switch voluntary. Our study investigates how banks’ exposure to the pandemic affects their decision to adopt the CECL model, as well as adopting banks’ pandemic-era pattern of loan loss provisions. First, consistent with pandemic-driven economic uncertainty reducing banks’ willingness to adopt the new model, we find a negative association between banks’ pandemic exposure and their CECL model adoption. This association is more pronounced for banks with more lending opportunities, more lending competition, or worse loan quality. Second, we document that compared to non-adopters, CECL adopters report more loan loss provisions during the pandemic’s early period, and less or even negative loan loss provisions during the late period. The negative loan loss provisions, which reflects a reversal of earlier loan loss reserves, is more pronounced for banks with more exposure to states with a higher vaccination level, consistent with banks having a more positive economic outlook due to improving pandemic conditions. Overall, our study offers useful insights into how pandemic conditions affect the adoption and implementation of the CECL model.

As of now, I do not plan to write another paper that extends the current paper.

15508421.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15508421.value: Our study investigates how banks’ exposure to the pandemic affects their decision to adopt the CECL model, as well as adopting banks’ pandemic-era pattern of loan loss provisions. Our paper contributes to the literature in three ways. First, we extend the literature on disclosure decisions in times of economic uncertainty. Our study complements and contrasts with the existing literature by leveraging the coincidence of the CECL model’s adoption schedule and the COVID-19 pandemic to examine banks’ decision to adopt the model after adoption changed from mandatory to voluntary. Second, our paper contributes to the literature on how the evolving economic outlook affects banks’ loan loss provisions. Our study complements and contrasts with the existing literature by leveraging a unique setting that allows us to observe how banks adjust their accrual estimates as the economic outlook evolves during the COVID-19 pandemic. Third and more specific to our CECL setting, our study extends the literature on the CECL model. Our study complements and contrasts with the existing literature in that we assess how economic uncertainty affects CECL model adoption and how adoption affects the adopting banks’ loan loss provisioning during the pandemic.

15508521.value: 會計領域的研究關注公司財務信息的外部用戶包括投資者、貸方和供應商/客戶如何影響公司披露。稅務部門也會使用財務信息。Bozanic, Hoopes, Thornock and Williams (2017) 發現美國國稅局 (IRS) 在 EDGAR 上訪問公司的財務報表。然而，關於稅務部門在塑造公司披露方面的作用幾乎沒有實證證據。本研究旨在檢驗稅務審查是否以及如何影響公司的披露決定，尤其是隱藏知識產權 (IP) 許可協議中部分信息的決定。 公司經常使用基於知識產權的轉讓定價來轉移收入和避稅。 美國國稅局根據獨立交易原則，即交易應可被視為是在無關方之間進行的，來評估納稅人的轉讓價格。知識產權許可協議包含知識產權的定價信息，美國國稅局可以使用這些信息來評估轉讓價格並發現不符合獨立交易原則的做法。因此，公司有不披露此類信息的動機。不披露可以採取隱藏信息的形式，因為公司可以選擇從向 SEC 提交的合同文件中隱藏某些商業敏感信息。因此，我們預測 (1) 利用知識產權轉移收入的公司更有可能從許可協議中隱藏信息，(2) 受到更多稅務審查的公司更有可能隱藏信息，以及(3) 因此，從許可協議中更頻繁地隱藏信息的公司被美國國稅局審計的可能性較低。 我們收集整理了來自 EDGAR 的知識產權許可協議並使用關鍵字篩選識別那些其中有信息被隱藏的。我們的關鍵變量是關於許可協議中是否有信息被隱藏的指標變量。為了檢驗以上三個預測，我們將此指標變量關聯到公司基於知識產權的收入轉移水平，美國國稅局對公司許可協議的關注程度，以及公司接受國稅局審計的可能性。我們預測隨著公司更多地參與基於知識產權的轉讓定價或受到美國國稅局更多的關注，他們更有可能從許可協議中隱藏信息，從而降低了他們接受國稅局審計的可能性。 我們希望這項研究對披露文獻和稅收文獻都有貢獻。這個 研究記錄了公司以從財務報表中隱藏信息的方式實現戰略性不披露的一個新決定因素 。特別是，它闡明了稅務部門在塑造公司信息披露方面的作用，這一點在披露文獻中並未受到太多關注。

15509321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15509321.value: In July 2014, the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) published IFRS 9 (Financial Instrument). Effective from 2018, the most significant change in IFRS 9 is the introduction of a new impairment model, the expected credit loss (ECL) model, which replaces the incurred credit loss (ICL) model in use for over 40 years. According to the American Bankers Association (2016), the adoption of the ECL model is considered “the biggest change ever to bank accounting”. The most prominent feature of IFRS 9 is that it requires banks to incorporate “forward-looking” information into the estimation of loan loss provision. Given that management earnings forecasts (MEF) are a primary source of “forward-looking” statements, the implementation of IFRS 9 provides an ideal setting for examining how a “forward-looking” accounting standard shapes banks’ “forward-looking” statements as reflected in MEF. This inquiry is important because the banking industry is more opaque (Morgan, 2002) and stakeholders rely heavily on MEF to acquire bank information (KPMG, 2016). Despite banking being among the top three industries with the highest MEF frequency (Li et al., 2019), the vast majority of the MEF literature only focuses on non-banking industries, leaving banks’ MEF behavior less explored and poorly understood. Economic theory (Diamond and Verrecchia, 1991; Leuz and Verrecchia, 2000; Verrecchia, 2001) suggests that IFRS 9 can impact banks’ MEF activities, but the direction of such impact is undetermined. On the one hand, IFRS 9 improves financial reporting quality by enhancing loan loss recognition timeliness (LLRT) (Kim et al., 2020), which facilitates investors’ incorporation of accounting numbers into investments and stimulates them to demand more MEF to help make timely decisions (Landsman et al., 2012; Li and Yang, 2016). On the other hand, improved LLRT reduces the information asymmetry between banks and outside stakeholders (Bushman and Williams, 2012; Akins et al., 2017), which could restrain managers’ incentives to engage in MEF since MEF’s main purpose is to decrease information asymmetry (Hirst et al., 2008). Thus, the net effect of IFRS 9 on MEF is an empirical question. We employ a difference-in-differences method to examine the impact of IFRS 9 adoption on MEF’s issuance, frequency, timeliness, and precision. We then test whether these effects are contingent on expected credit risk and LLRT in the pre-adoption period. By shedding light on the role of accounting standards in bank MEF, this project has policy implications for bank regulators, international accounting standard-setters, and bank practitioners. 2014年7月，国际会计准则委员会发布了第9号国际会计准则-金融工具。该准则自2018年1月1日起正式生效，其中，最为重大的变化是正式引入了预期损失模型，从而替代了已沿用40年的已发生损失模型。根据美国银行家协会的研究，这一模型的引入，并认为是银行会计当中迄今为止最为显著的变化。 在新引入的模型中，最为显著的特征即是，IFRS9要求银行在估计银行坏账损失时，引入前瞻性的信息。既然管理层预测是企业对外提供前瞻性信息的主要途径，这一特征为本项目提供了理想的设定，即，具有前瞻性要求的会计准则如何塑造前瞻性信息的提供。这一问题是重要的，原因在于银行业相较于非银行业更为不透明，而银行的利益相关者大多依赖于管理层预测来获取银行信息。尽管银行业的盈余预测数量位于所有行业中的前三位，但是，大多数的盈余预测的文献只研究了非银行业，而将银行业排除在外，导致学界对于银行业的盈余预测行为知之甚少。 根据相关的经济理论(Diamond and Verrecchia, 1991; Leuz and Verrecchia, 2000; Verrecchia, 2001)，IFRS9可能影响银行的盈余预测行为，但是这一影响的方向可能是不确定的。一方面，IFRS9通过加强坏账确认的及时性(Kim et al., 2020)来改善银行的财务报告的质量，这样可以促进投资者在投资中更好地使用会计数字，从而催生出更多对于盈余预测的需求来帮助投资者来更好地进行及时的决策(Landsman et al., 2012; Li and Yang, 2016)。另一方面，改善的坏账确认及时性降低了银行和外部利益相关者的信息不对称(Bushman and Williams, 2012; Akins et al., 2017)，这可能限制了管理层提供盈余预测的动机，因为盈余预测的主要目的在于降低信息不对称(Hirst et al., 2008)。所以，IFRS9对于盈余预测的影响尚待实证检验。 本项目将采用双重差分法来检验IFRS9对于盈余预测的发布、频率、及时性和精确度进行研究。随后，本项目将研究以下两种因素对于上述关系的影响：预期的信贷风险和准则应用前的贷款损失确认的及时性。 通过厘清会计准则在银行盈余预测中的作用，该项目对于银行监管层、国际会计准则的制定者和银行从业者将具有一定的政策启示。

15509321.label: Realisation of objectives
15509321.value: The project aims to examine the impact of IFRS 9 adoption on various aspects of banks' management earnings forecasts (MEF). The objectives were to assess the issuance and frequency, timeliness, precision, and the contingent effects of expected credit risk and loan loss reserve transitions (LLRT) in the pre-adoption period. Below is a detailed account of how these objectives have been achieved: Objective 1: To examine the impact of IFRS 9 adoption on the issuance and frequency of MEF This objective has been fully realized. Our findings indicate that the adoption of IFRS 9, which incorporates an expected loss model (ELM), has led to a significant increase in the issuance and frequency of MEF. Banks are more likely to issue forecasts and do so more frequently post-adoption. This enhancement is attributed to the forward-looking nature of the ELM, which aligns with the forward-looking requirements of MEF. Objective 2: To examine the impact of IFRS 9 adoption on the timeliness of MEF We have successfully achieved this objective. The study demonstrates that the timeliness of MEF has improved following the adoption of IFRS 9. Banks are able to provide more timely forecasts, which is crucial for stakeholders who rely on up-to-date information for decision-making. The forward-looking approach of the ELM has facilitated quicker recognition of credit impairments, thereby enabling more timely forecasts. Objective 3: To examine the impact of IFRS 9 adoption on the precision of MEF This objective has been met with positive results. The precision of MEF has increased post-IFRS 9 adoption. Our analysis shows that forecasts are not only more frequent and timely but also more precise. This improvement in precision is likely due to the more accurate and comprehensive assessment of credit risk under the ELM, which provides a better foundation for making precise forecasts. Objective 4: To examine whether the effects of IFRS 9 adoption on MEF are contingent on two factors: expected credit risk and LLRT in the pre-adoption period We have thoroughly examined this objective and found that the effects of IFRS 9 adoption on MEF are indeed contingent on the expected credit risk and LLRT in the pre-adoption period. Banks with higher expected credit risk and significant changes in loan loss reserves experienced more pronounced improvements in their MEF. This suggests that the benefits of IFRS 9 adoption are more significant for banks facing greater credit risk and those undergoing substantial changes in their loss allowances. Challenges and Attempts to Overcome Them While the project objectives have been largely achieved, we encountered some challenges, particularly during the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic. The unprecedented economic uncertainty made forecasting more challenging. However, this period also provided a unique opportunity to test the robustness of the ELM under extreme conditions. We addressed these challenges by incorporating additional data and refining our analytical models to account for the heightened uncertainty. Overall, the project has successfully met its objectives, providing valuable insights into the impact of IFRS 9 adoption on banks' management forecasts. The findings highlight the complementary relationship between expected loss recognition and MEF, contributing to the broader understanding of financial reporting and forecasting practices in the banking sector.

15509321.label: Major findings and research outcome
15509321.value: Accounting rules for credit impairment recognition have been shifting to a more forward-looking approach based on expected losses. We examine how the adoption of an expected loss model (ELM) influences banks’ management forecasts, which also are forward-looking. In a difference-in-differences setting of gradual implementations of the ELM worldwide, we find that banks enhance management forecasts after adopting the future-oriented provisioning model, as manifested in higher likelihood of forecast issuance, higher frequency of forecasts, more precise forecasts, and higher overall forecast quality. This forecast-enhancing effect is more prominent when accounting standards are more strictly enforced, when banks experience larger changes in loss allowance after ELM implementation, and when forecasting is more challenging such as during the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic. Moreover, banks’ post-ELM forecasting performance also improves in terms of greater forecast accuracy and persistency. Overall, our results suggest a complementary relation between expected loss recognition and banks’ management forecasts. A significant research outcome of this project is the development of a working paper titled "Expected Loss Recognition and Banks’ Management Forecasts." This paper is currently under revision at the prestigious Journal of Accounting and Public Policy, which is a highly respected, peer-reviewed academic journal that focuses on the intersection of accounting and public policy. Established in 1982 and published by Elsevier, JAPP is known for its rigorous standards and impactful research. The journal covers a wide range of topics, including the effects of accounting on public policy and vice versa, through both theoretical and empirical analysis. It is indexed in major databases such as Scopus and the Social Sciences Citation Index, and it has a strong impact factor, reflecting its influence and reputation in the field. Publishing in this journal signifies a high level of scholarly contribution and recognition within the academic community.

15509321.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15509321.value: The findings from this project open several avenues for further research and development. Here are some potential directions and proposed actions: 1. Extended Analysis of IFRS 9 Impact Across Different Regions and Bank Types Future research could expand the scope of analysis to include a broader range of regions and different types of banks (e.g., commercial vs. investment banks). This would provide a more comprehensive understanding of how IFRS 9 adoption affects MEF in various contexts and regulatory environments. Proposed Action: Conduct comparative studies across multiple countries and bank categories to identify regional and institutional differences in the impact of IFRS 9. 2. Longitudinal Studies on the Long-Term Effects of IFRS 9 While this project has provided insights into the immediate effects of IFRS 9 adoption, it would be valuable to examine the long-term impacts on banks' forecasting practices and financial stability. Proposed Action: Initiate longitudinal studies that track the effects of IFRS 9 over an extended period, analyzing trends and changes in MEF and overall financial health of banks. By pursuing these potential research directions, we can build on the current project's findings and contribute to a deeper understanding of IFRS 9's impact on the banking sector. This will not only advance academic knowledge but also provide practical insights for industry practitioners and regulators.

15509321.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15509321.value: This research explores how IFRS9 that requires banks to predict and account for future credit losses, affect their financial forecasts. By studying banks worldwide that are gradually adopting this rule, we find that banks are now issuing more frequent and precise financial forecasts. This improvement is especially noticeable when IFRS9 is strictly enforced, when banks experience significant changes in their credit loss allowances, and during challenging times like the COVID-19 pandemic. Overall, our findings suggest that these new accounting rules help banks make better financial predictions, leading to more accurate and reliable financial information for stakeholders.

15509521.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15509521.value: 摘要 越來越多的研究表明，個人的風險偏好可能會受到各種負面衝擊的影響，例如金融危機、恐怖襲擊和自然災害（例如地震、颶風、洪水、海嘯，以及最近一段時間內的公眾衛生緊急情況，例如 Covid-19 流行病）。然而，量化這些負面事件對投資者風險感知的影響具有挑戰性。交易量和波動率等經典指標可能無法單獨列出對風險偏好的影響，因為這些指標可能會受到投資者註意力有限的影響。 Goetzmann、Kim 和 Shiller（2017）使用他們的調查數據表明，當受訪者所在地區發生中度地震時，主觀市場崩盤風險感會增加。 擬議的項目旨在擴展文獻，並檢查地震事件後看漲期權和看跌期權訂單提交之間的不對稱性。為了梳理地震期間有限注意力的影響，我依賴於有限注意力和風險感知變化影響看漲期權和以不同方式看跌期權的論點。具體而言，有限的關注將推動看漲期權和看跌期權交易的減少，而風險感知的增加將導致看漲（看跌）期權需求的減少（增加）。因此，通過關注看漲期權下降和看跌期權訂單提交之間的不對稱性，我可能會發現自然災害對風險感知的影響。我還將檢查期權價格和期權執行價格的變化，以進行更全面的分析。 台灣期貨交易所（TAIFEX）數據的獨特性使我們能夠探索自然災害對各類投資者影響的異質性。在某種程度上，風險認知的扭曲反映了投資者對其自身認知資源的紀律不足，我假設專業機構投資者和更老練的散戶投資者受中等地震的影響較小。另外，認知能力較低的散戶投資者預計更容易出現可用性偏差，因此在地震期間受影響更大。 此外，該項目旨在通過調查對自然災害敏感性的影響來診斷散戶投資者的不良表現。我將測試機構投資者在地震日的表現是否優於散戶投資者，以及認知能力較好的散戶投資者是否優於認知能力較低的散戶投資者。

15509521.label: Realisation of objectives
15509521.value: To accomplish all the objectives, I analyzed two distinct datasets focused on corporate and market responses to major natural disasters, and the results are written in three research papers. 1. To test whether investors become more risk averse on days with natural disasters. This objective is 100% accomplished. To accomplish Objective 1, I analyzed two distinct datasets focused on corporate and market responses to major natural disasters. The first dataset, from RepRisk, tracks the reputation risk of U.S. companies. My analysis examined shifts in reputational risk perception during the pandemic, and the results were included in the Paper 1 titled: “Contagious corporate reputation risk: Uncovering the pandemic’s impact.” The second dataset, from the Taiwan Futures Exchange (TAIFEX), comprises comprehensive futures and options trading records. I evaluated several market measures—including time-to-cancellation, trading volume, put-call imbalance, cross-hedging activity, risk perception, and risk aversion—in response to earthquakes. These results were included in the Paper 2 titled: “Timing is Money: Limit Order Cancellation and Investment Performance” and Paper 3 titled: “Shaken Markets: How Earthquakes Rattle Investors?”. 2. To examine the heterogeneity of sensitivity to natural disasters among different investor types and among retail investors with various levels of cognitive ability. This objective is 100% accomplished. To accomplish Objective 2, I evaluated investor responses to earthquakes separately for retail and institutional investors using TAIFEX data, and I have found a sharp contrast of risk aversion among these two types of investors. These results were included in the Paper 2 titled: “Timing is Money: Limit Order Cancellation and Investment Performance” and Paper 3 titled: “Shaken Markets: How Earthquakes Rattle Investors?”. 3. To investigate whether the sensitivity to natural disasters is associated with poor investment performance. This objective is 100% accomplished. To accomplish Objective 3, I evaluated the profitability on earthquake days separately for retail and institutional investors using TAIFEX data. These results were included in the Paper 3 titled: “Shaken Markets: How Earthquakes Rattle Investors?”.

15509521.label: Major findings and research outcome
15509521.value: Three research papers have been written from this research project. In the first paper, my analysis examined shifts in reputational risk perception of US companies during the Covid-19 pandemic, revealing a marked increase in perceived risk throughout this prolonged disaster period. Interestingly, the reputation risk movement among local peers decreases, suggesting that social interactions among local managers may be an essential driver for the regional reputation risk co-movement before the pandemic. These results were included in the Paper 1 titled: “Contagious corporate reputation risk: Uncovering the pandemic’s impact,” which was published in Finance Research Letters (a SSCI Q1 journal) in 2024. In the second paper, I examined the Time-to-cancellation, defined as the time interval between order submission and cancellation. This measures investors’ inattention paid to the limit order execution process. The results show that investors wait till longer time on earthquake days before cancelling their stale limit orders. These results were included in the Paper 2 titled: “Timing is Money: Limit Order Cancellation and Investment Performance,” which has been presented in international conferences and seminars and is now under revise and resubmit at the Review of Asset Pricing Studies. In the third paper, I evaluated several other market measures from the Taiwan Futures Exchange (TAIFEX) with comprehensive futures and options trading records. The findings indicate that on earthquake days, trading volume declines while put-call imbalance, cross-hedging, risk perception, and risk aversion all significantly rise for retail investors. In contrast, while institutional investors experience a reduction in trading volume, their put-call imbalance, cross-hedging, risk perception, and risk aversion did not rise significantly. While retail investors experience higher returns on earthquake days, institutional investors experience lower returns on earthquake days. These results were included in the Paper 3 titled: “Shaken Markets: How Earthquakes Rattle Investors?” which has been presented in an international conference and seminars and is under review at the Review of Economic Statistics.

15509521.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15509521.value: My second research output (Paper 2) titled: “Timing is Money: Limit Order Cancellation and Investment Performance” and third research output (Paper 3) titled: “Shaken Markets: How Earthquakes Rattle Investors?” have been presented in conferences and seminars and are now under review. I will keep revising the papers once reviewers’ comments are available and will make sure they will be published in leading academic journals. I will also consider developing an additional project investigating other natural disasters such as Typhoon and their impact on household investment behaviors.

15509521.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15509521.value: The global rise in natural disasters presents critical challenges for financial markets. My research contributes to this literature by analyzing how distinct disasters distort market behavior and profitability. In the first study, I demonstrate that the Covid-19 pandemic significantly increased reputation risk and reduced risk-comovement among U.S. firms. In the second, focusing on earthquakes, I show that such events drive investors’ attention away from the financial market, leading to longer time-to-cancellation of their stale limit orders. In the third paper, I show that heighten risk aversion specifically among retail investors, while institutional investors remain unaffected. This shift leads to reduced market participation and risk-taking by retail traders, which in turn diminishes profitable opportunities for institutional players. Together, these papers reveal the heterogeneous and profound impacts of natural disasters on different market agents.

15510121.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15510121.value: 预测收益对学者和从业者都很重要。估值模型依靠预计股利或未来收益来推算公司和股权价值，例如贴现现金流和剩余收益模型，许多研究试图预测收益，但很少有研究寻求预测长期收益（即未来2年以上）。分析师不断寻找新方法去更准确地预测收益，但预测超过两年的分析师并不多。对于那些预测长期收益的人来说，由于未来存在很大的不确定性，预测通常是不准确的，并且更重要的是，分析师会受到行为偏差的影响，例如代表性启发或预期错误。 鉴于金融和经济学研究最近采用了机器学习方法，我们计划使用这些方法来解决一个重要的会计问题——它们是否可以改善长期收益预测。与传统的实证方法相比，机器学习方法可以容纳更详尽的预测变量列表和更丰富的函数形式规范，包括高维预测变量和非线性项。 我们将比较机器学习方法与传统实证方法的收益预测准确率。我们还将比较机器学习和深度学习方法，并且观察哪种方法最适合预测长期收益。我们将比较机器学习方法与分析师做出的收益预测，以检验前者是否更擅长预测未来收益。我们还将研究机器学习是否可以产生为分析师预测增加增量预测能力的信号。如果机器学习方法可以识别分析师预测中的偏差并产生具有增量预测能力的信号，我们将制定交易策略并检查它是否可以产生多空投资组合利润。 这项研究是会计领域的第一个旨在检验机器学习方法是否有助于预测长期收益的项目。我们的结果将有助于基础分析文献，也将对从业者产生影响。分析师可以采用我们在本项目中确定的机器学习方法来改善收益预测。投资者也可以使用机器学习方法来更好地识别未来基本面优越的公司。

15510121.label: Major findings and research outcome
15510121.value: This paper uses machine learning techniques to predict earnings jumps and crashes. We focus on extreme changes in earnings as they can lead to substantial revaluations of firm values and attract considerable investor attention. Additionally, extreme earnings events are inherently difficult to predict. Overall, we find that a random forest model outperforms linear models in predicting earnings jumps and crashes. Moreover, we show that over a 12-month holding period, a hedge portfolio based on the top 5% predicted earnings jump and crash probabilities generates significant annual size-adjusted returns of 14.13%. We also find that long-short portfolios based on predicted earnings jump or crash probabilities generate abnormal returns around earnings announcements. In general, our findings suggest that a random forest model is useful in predicting extreme earnings events and predicted probabilities help investors make profitable investment decisions.

Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15510121.value: This paper uses advanced computer techniques (machine learning) to predict big jumps or drops in a company's earnings. These extreme changes are important because they can significantly affect how much a company is worth and grab a lot of attention from investors. Predicting these big changes is tough, but the study found that a specific machine learning method (called a random forest model) does a better job than traditional methods. The research also shows that if you create a special investment strategy (a hedge portfolio) based on the top 5% of predicted big earnings changes, you could make a 14.13% return in a year. Additionally, using these predictions to guide buying and selling stocks around earnings announcements can lead to extra profits. In short, the study suggests that this machine learning model is a useful tool for predicting major earnings changes and can help investors make money.

15510321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15510321.value: The proposed research suggests considering asset accruals and liability accruals separately when estimating discretionary accruals and evaluating their performance, compared to the current state of the art. For three decades the Jones model has served as a major benchmark for measuring discretionary accruals. These discretionary accruals take on an important role in empirical accounting research because they serve as instruments to indicate firms’ attempts at managing reported earnings. The proposed approach relies on ideas similar to those that motivate the Jones model, but it refines the starting point: total accruals are separated into asset accruals and liability accruals. This separation suggests using disaggregated models to estimate discretionary asset accruals and discretionary liability accruals respectively. We are motivated by at least two points. First, the Jones model implicitly assumes that, the underlying reason for the asset accruals-sales growth correlation is similar to that for the liability accruals-sales growth correlation: e.g. credit policy. However, other factors may affect the credit policy differently. For example, a firm with high bargaining power (e.g. great sales growth) can request a faster turnaround of accounts receivable but a slower turnaround of accounts payable, suggesting that the asset accruals and liability accruals should be separately considered. Second, from the earnings management perspective, when managers want to manipulate earnings upward, they would prefer to overstate asset accruals and understate liability accruals. As a result, the correlation between discretionary asset accruals and discretionary liability accruals is negative, and the combined accruals as estimated by the Jones model can have high variances. Accordingly, we predict that the disaggregated model is likely to improve the estimation of discretionary accruals. We will evaluate the empirical effectiveness of the disaggregated models by considering if our suggested model improves the prediction of misreporting, such as SEC enforcement actions, class action lawsuits related to GAAP violation, accounting restatement, accounting fraud, disclosure quality, etc. We will also conduct textual analyses to detect managers’ earnings management tactics. We will conduct our analyses for both the U.S. and Chinese publicly traded companies. The proposed research can shed light on two accrual components: asset accruals and liability accruals, which can potentially improve the way of estimating discretionary accruals. Our findings can also contribute to the understanding of these measures and managers’ earnings management tactics. 本研究建议在估计可操控性应计项目时应该分别考虑资产和负债相关的应计项目。过去三十年来，琼斯模型是用来估计可操控性应计的主要模型，而可操控应计项目在实证会计研究中被用来衡量公司的盈余管理程度。本研究以传统的琼斯模型为基础，但进一步改进了其出发点：将总的应计项目划分为资产和负债相关的应计项目。这种区分意味着我们在计算可操控性应计项目时，需要分别估计上述两类应计项目。 我们的研究至少基于两个出发点。第一，琼斯模型暗含的假设是，构成资产类应计与收入增长关系的原因和负债类应计与收入增长关系的原因类似，例如信贷政策等。然而，其他因素可能会对信贷政策产生不同的影响。例如，议价能力较高的公司（收入增长较快的公司）可能会要求周期较短的应收账款和周期较长的应付账款，这意味着资产和负债应计应该被分开考虑。第二，从盈余管理的角度，当管理层想要往上操控盈余时，他们倾向于高估资产类应计而低估负债类应计。所以，可操控性资产类应计和可操控性负债类应计负相关，而在传统琼斯模型下合并在一起的应计项目可能存在较大的方差。于是，我们认为分开估计资产和负债类应计可以提高操控性应计项目估计的准确度。 为了评估我们所建议方法的有效性，我们需要检验是否新模型估计的操控性应计项目能更好地预测财务报表失真，例如美国证券监管委员会的处罚，因违反会计准则引起的集体诉讼，财务重述，会计舞弊，披露质量下滑等。我们也会采用文本分析的方式来检测管理层的盈余管理行为。我们将采用美国和中国上市公司的样本对上述问题进行检验。 本研究表明分别估计资产和负债类应计项目可以改进估计可操控性应计项目的准确度。同时，本研究可以对更好理解以上项目和公司盈余管理行为做出贡献。

15510321.label: Realisation of objectives
15510321.value: For objective 1, we have developed a conceptual model to illustrate the rationale behind disaggregating total accruals, supported by empirical evidence that evaluates the performance of this disaggregated model. Our current analysis focuses on U.S. firms, with plans to extend the empirical analysis to Chinese firms in the updated version. For objective 2, to verify our conceptual model, we applied various regression analyses. Specifically, we refined the discretionary accruals derived from Jones-type models by decomposing discretionary total accruals (DTA) into discretionary asset accruals (DAA) and discretionary liability accruals (DLA). Our findings indicate that the quality of DTA and DAA can each independently detect misreporting under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). However, when both DTA and DAA are used as explanatory variables, the ability of DTA quality to detect GAAP misreporting is overshadowed by DAA quality. Further analysis shows that these findings hold true for the income-increasing DTA subsample, but we did not observe DTA quality explaining GAAP misreporting in the income-decreasing DTA subsample. For objective 3, we employed sentiment analysis to assess abnormal tone as a proxy for financial misconduct, but we did not identify any consistent patterns using this proxy. Consequently, we have decided not to include these results in our latest manuscript.

15510321.label: Major findings and research outcome
15510321.value: We refine the discretionary accruals from Jones type models by decomposing discretionary total accruals (DTA) into discretionary asset accruals (DAA) and discretionary liability accruals (DLA), since firms have different level of discretions over asset accruals and liability accruals. We find that DTA quality and DAA quality can separately detect Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) misreporting. However, when both DTA and DAA are used as explanatory variables, the ability of DTA quality to detect GAAP misreporting is subsumed by DAA quality. Further inspections indicate that the results extend to income-increasing DTA subsample. However, we do not find DTA quality explains GAAP misreporting in income-decreasing DTA subsample. Our findings suggest that decomposing DTA as DAA and DLA has incremental benefits for detecting and understandings firms’ accruals manipulation behaviors.

15510321.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15510321.value: The findings of our research on the decomposition of discretionary total accruals (DTA) into discretionary asset accruals (DAA) and discretionary liability accruals (DLA) present several avenues for further development. Here are the proposed courses of action: (1) We plan to extend our empirical analysis beyond U.S. firms to include a broader range of international firms, particularly those in the Chinese market. This will allow us to explore cross-country differences in accrual manipulation behavior and the applicability of our model in different regulatory environments; and (2) Although our initial sentiment analysis did not yield consistent patterns, we could refine this approach by exploring more sophisticated sentiment metrics or combining sentiment analysis with other qualitative research methods, such as case studies or interviews, to uncover deeper insights into the motivations behind accrual manipulations.

15510321.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15510321.value: This research project focuses on examining how companies report their financial performance, particularly looking at how they manage their earnings through accruals. Accruals involve estimating income and expenses that haven't been paid yet, which can sometimes lead to misleading financial statements. The project is significant because it helps us understand the tactics companies use to influence their financial reports, which can mislead investors and regulators. By breaking down total accruals into two parts—asset and liability accruals—we can better identify potential inaccuracies in how firms report their earnings. The value of this research lies in its ability to improve transparency in financial reporting. It equips investors, regulators, and researchers with better tools to detect potential manipulation of earnings. Ultimately, this contributes to a fairer financial market, where information is more reliable, and stakeholders can make informed decisions. This research not only enhances academic understanding but also supports ethical business practices, benefiting society as a whole.

15600121.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15600121.value: 觀看視頻是自學英語的常用方法，最近我們研發了世界首個引導用家從YouTube視頻自學英文慣用語的應用程式 (Lin, 2019a, 2019b, 2019c, in preparation, under review)，此應用程式至今已吸引了全球7,800位用家。為籌備下一次大型更新， 系統需要更多實證數據，以判定系統內含 41,973條英文慣用語的教學優先次序和複習次數。 這項研究旨在運用機器學習模擬並推測英文慣用語的相對學習難度(learnability)，研究分兩個階段：首階段將建立全球首個規範數據庫，臚列41,973條英文慣用語的九項特徵，包括字數、發音、音素、音節數、口語出現頻率、書面出現頻率、具體度(concreteness)、 語意透明度(semantic transparency)及熟悉度(familiarity)，其中具體度、 語意透明度及熟悉度三項評分數據，會利用亞馬遜土耳其機器人(Amazon Mechanical Turk)平台從15,000名人士中收集。次階段會進行學習實驗，以計算出學習英文慣用語所需的複習次數，計算方法如下： 我們將從規範數據庫中，隨意抽取500條英文慣用語供二百名人士學習，所得之學習數據，會在R的caret套件內，執行多種監督式機器學習運算。演算法以複習次數為結果變項、前述數據庫中九項特徵為預測變項，所得的最佳演算模型，將會廣泛應用於推算規範數據庫內英文慣用語的複習次數。 此乃首項探查眾多因素如何相互影響英文慣用語學習難度的研究，過往研究多探索個別因素如何影響單字的學習難度，而鮮有針對英文慣用語的學習難度。此外，這項研究開創運用演算法解決語言學習、研究實際問題之先河，為日後發展智能與數據主導的教育及應用語言學開創新一頁。 最重要的，是這項研究將建立全球首個英文慣用語規範數據庫，提供日後英文慣用語對照實驗所需材料，並發展實證有效的英文慣用語課程、以及應用於教育和臨床上的英文慣用語能力評估方案。

15600221.value: 基于个人在他人眼中的名气和影响力的地位等级在人类群体中无处不在。对地位的渴望是人类的基本动机，人们采取各种地位策略来获得地位（Barkow，1985）。地位获得的三路径模型 (Bai, 2017) 在美德、能力和支配地位中找到了它的基础。美德基于引起爱戴的道德上值得称赞的特征（即美德–爱戴），可以提高地位。此外，一个人可以通过能力获得地位，这基于获得尊重的杰出任务技能和专业知识（即能力-尊重）。最后，基于引起恐惧的胁迫和恐吓（即支配-恐惧）的支配地位可能会导致更高的地位。 Bai、Ho 和 Yan（2020）发现，在他人眼中，美德–爱戴、能力–尊重和支配–恐惧是地位的独立预测因素。 然而，这种以变量为中心的方法侧重于每条路径如何单独预测地位获取——有时会混淆和限制研究。读者可以分别解释每条路径的独特影响，并得出结论，他们可以专门选择一条路径（与其他路径相对）以取得领先的地位（Kakkar & Sivanathan，2017 年）。这种分离忽略了可能存在独特的地位策略组合来塑造地位的可能性。此外，主要是静态的观点假设个人对地位策略的使用是稳定的，尽管已有相反的证据（Pettit & Marr，2020）。此外，静态视角忽视了地位策略和地位授予之间潜在的相互关系。人们做“很多事情”来获得地位（Barkow，1975），但他们获得的地位也会产生对未来行动的期望（Magee & Galinsky，2008）。 为了解决这些限制，我们提出了一种以人为中心的动态方法来研究地位获取。具体来说，我们利用潜在剖面分析 (LPA) 和潜在转变分析 (LTA) 来 (1) 识别使用独特的地位策略组合或剖面的子群体，(2) 调查地位策略组合随时间推移的有效性，以及 (3) 探索社会地位对地位策略组合及其转换的相互影响。我们的试点研究基于使用 LPA 对现有数据的重新分析，发现了七个在数量和质量上不同的地位策略组合或剖面。这些地位策略组合或剖面的发现挑战了过去基于回归分析的发现。在试点结果的基础上，我们建议进行三项大规模研究——对中国员工的纵向实地调查（研究 1）、对美国全职员工的纵向在线调查（研究 2）和基于预注册情景的在线调查对美国全职员工进行的实验（研究 3）——解决我们所有的研究问题。

15600621.label: Project Objectives
15600621.value: To further develop and substantiate the Household Accounting and Historical Inventory (HAHI) system through case study of Tai O’s stilt house architecture. HAHI is based on John F.C. Turner’s Household Accounting Survey (HAS) system for measuring residents’ housing satisfaction. HAHI adds historical data to this measurement system. This study aims to substantiate this system’s procedural clarity, and the validity of conclusions that can be drawn from it through case study. To describe household historical and preference-driven housing evolution processes, and their relationship with housing satisfaction and geometric complexity in stilt house architecture using HAHI and VDA. As a case study, this project’s datasets will allow specific analysis of HAHI and VDA data from Tai O’s stilt houses, creating a picture of how stilt house architecture evolved through resident preferences and historical conditions, the relationship between this process and residents’ housing satisfaction, and the geometric complexity and variety resultant therefrom. To describe resident preference-driven and historical contingency present in Tai O’s stilt house architecture development as a case study reflecting on Turner’s hypotheses. Turner hypothesized that housing satisfaction correlated to resident preferences and historically contingent evolution of housing architecture. As this case study measures historical and preference-driven housing evolution using HAHI, it will test Turner’s conclusions. To expand 3D scanning methods for recording vernacular architecture through case study. The study will return insight on practical techniques, limitations, and best practices for documenting and digitally preserving small, vernacular architecture of the coastal stilt house type. As a novel case for using the technology, this study aims to improve methods for similar applications. To elaborate 3D scanning preservation methods with observational and algorithmic Volumetric Development Analysis (VDA) techniques. Volumetric analysis is a novel method to understand evolving housing architecture types recorded using 3D point cloud scanning. This study offers a case to test and validate this technique, and validity of conclusions drawn from VDA. To elaborate HAHI and VDA methods by correlating both datasets for the same set of architectural objects. How housing evolves and residents’ satisfaction with it, inferred from HAHI data, is rarely correlated to the complexity of physical conditions resultant from this process, measured by VDA. This study provides a case to substantiate analysis correlating these data, to clarify any connection between them. To test hypothesized relationships between historically developed housing architecture types and variety and complexity within them through case study. Turner concluded that historically, resident preference contingent housing development processes and varied, complex housing architecture are correlated, with higher historical and resident preference-driven contingency supporting more complex, varied architecture. As a case study, this project will use HAHI and VDA to test Turner’s conclusions.

15600621.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15600621.value: This project is a case study of stilt houses in Tai O Village hypothesized to quantify and contextualize complexity and variety within the historical evolution of housing architecture types. Researchers’ multi-modal study will describe individual housing needs and history, the complex, varied physical architecture responding to those needs, and the evolving type describable thereby. The forms of research employed include Household Accounting and Historical Inventory (HAHI) and 3D Environment Scanning-supported Volumetric Development Analysis (VDA). These datasets reflect individual and historical factors that prompt housing decisions over time, and physical conditions resultant from them. Investigators hypothesize that comparing these datasets will quantify the complexity and variety resultant from housing decisions within a single typology. This allows deeper understanding of housing development and typology, methods and data from which will impact housing architecture practice through techniques and theory. Datasets from the project also impact government services and Tai O residents with help from conservation and concern groups. Remaining stilt house communities in Hong Kong include Tai O, Ma Wan Tsuen and Sam Ka Tsuen, and Ma Wan Chung Villages, with isolated residences on Lamma and Hong Kong Islands. Stilt houses are regulated as Surveyed Squatter Structures (SCPS) and have historical significance as remnants of Tanka fishing settlements. This type displays varied, complex architecture, hypothesized to result from evolutionary housing development. Internationally distinct, Hong Kong’s stilt house communities allow researchers to study relationships between a housing type, the complexity and variety within it, and the evolving needs and history resultant therefrom. This type is also threatened. Under the SCPS, stilt house residents’ land tenure status is “tolerated,” rather than under lease. This status constrains residents’ ability to renovate or repair stilt houses, leading to alienation and wastage. Flooding- and fire-prone conditions also recommend urgent research on this development pattern. To develop broadly applicable knowledge on the relationship between typological study, the complexity and variety within types, and the housing needs and historical evolution contributing thereto, this study addresses research objectives which will impact several constituencies; architectural practitioners through housing typology science and site survey methods; Government services and resource management, housing investment, and housing policy bodies, through case study data sharing and novel data gathering methods; and Tai O concern and conservation groups through data sharing for advocacy, house restoration, and cultural exhibition. These impacts will pass to Tai O residents through tourism economy benefits and greater visibility, and to architecture practitioners through improved methods. 本項目是一個大澳棚屋的案例研究，並假設可量化其在住屋建築的歷史變遷中的複雜性和變化。研究者的多模態分析將描述個人的房屋需求及歷史，因需求而形成的複雜多變的建築，以及不斷演變的類型。研究的形式採用包括家庭會計和歷史庫存和3D環境掃描支援的容量分析。這些資料反映隨時間推移影響住屋決定的個人和歷史因素，及因而形成的實質狀況。研究者假設通過比較這些資料將可量化同一類型住屋決策所導致的複雜性和變化。這可以對住屋發展和類型，方法及透過技術及理論影響住屋建築慣例的數據有更深入的理解。本項目的資料庫加上保育關注團體的協助會影響政府服務和大澳居民。香港現存的棚屋社群包括大澳，馬灣村，三家村和馬灣涌村，而在南丫島和香港島則有獨立的棚屋。棚屋是受監管於寮屋管制政策的已登記寮屋，也是蜑家人捕魚聚居的重要的歷史遺留物。這些住屋展示了複雜多變的建築，可以被假設為房屋發展變遷的結果。香港的棚屋社群令研究者可以分析其房屋類型，複雜性和變化，及逐漸形成的需求和歷史之間的關係。這些寮屋正面臨威脅。在已登記寮屋的寮屋管制政策的實施下，棚屋居民的土地使用權狀況是默許而非正式租用。這種狀況限制居民翻新或者修復棚屋，導致疏離和流失。水災和火災的情況使對於發展模式的研究變得迫切。為了開發關於類型學，其複雜性及變化，住屋需求和歷史變遷之間關係的有意義的知識，本研究針對的目標將影響幾個界別：建築執業者，透過住屋類型和現場測量方法；政府服務和資源管理，房屋投資和房屋政策機構，透過案例研究的數據共享和新穎的數據收集方法；大澳保育關注團體，透過數據共享的宣傳，房屋維修和文化展覽，並從而影響大澳居民。

15601021.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601021.value: Community-dwelling older adults can have difficulty walking safely in an urban area with an appropriate attentional focus due to numerous distractions and environmental challenges. Although older adults are required to engage in the everyday physical activity of walking, they frequently experience fall incidents. Unfortunately, a vicious cycle comes into play here: falls in older adults lead to a deterioration in their walking ability that further predisposes them to a high fear of falling. To tackle movement difficulties and the fear of falling while walking, older adults could allocate their focus of attention internally on their movements’ mechanisms along with movement-related rules through conscious movement processing. The internal focus using conscious movement processing in older adults was found to interfere with their attention allocation for navigation of the environment and multitasking while walking. This is because conscious movement processing requires the processing of movement-related rules that could overload the resources of working memory, causing movement failure and increased risk of falling in older adults. The detrimental effect of conscious movement processing could be even more pronounced in challenging walking environments that required attention optimisation. Nevertheless, the relationships among attentional focus instructions (i.e., a potential intervention), real-time (state) conscious movement processing propensity, gait parameters, and muscle efficiency in older adults with high and low trait conscious movement processing propensities while walking in a challenging environment remain unclear. This study aims to provide a novel scientific contribution through addressing critical knowledge gaps, examining the effects of attentional focus instructions on real-time (state) conscious movement processing propensity, gait parameters, and muscle efficiency in older adults in Hong Kong at risk of falling while walking in a challenging environment. It is a critical and logical extension of a successfully completed research project by our research team, and the research protocol is feasible as shown in a completed pilot study. The study results could update our scientific understanding of the mechanisms of conscious movement processing and the interventional effects of attentional focus instructions in older adults. It could ultimately enhance the methodology used for developing the most appropriate psychomotor gait re-education intervention in rehabilitation and provide clear guidelines on the exact attentional focus training that older adults require. Further, it could mitigate the effect of conscious movement processing and risk of falling in older adults.

15601521.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601521.value: 地方士人與國家的關係演變︰以十到十二世紀的福建莆陽為例

15601521.label: Project Objectives
15601521.value: Previous studies on Song localism have focused on the middle and lower Yangzi regions, with little attention given to the Fujian 福建region. However, this academic emphasis depicts only a partial picture of the social landscape of the Song dynasty, especially when we realize that the area that generated the most jinshi degree holders both in the Northern and the Southern Song was not in the Jiangnan江南 or Liangzhe 兩浙 region but in Fujian. Thus, the re-examination of Fujian will offer a different perspective to rethink the history of localism. While the existing scholarship argues that during the transition between the Northern and Southern Song, local literati cultivated localism and thus formed a centrifugal force against the central government, the case of Puyang莆陽, also named Xinghua jun興化軍, in Fujian will uncover a different story. Through analysing the interactions between Puyang literati and the state from the late Tang to the early Southern Song, this research will demonstrate that localism can be an advantage rather than an obstacle for literati to pursue higher political positions, for indigenous networks offered them support in their political advancement. Rethinking localism in this way will provide a more balanced and accurate picture of the interplay between local literati and state power in the middle period of Chinese history. To write three journal papers and to illustrate the following intellectual concerns. The first journal article will examine the relationship between Puyang literati and the changing regimes from the late Tang to the early Northern Song. I will explore the tendency of localism displayed by the Puyang literatus Huang Tao黃滔, a scholar-official and a renowned poet, in the late Tang. Through contextualizing Huang’s narratives in the specifics of local politics, this article aims to determine if the expression of local identity in Huang Tao’s writings worked against his pursuit of political advancement at the court. As one enters the early Song dynasty, expression of localism began to disappear from local literati’s narratives. I will investigate the reason behind this phenomenon and examine if it can be regarded as a lack of the literati’s concern for their locality. This article will show (1) whether the expression of a strong local identity in Puyang appeared only after the Southern Song or well before this period of time, and (2) whether localism was a permanent, actual presence or a measure of expedience that local literati resorted to in order to achieve specific goals within specific socio-political contexts. The second journal article will analyse the changing relationship between Puyang literati and the court during the Northern and the Southern Song transition. Because Puyang produced a large number of jinshi during the latter half of the eleventh century, Puyang literati had a strong relationship with the state in the late Northern Song, especially when the infamous Prime Ministers Cai Jing蔡京 and Cai Bian蔡卞, two natives of Puyang, were in power. I will then explain how the Jurchen invasions challenged this strong relationship, and how Puyang literati in the early Southern Song carefully re-interpreted their predecessors’ attitude toward Cai Jing. This paper will elucidate (1) if the strong local network of Puyang scholar-officials was an asset in their pursuit of better official careers in the late Northern Song, and (2) if this local network helped to maintain their political power to some extent during the Northern and the Southern Song transition. The third journal article will show different patterns of interactions between local literati and the state. I will use China Biographical Database (CBDB) to present the statistics of time-number political positions held by literati from (1) each southeastern circuit (Lu路), (2) the four prefectures producing most jinshi in Fujian, and (3) Puyang, Wuzhou婺州, and Fuzhou撫州 during the late Northern Song and the early Southern Song. Through this comparative approach, I will investigate how the different time-numbered political positions held by different regions’ literati shaped different relationships between local literati and the state. Furthermore, I will show which regions’ literati gained and which lost political influence during the Northern and the Southern Song transition. Supported by this digital humanities methodology, this article aims (1) to create an overview of the political engagements of literati in each southeastern region, and (2) to rethink how to set an appropriate scale in using digital humanities tools to perform a macro-analysis of the central-local interactions to reveal a different picture from existing studies.

15601521.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601521.value: 這項研究結合過去被分而論之的地方史與政治史，探討士人的地方社群網絡，如何與士人的政治活動相互影響。過去三、四十年，美國漢學界提出南宋士人地方轉向（localist turn）的論點，認為相較於北宋士人對仕宦中央的追求，南宋士人轉以地方作為經營權力與聲望的舞台。由此，地方士人的自發性組織，形成自外於帝國的一股力量。本研究以福建莆陽，即宋代興化軍為例，提出另一種地方社群與帝國互動的模式。我將指出，莆陽士人的在地認同，並不與他們的中央仕途相互扞格；尤有甚者，他們所經營的地方網絡，成為其仕宦生涯不可或缺的助力。 莆陽地方網絡與中央仕宦得以相互增幅，一個重要的前提，是莆陽士人在宋代科舉考試上的成功。過往宋代地方史研究，多聚焦於長江中下游地區，對於宋代進士及第人數最多的福建，著墨較少。在北宋，莆陽位列全國進士及第人數第四名，南宋則位列第七名。如果考慮莆陽的地狹戶寡，那麼莆陽出產進士的密度實則極高。高比例的進士及第人數，帶來高密度的地方社群網絡，從而強化莆陽士人在仕途上能夠從地方獲得的薦舉與幫助。兩者相輔相成，使他們逐漸在歷史書寫中，發展出較強的在地認同。 我計劃撰寫三篇論文。為求拓展這個領域的研究，這三篇文章各自聚焦於不同的材料與方法。其一，我將關注晚唐到宋初莆陽士人留下的碑刻。身處晚唐五代的動盪時期，莆陽士大夫如何藉由碑刻這種公開性強的文本，依違於更相迭次的政權之間，拿捏在地方與中央之間的分寸，將是我的研究旨趣。其二，我將利用文集、方志等有別於傳統政治史的文獻，分析南宋莆陽士人如何書寫他們在北宋的兩位政治前輩——蔡京、蔡卞二相。儘管蔡氏兄弟的掌權，讓北宋晚期莆陽士人的政治網絡臻至高峰；靖康之難與二蔡的歷史汙名，卻也如覆舟之水，成為南宋莆陽人的歷史包袱。就此而言，他們如何詮釋其先祖輩圍繞於二蔡所發展的網絡，進而改變地方歷史的敘事，便值得深論。第三篇文章將涉足數位人文的領域。我將在CBDB的資料基礎上，分析北宋最後三十年與南宋最初三十年這兩個時期，不同區域士人的仕宦強度。在現有研究關於婺州、撫州的豐富討論之上，本文將兩地與莆陽進行比較。北、南宋之際，婺州人仕宦比例大幅上升，莆陽人的仕宦率僅有些微增加；相對地，撫州人的仕宦幾無增長。比較三者，一方面可突破個案研究的限制，另一方面則有助於展現仕宦密度與比率的遞嬗，如何影響兩宋之交不同區域士人與中央政權的關係變化。
