16602621.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16602621.value: We examine the short- and long-term influences of disasters on the careers of Qing county magistrates and prefectural prefects between 1830 and 1912. In the short-term, we assess whether disasters increased the chances that an official’s career would end, and if so, what kinds of disaster were more likely to be associated with termination or demotion. We compare the influences on the chances of termination or demotion of floods, droughts, locusts, harvest failures, famines, epidemics, rebellions, and other disasters. This allows us to differentiate between disasters that were regarded as preventable or at least manageable, and ones that were acts of nature. We examine whether a disaster increased the chances that an official who was not terminated or demoted right away would later reach high office or have a longer career, and whether a disaster in a location in which an official had served previously increased their current chances of being terminated or demoted. The former is motivated by a hypothesis that at least for some officials, making it through a disaster without doing anything that led to termination or demotion might attract favorable attention from the higher officials who influenced promotions. The latter is based in Qing regulations according to which officials could be held responsible for floods or other disasters in locations where they had served previously if they were found to have neglected their duties. For this analysis, we apply quantitative methods including regression and more advanced approaches to two datasets that we have already created. The first is the China Government Employee Dataset-Qing, which as of October 2020 contains 4,195,280 linked quarterly records of 347,050 officials, with almost complete coverage between 1830 and 1912. The second is a database we have been constructing based on a published volume that collects 3,000 years’ worth of county-level records for China extracted from gazetteers and other sources (Zhang 2004). At present we have records of 27,134 county records between 1796 and 1814 and 1840 and 1911. We expect the results not only to inform our understanding of Qing personnel management during the 19th century, a period of considerable turmoil marked by frequent crises, but also contribute to the sociological study of career mobility by investigating the role of unplanned events as inflection points that may have set at least some individuals in an organization on a new trajectory by giving themselves an opportunity to distinguish themselves. 我們考察了 1830 年至 1912 年間自然災害對清縣知縣和知府的仕途的短期和長期影響。在短期影響方面，我們評估了災難是否增加了官員被革職的機會，如果是，哪種災害更可能與革職或降調有關。我們比較了洪水、乾旱、蝗災、歉收、飢荒、瘟疫、叛亂和其他災害對革職或降調機會的影響。這類信息使我們能夠區分被視作可預防或至少是可控的災害，以及天災。 我們研究災害是否會增加未立即革職或降調的官員後來擔任高品級官職或擁有更長仕途的機會，以及官員曾經任職過的地方發生的災害是否增加了他們該次被革職或降調的機會。前者是基於這樣一種假設：即至少對某些官員而言，能夠順利過渡災害而沒有做出任何導致革職或降職的事情可能會引起有權影響升遷的上級官員的積極關注。後者的假設是由於根據清朝的規定，如果官員被發現他們在曾任官職上疏忽職守，須要對他們以曾經任職地方的洪水或其他災情負責。 對於此分析，我們將定量方法包括回歸和更高級的方法應用於我們已經創建的兩個數據庫。第一個是中國政府官員數據庫-清代部分，截至 2020 年 10 月，它包含 347,050 名官員的 4,195,280 條鏈接季度記錄，幾乎完全覆蓋了 1830 年至 1912 年之間的所有時段。第二個是我們根據已出版的資料構建的數據庫，該著作收集了從地方志和其他資料中提取的過去3000 年的中國縣級災害記錄（Zhang 2004）。目前，我們有 27,134 條縣級的記錄，分別涵蓋 1796 年至 1814 年和 1840 年至 1911 年兩個時段。 我們期望分析結果不僅有助於我們理解19世紀清朝這個被標誌為有頻繁危機及相當動蕩的時期的人事管理制度，而且通過分析意外事件作為轉折點，讓某些個人能夠脫穎而出並走上新的職業軌道的作用，為職業流動的社會學研究做出貢獻。

16602821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16602821.value: Individualism and collectivism constitute a pair of contrasting constructs pertaining to the relationship between an individual and a group surrounding him that widely appear in writings of philosophers, political scientists, sociologists, and social psychologists. The exact meaning of each construct varies according to the context. In a normal sense, a construct prescribes what the ideal relationship should be (as viewed by a writer). In a positive sense, the construct describes which relationship is promoted by or/and prevails in practice in a society (as observed by a writer). The pair of constructs in the positive sense provides a familiar dimension to characterize different societies. Indeed, even a layman would assert that western societies are individualistic and eastern are collectivistic based on persistent behavioral patterns. Social psychologists actually document that people from individualist societies offer much different self-depiction than people from collectivist societies. The first object of this project is to understand individualism and collectivism. In particular, we ask why the persistent difference in behavioral patterns may be sustained in different societies. Whatever the civil society is, no individual can live by his own. He must interact with others for living. But there can be different ways for people to split surplus from cooperation. We treat individualism and collectivism as different norms to split the surplus; this is the novel piece of our project. Specifically, a collectivism norm maximizes the joint surplus for all participants involved in cooperation. Under an individualism norm, each participant maximizes his own surplus subject to the constraint that other participants also maximize their surplus. In this setup, no individual sacrifices his own interest---cooperation dominates autarky; and each norm sustains itself---no group-wise deviation from the norm can dominate the norm. The above treatment is rather abstract. So we embed it into a standard growth model as an application to examine its economic implications. We also intend to seek whether the model implications may get supported by empirical evidence. 個人主義和集體主義構成了一對對比概念。這一對概念涉及個人與他周圍的群體之間的關係，廣泛出現在哲學家、政治學家、社會學家和社會心理學家的著作中。每個概念的確切含義因上下文而異。在規範的意義上，每個概念規定了該概念使用者所認為理想的關係。從實證的意義上講，每個構念描述了該概念使用者觀察到在社會或文化的實踐中被促進或/和盛行的那種關係。這對概念在實證意義上提供了一個為人熟知的維度來表徵不同的社會。事實上，即便是大眾在一般的討論中也會基於觀察到的持久行為模式而斷言西方社會是個人主義的，而東方社會是集體主義。根據社會心理學家的記錄，來自個人主義社會的人們提供的自我描述與來自集體主義社會的人們大不相同。 這個研究項目的第一個目標是理解個人主義和集體主義。我們特別要問為什麼行為模式的持續差異可能會在不同的社會中持續存在。不管市民社會是什麼，沒有一個人可以靠自己生活。他必須與他人互動才能生存。但是人們可以通過不同的方式從合作中分配盈餘。我們將個人主義和集體主義視為分配盈餘的不同規範；這是我們項目的新穎部分。具體而言，集體主義規範使參與合作的所有參與者的聯合盈餘最大化。在個人主義規範下，每個參與者在其他參與者也最大化他們的剩餘的約束條件下最大化自己的剩餘。在這種設置中，任何個人都不會犧牲自己的利益，因為合作總是優於自給自足； 並且每個規範都能夠自我維持，因為任何對規範的偏離都無法使得所有的參與者都同時改善。上面的設置是比較抽象， 因此，我們將其嵌入到標準增長模型中作為一個應用來檢查其經濟影響。我們還打算尋求模型的預測是否可以得到經驗證據的支持。

16603521.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16603521.value: Effective climate policies of all nations are essential to achieve Paris Agreement target to limit the global temperature rise well below 2°C. Climate policies of nations are best expressed in Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) submitted to the United Nation Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) in 2017. The NDCs' are specified in terms of intended reduction or the peaking time of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. Assessing the effectiveness of climate policies in forms of NDCs is critical for understanding the gaps in policy and action, as well as for making adjustment in future efforts. The United Nations Environment Program (UNEP) has been conducting research and publishing annual reports on the gaps between the current global emissions and what is needed to achieve including temperature rise target and the progress towards the target. Such gap analysis approach requires a translation from global GHG emissions to temperature rise, which involves a great deal of uncertainty and major assumptions. In addition, it is often politically controversial when assessing contributions of individual countries. Thus, the UNEP approach is hard to be applied for assessing the climate policies of individual countries, not to mention providing an overall figure on emission gaps. As using the UNEP approach is impossible to measure the effort of each country, it is even harder to assess the speed of the country's energy transition and its resolve to tackle climate change. Therefore, in this project we will propose an alternative approach focusing on measuring the state of decarbonization of energy systems with development of a new indicator named Decarbonization Index (DCI). The DCI can measure the gap between the current state and the complete decarbonization of an economy or its energy system, and also be used for international comparison of different economies. We firstly construct the DCI to measure the progress of energy transitions and establish the carbon emissions database, and then calculate the current DCI and proposed DCI under NDCs in different countries in order to analyze the decarbonization gaps between the current state and proposed NDC targets. Calculating the gaps helps us understand the factors affecting the progress of energy transition and policy implications. The constructed DCI will contribute significantly to improving the measurement methods of carbon emissions of all countries. Results of this study will also shed lights on decarbonization and energy transition policies in individual countries. N/A

17100421.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17100421.value: 研究背景：氟化氨銀是一種臨床二期的醫療設備，具有無痛、無損傷、不會產生空氣溶膠并且價格實惠等優點。臨床醫生在蛀牙表面塗抹氟化氨銀，並讓其停留一段時間，直到多餘的部分被冲走。雖然目前臨床醫生們推薦更長的塗藥時間，但這一點缺乏科學依據。現有的研究大都隨機選擇了塗抹氟化氨銀的時間。由於氟化氨銀經常被用於難以配合的兒童，尤其是那些有多顆蛀牙需要治療的兒童，兒童的不配合往往會導致無法的實現氟化氨銀的預期治療效果，所以我們所共同期待的是氟化氨銀在一個短的塗藥時間内就可以達到好的治療效果。 研究目的：觀察延長塗抹氟化氨銀時間對蛀牙活動情況的影響。 研究方法：本試驗設計是一項分層隨機、雙盲、平行對照的臨床試驗。共有八個試驗組。本試驗將招募440名3至4歲患有蛀牙的幼兒園兒童，在蛀牙面上塗抹0.004 mL 38%氟化氨銀溶液，劑量依據製造商的使用說明。根據兒童蛀牙的狀況，分成高齲組和低齲組，然後按1:1的比例隨機分配到八個氟化氨銀塗藥時間組中，它們分別是5秒組、15秒組、30秒組、45秒組、60秒組、90秒組、120秒組和180秒組。從初始治療到6個月後，對蛀牙的活躍/停止的活動情況進行觀察。一名受過培訓牙醫將在基線檢查和隨訪時進行臨床檢查，并對試驗過程中的可能出現的危害進行監測和上報。納入研究的兒童的父母將會收到關於子女的口腔衛生狀況和蛀牙情況的報告。本試驗假設，氟化氨銀塗藥時間與阻止蛀牙惡化的效果之間存在單一遞增的趨勢。考慮到變量的影響，Cochran-Armitage趨勢檢驗。將用於確定兒童塗抹氟化氨銀的時間和阻止蛀牙惡化的情況之間的關系，同時，患有蛀牙的數量、蛀牙占據的的牙面數等多種情況也需要被考慮其中。80%最大濃度 [EC80] 分析將用於該試驗，觀察在某一個氟化氨銀塗藥時間下，阻止了80%蛀牙惡化的結果。我們將使用自助法對集群數據進行分析，並通過大量替换的重采樣来實現對95%的置信區間的設定。 可能的試驗結果和影響：本試驗結果將為氟化氨銀治療蛀牙的方案提供科學依據，這將會影響全球有5.73億患有蛀牙的兒童。

17100621.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17100621.value: 高效的DNA （脫氧核糖核酸）修復系統對維持基因組的穩定為其重要。近年的研究發現細胞會在修復受損DNA 雙鏈斷裂的同時抑制RNA (核糖核酸) 轉錄活動。可是，DNA 修復後轉錄重啟的機制與相關的因子還有待探討。未能及時修復與重啟轉錄活動不僅會危害基因表達，並可能對細胞造成有害的影響。 我們初步執行了文庫篩選以鑑定相關的修復因子，並由此揭示了在DNA 修復機制中未知作用的激酶候選物，包括 RIO 激酶 1 (RIOK1) 和牛痘相關激酶 3 (VRK3) 。 RIOK1 和 VRK3在激光微輻射誘導的DNA損傷軌跡上募集，這不僅需要PAR 聚合酶 (PARP) 的活性，轉錄抑製劑的預處理也有效的阻礙RIOK1 和 VRK3的募集。這現像不只聯繫了這兩個激酶和轉錄偶聯的 DNA 修復反應，也證明了它們對受損染色質的直接作用。 為進一步了解 RIOK1 和 VRK3 如何協調此過程，我們將在DNA損傷誘導和修復後進行全局轉錄組分析序列。我們也將分析 RIOK1 和 VRK3 的相互作用蛋白以檢定促進轉錄重啟的相關因子。我們也會進一步探討RIOK1 和 VRK3 活性失活會否影響染色體穩定性、細胞對 DNA 損傷劑的敏感性和細胞的身份維護。 這項研究代表了一項激動人心的舉措，旨在剖析相關因子在時空動態的層面上如何結合DNA 修復與轉錄重啟。這將增進我們對受損染色質轉錄控制的理解。我們解構的新型修復因子有望提供新型藥物用於管理與治療基因相關疾病。

17100621.label: Realisation of objectives
17100621.value: As described in our Objectives, we have uncovered a number of novel factors (including RIOK1 and VRK3) that are pivotal in promoting transcription restart following DNA repair. 17101021.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17101021.value: 白蟻在減輕熱帶地區乾旱影響方面的作用

17101021.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17101021.value: Dr Eggleton, Paul Dr Griffiths, Hannah Dr Khoon, Kho Lip Prof Parr, Kate

17101021.label: Project Objectives
17101021.value: Increase our understanding of the role termites play in ecosystem processes in a human-modified tropical landscape. This will be achieved using a fully factorial large-scale ecosystem manipulation of logged tropical rainforest and oil palm plantations, altering key elements of these widespread tropical ecosystems. Transferring our established experimental methodologies to new habitats, we will use cellulose baits treated with termite insecticide to suppress termite activity, allowing us, for the first time, to quantify the contributions of termites to ecosystem function in human-modified tropical landscapes. To do this, we will measure a suite of ecosystem properties including soil moisture, soil nutrient heterogeneity, decomposition rates and seedling survival across our experimental sites and treatments. A major advantage of the proposed project is that it builds on previous findings in local primary tropical rainforest of Sabah. We will expand the same ecosystem-scale manipulations to logged and oil palm habitats, in order to advance our understanding of the role of termites in human-modified landscapes. This will build on six years of previous collaborative research and expertise in primary tropical rainforest to understand the roles of termites in disturbed systems in the same region. We will extrapolate the results of our experimental manipulations by estimating the contributions of termites to carbon cycling under future climate change. We will be able to extend estimates of the contribution of termites to carbon cycling across the Bornean tropical landscape. Using data on rates of decomposition by termites under different climatic conditions and in different habitat types, we will be able to make some of the first estimates on of the contribution of termites to the carbon cycle across a human-modified tropical landscape. These data can also feed into more sophisticated climate-ecosystem models to predict feedback relationships between insects and the biosphere under future climate change. Quantify how termites affect oil palm ecosystem function. Termites are the dominant soil invertebrate group in many tropical ecosystems. Some termites (e.g. Macrotermes) persist in palm oil habitats and may provide ecosystem services such as decomposition and maintenance of soil moisture. However, some growers actively remove or poison all termites in oil palm, as a few species are pests of young oil palm trees. This will be one of the first studies of the relationship between termite diversity and their associated ecosystem functions in oil palm ecosystems. Given that Malaysia is responsible for around 30% of global oil palm production, this study may have a tangible impact on policy and management of sustainable oil palm in the region. We will quantify the interacting effects of drought and land-use change on termite diversity and associated ecosystem services and the ecosystem-level implications of these effects under future climate change. Climate change predictions for many rainforests globally indicate increasing droughts and severe El Niño events. Climate change predictions for our study area in Sabah, Malaysia indicate increased seasonality, which will result in drier dry periods (and wetter wet periods), which could be exacerbated by land-use change. Increased severity and frequency of El Niño events may also contribute to increased droughts in this region. Our experimental manipulations will quantify the contribution of termites to ecosystem processes in logged and oil palm ecosystems for the first time, and help to develop our understanding of how these processes change with drought. We will show how land use and drought interact to change termite-mediated ecosystem services such as decomposition, moisture retention and soil nutrient heterogeneity. Finally, we will use experimental seedlings to show how termites have potentially cascading ecosystem-level effects in human-modified tropical landscapes. Our previous work in primary tropical rainforests indicates that the importance of termites for maintaining ecosystem function might not become apparent until an ecosystem undergoes environmental perturbation such as drought. The buffering effects of termites during drought could have important but unexplored implications for seedling survival, forest regeneration and ecosystem function.

17101421.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17101421.value: Influenza A virus (IAV) is a respiratory pathogen with high transmissibility and spreads globally. The viral pathogenesis is closely associated with virus-host interaction, where the host molecular machineries are hijacked and/or modulated by viral proteins. To establish successful infection, IAV can evade host immunity through diverse strategies, including inhibiting host pre-mRNA processing and mRNA nuclear export through binding to Cleavage and Polyadenylation Specific Factor (CPSF) complex. Specifically, one of CPSF subunits, CPSF4, is blocked by influenza viral Non-Structural protein 1 (NS1). We previously developed a novel mRNA display with library of even-distribution (md-LED) method and identified a new NS1 binder, CPSF1, a scaffold subunit of CPSF. Since CPSF4 interacts with CPSF1, while NS1-CPSF1 interaction is identified in our data, it is possible that NS1-CPSF1 interaction is related to CPSF4 blockage. However, the mechanism of how NS1 binds to and suppresses CPSF module is not clear. We hence propose to determine NS1-CPSF module complex structure and identify their protein-protein interaction (PPI) interface through both cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) and crystallographic techniques. The NS1 inhibitory mechanism will be depicted comprehensively at atomic level and at the full protein scale. We have built a pool of virus mutants based on a NS1 saturated mutagenesis library, which has shown dramatically high efficiency on positive and negative selection. In parallel, we have a library containing all protein variants of NS1, each carrying one amino acid mutation. Based on the mutant protein library and mutant virus library, we propose to uncover the functional impact of each amino acid of NS1 on its interaction with CPSF module (i.e. either promoting or repressing). The binary interaction tests and viral replication assay will then validate NS1 mutants with altered binding affinity to CPSF module both in vitro and in vivo. Based on our data, we propose a working model candidate of how IAV NS1 inhibits host pre-mRNA processing via repressing CPSF module in two steps: 1) one effector domain of NS1 dimer recognizes CPSF1 N-terminal BPA domain, and anchors NS1 dimer to CPSF module, and 2) the other effector domain of NS1 dimer binds to CPSF4 N-terminal zinc finger domains, and blocks the polyadenylation signal (PAS) RNA recognition. Consequently, pre-mRNA 3’end processing is inhibited. Taken together, our mechanistic studies on NS1 will provide a proof of concept to comprehensively define the atomic-level structural details and functions of each amino acid on target protein upon interactions. 甲型流感病毒有很強的傳染性並且已經造成全球傳播。病毒的致病力是和病毒-宿主相互作用息息相關的，其中一個很重要的方面是病毒蛋白對宿主蛋白的調控。為了成功感染細胞，甲流病毒可以通過多種策略來逃避宿主的免疫力。这些策略中包括抑制宿主的CPSF (Cleavage and Polyadenylation Specific Facto) 复合物，从而抑制宿主pre-mRNA的加工和mRNA的轉運出核；具體來說，CPSF亞族之一，CFSP4蛋白，會被病毒的NS1（Non-structural protein 1）蛋白所抑制。本實驗室在前期工作中建立了新型的md-LED（mRNA display with library of even-distribution）篩選方法，並利用該方法鑒定出一個未知的NS1的結合蛋白，CPSF1。CPSF1是CPSF複合物的一個支架蛋白，并且会和CPSF4蛋白相互作用，所以NS1可能通過與CPSF1而對CPSF4進行抑制。但是，NS1蛋白與CPSF複合物結合並抑制其作用的機理並不清楚。所以，在本項目中，我們計畫通過冷凍電鏡和晶體學方法來鑒定NS1-CPSF複合物的結構和蛋白結合的作用平面，從而在原子分辨率上對NS1抑制CPSF的機理進行全面的解讀。 本實驗室已經建立了囊括NS1全蛋白序列飽和突變的甲流病毒文庫；同时，我们拥有一个NS1蛋白变体的文库，每个变体包含一个氨基酸的突变，覆盖了整个NS1蛋白序列。我们计划在体内和体外通过二项结合试验和病毒复制检测的方法，利用这两个文库来探究NS1蛋白中每个氨基酸对NS1-CPSF结合的影响。 在现有数据的基础上，我们设想了一种NS1抑制宿主pre-mRNA加工的两步模式：第一步，NS1中的一個蛋白結構域能夠識別CPSF1蛋白N端的BPA結構域，從而使NS1二聚物可以和CPSF複合物結合；第二步：另外一個NS1的結構域和CPSF4的鋅指結構域結合，進而阻止CPSF4識別RNA的聚腺苷酸化（polyadenylation，PAS）信號，從而抑制pre-mRNA 3‘端的加工。 綜上所述，本項目將利用解析原子分辨率的蛋白結構和解讀每個氨基酸對蛋白質相互作用的功能的方法，對NS1的抑制機理進行研究。這個項目將成為今後利用此種策略來研究蛋白質相互作用的範例。

17101821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17101821.value: Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) is an autoimmune disease with inflammation, bone erosion and new bone formation affecting mainly the sacroiliac joint and vertebrae. Early disease onset is marked by low back pain. AS is considered as an inheritable disease and the HLA-B27 accounts for 30% of the genetic effects. In 2018, the reported prevalence of AS ranges between 0.09% to 0.3%. We have recently identified a nuclear family with AS disease. After obtaining the consents from 7 patients and 5 normal subjects from this family, we performed whole exome sequencing followed by the confirmation by the Sanger sequencing. We found a proline to serine (P540S) mutation in the PIP5K1C protein and an alanine to serine (A609S) mutation in the AKAP13 protein from 5 patients in this family. The PIP5K1C and AKAP13 are key molecules in PIP2-IP3 signaling, which are important for regulating calcium production and nociceptive activation. We hypothesize that the PIP5K1C (P540S) and AKAP13 (A609S) mutations will lead to the auto-phosphorylation of these proteins, resulting in the activation of the PIP2-IP3 signaling, leading to increased pain sensitization. We have generated mutant Pip5k1c (P539S) (corresponding to human PIP5K1C-P540S) and mutant Akap13 (A606S) (corresponding to human AKAP13-A609S) knockin mice in Balb/c background. We found that PLC expression was significantly increased (over 100-fold) in DRG of Pip5k1c/Akap13 double mutant mice. We also found a significant increase in the sensitivity of mechanical allodynia, demonstrated by reduced von Frey threshold in Pip5k1c/Akap13 double mutant mice compared with the WT littermates. These results clearly demonstrated that Pip5k1c/Akap13 double mutant mice suffer from the pain-related nociceptive behavior. The underlying hypothesis of this project is that PIP5K1C and AKAP13 mutations lead to activation of PIP2-IP3 signaling pathway in cartilage, bone and DRG tissues, resulting in the development of AS-like pathological changes. To test this hypothesis, we proposed two specific aims to investigate roles of PIP5K1C and AKAP13 mutations in AS pathogenesis. In Specific Aim 1, we will determine if mutation of Pip5k1c or Akap13 will lead to AS phenotype. In Specific Aim 2, we will determine if Pip5k1c and PLC are critical molecular targets for anti-AS drug development. We will determine if PIP2-IP3 signaling pathway is activated in Pip5k1c and Akap13 mutant mice. We will also determine if inhibition of Pip5k1c or PLC could relieve the AS phenotype in AS mouse model. Our studies will provide novel insights into the pathological mechanisms of the AS disease. 強直性脊柱炎（AS）是一種自身免疫性疾病，伴有炎症、骨侵蝕和新骨形成，影響骶髂關節和椎骨。疾病早期特徵為腰痛。AS被認為是一種可遺傳的疾病，HLA-B27佔遺傳效應的30%。截至 2018 年，報告的 AS 患病率在 0.09% 至 0.3% 之間。我們最近發現了一個患有 AS 疾病的核心家庭。在獲得該家族7名患者和 5 名正常受試者的同意後，我們進行了全外顯子組測序，然後通過 Sanger 測序進行確認。我們發現該家族5名患者的 PIP5K1C 蛋白中有脯氨酸到絲氨酸 (P540S) 突變和AKAP13 蛋白中有丙氨酸到絲氨酸 (A609S) 突變。PIP5K1C 和 AKAP13 是 PIP2-IP3 信號傳導中的關鍵分子，它們對於調節鈣的產生和傷害感受的激活很重要。我們假設 PIP5K1C (P540S) 和 AKAP13 (A609S) 突變將導致這些蛋白質的自磷酸化，從而激活 PIP2-IP3 信號傳導，導致疼痛敏感性增加。我們構建了突變體 Pip5k1c (P539S)（對應於人類 PIP5K1C-P540S）和突變體 Akap13（A606S）（對應於人類 AKAP13-A609S）的基因敲入Balb/c小鼠。我們發現 Pip5k1c/Akap13 雙突變小鼠的背根神经节中 PLC 表達顯著增加（超過 100 倍）。我們還發現機械性異常性疼痛的敏感性顯著增加，這一點可從Pip5k1c/Akap13 雙突變小鼠的馮弗雷閾值與 WT 同窩小鼠相比降低得到證明。這些結果清楚地表明 Pip5k1c/Akap13 雙突變小鼠具有與疼痛相關的傷害性表型。該項目的基本假設是 PIP5K1C 和 AKAP13 突變導致軟骨、骨和背根神经节組織中 PIP2-IP3 信號通路的激活，從而導致 AS 樣的病理變化。為了驗證這一假設，我們提出了兩個具體目標來研究 PIP5K1C 和 AKAP13 突變在 AS 發病機制中的作用。在具體目標 1 中，我們將研究 Pip5k1c 或 Akap13 的突變是否會導致 AS 表型。在具體目標 2 中，我們將研究 Pip5k1c 和 PLC 是否是抗 AS 藥物開發的關鍵分子靶標。我們將研究 PIP2-IP3 信號通路在 Pip5k1c 和 Akap13 突變小鼠中是否被激活。我們還將研究抑制 Pip5k1c 或 PLC 是否可以緩解 AS 小鼠模型中的 AS 表型。我們的研究將為 AS 疾病的病理機制提供新的知識。

17101821.label: Major findings and research outcome
17101821.value: Ankylosing Spondylitis (AS) is accompanied with osteoarthritis (OA), a painful degenerative joint disease and the leading cause of chronic disability among elderly individuals. It involves nerve in-growth in synovial tissue and articular cartilage. These nerves act as nociceptors and therefore are indicator of OA pain signals. The molecular mechanisms for paintransmission from the joint tissues to the central nerve system (CNS) in OA is currently not clear. In current study, we utilized 12M Pip5k1c (P539S) (ki/ki) homozygous mutant mice, Akap13 (a606s) (ki/ki) homozygous mutant mice, and Pip5k1c (p539s)/Akap13 (a606s) (ki/wt) double-mutant heterozygous mice to study pain behaviour and functional dysfunction of spinal joints. Immunofluorescence staining revealed increased TPRV1 expression in the degenerative regions of intervertebral disc and sacroiliac joint cartilage of three mutant mouse models. These findings indicate that the mutant mice exhibit inflammatory infiltration characteristics. Immunohistochemical staining also showed an increase in CAMKII expression in the degenerative intervertebral discs and sacroiliac joint cartilage layer in 12M Pip5k1c (P539S) (ki/ki) homozygous mice. This suggests that pain and calcium-regulated proteins were increased in the mutant mice. Our findings indicate that with age progression, all mutants exhibited pain-related behavioural alterations accompanied by disc disorder with ectopic ossification and osteophyte formation. These mutant mice demonstrate systemic hyperinflammatory states along with elevated expression of pain signalling pathways and calcium regulatory proteins. Furthermore, microRNA miR-204 has been demonstrated to maintain the homeostasis of joint tissues and have chondro-protective effect on OA pathogenesis. However, the role of miR-204 in OA pain has not been determined. In this study, we investigated the interactions between chondrocytes and neural cells and evaluated the effect and mechanism of miR-204 delivered by exosome in the treatment of OA pain in a mouse model. Our findings demonstrated that miR-204 could protect OA pain by inhibition of SP1- LDL Receptor Related Protein 1 (LRP1) signalling and blocking neuro-cartilage interaction in the joint. 17101821.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17101821.value: Ankylosing spondylitis (AS), along with Osteoarthritis (OA), are pathological conditions in which the body’s immune system mistakenly attacks its own joints, causing inflammation, bone damage, and extra bone growth in the spine and causes back pain. We investigated a family where several members have AS, and the genes of 7 family members with AS and 5 without it. Study found two specific changes (mutations) in 5 of the family members with AS: one in a gene called PIP5K1C and another in a gene called AKAP13. These genes make proteins that help control the signalling pathway PIP2-IP3, which regulates calcium levels and influence how the body feels pain. We further created mutant mice with similar gene mutations in their human counterpart. Mice with both mutations showed significantly more expression of a protein called PLC in the nervous system that handles pain signals (dorsal root ganglia). These mice also reacted more strongly to light touches than normal mice, suggesting they have higher sensitivity to pain. In summary, we found that mutations over activate the PIP2-IP3 pathway in joints, bones, and pain-processing tissues, leading to AS-related pathology. Our study provided novel insights into the pathomechanism of AS & OA.

17102121.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17102121.value: 生態系統工程師（即會製造生境予其他物種的物種）對維持生物多樣性，特別在極端和酷熱的氣候下，尤為重要。觀乎世界海岸，雙殼類（即青口丶蠔之類的物種）乃重要的生態系統工程師，為繁多的物種提供了重要的生境和躲避酷熱的空間。故此，在全球暖化日益嚴重的挑戰下，生態系統工程師對維持地方生物多樣性，尤其在眾多物種正臨近其生理極限的熱帶海岸，更為重要。然而，不同的生態系統工程師對高溫的忍耐程度有異，其對維持生物多樣性的功能也不盡相同。其中關鍵，乃是若我們在未來因極端氣候而失去不同的生態系統工程師，不同尺度（跨海岸，或是跨地域之海岸）的生物多樣性將會受到何種影響？ 黑青囗（Mytilisepta virgata）和石蠔（Saccostrea cuccullata）乃是兩種可用作測試以上課題的生態系統工程師。牠們單一或混合地附着在香港的岩岸，故可用以檢視失去生態系統工程師對生物多樣性的影響。黒青口常見於大浪的岩岸，為很多固着或可活動的物種提供重要的生境。可是，因其源自北方溫帶海洋，香港已是其族群的地理極限，故每年夏天本港海岸的黑青口死亡率高達七成或以上。反之，石蠔常見於熱帶印度太平洋中浪力不高的海岸，卻未有如黑青口般大量死亡。在中等浪力的岩岸上，則可找到兩者混合固着的生境。 依附在黑青口和石蠔上的物種數量和群落組成將會用以驗証生物多樣性在不同生態系統工程師上的異同。我們也會實地移除不同的生態系統工程師（黑青口丶石蠔丶或兩者之混合）以達致不同的密度，用以模擬牠們死亡後對生物多樣性的影響。最後，我們將會用熱能生理實驗測量牠們在一系列高溫下的死亡率和可承受之時間，並與實地模擬移除之實驗相配合，計算預測在黑青口和石蠔繁多的地方（包括香港及華南沿岸一帶），全球暖化對生態系統工程師和生物多樣性之影響。

17102121.label: Realisation of objectives
17102121.value: This project aimed to demonstrate a key message – ecosystem engineers (EE) are not equal. To achieve this, three interrelated objectives were proposed, and two common EE on Hong Kong rocky shores, the mussel Mytilisepta virgata and the oyster Saccostrea cuccullata, used as model species. This project firstly studied what and how many associated species were hosted by the EE (Objective 1). Next, the loss of EE was simulated in manipulative experiments, and the responses of the associated assemblages measured (Objective 2). Finally, to understand the vulnerability of the two EE towards heat stress, thermal physiology and onshore populations were measured (Objective 3). Several minor details in the original proposal were changed to accommodate actual conditions (e.g. size of the monitoring plots, see below). The amended procedures did not alter the original goal of the task, and even enhanced (by adding extra measurements) the project. Objective 1: to investigate how the different ecosystem engineers, Mytilisepta and Saccostrea, affect biodiversity on Hong Kong shores (100% achieved) This objective investigated how much and what biodiversity was hosted by the two EE species. Destructive samples were collected from April to May 2022 at all study sites. All materials in the samples were sorted from the associated species assemblages in M. virgata, S. cuccullata, and mixed patches of the two, with organisms identified to the lowest possible taxonomic level or morphospecies. By using alpha and beta diversity analyses, the associated species composition in the three types of EE matrices was described and compared. In the proposal, habitat complexity would be measured by volume of the EE, using water displacement. Volume of EE was, however, difficult to be accurately measured because the EE individuals were often broken by the sampling procedures. To overcome this, several surface complexity metrics were estimated for the EE samples estimated from scans of the pre-disturbed samples using a photogrammetric method. The scanned objects (3D point clouds) were then used to computed multiple complexity metrics (both traditional ones and novel ones as part of a PhD thesis and subsequent paper, see Other Outputs). For the second part of the objective, temperature loggers were deployed within and outside EE beds, and at two tidal levels (at the vertical centre and the upper edge of EE beds). These temperature measurements started in May 2022 and lasted for more than two years (two summers in 2022 and 2023). The difference in temperatures recorded inside and outside EE beds was used as the supporting information of EE as thermal shelters for the associated species. Objective 2: To assess how loss/fragmentation of these different ecosystem engineers affects local and regional patterns of biodiversity (100% achieved) This objective aimed to study the cascading effects on the associated species assemblages upon mortalities of EE. Twelve permanent plots were established at each site in June 2022, with each assigned to one of three treatments (25%, 50% and 75% loss of EE). The original plan was to analyse the mortality effect as a categorical variable but due to the varying initial EE coverage (68% – 100% for M. virgata and 27% –93% for S. cuccullata), and post-manipulation changes (natural die off after manipulation), EE coverage turned out to be a gradient from 4% to 77%, and was subsequently analysed as a continuous variable. Such change in analytical approach, however, did not alter the hypothesis: that associated diversity changes with EE coverage. Another adjustment from the proposal was the manipulation plot size. The proposal aimed to manipulate a larger area (60 × 60 cm), but the on-shore vertical extent of the EE was often smaller than this range. Plot size was, therefore, changed to 30 × 30 cm, which still covers a representable patch size (> 500 mussels or > 100 oysters at 100% coverage). The establishment of these plots proved very labour-intensive and we were able to draft in a team of helpers, interns and RAs (sometimes > 6 people per day, see Other Outputs) to complete this work. In October 2022, destructive samples were collected from all plots. Organisms were sorted from the destructive samples and identified to lowest possible taxonomic level (or morphospecies) and used to represent the associated species assemblages along a gradient of EE coverage. The associated species composition was described using alpha (species richness) and beta diversities (compositional dissimilarity across samples). By regressing these diversity metrics along EE’s coverage, the effect of EE loss was tested and compared between the EE. Objective 3: To determine which of the ecosystem engineers, Mytilisepta and Saccostrea, are more susceptible to thermal stress and, hence, are less resistant habitats for biodiversity (100% achieved) This objective aimed to measure and compare thermal physiology of, and heat stress experienced, by the two EE species, and was achieved by the integration of four parts of laboratory experiments and field measurements: (1) cardiac performances of EE along a temperature gradient, (2) mortality experiments; (3) onshore body temperature estimation via biomimetic loggers, and (4) natural population monitoring (see above). In the laboratory, cardiac performance curves were measured for M. virgata and S. cuccullata from June to July 2023. Two metrics were extracted for each performance curve: Arrhenius breakpoint temperature (ABT) and flatline temperature (FLT). These thermal physiology data were then used to decide the temperature treatments in the mortality experiments, in which 40, 42, 44 and 46 °C were used, representing different levels of heat stress (from ABT minus 3 to 4 °C to FLT). For the mortality experiments (from August to September 2023), individuals of EE were exposed to each combination of 4 temperature treatments × 6 durations (from 30 min to 3 hours). Mortality rate across individuals was assessed and used to build mortality predictive models (binomial GLMs). An individual’s chance of mortality can then be estimated by inputting temperature, duration and site. To validate these predictive models, EE populations were monitored, with body temperature estimated via biomimetic temperature loggers in both 2022 and 2023 summers. The biomimetic temperature loggers were a NFC-tagged temperature logger inside empty EE shells, fixed within patches of EEs. The temperature data recorded were then input into the predictive models to obtain the predicted survival chance of an EE individual in their natural environment. Natural populations of EE were also monitored in permanent plots. Similar to the amendment in Objective 2, the plot size was changed to 30 × 30 cm from 60 × 60 cm due to space limitations. In 2022 summer, only three plots were set up for each site as 12 plots of the same size were used for the manipulations (Objective 2). The monitoring data in 2022 were, therefore, preliminary data. In 2023 summer, when the manipulative experiments were completed, ten permanent 30 × 30 cm plots were established at each site and visited biweekly, when the percentage cover of EE was measured before and after summer. Relative change in EE percentage cover was calculated for each plot and checked with the predictive. Overall, by completing these four parts of laboratory experiments and field measurements, the thermal physiology and onshore temperatures were compared between the two EE species, to achieve Objective 3

17102121.label: Major findings and research outcome
17102121.value: The two ecosystem engineers (EE) host a great number of associated species (~ 2-3 times more than bare rock) but their composition is different, with greater richness within mussels than oysters and the mixed habitat containing an intermediate species richness. The two EE are also “unequal” in (1) their thermal tolerance, (2) level of heat stress experienced in their natural environment, (3) surface complexity created, and (4) the cascading effects on the associated species upon their mortalities. M. virgata lives on wave-exposed shores that experience fewer hot days but is more vulnerable to prolonged heat stress, exhibiting earlier onset of, and more severe mortalities, than S. cuccullata. The loss of M. virgata also leads to a drop in associated species diversity. Mortalities of S. cuccullata did not lead to a decline in associated species number, likely because their dead valves stay attached to the rock, remaining ‘functional’ for associated species. M. virgata is, therefore, predicted to be more vulnerable under climate change, and so will be its associated species. One manuscript has been published and one is ready to be submitted (Research Outputs). The first was published in Methods in Ecology and Evolution (Research Output No. 1), which utilized surface 3D scans of EEs (Objective 1) to measure habitat complexity between the EEs and was also part of the PhD thesis of Y GU. The manuscript ready for submission (Research Output No. 2) describes the key message of this project: “ecosystem engineers are not equal” and is intended for Functional Ecology. This connects the thermal physiology of the two EE with their natural population dynamics and cascading effect on associated assemblages upon mortalities. By comparing the two EE in multiple aspects (Objectives 2 and 3), the findings reveal that EE enhance biodiversity, but their responses towards a common threat and their facilitative functions are highly species-specific. The conclusion highlights “species identity matters”, emphasizing EE are not functionally equivalent cautioning that species- (or trait-) level specificity needs to be incorporated for more-accurate predictions and restoration initiatives (see Section 6.2). A final manuscript in preparation describes the associated biodiversity in the two EE and their mixed patches and will target a regional journal. This work will present a species checklist as an updated reference for comparisons with past records, adjacent regions or with other EE species in Hong Kong.

17102121.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17102121.value: The importance of ecosystem engineers (EE) to local biodiversity is well recognized in temperate areas, yet is lacking in tropical regions. By studying two common EE species in Hong Kong, this project demonstrated that “EE are not equal”, but both host a great number of species, and are threatened by intensifying heat stress. Identifying the importance of other EEs to local biodiversity is a new research avenue by comparing the associated biodiversity in more species such as other bivalves and algae to estimate how these few species affect overall local biodiversity. Ultimately, we may be able to link properties of associated species assemblages (e.g. composition of species/traits) by their environment (e.g. wave-exposed vs. sheltered) and EE species present to predict importance for biodiversity conservation. This knowledge can be applied to applied situations, as urban coastlines expand, the creation and implementation of artificial shorelines creates opportunities to strategically introduce EE for biodiversity enhancement. To do this successfully, implementation requires ecological knowledge linking specific EE species to their biodiversity enhancement capacity and environmental suitability to the restored areas. With the above-mentioned knowledge, conservation practitioners can confidently identify the most suitable EE species needed for particular localities.

17102121.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17102121.value: On tropical rocky shores, thermal stress is intense in summer when vulnerable species are killed. Ecosystem engineers are species that physically modify the environment, creating extra complexity, lowering environmental stress and enhancing biodiversity by providing a safe habitat for other species. Ecosystem engineers are, therefore, like oases: providing habitats and shelters from heat for other species; but just like these species, they are also susceptible to heat stress. To understand how heat stress affects different ecosystem engineers, and how this impacts local biodiversity, thermal tolerance in a common mussel and oyster species was assessed. While both ecosystem engineers enhance local biodiversity, mussels proved more vulnerable to heat and their death causes dramatic declines in associated biodiversity. Surprisingly, when oysters die their associated species survive because dead oyster shells remain cemented to rocks, continuing to provide habitat. These findings show that "no two species are the same" and that the two ecosystem engineers provide different benefits to local species. Understanding these species-level differences is, therefore, crucial for predicting which ecosystem engineers will be most vulnerable to climate change and developing effective protection or conservation measures to maintain local biodiversity on Hong Kong shores.

17102521.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17102521.value: 在革蘭氏陰性病原體銅綠假單胞菌中，毒力因子的產生主要由三個分層次組織的群體感應 (QS) 系統 Las、Rhl 和 Pqs 控制。在模式菌株 PAO1 和 PA14中的研究表明這三個群體感應系統對於的毒力都是必不可少的，但在臨床環境中尤其是在慢性銅綠假單胞菌感染中經常分離出 lasR功能喪失的突變體。這些 LasR 突變株如何激活下游 QS 系統並保持其毒力？這是我們理解慢性銅綠假單胞菌感染過程的一個未解問題。 在我們之前由 GRF 支持的研究中，我們從香港瑪麗醫院的一例血液感染病例中分離出了一株流行性多重耐葯銅綠假單胞菌菌株 PA154197。此外，還開發了一種天然 CRISPR-Cas 介導的基因組編輯技術，用於該基因型的直接功能基因組學。 PA154197 被發現在 lasR 中含有點突變，並顯示出典型的 lasR 功能喪失表型。有趣的是，下游 Rhl 和 Pqs 系統在該菌株中很活躍，並且主要由 QS 系統控制的銅綠假單胞菌主要毒力因子綠膿素 (PYO) 的產生水平甚至高於 PAO1。這些結果表明 PA154197 已經開發出補償機制來激活下游 Rhl 和 Pqs 系統並保持其毒力獨立於主調節器 LasR。然而，潛在的遺傳和分子機制尚不清楚。 在我們對本提案的初步研究中，我們在 PA154197 中進行了 Himar1 C9 轉座子插入文庫篩選，並確定 AlgZR 兩組分系統激活該基因型中的 Rhl 和 Pqs QS 系統和 PYO 生產。進一步的研究表明，與 PAO1 AlgR 不同的是，PA154197 中的反應調節劑 AlgR 主要以非磷酸化狀態存在。這些結果使我們假設有一個 AlgR-Pqs-Rhl 調節迴路，它在沒有 Las 的情況下激活 QS 和 PYO 的產生。因此，該提案旨在使用原型 lasR 功能喪失基因型 PA154197 作為範例來闡明這種補償性調節機制。 由於它們在調節細菌毒力方面的重要作用，QS 系統代表了一類新的抗菌目標。然而，lasR 無效或功能喪失的銅綠假單胞菌變體經常出現在臨床環境中，這給基於抗 QS 的抗菌劑帶來了難題。了解這些 LasR 變體如何重新連接其基因調控途徑並保持毒力將促進我們對病原體在感染過程中的進化適應的理解，並促進新型抗菌干預措施的開發。

17102921.value: 背景：牙齒發育程度可用於估計青少年人的年齡，因為環境因素對齒齡的影響較其他骨骼或軀體成熟度指標為小。我們的研究團隊基於4,000 張具完整恆齒列的X光片及尖端的數學方法，建立了首個華南人的齒齡測定 (DAE) 參考數據集 (RDS)，達到了高準確度。這個完整的RDS已被證明適用於華北人、東亞人以及東南亞人。然而，這種 DAE 方法的效能依賴於訓練有素的專家進行手動識別，這耗時且昂貴。我們建構了一個人工智能（AI）系統，透過識別正在發育中的臼齒，達到為華南人進行自動化年齡測定。我們提議開發一個新的AI系統，使其能夠識別所有DAE 所需的牙齒，以達致最高精確度及最大化華南RDS 的效能。 關鍵議題：身份識別問題發生於自然災害，例如熱帶風暴、地震、海嘯和火山爆發等期間，亦發生於未登記兒童及其相關的侵犯人權行為，包括童工、童婚和人口販賣。為兒童和青少年提供 DAE 可以使他們獲得正式的身份證明文件，從而為他們提供法定權利，以及獲得教育和社會福利的機會。儘管如此，要建立一個種族特定的AI系統用作DAE，在方法和技術上都是困難重重，尤其是對於大多數東南亞國家而言。最近的基因研究顯示，華南的人口遷移緩慢地擴展到東亞其他地區。因此，東亞人展現出共同的牙齒表現型。故此，測試華南AI系統是否可以應用於東南亞人作DAE是值得研究的，其結果也會影響國內外這些人群。 目的：開發及驗證一個建基於整套恆齒列的華南AI系統用作DAE，並探究其對東南亞人的適用性。 研究計劃：從已建立的華南RDS 中隨機抽取的 1,000 張牙科 X 光片，並將其生成超過 100,000 張牙齒圖像，以用作訓練三個AI模型於識別門齒、犬齒和小臼齒，且能辨認恆齒的發育程度。當該三個模型通過全面測試後，它們將會與我們所建立用於識別臼齒的AI系統相結合，並且運用華南RDS及高等算法來估計齒齡。這個開發的AI系統之有效性將會透過來自香港具有代表性的華南樣本（432 張X光片）進行驗証。總共3, 456張牙科X光片將會從東南亞合作機構所提供的檔案中隨機抽取。已驗證的華南AI系統將會為每位受試者推算其估計的齒齡（範圍從 5 到 22 歲）。統計分析將會在最嚴格的審查下進行，每個人群/年齡/性別組中的受試者其估計的齒齡和實際年齡（黃金標準）之間的差異將會用以鑒定華南AI系統在東南亞人群中的適用性。 創新：該提案將是第一個DAE 研究採用AI 自動化數據處理系統，具備全面的 RDS 和綜合統計分析來測定年齡。 影響：開發的系統將會為政策制定者及政府和非政府組織提供實用且可靠的工具進行有效率的年齡測定，為未登記的兒童和青少年人提供重要証據予出生登記和核實身份，從而改變和改善他們的生活，維護他們的公民、法律、社會和政治的權利。

17103821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17103821.value: As a systemic autoimmune disease, primary Sjögren's syndrome (pSS) is characterized by hypofunction and tissue destruction of salivary and lachrymal glands, leading to severe dry mouth and eyes. In patients with pSS, the lymphocytic infiltration in salivary glands (SG) is a prominent feature of disease pathology with diagnostic value. Although the etiology is still unclear, numerous studies have demonstrated an important role of T cells and B cells in the pathogenesis of pSS. However, it remains largely unclear whether and how innate immune cells contribute to the development of this disease. Natural killer (NK) cells are well recognized as an important innate player in host defense against infections for early immune protection. Increasing evidence indicates an involvement of NK cells in autoimmune pathogenesis. In our pilot studies, we observed reduced numbers of circulating NK cells with impaired function in pSS patients. Moreover, we detected a large population of NK cells residing in the SG with resident phenotype, but it is unknown whether NK cells are involved in pSS pathogenesis. Using a well-established mouse model of experimental SS (ESS), we found that NK cells in SG possess a regulatory function in suppressing T cell proliferation but change to a proinflammatory phenotype during ESS progression. Remarkably, the depletion of SG NK cells by retrograde cannulation with an anti-NK1.1 monoclonal antibody before the disease onset resulted in significantly increased salivary hypofunction and severe SG tissue inflammation with massive T cell infiltration in mice, indicating a critical role of SG NK cells during ESS development. In this project, we will characterize both phenotypic and functional features of NK cells at different stages of ESS development by using genetically-modified mice and NK cell depletion methods. Moreover, we will determine the key proinflammatory cytokines and molecular mechanisms involved in modulating NK cell maturation and functional changes in SGs of both ESS mice and pSS patients. Furthermore, we will investigate the therapeutic effects of targeting SG NK cells on ESS development in mice. The expected findings and outcome from the translational studies will identify a novel function of NK cells in pSS pathogenesis, which may facilitate the development of new therapeutic strategies for the treatment of pSS, a chronic autoimmune disease with high social relevance in Hong Kong. 原發性乾燥綜合徵 (primary Sjögren's syndrome, pSS) 是一種系統性自身免疫疾病，其主要特徵是唾液腺和淚腺功能減退和組織破壞而導致的口乾和眼乾。在pSS患者中，唾液腺淋巴細胞浸潤是對疾病診斷具有重要價值的病理特徵。大量研究表明T細胞和B細胞在pSS發病過程中發揮了重要作用。然而，先天免疫細胞是否以及如何參與pSS疾病發生和發展目前仍不清楚。 自然殺傷 (Natural killer, NK) 細胞是在宿主早期抗感染免疫中發揮重要作用的先天性免疫細胞。目前已有證據表明 NK 細胞也參與自身免疫性疾病的病理機制。在我們的初步研究中，我們觀察到pSS患者外周血NK細胞數量減少，且功能受損。此外，我們在唾液腺中檢測到大量具有組織駐留特徵的NK細胞，但NK細胞是否參與pSS發病目前仍不清楚。利用成熟的實驗性乾燥綜合征 (ESS) 小鼠模型，我們發現唾液腺NK細胞可抑制T細胞增殖，且在ESS發病過程中獲得促炎性表型。在疾病起始階段使用唾液腺逆行插管技術清除唾液腺NK 細胞，可導致小鼠唾液分泌功能明顯下降和加重的唾液腺組織炎症，並伴有大量 T 細胞浸潤，提示唾液腺NK細胞在ESS發病過程中發揮重要作用。 在本項目中，我們將使用轉基因工具小鼠和特異性清除NK細胞等方法研究在ESS發病過程中NK細胞的表型和功能特徵。此外，我們將確定調控NK 細胞成熟和功能變化的關鍵細胞因子和分子機制。我們將進一步研究靶向唾液腺NK細胞對小鼠 ESS發病的治療效果。這些轉化研究的預期結果將鑒定出NK細胞在pSS發病機制中的新功能，有助於開發針對pSS病人的新型治療策略。

17103921.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17103921.value: We are the first group to introduce three novel sensors for the detection of ATP (AT1.03), NADPH (iNAP) and NADH/NAD+ ratio (SoNar) for monitoring of dynamic changes of these energy carriers in different subcellular compartments (e.g., cytosol, chloroplasts, peroxisomes, etc.) of various tissues (e.g., leaves, hypocotyl, roots, etc.) in live plants. This new technique is superior to previous in vitro methods (e.g., enzyme assays, bioluminescence, LC-MS, etc.) that require prior extraction and thus cannot provide real-time or subcellular information. In this project, we have introduced these novel sensors into the pollen of wild-type Arabidopsis thaliana under the control of a pollen-specific Lat52 promoter. Then, we will make use of a number of inhibitors (glycolysis, mitochondrial ATP production, oxidative pentose phosphate pathway, pyruvate dehydrogenase, pyruvate dehydrogenase bypass, lipid synthesis, mobilization) and T-DNA mutants (acn1, acs, adh1, aldhs, nadp-mes, ntt1, ntt2, pdkc-1) to delineate the energy metabolism during pollen tube growth, the fastest growth process in plant cells. We will examine 1) the biological roles of pollen plastids, and 2) the sources of ATP, NADPH, NADH, and acetyl-CoA for fatty acid synthesis in pollen plastids. We believe plastids play an important role in transforming carbon and energy from the exogenous sugars into fatty acids, which supply membrane lipids for rapid pollen tube growth. Our ultimate goal is to establish a clearer model of the energy flow during pollen tube growth that links plastids, energy flow, and lipid synthesis. 我們課題組率先在植物中引入了可以檢測 ATP (AT1.03)、NADPH (iNAP) 和 NADH/NAD+ 比率 (SoNar) 的三種新型傳感器，用於監測在活體植物不同組織（例如，葉、下胚軸、根等）及其各種亞細胞區室（例如，細胞質，葉綠體、過氧化物酶體等）中這些能量載體的動態變化。相較於以前需要預先提取待測分子而無法提供實時的亞細胞信息的體外方法（例如酶測定法、生物發光法、液相色譜-質譜聯用法（LC-MS） 等），這種新技術更為優越。在這個項目中，我們會用花粉特異性lat52啟動子來調控這些新型傳感器的表達，並將這些傳感器引入野生型擬南芥的花粉中。之后，我們擬通過應用許多能量代謝通路抑制劑（糖酵解、線粒體 ATP 生產、氧化戊糖磷酸途徑、丙酮酸脫氫酶、丙酮酸脫氫酶旁路、脂質合成、運輸）和相關的T-DNA 突變體（acn1、acs、adh1、aldhs、nadp-me, ntt1, ntt2, pdkc-1) 來研究植物細胞中最快的生長過程，即花粉管的生長中的能量代謝詳情。我們將探討 1) 花粉管質體的生物學作用，以及 2) 用於花粉質體中脂肪酸合成的 ATP、NADPH、NADH 和乙酰輔酶 A 的來源。我們相信在把碳和能量從外源糖轉化為脂肪酸， 從而為花粉管的快速生長提供膜脂的方面，質體發揮著重要作用。該項目的最終目標是建立一個更清晰的花粉管生長過程的能量流動模型，將質體、能量流動和脂質合成聯系起來。

17104721.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17104721.value: TRIF：調節內臟脂肪細胞中脂滴增大的新型分子

17104721.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17104721.value: Prof Hoo, Ruby Lai Chong Dr Lam, Jenny Ka Wing

17104721.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17104721.value: Cardiovascular and metabolic diseases are often thought as a kind of obesity- or overweight-related problems in Western societies. However, Chinese and East Asian patients with these problems are usually have normal body weight or body mass index less than 25. Several studies have reported the correlation between the fat distribution in our body and the risks for these diseases. People with normal BMI but a high waist-to-hip ratio appearing as an apple-shaped body have a higher risk to develop these diseases. The larger waist circumference is commonly caused by the accumulation of fat in viscera while a larger hip manifests the build-up of fat in subcutaneous layer. As we age, the proportion of visceral fat increases, and the visceral fat contributes to the age-related metabolic and cardiovascular risks. However, what kind of factors regulate the distribution of fat in different depots is unclear. Inflammation is one of the facilitators of fat tissue expansion and involves numerous signaling pathways. Whether and how inflammation regulates to the differential fat deposit is noteworthy to be explored. Toll-like receptor (TLR) is one of the key receptor families regulating innate immunity. Increasing evidence demonstrates their roles in metabolic pathways. Our preliminary data show a higher expression of TIR-domain-containing adapter-inducing interferon-β (TRIF), one of the branches of TLR signaling pathway, in visceral adipose tissue (VAT) than subcutaneous adipose tissue (SAT). TRIF-deficient mice has smaller VAT compared with wild type, and the adipocyte size in this depot was also smaller. Several genes synchronizing adipogenesis were suppressed in VAT but not SAT in TRIF-deficient mice. We also observed a lower expression of CIDEC, a key protein regulating adipocyte enlargement, in VAT upon TRIF deletion. Hence, we hypothesize that TRIF promotes VAT expansion by regulating adipocyte enlargement. In this study, we are going to find out the underlying mechanism how it happens. As blockade of VAT expansion alone appears undesirable because it may cause an increase in ectopic fat accumulation in liver and muscle which aggravates metabolic risks. Therefore, as a proof-of-concept, we will also explore the feasibility to shift the fat storage site from VAT to SAT by stimulating TRIF pathway or expression in SAT. Overall, the findings of our study will help us understand the mechanism of how VAT expands, and subsequently explore a better way to treat cardiovascular and metabolic diseases. 在西方社會，心血管和慢性代謝性疾病通常被認為是一類與肥胖或超重相關的問題。但在中國和其他東亞國家中，患有這類疾病的病人往往體重正常或BMI低於25。一些研究發現體內脂肪分佈和這些疾病的風險因素之間存在相關性。同是BMI正常, 但若腰臀比值高且身材呈“蘋果型”的人患心血管疾病或其他代謝性疾病的風險更高。腰圍偏大通常是內臟脂肪堆積所致，而臀圍偏大則表現為皮下脂肪堆積。隨著年齡的增長，內臟脂肪的比例增加，而內臟脂肪會增加年齡相關的代謝性疾病和心血管事件的風險。然而，調節脂肪分佈位置的因素尚未清楚。炎症是促進脂肪組織體積增大的因素之一，其涉及的信號通路有很多。炎症是否牽涉脂肪分佈調節值得進一步探討。 Toll樣受體（TLR）是調節先天免疫的關鍵受體之一。越來越多的證據表明它們在代謝途徑中的作用。我們的前期研究發現，與皮下脂肪組織相比，TLR信號通路中的β干擾素TIR結構域銜接蛋白（TRIF）在內臟脂肪組織中表達更高。Trif敲除小鼠的內臟脂肪組織比野生型小鼠較小，且脂肪細胞體積也小，與此同時，合成脂肪相關的基因在內臟脂肪組織中表達降低，但在皮下脂肪組織其表達不受抑制。我們還發現，在Trif敲除小鼠的內臟脂肪組織中，CIDEC（一種調節脂肪細胞體積增大的關鍵蛋白）的表達下降。TRIF可能通過調節脂肪細胞體積增大來促進內臟脂肪組織增大。在此項研究中，我們將探討這可能性及有關機制。由於抑制內臟脂肪組織增大可能導致肝臟和肌肉組織中脂肪堆積的增加，從而增加發生代謝性疾病的風險，因此，我們亦會探討能否 通過刺激皮下脂肪組織中的TRIF，從而 將脂肪儲存由內臟脂肪轉移至皮下脂肪的可行性。總體而言，我們的研究結果將有助於我們理解內臟脂肪組織增大的機制，繼而探索治療心血管和慢性代謝性疾病更有效的方法。

17105221.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17105221.value: 中生代中最多樣化的鳥類反鳥亞綱的飲食習性的定量調查

17105221.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17105221.value: Dr Ali, Jason Richard Dr Bevitt, Joseph Prof Wang, Xiaoli Prof Zheng, Xiaoting

17105221.label: Project Objectives
17105221.value: To improve understanding of diet in the most important group of Mesozoic birds. Enantiornithines are the most speciose and widespread birds of the Mesozoic era [1]. Recent studies have commented on their locomotion [2] and reproduction [3], but their diet remains entirely speculative [4]. Diet shapes the niche specialisation of organisms, determines the structure of food webs in communities, and underpins the structure of entire ecosystems [5]. Thus, without understanding their diet, the ecology of this key fossil group will remain unclear. We seek to remedy this situation by applying our novel framework of modern techniques to infer fossil diet. To test and refine our novel framework for determining fossil bird diet to produce a fully tested gold standard. Seven lines of evidence (dental microwear, cervical muscle construction, body mass estimation, stable isotope geochemistry, traditional morphometrics, mechanical advantage modelling, and finite element analysis) have been proposed to reflect avialan diet, all using extant taxa as a reference (usually extant birds, extant lepidosaurian reptiles when comparing teeth). In this proposal, Avialae is defined as a clade that includes living birds and their closest fossil relatives: a stem-based taxon containing Passer domesticus (house sparrow) and all coelurosaurian dinosaurs closer to it than to Dromaeosaurus albertensis (dromaeosaurid) or Troodon formosus (troodontid) [6]. We expect the use of combined techniques to allow us to narrow the dietary possibilities more than any individual technique could, and to potentially identify unique feeding styles not present in modern birds (see Figure 1 for a summary). To date, a maximum of only two lines of evidence have ever been applied to any given fossil avialan. We will evaluate the efficacy of our proposed framework by observing whether, and if so how, it increases the specificity and confidence of diet assignment. The project will therefore result in a gold standard for understanding fossil bird diet for the foreseeable future. To reconstruct ancestral bird diets. Living bird diets are extremely varied [7], but it is unclear when in the theropod lineage such variation emerged. The diet of the common ancestor of all birds is particularly contested [8-10], primarily because the diet of less than 5% of non-avian avialan taxa is known. In this proposal, Aves refers to crown birds only: living birds and all of their ancestors back to their most recent common ancestor [6]. Enantiornithines make up the majority of non-avian avialan taxa. We expect our study to more than double the number of data points in avialan diet ancestral state reconstruction. To determine whether edentulism (tooth loss) was a driving force in the dietary diversity of modern birds. As nearly all enantiornithines were toothed [11], their diets will test the hypothesis that edentulism allowed modern birds to diversify their diets [12]. Dietary radiation(s) in the toothed enantiornithines would imply that beaks alone could not have led to the modern diversity in bird diets. To advance understanding of Mesozoic ecosystems. Living birds are vital to understanding modern ecosystems owing to their role as indicator species and their rapid rates of species diversification and turnover [13]. By furthering our understanding of the ecology of enantiornithines (the closest Mesozoic analogues to modern bird diversity), as described in the first objective, we will also gain a much clearer picture of Mesozoic ecosystems. Enantiornithine inter- and intrageneric niche specialisation (the precise role each genus plays in the ecosystem) will be the main focus of study to identify the niche occupation range (i.e. set of niche specialisations across the entire group) of enantiornithines relative to modern birds. Additional palaeoecological information will be gathered and published as part of the study, notably information on the dental microwear and stable isotope geochemistry of other organisms in the Jehol biota as reference taxa.

Enantiornithines make up the majority of non-avian avialan taxa. We expect our study to more than double the number of data points in avialan diet ancestral state reconstruction.

To determine whether edentulism (tooth loss) was a driving force in the dietary diversity of modern birds. As nearly all enantiornithines were toothed [11], their diets will test the hypothesis that edentulism allowed modern birds to diversify their diets [12]. Dietary radiation(s) in the toothed enantiornithines would imply that beaks alone could not have led to the modern diversity in bird diets.

To advance understanding of Mesozoic ecosystems. Living birds are vital to understanding modern ecosystems owing to their role as indicator species and their rapid rates of species diversification and turnover [13]. By furthering our understanding of the ecology of enantiornithines (the closest Mesozoic analogues to modern bird diversity), as described in the first objective, we will also gain a much clearer picture of Mesozoic ecosystems. Enantiornithine inter- and intrageneric niche specialisation (the precise role each genus plays in the ecosystem) will be the main focus of study to identify the niche occupation range (i.e. set of niche specialisations across the entire group) of enantiornithines relative to modern birds. Additional palaeoecological information will be gathered and published as part of the study, notably information on the dental microwear and stable isotope geochemistry of other organisms in the Jehol biota as reference taxa.

17105221.label: Major findings and research outcome
17105221.value: The project achieved its aim to improve understanding of diet in the most important group of Mesozoic birds, the enantiornithines. This in turn improved our understanding of the ecology of this key fossil group. We tested, refined and applied our novel framework of modern techniques to infer fossil diet (Objectives 1+ 2). We considered all seven lines of evidence (dental microwear, cervical muscle construction, body mass estimation, stable isotope geochemistry, traditional morphometrics, mechanical advantage modelling & finite element analysis) (Objective 2), but could not apply stable isotope geochemistry and dental microwear as we were unable to conduct required sampling and analysis during COVID lockdown in China (see section 5.3). However, as noted in our progress report, we worked very hard maximise the success of the project in the face of these exceptional challenges, expanding study in relation to the other lines of evidence. We used the combined techniques to narrow the dietary possibilities of the three major enantiornithine families - Longipterygidae, Pengornithidae and Bohaiornithidae - achieving our aim to exceed two lines of evidence in fossil avialan dietary reconstruction as well as increasing its specificity and confidence (Objective 3). We found that longipterygids most likely were invertivores or generalist feeders. Pengornithids show adaptations for vertebrate carnivory with the similar talons of Pengornis to living raptorial birds representing the earliest known adaptation for avian macrocarnivory. Bohaiornithids were found to be more ecologically diverse than any other enantiornithine family e.g., Bohaiornis and Parabohaiornis are similar to living plant-eating birds whilst Longusunguis resembles raptorial carnivores. Synthesising this we predict the ancestral enantiornithine was a generalist that ate a wide variety of foods. By the Early Cretaceous, we find that enantiornithines had diversified into a variety of ecological niches like crown birds after the K-Pg extinction, adding to evidence that traits unique to crown birds cannot completely explain their ecological success (Objective 5). This also implies that beaks alone did not lead to the modern diversity in bird diets (Objective 4). Our work more than doubled the number of data points in avialan diet ancestral state reconstruction (Objective 3). The project results were published in three papers in BMC Biology, iScience and the high-impact eLife. These papers and media coverage of the project are testament to the project’s success and the major advances made which set a gold standard for the foreseeable future. We thank the grant body for making this possible.

17105221.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17105221.value: Our project points to the common ancestor of Enantiornithes as an arboreal generalist feeder. This implies the numerous ecological specialisations within Enantiornithes likely represent lineages already exploiting a resource that are then further specialising in it (rather than dramatically undergoing trophic shifts). Our quantitative reconstruction of the common ancestor of Enantiornithes in many ways resembles a smaller pengornithid, so further ecological study of the earliest-diverging enantiornithines would be important to test this. It is clear that much ecological change and diversification occurred within Enantiornithes by 120 Ma, a period of ~25 million years, just like the time it took for crown bird diversification. This suggests that many traits, including the beak, cannot fully explain the rate or extent of ecological diversification of crown birds after the K-Pg extinction. Instead, to fully understand this, we suggest that future work should focus on the ecological success and diversity of Ornithothoraces as a whole which includes main evolutionary milestones including in flight development. These suggested priorities promise to uncover even more impactful results and will leverage and build upon this project’s success.

17105221.value: The project aimed to improve understanding of diet in the most important Mesozoic birds, the enantiornithines. This is necessary to improve understanding of Mesozoic ecosystems and the origins of modern ecosystems. We tested, refined and applied a novel framework of modern techniques to infer fossil diet considering multiple lines of evidence. We used the combined techniques to narrow dietary possibilities of three major enantiornithine families. We found longipterygids were most likely invertivores or generalist feeders. Pengornithids show adaptations for vertebrate carnivory with Pengornis showing the earliest known adaptation for avian macrocarnivory. 17105721.label: Realisation of objectives
17105721.value: We have used the term “small extracellular vesicles” in place of “exosomes” in this report and related publication. 1. To characterize the functional role of small extracellular vesicle (sEV)-NAMPT in HCC tumorigenesis and metastasis To explore the functionality of sEV-NAMPT, NAMPT expression was suppressed in metastatic MHCC97L and MHCCLM3 cells (NAMPT-KD1 and NAMPT-KD2), with non-targeting stable cells serving as controls (CTL-KD). We observed that a reduction in the cellular level of NAMPT led to a corresponding decrease in the level of NAMPT in isolated sEV. Consistent with our previous findings, the treatment of PLC/PRF/5 and HLE cells with CTL-KD-sEVs resulted in an augmented glycolytic rate and oncogenesis, whereas NAMPT-KD-sEVs were less able to trigger such promoting effects. To determine the specific functions of sEV-NAMPT, we overexpressed NAMPT (NAMPT-SAM1 and NAMPT-SAM3) in HLE cells using an empty vector (CTL-SAM) as a control. Increased expression of cellular NAMPT resulted in an increase in the level of NAMPT in secreted sEV. In agreement with our expectations, treatment of recipient cells with NAMPT-SAM-sEVs resulted in an increase in the glycolytic rate and oncogenesis, whereas such increases were not observed in response to treatment with CTL-SAM-sEVs. To further investigate the impact of sEV-NAMPT in vivo, PLC/PRF/5 cells were subcutaneously injected into immunodeficient mice cotreated with different sEV. Compared with those in the PBS group, the tumors were substantially larger when CTL-sEVs were added. However, this effect was not observed in the mice treated with NAMPT-KD-sEVs. Extrahepatic metastasis to the lung is commonly observed in late-stage HCC and is correlated with poor clinical outcomes. Therefore, we examined the effect of sEV on HCC metastasis. Luciferase-labeled murine p53-/-;Myc hepatoblasts were co-injected with PBS, CTL-KD-sEVs, or NAMPT-KD-sEVs into nude mice, after which the lungs were colonized for two weeks. Notably, lung colonization ability and the number of metastatic lesions were markedly greater in the CTL-KD-sEV treatment group than in the PBS and NAMPT-KD-sEV groups, suggesting that sEV-NAMPT contributes to HCC tumorigenesis and metastasis. Notably, the in vivo oncogenic potential of the sEV was exacerbated when NAMPT was overexpressed. Co-injection of NAMPT-SAM-sEVs also resulted in accelerated tumor development, leading to the formation of larger subcutaneous tumors than those in the PBS and CTL-SAM groups. A similar trend was also observed in the lung colonization model, in which more metastatic lesions were observed in the groups treated with NAMPT-SAM-sEVs. Taken together, these data demonstrated the oncogenic role of sEV-NAMPT in promoting glycolysis and tumorigenesis in HCC. sEV-NAMPT activates the NF-κB transcription factor through toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), leading to elevated SLC27A4 expression. To extend our study further, we analyzed the functional changes in TLR4-KD cells in response to sEV-NAMPT treatment and found similar changes in CTL-KD cells. Notably, reduction in TLR4 levels did not significantly affect the intrinsic cancer properties of PLC/PRF/5 or HLE cells, as evidenced by the negligible differences observed in migration, invasion, and colony formation ability. However, disruption of TLR4 expression consistently impaired the responsiveness of recipient cells to sEV derived from MHCC97L and MHCCLM3 cells. Specifically, the stimulatory effect of NAMPT-SAM-sEVs on the cancerous properties of recipient cells was abolished in TLR4-KD cells. Furthermore, the increase in glycolysis induced by sEV derived from MHCC97L and MHCCLM3 cells was significantly attenuated in TLR4-KD cells compared to that in CTL-KD cells. The insensitivity of TLR4-KD cells to NAMPT-SAM-sEV-induced glycolysis further indicated the reliance of sEV-NAMPT on TLR4 expression. 2. To delineate the mechanism of how sEV-NAMPT activates aerobic glycolysis, increases energy production and induces oxidative stress leading to HCC aggressiveness SLC27A4 functions primarily as a long-chain fatty acid transporter and acyl-CoA synthetase. Increased TG levels enhance lipolysis via hepatic lipase and facilitate the conversion of glycerol-3-P to DHAP, an intermediate that bridges lipid metabolism and glycolysis. This study uncovers a novel regulatory axis involving sEV-NAMPT and SLC27A4 in glycolysis, independent of traditional fatty acid metabolism pathways. SLC27A4 mainly functions as a fatty acid transporter for the trafficking of long-chain fatty acids or as an acyl-CoA synthetase that catalyzes the conversion of unesterified fatty acids to fatty acyl-CoA. Interestingly, our findings showed that the loss of SLC27A4 mainly affected the glycolytic rate but did not result in obvious changes in intracellular fatty acid uptake. To explore how SLC27A4 mediates glycolysis, we performed lipidomic profiling to delineate its underlying mechanisms. Lipidomic and metabolomic analyses revealed a positive correlation between SLC27A4 and intracellular levels of triacylglycerol (TG) and dihydroxyacetone phosphate (DHAP). Detailed lipidomic further showed a drop in all TG molecules in SLC27A4-KD cells. Concurrently, we confirmed the correlation between the TG levels in vivo. In the orthotopic liver implantation model, PLC/PRF/5 SLC27A4-KD cells exhibited a slower tumor growth rate. Histological analysis of tumor tissues revealed that SLC27A4 levels positively correlated with lipid deposition, as demonstrated by enhanced Oil Red O staining. Moreover, lower TG levels were detected in tumor tissues from the SLC27A4-KD group than in those from the CTL-KD group. We investigated the relationship between SLC27A4-mediated increase in TG levels and glycolysis. Metabolomic profiling revealed lower levels of pyruvate and lactate following the reduction in SLC27A4, confirming the involvement of SLC27A4 in glycolysis. In the early stages of glycolysis, glucose is phosphorylated to glucose-6-phosphate (Glu-6-P) by hexokinase and subsequently converted to fructose-6-phosphate (Fru-6-P). Although a reduction in SLC27A4 expression resulted in a decrease in glycolytic end products, we observed that glucose, Glu-6-P, and Fru-6-P levels were independent of SLC27A4 expression. This finding suggests that SLC27A4-mediated glycolysis is not initiated by glucose metabolism. Instead, we observed a significant decrease in DHAP levels upon SLC27A4 knockdown. DHAP serves as an intermediate metabolite that facilitates the transition between glycolysis and lipogenesis. Under normal cellular conditions, a tightly regulated homeostatic balance is maintained among the various metabolic pathways. In HCC, we observed a positive correlation between SLC27A4 expression and TG levels. During lipolysis, TG are broken down into fatty acids and glycerol. Glycerol is then phosphorylated by glycerol kinases to form glycerol-3-phosphate, which can be further oxidized to DHAP, thereby entering glycolysis. Therefore, we postulated that SLC27A4 regulates glycolysis through the TG-induced DHAP transition. Our metabolic profiling supported this hypothesis, as we observed a correlated expression of metabolites beyond the DHAP transition, ranging from DHAP to 3-phosphoglycerid acid (3-P-glyceric acid). Collectively, our findings provide new insights into the role of the sEV-NAMPT/SLC27A4 axis in the regulation of glycolysis. 3. To evaluate the clinical significance of EV-NAMPT as a non-invasive biomarker of HCC The expression of NAMPT was significantly elevated in both 97L-sEV and LM3-sEV and sEV of other cell lines. sEV-NAMPT levels were positively correlated with the metastatic potential of the HCC cells. It is also observed that NAMPT transcription and protein level positively correlated with metastatic potential of HCC cells. We further compared the levels of NAMPT in circulating sEV from non-HCC control subjects to those in patients with HBV, cirrhosis, and HCC. Our clinical data showed that sEV-NAMPT levels were significantly higher in patients with HCC than in controls and in patients with HBV and cirrhosis. After tumor resection, 12 of the 19 patients (approximately 63%) had reduced sEV-NAMPT levels. These data highlight the association between elevated sEV-NAMPT levels and HCC progression, suggesting the diagnostic ability of sEV-NAMPT.

17105721.label: Major findings and research outcome
17105721.value: sEV are critical mediators within the tumor microenvironment (TME) and are known to regulate various metabolic pathways. In metastatic HCC, mass spectrometry protein analysis of HCC-derived sEV (HCC-sEV) identified an upregulation of NAMPT, a key enzyme in maintaining cellular NAD+ levels. Our study demonstrates that sEV-NAMPT enhances glycolysis, tumorigenesis, and metastasis in HCC. Specifically, sEV-NAMPT activates the NF-κB transcription factor through TLR4, leading to elevated SLC27A4 expression. SLC27A4 functions primarily as a long-chain fatty acid transporter and acyl-CoA synthetase. Lipidomic and metabolomic analyses revealed a positive correlation between SLC27A4 and intracellular levels of TG and DHAP. Increased TG levels enhance lipolysis via hepatic lipase and facilitate the conversion of glycerol-3-P to DHAP, an intermediate that bridges lipid metabolism and glycolysis. This study uncovers a novel regulatory axis involving sEV-NAMPT and SLC27A4 in glycolysis, independent of traditional fatty acid metabolism pathways. Clinically, targeting sEV-NAMPT with the inhibitor FK866 significantly inhibited tumor growth in various HCC in vivo models, highlighting the potential of sEV-NAMPT as both a biomarker and therapeutic target in HCC. These findings have been published in Journal of Extracellular Vesicles 2025, 14(4):e70071, and presented at international conferences such as 2024 American Association for Cancer Research Annual Meeting and 2023 Asia Pacific Societies for Extracellular Vesicles Conference.

17105721.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17105721.value: Overexpression of NAMPT is frequently observed in human cancers, highlighting its potential as a promising molecular target. However, none of the existing NAMPT inhibitors have advanced to late-phase clinical trials, partly due to the essential role of NAMPT in normal physiology. Homozygous NAMPT knockout is lethal in adult mice, which may also account for the toxicity and side effects associated with NAMPT inhibition. Additionally, the emerging role of extracellular NAMPT in human diseases poses challenges for inhibitors originally designed to target cellular NAMPT. Our study provides valuable insights into the impact of sEV-NAMPT, which could inform the development of more precise therapeutic strategies. Understanding the distinct roles of sEV-NAMPT may enable optimized delivery routes and dosing regimens, ultimately improving therapeutic outcomes while minimizing adverse effects in cancer treatment. In the context of HCC, patients are often diagnosed at advanced stages when curative options are limited. This underscores the critical need for sensitive and specific biomarkers for early detection. Our findings demonstrate that sEV-NAMPT is overexpressed in early-stage HCC patients and decreases following surgery. These expression patterns suggest that sEV-NAMPT has significant potential as a non-invasive biomarker for early HCC diagnosis and monitoring, which could improve patient prognosis through earlier intervention.

17105721.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17105721.value: Small particles released by tumor cells, called small extracellular vesicles (sEV), play an important role in the tumor environment and help regulate how cancer cells get their energy. In liver cancer that has spread, we found that these particles contain higher levels of an enzyme called NAMPT, which is important for keeping a molecule called NAD+ that cells need to produce energy. Our research shows that this sEV-NAMPT helps cancer cells break down sugars faster, grow more, and spread more easily. It does this by activating a specific pathway inside the cell involving NF-κB transcription factor, which then increases the production of another protein called SLC27A4. This protein helps transport fats into cells and supports energy production. We found that higher levels of SLC27A4 are linked to increased fats and energy-related molecules inside the cancer cells. This process connects fat breakdown and sugar metabolism in a new way, separate from usual fat use pathways. Importantly, blocking NAMPT with a drug called FK866 significantly slowed down tumor growth in animal models, suggesting that targeting sEV-NAMPT could be a promising approach for treating liver cancer.

17106021.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17106021.value: Schizophrenia and bipolar affective disorders (BAD) are chronic mental disorders and among the most disabling diseases worldwide. Despite the advances in medicine and intervention strategies over the last few decades including the implementation of the early intervention services for psychosis providing intensive intervention to patients with first-episode psychosis during the initial 2-3 years of the illness, long-term outcomes are heterogeneous and complete recovery rate remain at around 14-25%. Furthermore, patients with schizophrenia and BAD have shortened life spans compared with healthy controls and both conditions have been suggested as disorders associated with accelerated aging including brain ageing. Therefore, it would be crucial to understand the trajectories of the outcomes and the clinical predictors of the long-term outcomes to identify the gaps of the services and knowledge, and inform the future development of intervention strategies. Leverage on the cohort of first-episode psychosis patients established about 20 years ago as part of the historical control study comparing short-term outcomes of patients with first episode psychosis received the early intervention service and those received standard care service, we propose a 20-year follow-up study of a subset of patients with first-episode schizophrenia spectrum disorders and bipolar affective disorders (N=398). Patients will have clinical interviewed to assess for clinical, social functioning and cognitive functioning. Longitudinal outcomes including hospitalization, relapse, suicidal attempts and medication treatment will be obtained through systematic 20-years clinical record review. Multimodal imaging assessments including structural and brain connectivity, will be conducted in a subset of patients with BAD and schizophrenia (n=110), and matched health control. The study aim to 1) compare long-term clinical, functioning and cognitive outcomes and longitudinal functioning trajectories of patients with schizophrenia and BAD; 2) compare 20-year longitudinal clinical and functional outcomes of patients with schizophrenia-spectrum disorders received early intervention service for psychosis and standard care; 3) compare neurobiological difference between schizophrenia and BAD; 4) explore effect of treatment related factors, particularly long-term medication use, on the neurobiological outcomes within group and between groups; and 5) compare brain ageing of schizophrenia and BAD. Results of the study could be one of the important pieces of evidence informing local and international treatment guidelines of patients with schizophrenia and BAD. The potential improvement of the service and intervention strategies may help to improve the long-term outcomes of patients with these chronic mental conditions. 精神分裂症(Schizophrenia)精神分裂症 (BAD) 乃慢性精神疾病，亦是全球最致殘的疾病之一。儘管在過去的幾十年裏，相關醫學和介入服務都取得了進步，包括實施針對精神分裂症初發患者的早期介入服務，於患者病發的首二至三年內及早介入，然而患者的長遠病情結果不一，整體康復率也只維持在大約百分之十四至二十五。此外，與健康人士相比，精神分裂症及雙相情感障礙的人士壽命較短，這兩種疾病都被認為與加速衰老有關，包括腦老化。因此，了解患者病情的長期演變方向以及相關臨床預測因素對於找出現時服務的不足之處，以及推動未來介入服務的發展尤其重要。我們於二十年前進行了一項歷史對照研究，該研究包括了接受早期介入服務以及標準護理服務的精神分裂症初發患者，並比較他們的短期病況。利用該研究，我們提出以當中一部分精神分裂症譜系初發患者和雙相情感障礙患者 (N=398)為對象，進行為期二十年的追蹤研究。患者將接受臨床訪談，以評估其臨床、社會功能和認知功能。另外，包括住院、復發、自殺企圖和藥物治療在內的縱向結果將系統性通過二十年間的臨床記錄獲得。一部分雙相情感障礙和精神分裂症患者 (n=110)，以及與其匹配的健康人士亦會接受多模態影像評估，研究其大腦結構和連結性。此研究旨在 一) 比較精神分裂症和雙相情感障礙患者的長期臨床、個人功能和認知能力，以及他們個人功能的縱向變化； 二) 縱向比較接受早期介入服務和標準護理服務的精神分裂症患者二十年間的臨床和個人功能結果；三) 比較精神分裂症和雙相情感障礙在神經生物學上的差異；四) 探討與治療相關的因素，特別是長期用藥，在研究組別之內和組別之間所造成的神經生物學上的影響；五) 比較精神分裂症和雙相情感障礙患者的腦老化狀況。此研究的結果可能會為本地以及國際的精神分裂症和雙相情感障礙治療方針提供重要根據。長遠而言，服務和介入策略的改進將有助改善這些慢性精神疾病患者的病情。
