17308321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308321.value: Survival analysis plays a critical role in randomized clinical trials. The Kaplan-Meier estimator is the most popular approach to estimating the survival probability, and the Cox proportional hazards model is frequently used for regression analysis. Correlated survival times often appear in practice, e.g., recurrent events when the event of interest may occur repeatedly over time, as well as progression-free survival and overall survival observed from the same subject. We develop more flexible and robust methods to analyze such complex survival data using the Box-Cox transformation on the nonparametric estimator and concordance-based regression model. Our methods include the Kaplan-Meier estimator as a special case and provide a better fit when the proportional hazards assumption of the Cox model is violated. For social network data, we propose a new triangular concordance metric to cluster social network data based on the Euclidean distances among every three observations. We further develop an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) approach to maximizing the objective function and demonstrate its utility in real data clustering. 生存分析在隨機對照試驗數據分析中至關重要。Kaplan-Meier方法是估計生存概率最常用的方法，而Cox比例風險模型經常用於回歸分析。相互關聯的生存事件常出現在實際數據中，比如針對同一病人的復發事件、無進展生存時間和總體生存時間。為了處理這些復雜的生成分析數據，我們提出更加靈活也更加魯棒的方法。我們的方法在非參數估計上應用Box-Cox變換，並且使用基於一致性度量的回歸模型。Kaplan-Meier估計方法是我們方法的一個特例。而當Cox模型的比例風險假設不滿足的時候，我們的方法可以有更好的回歸表現。並且，我們提出了一個新的基於三個觀測值的歐氏距離的三角一致性度量，用以聚類社交網絡數據。我們更進一步提出了一個交替方向乘子法（alternating direction method of multipliers, ADMM）優化目標函數，同時將該方法應用於現實數據的聚類問題。

17308521.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308521.value: With the project `Using Quantum Geometry for Information Storage' we aim to put on solid footing the existence of quantum degrees of freedom spacetime, by answering a basic question: can information be stored in the degrees of freedom of quantum geometry? While it is widely suspected the answer is in the positive, what has been missing so far for an authoritative argument was a clear link between Quantum Gravity theory and Quantum Information theory. The PI and co-I of the proposal are uniquely positioned between these two worlds and have all the necessary tools to make specific contributions to this open foundational problem. We will carry out interdisciplinary theoretical research at the interface of the two disciplines of Quantum Information and Quantum Gravity, perform a groundbreaking simulation at a world class quantum computing laboratory with photonics, and devise a table--top experimental test of quantum gravity. The project is placed in the context of a recently established collaboration between the Quantum Information and Computation Initiative of The University of Hong Kong and the groups of 1) Renowned physicist Carlo Rovelli, a leading figure in Quantum Gravity, based in Marseille 2) Fabio Sciarrino, who is leading world class quantum photonics laboratories at Rome 3) Pablo Arrighi, who pioneered quantum walks paradigms suitable for a relativistic setting, based in Paris. This project will be of profound impact in fundamental physics and particularly relevant to the information loss paradox of black holes, a focal point of study in gravitational physics and our general understanding of the universe. Our results will in parallel set a milestone that expands our understanding of the computational resources available nature. We aim to convincingly argue that the quantum degrees of freedom of spacetime exist, are a potentially vastly powerful computing resource, and open the way for a first experimental verification. N/A

17308821.value: 非厄米自協方差矩陣的譜分佈

17308821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308821.value: An important task in time series analysis is to check whether a model fit is of good quality. Such diagnostic checking is often achieved by the so-called portmanteau white-noise test. It is really portmanteau and widely used by practitioners. The portmanteau test is based on the knowledge and properties of sample autocovariance matrices. Meanwhile, in Hong Kong’s finance and banking industry, people are routinely using time series analysis with hundreds of stocks, assets or indicators. In this era of “big data”, most of these existing methodologies for the white noise test are challenged by the large number of measured variables (stocks) and indicators. This is leads to the modern and difficult problem of “curse of dimension”. This project aims at developing useful mathematical theory on such sample autocovariance matrices in order to derive new testing methodologies that can be used in big data analysis. Upon completion of the project, new understanding on the general properties of such large sample covariance matrices will be created. Such new knowledge will then be transferred into practical methodology for the analysis of high-dimensional time series analysis. Application areas include genomic data analysis, financial data analysis and network data analysis. 時間序列分析中的一個重要任務是檢查模型擬合的質量好壞。這種模型檢查通常是由常規白噪音測試來完成的。這個測試方法被從業者廣泛使用。 測試的原理基於樣本自協方差矩陣的知識和屬性。同時，在香港的金融和銀行業，人們經常使用對數百隻股票、資產或指標進行時間序列分析。在這種“大數據”時代，測量的變量數目巨大而形成對上述的白噪聲測試方法挑戰。這就導致了現代統計裏面的“維度詛咒”難題。該項目旨在開發有用的樣本自協方差矩陣的數學理論，以便推導出新的可用於大數據分析的測試方法。項目完成後，對此類大樣本協方差矩陣的一般性質會有新的認識。這樣的新知識將被轉化為分析高維時間序列的實用方法， 而應用到基因組數據分析、金融數據分析和網絡數據分析。

17308921.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308921.value: 金屬化合物正處於臨床開發階段，用於診斷和治療各種疾病。目前臨床上使用的金屬類藥物有鉑類或砷類抗癌藥、鉍基抗潰瘍藥和金(I)的抗類風濕藥物等。最近，金屬配合物也被認為是新抗生素的希望來源，並正在積極研究中。事實上，銅合金已被註冊為第一種抑制醫院感染的固體抗菌材料，因為它能夠通過接觸殺死耐甲氧西林金黃色葡萄球菌(MRSA)。銀基材料目前在燒傷傷口治療和生物醫學材料中用作殺菌劑。最近，發現銀（如硝酸銀）可以把抗生素對革蘭氏陰性菌的功效提高 10-1000 倍。而且重要的是，可以在動物模型中恢復對耐藥菌株的抗生素功效。幾個世紀以來，鉍化合物已被用於治療各種疾病，尤其適用於胃腸道疾病的治療。鉍劑是三聯或四聯療法的活性成分，可有效根除幽門螺桿菌(H. pylori)，包括抗生素耐藥菌株。最近，申請人已經證明，鉍類藥物是有效的抗生素佐劑，可以使耐碳青黴烯的大腸桿菌(E. coli)重新敏感，並顯著抑制此類細菌耐藥性的發展。然而，臨床使用的鉍劑本身的抗菌效力較低，這可能是由於其有限的細胞攝取或微生物固有的金屬處置作用。因此，進一步探索新的鉍化合物以增強其抗菌活性的潛力很大。對藥物作用機制的了解有助於合理設計和開發更好的藥物。 通過將 鉍(III)與親脂性天然提取物檜醇絡合，我們發現 鉍(III)托酚酮配合物是一種有效的廣譜抗菌劑，可對抗的革蘭氏陽性和革蘭氏陰性耐藥菌株。基於這一令人興奮的發現，申請人擬用金屬蛋白質組學和蛋白質組學方法揭示其作用機制，並最終為耐藥細菌感染開發更有效的抗菌療法。具體來說，我們將通過我們建立的二維凝膠電泳結合電感耦合等離子體質譜(GE-ICP-MS)金屬蛋白質組學方法在化合物暴露於細菌後系統地跟踪蛋白質組內的鉍結合蛋白。我們還將通過定量蛋白質組學方法同時識別細胞中受鉍(III)調節的蛋白質。然後，我們將對已鑑定的 鉍(III)結合蛋白和受調控蛋白進行功能分類，並通過生物信息學探索鉍相關蛋白的蛋白質 - 蛋白質相互作用網絡，並通過實驗驗證被 鉍(III)中斷的關鍵蛋白質靶標或生物途徑通過生物測定或生物物理、分子生物學方法檢測托酚酮。 我們的預期發現將增進我們對鉍(III)托酚酮作為廣譜抗菌劑的作用機制的理解，以及將基於機制的基本原理應用於開發更有效的耐藥細菌感染療法的潛在益處。

17308921.label: Major findings and research outcome
17308921.value: To combat AMR, repurposing clinically approved drugs has emerged as a cost-effective strategy. Bismuth(III) antibacterial drugs, when combined with antibiotics, have previously been proven to be effective against Helicobacter pylori, including antibiotic-resistant strains. However, bismuth drugs alone exhibit limited antimicrobial activity against a narrow spectrum of pathogens. Therefore, a novel approach to enhance the efficacy and broaden the antimicrobial spectrum of bismuth drugs is urgently necessary. In this GRF project, we screened a panel of chelating ligands and identified a naturally occurring monoterpenoid, hinokitiol (β-thujaplicin) as the most promising compound that could greatly potentiate antibacterial activity of bismuth drugs against a broad-spectrum of Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria. We observe a strong synergy between hinokitiol and colloidal bismuth subcitrate (CBS) against various Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacterial strains, including methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA). Equally important, the combination of hinokitiol and CBS exhibits anti-biofilm activity by prevention of biofilm formation and elimination of S. aureus persister cells. Importantly, we further demonstrate that the combination therapy exhibits promising antimicrobial efficacy in murine infection models including skin wound, gastrointestinal and blood infections. Our mechanistic studies consisting of metalloproteomics and bioassay reveal that hinokitiol enhances Bi(III) uptake and reduces intracellular iron levels. By using thermal proteome profiling combined with dynamic quantitative proteomics analysis, we show that the bismuth-hinokitiol combination propagated the bismuth binding and interfered with ribosome synthesis, the glycolysis process, impaired bacterial cell wall synthesis and pathogenesis in MRSA. We highlight the potential of combinatorial hinokitiol and bismuth drugs in the fight against AMR (RSC Med Chem 2025, Nat Microbiol 2024). Further, we have synthesized a series of hinokitiol analogues and their complexation with Bi(III), The structure-and-activity relationship (SAR) was found and accordingly, better activity was achieved. Moreover, we unexpectedly found that certain hinokitiol analogues exhibit excellent antibacterial and antiviral activities possibly through disruption of intracellular iron or zinc(II) homeostasis, opening a new horizon for further investigation of this class of compounds (J Am Chem Soc 2025, Acc Chem Res 2025).

17308921.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17308921.value: Our exciting in vitro data demonstrated that it is worth investigating the translational potential of the combination therapy and/or the hinokitiol analogues themselves. More pharmacokinetics and toxicity studies are required which may need to seek support through other scheme. Tentatively, we will apply for ITF for more data prior to filing a patent. A proposal partially based the data of this GRF project, was submitted to ITF. We will also seek other possibility to carry on translational study.

17308921.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17308921.value: Antimicrobial resistance has posed a great threat to public health. In this GRF project, we found that hinokitiol could greatly potentiate antibacterial activity of bismuth drugs against a broad-spectrum of Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria. Hinokitiol may mimic siderophore to enhance cellular uptake of Bi(III) to achieve the synergy. Moreover, the combination of hinokitiol and Bi(III) drugs exhibits anti-biofilm activity by prevention of biofilm formation and elimination of S. aureus persister cells. We further demonstrate that the efficacy of the combination therapy in vivo. By integration of proteomics analysis with other bioassay, we show that the bismuth-hinokitiol combination propagated the bismuth binding and interfered with multiple pathways including ribosome synthesis and impaired bacterial cell wall synthesis in bacteria. We have also synthesized a series of hinokitiol analogues and their complexation with Bi(III), and rationalize the structure-and-activity relationship. We highlight the potential of combinatorial hinokitiol and bismuth drugs in the fight against AMR. Our work may have translational potential.

17309021.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309021.value: This project aims to investigating Goos-Hänchen and Imbert-Federov effects for a beam reflected at the interface of topological photonic metamaterials. When a beam of light experiences total internal reflection at an interface, a shift of the beam center usually occurs which arises from the wave nature of light. There are two types of beam shifts: Goos-Hänchen (GH) shift that is in the longitudinal direction (in the incident plane) and Imbert-Fedorov (IF) shift that is in the transverse direction (orthogonal to the incident plane). In recent years, there have been a number of theoretical proposals on using GH and IF shifts of electrons to probe the topological properties of materials in condensed matter physics. However, experimental observation of the beam shifts for electron wave packets is extremely difficult and therefore they have not been experimentally demonstrated. Metamaterials, with artificially engineered atoms, have been realized to exhibit various exotic optical properties for photons such as negative refraction, gigantic chirality and hyperbolic dispersion. There have been tremendous progress in utilizing metamaterials for achieving various topological states for photons, such as Weyl degeneracies, nodal lines and nodal links, 3D Dirac degeneracies etc. These topological metamaterials provide an ideal platform for studying the fundamental physics associated with topological properties and Berry curvatures, which would have been challenging to investigate in electronic systems. In this proposal, we will look into the scattering properties of topological metamaterials with judiciously engineered Berry curvature distributions in the momentum space, and we will focus on the topological signature of GH and IF shifts for an electromagnetic wave reflected off the surface of topological metamaterials. Our proposal will provide a new gateway for investigating the topological properties that go beyond the conventional studies on topological surface states. The new topological effects in this research will greatly impact a number of disciplines including photonics and condensed matter physics. 該項目旨在研究拓撲超構材料界面上反射的光束的Goos-Hänchen和Imbert-Federov效應。當一束光在一個界面上經歷全反射時，通常會發生光束中心的偏移，這是由光的波的性質引起的。光束偏移分兩種類型：Goos-Hänchen（GH）位移是在縱向方向（在入射光平面），Imbert-Fedorov（IF）位移是在橫向方向（與入射光平面正交）。近年來，有許多理論建議利用電子的GH和IF位移來探測凝聚態物理學中材料的拓撲特性。然而，對電子波包的束流偏移進行實驗觀察是非常困難的，因此它們目前還沒有得到實驗證明。超構材料，通過對其人工原子的精心設計，可以用來實現各種奇異的光學特性，如負折射、巨大的手性和雙曲色散關係等等。最近，人們在利用超構材料實現光子的各種拓撲狀態方面取得了巨大的進展，如外爾簡併點、簡併結線和纏繞的簡併結線、三維體系的狄拉克簡併點等。這些拓撲超構材料為研究與拓撲特性和貝里曲率有關的物理現象提供了一個理想的平台。在這個項目中，我們將精心設計超構材料的動量空間中的貝里曲率分佈並研究與其相關的光子散射特性。我們將重點研究從拓撲超材料表面反射的電磁波的GH和IF移動的拓撲特徵。這個項目將為研究拓撲特性提供一個新的途徑，超越了對拓撲表面態的傳統研究。這項研究中的新拓撲效應將對包括光子學和凝聚態物理學在內的許多學科產生影響。

17309021.label: Realisation of objectives
17309021.value: We have achieved all the revised objectives. Specifically, we have studied topological metamaterials at microwave frequencies and investigated the Berry curvature distributions in the momentum space in metamaterials. We also studied various types of topological phenomena including non-abelian Thouless pump, Yang monople under gauge field, Berry dipole under an artificial gauge field etc. The project has produced over 30 papers including Science, Nature Communications, Physical Review Letters etc, all having acknowledged this grant.

17309021.label: Major findings and research outcome
17309021.value: When light strikes a surface, it can shift in specific ways. Two well-known shifts are the Goos-Hänchen shift, which moves light sideways within the plane of the incoming light, and the Imbert-Fedorov shift, which moves it perpendicular to that plane. Light possesses a property called "spin angular momentum," resembling a tiny spinning motion, typically aligned with its direction of travel. This spin can cause light to shift sideways upon hitting a surface, a phenomenon known as the spin Hall effect. Our research revealed a novel type of spin called "transverse-spin" or T-spin, where the spin is oriented sideways, not aligned with the light’s path. This T-spin can occur in certain surface waves or within specially engineered materials called metamaterials. We demonstrated that when light with T-spin hits the edge of a metamaterial, it shifts sideways in a distinct manner, differing from the conventional Goos-Hänchen and Imbert-Fedorov shifts. This shift occurs within the same plane as the incoming light, and its direction depends on the orientation of the T-spin. This newly identified shift is linked to the geometry and motion of the light, providing a novel approach to controlling light-surface interactions, with potential applications in advanced technologies. We have also studied various types of topological metamaterials and in different dimensions including 2D, 3D and 5D. Inhomogeneous metamaterials were designed to exhibit interesting gauge field effects.

17309021.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17309021.value: We will continue to explore topological metamaterials and Berry curvature related phenomena. Potential research directions include the incorporation of nonlinearity, gain and loss, nonciprocal coupling into the metamateiral design.

17309021.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17309021.value: When light hits a surface, it can shift in different ways. Two known shifts are the Goos-Hänchen shift, which moves light sideways in the same plane as the incoming light, and the Imbert-Fedorov shift, which moves it perpendicular to that plane. Light also has a property called "spin angular momentum," like a tiny spinning motion, usually aligned with its travel direction. This spin can cause light to shift sideways when it hits a surface, an effect called the spin Hall effect. Recently, scientists found a new kind of spin called "transverse-spin" or T-spin, where the spin is sideways, not aligned with the light’s path. This T-spin can occur in certain surface waves or in specially designed materials called metamaterials. In this project, we showed that when T-spin light hits a metamaterial’s edge, it shifts sideways in a unique way, different from the Goos-Hänchen and Imbert-Fedorov shifts. This shift stays in the same plane as the incoming light, and its direction depends on the T-spin’s orientation. This new shift is related to the light’s geometry and motion, offering a fresh way to control light-surface interactions, which could lead to new technologies.

17309121.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309121.value: Tengchong volcanic field in Yunnan Province is geologically important, because it sits on the edge of collisions between Indian and Eurasian plates. Previous studies show that there were multiple eruptions in Tengchong volcanic fields. The timing of eruptions indicates crucial information relating to the tectonics and potential geohazards in the region. Dating of old (over a few millions years) ingenious rocks can be achieved by isotopic dating methods, such as Rb-Sr, K-Ar methods. It is not enough for studying the recent activities and eruptions. Radiocarbon and Luminescence dating methods are suitable for young samples. However, radiocarbon is often not applicable, because of lack of suitable materials like organic matters and ages over its dating limit. Luminescence dating includes Thermoluminescence (TL) and optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) dating techniques. Both methods are suitable to date volcanic materials in ages younger than 1 million years beyond C-14 dating limits, providing that the luminescence signals are stable over the age periods. It was reported that the TL signals from plagioclases, commonly found in volcanic rocks, are unstable, known as anomalous fading. But this can be overcome in OSL dating with a pre-treatment of infrared exposures. This study aims to establish protocols of luminescence dating, which can be reliably applied to volcanic materials from Yunnan. The developed techniques can also be used for other volcanic materials with similar mineral compositions of plagioclase, which is also the common minerral found in other planets like Mars and Moon. 因为处于欧亚和印度板块的边缘，云南腾冲火山群在地质研究中尤其重要。以往的研究表明，腾冲火山群曾经多次喷发。喷发的时间揭示了该区域的构造和潜在地质灾害有关的重要信息。对古老的（几百万年以上）火成岩的年代测定可以通过同位素测年方法实现，如Rb-Sr、K-Ar法等。这些方法不能用于最近的活动和喷发。放射性碳和释光测年法是最常用的方法，它们适合年轻样品。然而，由于缺乏合适的材料（如有机碳），放射性碳通常不适用火山年龄测定。或者，火山的年龄超过其最老测年范围。 释光测年包括热释光（TL）和光释光（OSL）测年技术。这两种方法都适用于确定火山岩的年龄小于100万年的材料，前提是发光信号在各个年龄段都是稳定的。据报道，TL斜长石通常存在于火山岩中，其信号不稳定，称为异常衰褪。但是，在OSL测年中，通过预处理红外线释光测定可以解决此问题。本研究旨在建立发光测年的方法，该方法可以可靠地应用于云南的火山物质。而所开发的技术可以可用于其他矿物成分类似的火成岩材料。所用的斜长石，也是在火星和月球等其他行星的常见矿物。

17309121.label: Realisation of objectives
17309121.value: Volcanic eruptions potentially threaten local and global environments, making it crucial to reconstruct their eruption history for risk assessments and forecasts. However, accurately dating of young (e.g., Holocene) volcanoes remains challenging. For example, K-Ar and 40Ar/39Ar dating are potentially problematic due to the long half-lives of radioisotopes, while radiocarbon dating requires organic materials. This study focuses on quartz minerals extracted from lava-baked sediments in the Tengchong volcanic field, southeastern the Tibetan Plateau, using the optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) technique. The results show that samples with initial OSL signals dominated by the fast component yield reliable ages. Conversely, samples dominated by unstable medium and slow components broadly underestimate their OSL ages, requiring corrections. By using the plot of De against recuperation for each aliquot, the underestimated OSL ages can be corrected. The final single-aliquot quartz OSL ages are consistent with single-grain quartz OSL and 14C ages recording the same eruption event, thus validating the reliability of the dating ages. Furthermore, new signals, e.g., photoluminescence, are also important to be used in the research of volcanic geochronology. In recent years, PL of feldspar has been explored for geological dating because it offers a great increase in signal intensity with increasing radiation dose. However, a comprehensive understanding of the PL emission spectra of different types of feldspar minerals remains poorly understood and the uncommonly available instruments have hindered its research. In this study, we investigated PL characteristics (e.g., emission spectra and the dependence of PL emission on irradiation dose) of single-crystal alkali and plagioclase feldspars using a commercial Raman microscope instrument configured to excite samples with 532 and 785 nm lasers. The results show that despite being sample-dependent, 2-3 PL bands peaking at ~2.10 eV (590 nm), 1.75 eV (710 nm), and 1.43 eV (865 nm) under 532 nm laser excitation, and 0-2 peaks ranging from ~1.43 eV (865 nm) to ~1.34 eV (925 nm) under 785 nm laser excitation, are broadly observed. These variations in PL bands may be attributed to subtle differences in chemical composition and crystal structure among the feldspar minerals. The sensitivity of PL emission to irradiation dose varies greatly depending on feldspar types and peak positions. The PL intensities of the peaks at ~1.43 eV (865 nm) are particularly sensitive in K-feldspar, demonstrating their potential applicability for dating applications. Additionally, solar bleaching experiments demonstrate that PL signals of these peaks can be effectively reset by 1.5 hours of solar exposure. The dose-response curves obtained using 860-870 nm PL signals of K-feldspar conform to a relationship of a single saturating exponential function between the signal and irradiation dose. Furthermore, this study demonstrates that a commonly available Raman system can be utilized for PL measurements of single grains. Finally, we applied multiple dating methods on the lava baked profiles to obtain the eruptive ages of Tenchong volcanic field. Combining with previous chronological studies, we conclude that Tengchong volcanoes have erupted at least eight times during the Holocene, occurring at 11.6-11.1, 10.5-10.0, 7.9-7.6, 5.9-5.7, 5.0-4.8, 3.5-2.5, 2.0 ka, and 1609 AD. Despite the current stability of the Tengchong volcanoes, frequent tectonic activities, eruptive history and the presence of active magma chambers suggest the potential for future volcanic eruptions.

17309121.label: Major findings and research outcome
17309121.value: dating and volcanic eruption of Tengchong Volcanic Field. One paper has been published, while other two are still in review. 1. We firstly investigated the quartz OSL properties from a lava-baked sediment layer from the Tengchong volcanic field, southwest China. The results indicated that some apparent ages should be underestimated as the unstable medium component in the initial OSL signal of the lava-baked quartz. However, they can be corrected by 1) fitting the De-t plot, and 2) fitting the De-recuperation plot. The corrected quartz OSL ages agree well with independent MET-pIRIR ages of potassium feldspar and 14C ages. The reliable chronological results suggest that the Dayingshan volcano erupted approximately 41–45 thousand years ago. This research has been published in Quaternary Geochronology this year. 2. We also investigated PL characteristics (e.g., emission spectra and the dependence of PL emission on irradiation dose) of single-crystal alkali and plagioclase feldspars using a commercial Raman microscope instrument configured to excite samples with 532 and 785 nm lasers. The results show that the sensitivity of PL emission to irradiation dose varies greatly depending on feldspar types and peak positions. The PL intensities of the peaks at ~1.43 eV (865 nm) are particularly sensitive in K-feldspar, demonstrating their potential applicability for dating applications. The dose-response curves obtained using 860-870 nm PL signals of K-feldspar conform to a relationship of a single saturating exponential function between the signal and irradiation dose. This research has been under second revision with minor revisions in Radiation Measurements. 3. Combining with previous chronological studies, we conclude that Tengchong volcanoes have erupted at least eight times during the Holocene, occurring at 11.6-11.1, 10.5-10.0, 7.9-7.6, 5.9-5.7, 5.0-4.8, 3.5-2.5, 2.0 ka, and 1609 AD. Despite the current stability of the Tengchong volcanoes, frequent tectonic activities, eruptive history and the presence of active magma chambers suggest the potential for future volcanic eruptions. This research has been under review by Palaeogeography, Palaeoclimatology, Palaeoecology.

In terms of instrumentation, it is crucial to include attachments such as a Raman system for spectroscopy, an irradiator as the irradiation source, a PMT for detecting emissions, and an EMCCD imaging system to ensure comprehensive and high-resolution PL research.

17309221.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17309221.value: 基於可見光活化的光交聯分子應用於絡氨酸蛋白翻譯后修飾的研究

17309221.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309221.value: Proteins represent the major functional molecules in living cells, playing essential roles such as catalysis, transport, and maintenance of structural integrity. Through dynamic yet site-specific attachment and removal of covalent groups, protein post-translational modifications (PTMs) represent a rapid and reversible mechanism in eukaryotic cells and act as molecular switches to cause changes in their stability, localization, and associations with other molecules. This dramatically increases the diversity of protein structures and allows proteins to respond to developmental signals or environmental stimuli. One important source of such stimuli stems from by-products of oxygen metabolism, collectively known as reactive oxygen species (ROS). Physiological levels of ROS function as regulatory mediators in signalling processes through induction of oxidative PTM. However, under oxidative stress where ROS production is aberrant and the antioxidant defence system overwhelmed, irreversible oxidative PTMs can lead to pathological conditions. A major challenge in studying oxidative PTM is to distinguish between physiologically/pathologically relevant modifications and collateral damage. Identification of the binding partners and regulating enzymes of oxidative PTMs is thus essential for uncovering their cellular functions and regulatory mechanisms, and for understanding the crosstalk with other PTMs. Chemical proteomics, combined with photoaffinity labelling, is invaluable in elucidating PTM-mediated protein–protein interactions, as it allows transient and weak interactions to be covalently captured; and minute quantities of protein to be enriched and selectively identified through proteomics approaches. However, currently available photoaffinity tags require activation using ultraviolet irradiation, which damages proteins and induces ROS production. These side effects render this otherwise powerful technology unsuitable for oxidative PTM studies, as they introduce artefacts, confound biological investigations, and lead to erroneous conclusions. We have recently reported a novel fluorogenic photocrosslinker that is activatable with blue light. In this proposal, we wish to further develop this photocrosslinker into a photoaffinity tag suitable for chemical proteomics. Specifically, we aim to produce a photocrosslinker that can be activated with long-wavelength visible light, allowing its use in thicker biological specimens such as tissue samples. We wish to install a latent handle for affinity purification, enabling identification of targets with low abundance. We also endeavour to take advantage of the unique property of visible light photoactivation in the investigation of protein tyrosine nitration, its crosstalk with tyrosine phosphorylation and the implications in redox regulation of phosphotyrosine signalling. Ultimately, by gaining an understanding of these biological processes at a molecular level, we hope to identify new proteins as novel therapeutic targets. 蛋白質作為一種主要的生物大分子，在細胞催化，信號轉導和結構穩定性等方面起著重要作用。 蛋白質翻譯后修飾（PTM）通過特異性的共價結合或者一些功能基團的轉移，在穩定蛋白結構，蛋白定位以及與其他分子的相互作用中發揮著關鍵作用。 同時，蛋白翻譯后修飾引起的蛋白結構多樣性使其能夠參與更多的細胞信號調節來應對外界誘導因數的刺激。 活性氧自由基（ROS）作為生物有氧代謝過程的副產物，是一種重要的外界誘導因數來源。 在正常水準下，氧化作用產生的PTMs可以調節信號轉導過程。 然而，細胞在氧化應激條件下產生的大量ROS會誘導形成不可逆氧化的PTMs， 從而導致一些病理結果。 如何分辨正常條件和病理條件下產生的氧化PTMs以及它們的影響成為當下的主要難題。 因此，鑒定與氧化產生的PTMs相關的結合蛋白和調節酶對這些PTMs在細胞功能，調節機制以及與其他PTMs相互作用的研究中至關重要。化學蛋白組學結合光親和標記的方法具有瞬間性弱共價結合，微量蛋白富集和選擇性識別的應用特點，因而成為研究PTMs介導的蛋白-蛋白相互作用的重要方法。 但是，目前可用的光親和基團需要紫外光照，而這對細胞造成損傷， 並會誘導產生ROS。 這些不足之處可能產生人為的，不確定的甚至不正確的結論，從而極大的限制了該技術在氧化性PTMs研究中的應用。 此前，我們報導了一個可用藍光啟動的螢光光交聯分子。 在本課題中，我們希望進一步開發一個包含光親和性基團的，適用於化學蛋白組學研究的光交聯分子。 具體來講，本課題致力於開發一個可被長波長可見光激發的光交聯分子，來研究相對較厚的，類似於組織樣本的生物樣本。 我們希望通過加入一個新型的親和純化基團來鑒定微量的靶標分子。 通過發揮它可見光啟動的特性，我們希望可以用它來來研究蛋白的絡氨酸硝化和相關的磷酸化通路，從而應用該分子於絡氨酸磷酸化的氧化還原調控。 我們希望通過分子層面的生物過程研究，最終可以發現新的治療靶點。

17500321.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17500321.value: 中國社交媒體對政企問責以及公共健康的作用

17500321.label: Project Objectives
17500321.value: The overall objective of this project is to investigate empirically whether and how social media helps hold governments and firms accountable in the healthcare sector and pharmaceutical industry in China. We will accomplish the following specific objectives. Develop a set of textual mining and classification machine learning techniques that are not only suitable for the current project, but also general enough for other social science studies involving large quantities of textual data obtained from various sorts of media. Estimate the causal effects of social media coverage of medical scandals on local governments’ procurement and regulatory activities. Estimate the causal effects of social media exposure on pharmaceutical firms’ sales and market performance as well as their corporate strategy such as introduction of new products and patent applications. Examine whether social media exposure diminishes the value of political connection of pharmaceutical firms and helps improve corporate accountability.

17500321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17500321.value: In recent years, some influential individuals, technology companies, and government agents have been witnessed to actively manipulate information on social media and turn them in their favor. The accountability-promoting role of the media becomes more questionable, although information flow is more open and diverse. We propose to investigate whether and how social media helps hold governments and firms accountable in the Chinese healthcare sector—a sector in which transparency and accountability are crucial for social welfare, and information flow on social media is relatively free. The proposed project aims to empirically examine the effects of social media on three aspects of accountability: (1) political accountability, (2) corporate accountability, and (3) societal accountability. Correspondingly, we will study (1) how social media coverage of medical scandals and bad drugs affects local governments’ procurement and regulation of public-health-related products; (2) how social media exposure affects the performance and corporate strategy of pharmaceutical firms; and (3) how social media exposure affects the value of political-business connections. A unique advantage of this project is that we have assembled a comprehensive dataset combining media coverage and real outcomes related to healthcare and medical matters in 2010-2018. Most significantly, our social media data are based on more than 13 billion posts published on Sina Weibo (the Chinese equivalent to Twitter). Our methodological innovation will involve a creative combination of causal inference and machine learning. We will employ cutting-edge textual mining techniques to explore specific content and the pattern of narrative of media data. To facilitate the identification of causal effects, we will leverage information shocks due to government policies or technological changes combined with cross-region variation in information flow. This project will contribute to media economics, development economics, health economics, research on Chinese institutions, and big data applications in the social sciences. The project has important policy implications for public health issues in China and other developing countries. Some of our research outcomes could be used to help identify problematic medical products and enforce drug-quality regulation. The project will engage a team of postgraduate and undergraduate students who will learn the scientific principles of big data analysis through processing textual data and practicing machine-learning techniques. Training modules based on our research could be used to enhance the education in economics, computational social science, and data science. 摘要 近年來，一些有影響力的個人、科技公司和政府機構積極地操控社交媒體上的信息以創造對之有利的輿論環境。結果便是，盡管信息環境比以前更加開放和多元化，媒體對社會的監督和問責作用卻深受置疑。在中國的醫療保健行業中，信息透明和問責製度對社會福利至關重要，社交媒體上相關信息的流通也相對自由。在本研究項目中，我們將探索社交媒體是否以及如何在中國醫療保健行業對政府和企業起到監督問責的作用。 本項目旨在從三個方麵，以嚴格科學的實證方法檢驗社交媒體對問責的影響：政府問責、企業問責、以及社會問責。與這三個方麵相對應，我們將研究（1）社交媒體對醫療醜聞和劣質藥品的報道如何影響地方政府對公共衛生產品的采購和監管；（2）社交媒體的曝光如何影響製藥公司的業績和企業戰略；（3）社交媒體如何影響政商關聯的價值。 本項目的一個獨特優勢在於，我們收集了一個相當全麵的數據集，涵蓋了2010至2018年間與醫療保健相關的各種媒體報道及豐富的社會經濟變量。其中最重要的是，我們的社交媒體數據是基於新浪微博上發布的超過130億條帖子采集而成。本研究在方法上，擬創造性地結合因果推斷和機器學習。我們將采用前沿的文本分析方法來探索以及展現媒體數據的具體內容和敘事模式。同時，我們將利用政府政策或技術變革引起的信息衝擊在地區之間的不同強度，來估算驗證社交媒體對政企問責等實際變量的因果關係。 本項目將對媒體經濟學、發展經濟學、健康經濟學、中國製度研究以及社會科學中的大數據應用做出貢獻。本項目對中國和其它發展中國家的公共衛生問題具有重要的政策意義。我們的部分研究成果有助於鑒別醫療市場上的問題產品，並加強藥品質量的監管。本項目將組建研究生和本科生團隊，引導訓練他們通過處理文本數據和練習機器學習的技術，從而更好地掌握大數據分析的基本方法。基於本研究的學術成果，可用於經濟學、計算社會科學、以及數據科學方麵的教育。

17500321.value: 1. Citizen complaints on social media promote government responsiveness and accountability in China. The social media effects intensify where local officials face higher information deficits, lower public trust, stronger inspection pressure, and greater career incentives. 2. Our findings support a visibility-driven top-down pressure mechanism, which enhances government responsiveness at the cost of policy rigidity. 3. 17500321.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17500321.value: This research studies whether social media promotes government accountability in China in the setting of vaccine procurement during 2014–2019. Exploiting an unexpected scandal that induced cross-city variation in complaints about vaccine safety on Weibo (Chinese Twitter), we use difference-in-differences estimation instrumented by celebrity fan bases during early Weibo penetration. Stronger Weibo shocks increase transparent procurement and reallocate purchases toward reputable nonlocal suppliers. Effects intensify where officials face information deficits, lower trust, and stronger inspection pressure. Beyond vaccine procurement, enhanced information-monitoring capacity magnifies government responsiveness to high-visibility sentiment but not verified petitions. Our findings support a visibility-driven top-down pressure mechanism.

17500421.label: Major findings and research outcome
17500421.value: There are two complete research outputs from this project. In the first paper, our study analyzes 6 million civil judgments in China from 2014 to 2018, documenting gender disparities that disfavor female litigants. We investigate the impact of an open justice reform that mandated courts to broadcast legal proceedings live on a centralized online platform. By exploiting variations in its implementation across courts and over time and employing both difference-in-differences and Bartik IV approaches, we find that gender disparities in chances of winning decrease as broadcast intensity increases. Analysis of the textual content of judicial decisions provides further evidence that these changes in judicial outcomes stem from altered judge behaviors (i.e., attention and effort) under enhanced judicial transparency. Our results demonstrate how information technology shapes judges' conduct, underscoring its broader potential to improve accountability in public institutions. In the second study, utilizing 1.57 million judicial judgments from enterprise-to-enterprise litigation between 2014 and 2019 in China, we provide evidence of municipal leaders exerting influence over the courts to favor enterprises connected to them. By leveraging variations in enterprise connections resulting from official turnover, we show that enterprises with connections to party leaders have higher chances of winning in business litigation than unconnected enterprises. We also examine the impact of the staggered rollout of circuit courts, a top-down institutional reform, on cronyism in the courtroom. Our findings show that this reform has effectively reduced the judicial advantage enjoyed by connected enterprises by two-thirds.

17500421.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17500421.value: Potential for Further Development: The research can be expanded in three key directions: Comparative Studies: Examine how judicial transparency reforms affect bias and political influence in other countries, particularly emerging democracies. AI Applications: Develop machine learning tools to detect judicial bias patterns in real-time, creating automated monitoring systems for court administrators. Long-term Tracking: Follow up on reformed courts to assess whether improvements persist or if judges adapt their behavior over time.

17500421.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17500421.value: Imagine if court proceedings were suddenly broadcast online for everyone to see. Would judges behave differently? Our research studied millions of court cases in China to find out. We discovered two important problems in the legal system: female litigants were less likely to win their cases compared to men, and businesses with political connections had unfair advantages in court. These biases undermined justice and public trust. When China required courts to livestream their proceedings online, something remarkable happened. The gender gap in court outcomes shrank significantly—judges became fairer when they knew the public was watching. Similarly, when special circuit courts were introduced to handle business disputes independently, politically connected companies lost much of their unfair advantage. This research matters because it shows how simple technological solutions like livestreaming can make powerful institutions more accountable. Just as body cameras changed police behavior, courtroom transparency changes how judges decide cases. Our findings offer hope for countries struggling with corruption or discrimination in their legal systems. By making justice more visible, we can make it more fair—protecting ordinary citizens from bias and ensuring everyone gets their day in court, regardless of gender or political connections.

17500821.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17500821.value: 绩效薪酬复杂度对工作绩效的影响机制：基于信号理论的视角

17500821.label: Project Objectives
17500821.value: To conceptualize a new construct of performance pay complexity. Performance pay complexity is an important source of variance in performance-for-pay (PFP) programs, but it differs from the commonly studied characteristics of PFP programs, such as incentive intensity (high or low), program type (merit pay or bonus pay), incentive basis (based on individual, team, or firm performance), and performance measure (objective or subjective). It is a new characteristic that describes how employees perceive a compilation of the existing characteristics. To develop a new measure of performance pay complexity. As a new construct, there is no readily available measure of performance pay complexity. Employees are likely to have varying views about how complex their PFP programs are, so we take an employee-centric perspective here to capture employee perceptions of the program complexity. We plan to follow the established steps in scale development and use working adults from a wide range of organizations (recruited from Mturk) to validate this new measure. To test the effects of performance pay complexity. Building on signaling theory, we argue that performance pay complexity hinders employees’ interpretation of organizational signals. We postulate that, due to a lack of signal clarity, observability, and reliability, performance pay complexity should weaken employees’ PFP perceptions and consequently employee outcomes (i.e., lower job performance and extra-role performance as well as higher turnover). We test these effects with a field experiment, which intends to show how an intervention that reduces performance pay complexity influences these employee outcomes. To test a theory-driven model of performance pay complexity. We further argue that the effects of performance pay complexity vary with organizations’ pay communication environments and employees’ preferences of seeking pay information. The effects capture the variance brought by signal senders and signal receivers. Our model thus covers the whole signaling process, in which we investigate how the signal (i.e., complex design of PFP plans), signal sender (i.e., the organization’s pay communication), and signal receivers (i.e., employees’ preferences to seek pay information) work together in shaping employee job outcomes.

17500821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17500821.value: Pay-for-performance is a commonly used management practice to motivate employees for better performance. Academic research rarely questions the link between performance and performance-based pay. This is not surprising, because why do we call it performance-based pay if it is not based on performance? Interestingly, such link seems to be intuitive in management theories but does not necessarily hold in management practices. Based on our experience in the field and research findings from a few large-scale national surveys, there is a trend of organizations making pay-for-performance programs more and more complex: they implement multiple incentive programs simultaneously, reward multiple dimensions of job performance, and apply complex pay formulas and payment methods. The reason behind this trend is that organizations must accommodate various needs and/or constraints in the design and implementation of performance-based pay programs. For example, if organizations want to eliminate uncontrollable external factors that affect employee performance, they need to add more elements to their pay-for-performance programs. The unintended effect of these changes is that the link between performance and performance-based pay is not strong and clear. In this grant proposal, we introduce a new construct called performance pay complexity. Drawing on signaling theory, we theorize that pay-for-performance programs serve as an important carrier of organizational signals. Given the complexity in program types, performance measures, pay formulas, and payment methods, it is often difficult for employees to see the link between their performance and performance-based pay. As a result, performance pay complexity is likely to cloud the signaling process and consequently impair the effects of the pay-for-performance programs. In this project, we (1) provide a clear definition of performance pay complexity, (2) develop a measure of this new construct, (3) test its effects on employee performance, and (4) identify theory-driven boundary conditions. We have already completed a pilot study, in which we analyzed the archival data of a garment factory. We found that when the design of the pay-for-performance program is complex, employees’ performance and performance-based pay are not positively correlated. Such preliminary evidence confirms that performance pay complexity is real, relevant, and consequential. We further propose a scale development study and a field experiment with a control group. The project expects to provide a new theoretical lens through which to view the design of performance-based pay programs and to offer implications about actions that can better guide the practice of designing and implementing these programs. 绩效薪酬是一种常用的激励方式。企业在实践中通常同时采取多种激励方案，奖励多种绩效维度，并且因为多种考量不得不设置日趋复杂的计算规则和给付规则。传统的绩效薪酬研究通常基于动机理论或代理理论中的普遍假设，默认方案中绩效与薪酬是完美挂钩的，员工为了拿到更高的绩效工资而付出相应的努力。但本研究认为在多种项目类型、考核标准、计算规则、给付规则的共同作用下，这种关联性在员工的感知中并不清晰。在高度复杂的管理情境下，尚未有理论与实证研究解答验方案是否能达到预期效果。 本项目首先计划利用线上调研开发新的多维度构念绩效薪酬复杂度，其次在一家大型企业进行干预，用有对照组的田野实验来检验一个基于信号传递理论的研究模型，最后为了更好地指导实践，将开发一个基于客观数据计算的绩效薪酬复杂度指数，帮助企业自测和进行横向对比。本项目将为绩效薪酬方案的设计及实施员工激励提供一个全新的理论视角，并具有很强的实践指导性。

17500821.label: Realisation of objectives
17500821.value: We have successfully completed Objectives 1, 2, 3, and 4. However, we would like to note that despite completing the second objective—developing and validating a survey measure of performance pay complexity on the Mturk platform—this measure was not included in the manuscript. The original plan was to conduct field experiments and then collect survey data in the field setting. Although we initially received verbal consent from the CEO of the manufacturing group, we faced resistance from factory managers who felt that the survey data were too sensitive. Consequently, our manuscript is based solely on archival data from the factory. Nevertheless, we managed to use some naturalistic variations and subgroup matching to establish causality. Despite these difficulties, which also caused project delays, we have finalized the manuscript. The process was challenging, particularly due to the obstacles we faced in data collection and the subsequent decision to use archival data to test our hypothesis. The final model is slightly different from what we initially proposed, but it still focuses on the key idea of uncovering how much organizational incentives have been compromised by performance pay complexity. We are grateful for the generous support from the Research Grants Council (RGC) in making this possible!

17500821.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17500821.value: The primary purpose of pay-for-performance (PFP) systems is to incentivize employees by tying job performance to monetary rewards. However, as a system evolves through interactions between managers and employees, there is a disorganized accumulation of performance pay complexity that might inadvertently obscure the primary purpose of the system. Our paper challenges the implicit assumption in compensation research that adding complexity to PFP systems is essential, or at least inevitable, for system effectiveness. Our paper suggests that there exists a critical threshold beyond which the escalation of complexity will significantly undermine system effectiveness. In a large manufacturing factory, we collaborated with factory managers to assess its existing PFP system and determined that its excessive complexity had compromised the primary purpose of the system. To address this problem, we developed and implemented a “break-and-build” intervention that aimed to reduce performance pay complexity. We found that not only did the link between performance and pay strengthen, but also the job performance of frontline workers significantly improved. Our study underscores the importance of considering performance pay complexity in system design and calls for managerial attentiveness to periodically review and update the system to manage complexity effectively.

17501021.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17501021.value: 消费者评论偏差对质量推测以及点评系统设计的影响

17501021.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17501021.value: Prof Chen, Yuxin Dr Lei, Ying

17501021.label: Project Objectives
17501021.value: To systematically examine the consequence of review bias, caused by consumer self-selection, on consumers’ information acquisition. In light of the rise of consumer review platforms and empirically validated review bias patterns, the first objective of the proposed project will be to systematically examine the effect of review bias, caused by consumer self-selection, on consumers’ information acquisition. Specifically, how does a biased review score affect consumers’ rational expectations of a seller’s quality? Conversely, how do endogenous quality expectations shape the evolution of a seller’s review score through consumer self-selection? To gain a profound understanding of the influence of review bias on a seller’s perceived quality and profits. With consumers’ review writing behavior as a micro foundation, the second objective of the proposed project will be to understand the influence of review bias on the consumer’s perception of the seller’s quality, and its effect on profitability. In particular, under what conditions will a seller experience gain or loss from systematic consumer review bias? The finding of this project will provide new insights and recommendations for sellers on how to manage bias that spreads through word of mouth. To provide guidance on the design of review platforms. The third objective of the project will be to provide guidance on how best to design review systems. We are particularly interested in answering the following questions. Should a review platform tolerate a certain level of review bias, especially when review platforms and listed sellers have misaligned incentives? If so, how can a platform achieve the optimal degree of review bias? To provide guidance to policy makers concerned with market failure caused by information asymmetry between sellers and buyers. Lastly, the project will provide guidance for policy makers who are concerned about market failure caused by information asymmetry between sellers and buyers. Despite the emergence of organic consumer review platforms, consumer self-selection can still cause information asymmetry that is then strategically shaped by the platform’s review system. Our findings help to regulate certain consumer markets in which information transparency is critical.

17501021.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17501021.value: Review platforms such as Yelp, TripAdvisor, and OpenRice are successful thanks to their large number of organic consumer reviews, which effectively resolve information asymmetry in the consumer market. According to Bright Local’s 2019 Consumer Review Survey, 82% of consumers read online reviews for local businesses and 76% trust reviews as much as they do personal recommendations. However, researcy studies have documented an aggregate review bias on almost all review platforms. As consumers are more likely to leave a review when the quality of the experienced product/service deviates significantly from their initial expectation, this self-selection causes consumer review scores to exhibit extremeness by typically following a bimodal or a J-shaped distribution. Prior literature has extensively studied consumers’ motivation for writing reviews and the resulting patterns of consumer reviews. However, we still have limited knowledge of the consequences of review bias on consumers’ information acquisition. Is review bias a real concern to consumers and to a review platform? If an aggregate biased review score is simply a rescaling of the score that reflects a seller’s true quality, rational or experienced consumers should be able to infer the seller’s true quality from the biased review score, making review bias less of an issue. Interestingly, our preliminary analysis shows that consumer bias not only rescales review scores but also, and more importantly, results in sellers of different qualities generating the same scores. The proposed project will theoretically explore four issues, as follows. (1) Consumer Self-Selection. How do consumers use a seller’s review score to form a rational expectation of the seller’s quality, and how does their expectation affect their propensity to leave a review? (2) Review Bias. How does consumer self-selection lead to review bias and, in particular, the pooling of review scores? (3) Influence on Sellers. How do review bias and scores pooling affect sellers that vary in qualities, and how do sellers respond? (4) Review Platform Design. How should a review platform optimally design its review system in light of review bias and scores pooling? The findings will enhance our understanding of the impact of review bias on the “seller–review platform–consumer” ecosystem and provide sellers and review platforms with guidance on how to better manage user generated content. Yelp, TripAdvisor, OpenRice等点评平台因为其大量真实的消费者点评有效解决了消费市场的信息不对称问题而取得了巨大的成功。 根据 Bright Local 的 2019 年消费者评论调查，82% 的消费者会阅读本地企业的网上评论，76% 的消费者对评论的信任度与他们对个人推荐的信任度一样。 然而，最近的研究表明几乎所有评论平台上都存在总体评论偏差。 这是因为当所体验的产品/服务的质量与消费者最初的期望显著偏离时，消费者更有可能留下评论。这种自我选择导致消费者评论分数通常遵循双峰或 J 形极端分布。 已有的文献广泛研究了消费者撰写评论的动机以及由此产生的消费者评论分布。 然而，我们对评论偏差对消费者信息获取的后果的了解仍然有限。 评论偏差对于消费者和评论平台是一个需要解决的问题吗？ 如果存在总体评论偏差的评论分数只是反映卖家真实质量的分数的重新调整，理性的消费者能够从有偏差的评论分数中推断出卖家的真实质量，从而使得评论偏差不是一个问题。 有趣的是，我们的初步分析表明，消费者偏差不仅会重新调整评论分数，而且更重要的是，会导致不同质量的卖家产生相同的分数而导致消费者无法推测卖家质量。 本项目将构建理论上探讨以下四个问题。 (1) 消费者自我选择。 消费者如何通过评论评分来形成对卖家质量的理性预期，而他们的预期又如何对他们评论行为构成影响？ (2) 评论偏差。 消费者自我选择如何导致汇总后的整体评论偏差？特别的，这些偏差如何导致不同质量的卖家产生相同的评论分数？ (3) 对卖家的影响。 评论偏差以及不同质量的卖家产生的相同分数汇总如何对不同质量的卖家造成影响。卖家如何回应？ (4) 点评平台的设计。 在评论偏差以及不同质量卖家产生相同评论分数存在的情况下，点评平台应该如何优化设计其点评系统？ 这些发现将增强我们关于评论偏差对“卖家-点评平台-消费者”生态系统影响的理解，并为卖家和点评平台如何更好地管理用户原创内容提供指导。

17501021.label: Realisation of objectives
17501021.value: Objective 1: The objective is successfully achieved. Through building a novel model which incorporates the review bias induced by consumers self-selection in their review behavior, we were able to characterize consumer behavior, firm behavior, and thoroughly examine the implication on market price and the communication of firm's quality information. Objective 2: The objective is successfully achieved. Our analysis unveils the dual roles a review system plays in conveying quality information: In addition to directly communicate the quality information through customer reviews, the selection bias enables a review system to engage a seller in price signaling to reveal its quality. Therefore, complementing to existing studies which mostly focus on price functioning as a tool to influence reviews and increase demands, we demonstrate that price itself can also play dual roles in the presence of customer reviews as it may serve as a quality signal. The dual roles interplayed by customer reviews and price are robustness in several design variants of a review system commonly seen in practices. Our analysis thus shows how a seller may optimally manage the interactions of the dual roles of price and customer reviews in communicating its quality to consumers. Objective 3: The objective is successfully achieved. Regarding the design of a review system, we find that the selection bias per se shouldn't concern a seller who aspires to convey its high quality to consumers, as the existence of a review system enables the seller to use the price as another lever to convey the quality information. Moreover, for a review platform which strives to grow the consumer base, combating the selection bias in customer reviews may be counterproductive, as doing so will not necessarily improve the information communication but may hurt consumer welfare. Objective 4: The objective is successfully achieved. From the regulation's point of view, we find that as the propensity of selection bias increases (i.e., as $\lambda$ gets larger), the surplus from trade transfers from sellers to consumers. Our results also imply that the popularity of third party price trackers such as CamelCamelCamel can motivate sellers' price signaling and improve consumers' surplus.

17501021.label: Major findings and research outcome
17501021.value: This study focuses on a context where consumers make one-time purchase of an experience good and rely on potentially biased reviews to resolve the uncertainty in product quality, and study how a seller conveys its quality information through customer reviews and/or its product's price. The analysis unveils the dual roles a review system plays in conveying quality information: In addition to directly communicate the quality information through customer reviews, the selection bias enables a review system to engage a seller in price signaling to reveal its quality. Therefore, complementing to existing studies which mostly focus on price functioning as a tool to influence reviews and increase demands, this study demonstrates that price itself can also play dual roles in the presence of customer reviews as it may serve as a quality signal. The dual roles interplayed by customer reviews and price are robustness in several design variants of a review system commonly seen in practices. The thus shows how a seller may optimally manage the interactions of the dual roles of price and customer reviews in communicating its quality to consumers. Regarding consumer welfare, contrary to the previous predictions that consumer surplus suffers from the selection bias in reviews, this study finds that consumers may actually benefit from the selection bias of reviews through enjoying a lower price resulted from price signaling without suffering any information loss on product quality. The study also considers consumers' risk aversion. In this case, not only a review system improves total social welfare compared to when the system is absent, but also the selection bias in reviews further improves total social welfare by mitigating information uncertainty both before and after customer reviews are generated. Furthermore, the incremental welfare brought by the review system can be split between consumer surplus and seller profits, resulting in a win-win situation for both consumers and the seller. The findings generate important implications for firms. For example, the selection bias per se shouldn't concern a seller who aspires to convey its high quality to consumers, as the existence of a review system enables the seller to use the price as another lever to convey the quality information. For a review platform which strives to grow the consumer base, combating the selection bias in customer reviews may be counterproductive. We also show that the popularity of third party price trackers scan motivate sellers' price signaling and improve consumers' surplus.

17501021.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17501021.value: This study serves as a starting point for further exploring several interesting issues. First, the goal of the study is to examine the dual roles interplayed by customer reviews and price under selection bias of reviews. The study does not explicitly model a review platform and its objectives. In light of the findings, further work can focus on a platform's perspective, explicitly distinguish a platform's business models (e.g., charging commission fees from sellers, or monetizing consumer attention through charging advertisers, or both), and accordingly further explore a platform's strategies of managing the dual roles of a review system. Second, the selection bias this study focuses on refers to the situation that consumers who make purchases, depending on their post purchase experiences and the product price, may not always leave reviews. The literature has also identified other types of selection bias, such as the "acquisition bias" in that consumers who make purchases may have predisposition favorable towards the product and therefore their opinion reflected in the reviews can be biased. Further research can examine the interplay of customer reviews and price in such a context. Last but not least, empirical work that investigate this topic with field data is called for.

17501021.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17501021.value: Customer reviews help communicate product information, but their effectiveness may suffer from selection bias, i.e., depending on factors such as the individual experience and price, not all consumers may voluntarily write reviews. Consequently, a seller may have to resort to additional means, e.g., signaling through price in the context of an experience good, to convey its quality. This paper develops an analytical model to investigate the interaction of customer reviews and price with the presence of selection bias in marketing an experience good with uncertain quality to consumers. Our analysis reveals the dual roles played by both customer reviews and price in communicating quality information. On one hand, customer reviews may either directly convey product information with unbiased distribution of reviews or facilitate price signaling when reviews are biased due to selection. On the other hand, price may be adjusted to mitigate the selection bias of reviews to make them more informative and it may also signal quality directly in the presence of review bias. As a result, we show that bias in reviews may actually benefit consumers without compromising information communication, as the incentive to reduce review selection bias makes it credible and profitable for the high-quality seller to signal its type by undercutting the price would be set if it is of low-quality. We then extend our analysis to examine the information, profits, and welfare impacts of several important design elements of a review system, as well as the impact of consumers' aversion to risk. Finally, the implications of our findings on the management of user generated content and pricing are discussed.

17501221.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17501221.value: 創新是知識經濟中最重要的資產。在世界由舊工業經濟向新的知識經濟轉型的過程中，培育創新的能力至關重要。然而，人們普遍認為在自由市場中很難為創新融資（Arrow，1972）。知識具有非競爭性和非排他性，並可以以零邊際成本被復製。如果一位企業家的某個創新想法能被輕易複製，那麼該企業家則可能很難將該想法轉換為經濟利益。知識產權僅部分解決了這個問題。由於投資者對技術過時（Aghion and Howitt，1992）、管理短視（Ederer & Manso，2013；Manso，2011； Tian & Wang, 2014)、以及投資者與企業家之間信息不對稱（Arrow，1972）等因素的擔心，許多有益於社會的項目無法得到投資。 世界各國政府普遍認為應該針對這些市場失靈和摩擦採取行動。例如，從 1995 年到 2008 年，每年從美國政府得到創新資助的公司均多於通過私人風險投資基金融資的公司（見圖 1）；僅在 2015 年，中國的政府引導基金就投資超2,310 億美元用於政府資助的風險投資（Lerner, 2020）。儘管如此，這些政府對於創新的資助程度是否已達最優仍然難以確定。政府是否應該加大對於創新的資助力度，亦或他們已經對於創新過度投資仍是一個有待解答的問題。 在這個項目中，我們希望建立一個模型來研究當創新活動受到以下兩種不確定性的影響時政府創新資助（相對於市場創新投資）的最優比例：一、項目是否會成功； 二、項目是否會有市場需求。前者來源於技術的不確定性，而後者來源於偏好的不確定性。技術的不確定性導致信息摩擦，而我們認為政府在克服信息摩擦方面具有比較優勢。另一方面，我們認為當項目不確定性是由偏好引起時，市場在投資該項目方面具有比較優勢。 我們的模型基於以下觀點：創新行為的價值創造很大程度上不僅來源於對新事物的生產，也取決於人們對於該新事物的需求。我們將研究政府和市場投資者如何合作以實現有價值的創新。例如，Apple革命性的產品iPhone中各部件使用到的技術主要由政府研究機構資助研發（見圖 2）。而Apple自身的創新在於設計出將組件組合在一起並生產出對人們最有價值的產品的方式。

17501321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17501321.value: In the recent years the share pledges have emerged as a popular choice for corporate insiders to borrow money. Using their stock holdings as the collateral to avail the loans, corporate insiders (i.e., the pledgers) can obtain funds without selling their stocks in the open market. As a result, insiders’ private information may not be conveyed to the public through the traditional channel of corporate insider trading. It follows a natural question whether insiders’ share pledges provide an information advantage to selected investors who have privileged information access in the share-pledging business. Given the prevalence of brokerage firms being the pledgees (i.e., the lenders of the pledged loans), the empirical evidence would shed light on the brokerage firms’ information acquisition through their share-pledging business. The extant research has shown the impacts of share pledges on the borrowers’ risk preference and hence the pledging firm’s risk-taking (e.g., Dou, Masulis and Zein 2019; Pang and Wang 2020). In this study, we take the lenders’ view by utilizing the mandatory disclosures of share-pledging transactions in China that provide the names of loan lenders and the unique data of brokerage fees paid by Chinese mutual funds. Specifically, we examine the information advantage possessed by those mutual funds connecting to the brokers involving in the share pledges. As required by China Securities Regulatory Committees (CSRC), Chinese listed firms disclose major shareholders’ share pledges within two trading days, allowing the identification of mutual funds which pay for the brokers’ service over the trading periods when the share pledges take place. We expect that the brokers acquire and disseminate two types of private information in their networks. First, the share-pledging business is a unique source of information concerning the wealth and risk preference of a firm’s major shareholders. Second, the borrowers might provide firm-specific private information about the pledging firms’ fundamentals to reduce lenders’ uncertainty about the quality of the pledged assets and to negotiate for better loan terms. Therefore, we hypothesize that connected funds have an information advantage over other funds in trading on the stocks of the pledging firms. Next, we examine whether the information advantage for connected funds varies with the characteristics of the loans, the funds and the pledging firms. These characteristics are posited to affect the quality of the information acquired in due diligence and the relative usefulness of the disseminated information for connected funds.

17501321.label: Realisation of objectives
17501321.value: In this GRF project, we have realized all the research objectives by documenting the empirical evidence supportive of the informational role of brokerage house’s share-pledging business. We will highlight the specific research objectives when describing the respective findings of our paper in the following paragraphs. This study aims to investigate the role of share-pledging business in conveying corporate insiders' private information to the selected investors. By pledging shares for loans, shareholders can borrow money without selling their shares in the open market. Extant research has shown that share pledging alters corporate insiders’ risk preference and financial reporting incentives, influences corporate risk-taking and investment decisions and eventually has an impact on firm value. In this study, we examine the impact of share pledging from a lender’s point of view. As such, we posit that share pledging is an information event wherein the lenders of pledged loans, brokerage houses in particular, acquire private information from corporate insiders and disseminate such information to their fund clients. Accordingly, we examine whether mutual funds that are affiliated with the lending brokerage houses (i.e., connected funds) obtain a privileged access to information about the future performance of the listed firms. Therefore, the findings of this study can potentially shed light on the information flows from one business unit to another unit within the brokerage firms. Our findings also extend the understanding of the information advantage obtained by mutual funds from their trading commission business with the brokerage houses. For the purpose of this research, we utilize the regulation of the mandatory disclosure of major shareholders’ share pledging in China. Specifically, Chinese listed firms are mandated to make a public announcement within two business days after the completion of share pledging transactions by the major shareholders. This mandatory announcement provides a unique source of data for the names of the lending institutions. As such, we are able to identify the lending brokerage houses for all the share pledging agreements. This Chinese setting has another advantage. In China, mutual funds are required to disclose their payments of trading commission fees to individual brokerage houses in the semi-annual fund reports. Some prior studies have utilized this unique dataset of trading commission fees to identify the connection between fund companies and brokerage houses (Firth, Lin, Liu, and Xuan 2013; Gu, Li, and Yang 2013). By combining this dataset with the data of share pledging transactions, we are able to identify the connected funds for this study as those funds that hold the shares of a listed firm and have purchased the trading services from the brokerage house engaged in the pledging of this listed firm’s shares during a semi-annual holding period. Our analysis is based on the changes in the semi-annual fund holdings of the listed firms with share pledging transactions announced in the semi-annual periods over 2013-2019. Our sample consists of 436,138 fund holding changes that are pertinent to 2,007 unique listed firms with their major shareholders pledging shares for 30,040 loan agreements engaged by brokerage houses. The sample period starts at the year of 2013 when brokerage firms are permitted to engage in share pledging business. Out of the whole sample, 35.0 percent are identified as the holding changes of connected funds. Consistent with our prediction, connected funds’ holding changes are more positively correlated with future stock performance of the listed firms of pledged shares than non-connected funds. The main findings are robust to controlling for time-, fund- and firm-fixed effects and other variables shown to affect funds’ trading in prior literature. Using the adjacent semi-annual periods as the pseudo pledging periods, we find that connected funds have an information advantage only in the event periods with the occurrence of share pledging transactions but not in other semi-annual periods surrounding the event periods. In one additional analysis, we construct a small sample of funds that establish their connection to lending brokerage houses through the mergers and acquisitions (M&A) of brokerage firms in the event periods. Using other non-connected funds’ holding changes as the control group, we show that the trading of these newly-connected funds have the similar predictability of future firm performance as that of non-connected funds in the period right prior to the event period. This empirical evidence supports our argument that the information advantage for connected funds stems from their connection with the lending brokerage houses which collect private information through share pledging and disseminate such information to fund clients (Project objectives #1, #2 and #4 of the GRF proposal). In the additional analyses, we find a greater information advantage for connected funds when the share pledging transactions involve with higher market values of pledged shares, with the pledgers being top executives of the listed firms, and with the large shareholders of the listed firms being more likely to engage in self-dealing behaviors (Project objectives #1 and #3). The effect also varies with the broker-fund client relationship. The information advantage of connected funds is more salient when these funds pay higher commission fees and have a longer brokerage relationship with the lending brokerage houses. In addition, connected funds have a greater information advantage when the listed firms are followed by in-house analysts of the lending brokerage houses. Overall, these findings suggest that brokerage firms are more willing to share private information with their fund clients of economic importance and that the information dissemination is more effective when supported by in-house analysts’ expertise (Project objectives #1 and #4). Furthermore, the value of the private information varies with how well such information extends fund managers’ understanding of firm operation. We find that connected funds have a more prominent information advantage over non-connected funds when listed firms operate in diversified business lines, are located farther from funds, and have more intangible assets (Project objective #3). Collectively, our paper (working paper, conference paper and journal publication) help to realize all the objectives of our GRF proposal to a great extent.

17501321.label: Major findings and research outcome
17501321.value: We successfully developed a well-shaped paper from the funding of this GRF project. The paper is titled “Information Diffusion along the Fund-Broker Relationship around Share Pledging.” We submitted our paper to Journal of Accounting and Economics JAE, one of the top accounting journals. I am the corresponding author of this manuscript. Although we received a rejection letter, the editor and reviewers provided us with very valuable suggestions. We have made significant revisions based on their feedback and will soon submit it to another top journal. For reference, the JAE version of our paper is attached to this report as “under preparation” paper in Part C: Research Output. The editor’s letter of decision is also in the attached file for your reference. In this study, we investigate the role of share-pledging business in creating the information collecting opportunities for brokerage houses that engage in the pledge loans. Corporate insiders often pledge their shares as collateral for loans that are funded by brokerage houses. By making loans to corporate insiders, a brokerage house can extrapolate inside information about the future performance of listed firms and disseminate it to the fund clients of brokerage services (hereafter, connected funds). Using the mandatory disclosures of the lending institutions of pledged loans and the disclosures of trading commission fees paid by funds to brokerage houses in China’s stock market, we identify the connected funds for the newly-announced share pledging transactions and find that connected funds’ trading is more positively correlated with future firm performance than that of non-connected funds. This information advantage varies with various factors that pertain to the effectiveness of information acquisition in due diligence, brokers’ willingness to disseminate private information, and the usefulness of the disseminated information for funds’ trading. Collectively, this study demonstrates the role of major shareholders’ share pledging in shaping firm’s information environment and extends our understanding of one potential mechanism through which institutional investors become informed. Besides the paper pertinent to goal of this GRF proposal, we also developed a dataset of the shareholdings and compensation structure of the top executives of Chinese listed firms. This dataset helps with the PhD training at HKU Business School. Specifically, my PhD student, Mr. Kong Xiangnian, who graduated in June 2024, has utilized the dataset in his thesis of Chinese IPOs and SEOs which relates to the incentives of firms’ top executives for ESG-related inspection. Please see the “Students Trained” in Part C of this report.

17501321.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17501321.value: There are two direct ways to extend this research. First, it is an insightful topic whether the share-pledging business of brokerage houses affects the forecasts of in-house analysts; if yes, in what way these in-house analysts make forecasts to facilitate the share-pledging business. Accordingly, we propose to collect all the in-house analysts’ employment status, prior experience and the history of earnings forecasts for share-pledging firms and control firms. Second, Regulators have recently issued a series of measures aimed to mitigate the risk embedded in stock pledges. In January 2019, the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges released the "Notice on Matters Related to Stock Pledge Repurchase Transactions," which clarified regulations regarding extensions of defaulted stock pledge contracts and the introduction of new stock pledge repurchase activities. In April 2020, the exchanges lowered the threshold for transfer via agreement to facilitate the resolution of stock pledge risks through such transfers. Brokerages certainly prioritize the safety of their own funds; As such, we can make use of these newly-issued regulations to verify the brokerage houses’ risk control over the pledged shares and document the changes in their choice of firms to conduct the share-pledging business.

17501321.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17501321.value: This study examines how share pledging affects the informativeness of fund trading. We utilize the mandatory disclosure of the lending institutions of pledged loans in China to identify the share pledging transactions engaged by brokerage houses. Using Chinese mutual funds’ payments of trading commission fees to identify the fund-broker connection (i.e., connected funds), we find that connected funds’ fund holding changes are more positively correlated with the focal firms’ future firm performance than other non-connected firms. The effect is more prominent when brokerage firms are engaged in pledged loans of greater amount, loans for top corporate executives, and loans for listed firms with weaker governance. Moreover, connected funds’ information advantage is more prominent for those lending brokerage houses that receive higher commission fees from the connected funds, have served the connected funds for a longer period of time, and deploy in-house analysts to follow the firms of pledged shares. Overall, this study contributes to the literature on broker tipping by documenting that brokerage houses’ share pledging business plays a role in the dissemination of major shareholders’ private information into the capital market. Therefore, the prevalent share pledging transactions by major shareholders can potentially shape firms’ information environment.
