17600721.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17600721.value: South Korea’s protest movements of the 1970s and 1980s have long received widespread scholarly and popular attention because of the resultant liberalization of the country’s social and political systems. The published literature often notes that Korean Protestant organizations, missionaries, and international Protestant communities provided spaces for these movements, especially during the repressive 1970s. Yet the origin and nature of the partnerships that existed between Korean and non-Korean Protestant actors remain poorly understood. The reason for this knowledge gap is that scholars have emphasized Korean agency and events that took place within the borders of the Korean Peninsula. Consequently, little attention has been paid to the institutional history and internal decision-making processes that, as they unfolded outside the country, motivated numerous international Protestant communities to take action in Korea. This project will historicize the development of the transnational networks that connected Korean and non-Korean Protestant organizations. Building on the work of Dianne Kirby and others who have stressed that the Cold War was also a “religious war,” this work will investigate how the outbreak of the Korean War and the coalescing of the Cold War informed the actions of Western Protestant leaders who sought to become involved in Korea. The Korean War catalyzed a transformation of Protestantism both in Korea and beyond. It created a humanitarian crisis that, from the perspective of Protestant leaders, needed to be addressed to prevent impoverished Koreans from falling prey to communist propaganda. At the same time, the war challenged the movement towards Protestant ecumenical cooperation. One question that concerned the leaders of the ecumenical movement was how to interact with churches that had been established by mission societies in non-Western countries like Korea. Though missionaries had long espoused the ideal of equality between them and their converts, racism and structural inequalities persisted. My project will examine how Protestant leaders addressed these inequalities while navigating the complexities of the Cold War. Viewed broadly, this work speaks to a growing scholarly awareness of the roles religions have played in the formation of “global civil societies.” The Korean War caused Western Protestant leaders to shift their attention from Europe to Korea. The resulting networks of cooperation played pivotal roles in South Korea’s protest movements of the 1970s and 1980s. These networks, moreover, are still active. Thus, in analyzing the history of Korean Protestantism from a global perspective, this work sheds light on both the past and the present.

17601021.label: Project Objectives
17601021.value: To analyse the remaking of the Chinese state amidst urban development in Lhasa. Economic development in Tibet has long been characterised as a dependency economy, driven primarily by massive financial subsidy from the Chinese Central Government and provinces in China Proper. While state aid has subsidised different economic sectors and infrastructure development, existing evidence implied that market efficiency has not been a key consideration (Fischer, 2014). However, by investing directly in land development and urban expansion, the local state in Lhasa is making a transition to more entrepreneurial, profit-driven approaches of using aid money, by activating the latent value of land, creating a land market, and catalysing market-based transactions to dilute the centrality of state allocations. Meanwhile, during our pilot study in 2019, local officials suggested that urban development has cultivated market-based identities and relations, which are “de-radicalised” and easier to govern than traditional ethnic and cultural identities. This marks a new modality of state-building and nation-building in Tibet. The two urban mega-projects exemplify these processes of state transformation. In unpacking how different rationalities of the state unfold in concrete practices of urban development, this project will enrich our understandings of the geo-historical specificities of the Chinese state in Tibet and Lhasa, which now derives much of its competency, institutional identity and political authority from situated urban processes. This investigation will also complement existing scholarships on state power in urban development, which have hitherto paid limited attention to how diverse state rationalities constitute, reinforce or constrain each other. To examine heterogeneous spatial formations caused by urbanisation, and the dialectical relationships between spaces and people’s lived experiences and practices. Large-scale land development in the two case study sites has given rise to heterogenous spatial fabrics. Amidst emerging industrial, consumption and residential spaces, there are resettled communities, urban villages and informal spaces. Meanwhile, distinctions between the urban and rural have been obscured by population mobilities and functional ties between urbanised areas and rural hinterlands. This project will systematically unpack these spatial changes, as well as the dialectical relationships between spaces and new lived experiences, social relations and cultural practices. While existing studies have interrogated stereotypical spatial forms in Global South cities such as spectacular and “worlded” spaces, urban villages, slums and the desakota, this project goes one step further to highlight heterogeneous spatial practices that crisscross the boundaries between the modern and pre-modern, formal and informal, urban and rural, and how they contribute to contingent and ambivalent experiences and identities as newmade urban citizens. To understand Tibetans’ agency and aptitude in negotiating urban changes and reconfiguring ethnic identity. The two case study sites witness a series of new conditions for Tibetans to negotiate: (1) the ascendancy of market-based economic activities that urges Tibetans to refashion cultural ideas, values and everyday practices; (2) deepening interactions among local Tibetans, Tibetan migrants from rural regions, and Han migrants; and (3) emerging socio-spatial fragmentations that creates new challenges for Tibetans to maintain community and cultural identity. Vis-à-vis the privileged positions of Han both in political and economic terms, how do urban changes create new challenges and vulnerabilities, but also opportunities and possibilities for Tibetans? How do Tibetans engage with the state-market coalition, which attempts to turn them into market-savvy and entrepreneurial subjects? How do they harness situated opportunities to secure livelihoods and negotiate uncertainty? How do they reconfigure social relations with different groups of people? How do they preserve ethnic identity, and perform contingent, situated and reinvented conceptions of being Tibetan? Answering these questions will not only foreground Tibetans’ everyday agency, but also enrich literatures on Global South urbanisms that highlight ordinary people’s aptitude vis-à-vis socio-spatial changes. To enrich knowledge on urban and regional development in China’s peripheral regions in general and Tibet in particular. Furthering the existing studies on recent urban and regional development in peripheral China in general and Tibet in particular, this project aims to illustrate a state-space-urban aptitude framework that has a series of advantages. First, this framework is sensitive to the multiplicity and specificity of state rationalities (modernist developmentalism, urban entrepreneurialism, citizenship, state-building, etc.) in ethnic frontier regions, and the mutual constitution among different rationalities. Second, in highlighting heterogeneity of urban spaces, this framework emphasises the nexus of space, society and culture, and the mundane practices of people for navigating across different socio-cultural worlds. Finally, the emphasis on agency and aptitude enables scholars to develop more relational and praxis-based conceptions of cultural identity and belonging, beyond Tibetanness as a pre-given category with unambiguous meanings.

17601021.value: 曾經被浪漫化為農牧文化的西藏，如今正在經歷著一場城市革命。從政治上講，城市化本質上是一項國家工程，它將對於經濟發展的幹預視為治理民族身份和促進國家建設的關鍵手段。在經濟上，越來越多的藏族人參與到資本和市場經濟活動之中，社會脆弱性和邊緣性呈現出新的格局。傳統社區的社會空間結構正在被新的空間結構取代或動搖，漢族和藏族移民的湧入加劇了社會空間的碎片化，給藏族人維系社會網絡和文化身份帶來了新的挑戰。如果沒有一個明確的空間和城市維度的理論化和實證研究，對理解西藏的轉型將是相當不完整的。 在這種背景下，這個為期36個月的項目將考察西藏自治區首府拉薩的兩個大型城市項目。項目的背景放置在2008年西藏的動蕩之後，而這一期間依賴國家補貼的經濟發展是國家管治戰略的核心。本項目將采用多種研究方法，包括檔案研究、自然語言處理、基於GIS和遙感的建模、問卷調查、深度訪談和參與式觀察，系統地理解國家與市場的結盟、政治管治、日常生計以及社會文化生活的新模式是如何通過城市和空間過程而形成的。 在理論層面，本項目遵循城市研究的新興範式，特別是“普通城市概念”和全球南方城市主義，並強調了城市體驗的語境性、情境性和異質性。它描繪了一套由三個維度組成的分析框架：國家權力的展演，城市空間的生產，以及個體在協商城市轉型中的日常生活能動性。通過對三個維度的研究，本項目旨在重新思考、修正和創新城市研究中已建立的概念和理論範式。 在實證層面上，本項目將為中國邊疆地區的城市化研究提供新的見解，綜合考慮到國家理性的多樣性、社會空間結構的紛繁復雜的變化，以及個體應對轉型的能動性。同時，本項目聚焦於國家權力的生產、生計的重構、社會關系的協商和文化身份再發明的過程與實踐，將有助於更新關於西藏和拉薩近期的社會轉型的知識。在學術界之外，本項目能夠為政策的製定者、非政府組織以及一些對西藏議題感興趣的人（包括許多香港人士）提供一些見解。

17601221.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17601221.value: Like many coastal cities, Hong Kong is vulnerable to the future impacts of climate change (Kim et al. 2020). While there is a scientific consensus on the need to mitigate and adapt to climate change, there is relatively little concern among the general public as the major impacts of climate change will only become salient in the future (Lo 2016). This is important as low risk perceptions negatively influence individual and institutional responses to climate change (Dilling et al. 2015). To increase risk perceptions of climate change, studies suggest that we can use extreme weather (e.g. tropical cyclones, flooding, heatwaves, drought) as focusing events to communicate the risks of climate change (Larcom et al. 2019). This is premised on a hypothesised process where experiencing an extreme weather event increases risk perceptions of climate change through Bayesian updating (Deryugina 2013). In recent reviews of the empirical literature, Howe et al. (2019) and Reser and Bradley (2020) find that we have been unable to systematically validate this process due to two significant methodological challenges. First, the nature of extreme weather events means that we cannot randomly assign individuals to experience an extreme weather event. This means that we are unable to use randomisation as an identification strategy to isolate the effect of experiencing an extreme weather event on risk perceptions. Second, individuals may not associate current extreme weather events with climate change as many of the major impacts of climate change will only become salient in the future. We offer a novel approach that obviates existing methodological challenges to examine if we can use extreme weather events to communicate the risks of climate change. Specifically, we will leverage recent advances in virtual reality, where there is a growing literature showing that individuals internalise well-designed virtual experiences as if they were real (Markowitz et al. 2018). We will run a laboratory experiment with random assignment of a treatment, which will consist of an Immersive Virtual Environment (IVE) simulation of a future extreme weather event in Hong Kong that is a clear manifestation of climate change. Using randomisation as an identification strategy, we will isolate the treatment effect within the controlled environment of a social science laboratory setting. By using a novel methodological approach, our study will make a substantial contribution to the literature and inform climate change risk communication strategies both in Hong Kong and abroad. 香港跟很多沿海城市一樣面臨氣候變化的威脅 (Kim el al. 2020)。儘管科學上普遍認為需要減輕和適應氣候轉變，由於其影響長遠才會浮現，所以普羅大眾則予以較少關注 (Lo 2016)。但大眾的關注同樣重要，因為較低的風險知覺會對個人和制度對氣候變化的反應產生負面影響。對於加強風險知覺，從前的研究建議聚焦於極端天氣 (例如熱帶氣旋、洪水、熱浪、乾旱) 用以傳達氣候變化的風險 (Larcom et al. 2019) 。但這論點建基於一個假設性的過程，即經歷極端天氣事件會透過貝葉斯更新增加風險知覺 (Deryugina 2013)。在近期對於實證文獻的回顧中，Howe et al. (2019) 和 Reser and Bradley (2020) 注意到兩個研究方法上的重要問題令有系統地驗證這一個假設性的過程變得困難。首先，極端天氣的本質意味着不可能將個體隨機分配到某件極端天氣事件。因此我們無法使用隨機化作為識別策略，隔離極端天氣事件對風險感知的影響。其次，個體未必會將極端天氣事件和氣候變化連繫起來，因為後者的主要影響要經過長時間才會浮現。我們因此提供一種嶄新的方法避免現有研究方法上的問題，檢視可否以極端天氣傳達氣候變化的風險。具體而言，我們會借助虛擬現實文獻的最新發展。文獻表明個體會將精心設計的虛擬體驗內化，猶如真實經驗一樣 (Markowitz et al. 2018) 。我們進行一項包含隨機分配實驗組的的實驗，其中包括模擬一個未來香港極端天氣事件的沉浸式虛擬實境。我們使用隨機化作為識別策略，在社會科學實驗室對照實驗的設置中隔離極端天氣事件對風險感知的影響。我們的研究藉嶄新的研究方法對現時文獻和香港及海外傳達氣候變化風險的策略作出貢獻。

17601421.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17601421.value: 研究成年人的日常壓力：一個數碼健康方案 摘要 背景 現有研究表明，在職成年人特別容易受到壓力，職業壓力會損害家庭關係和工作與生活的平衡。本地證據表示，大多數患有精神障礙的人沒有尋求幫助，因為尋求心理健康服務會附帶恥辱感，也因為有較差的心理健康知識的水平而有所影響。雖然之前的研究已經證明線上干預在緩解心理困擾和有替代面對面治療方面的潛力，但高流失率表明需要改進以技術為主的干預計劃。為了利用技術促進心理健康的力量，本研究推出了一款智能手機應用程序，該應用程序結合了自然評估和個性化干預，可在日常的生活自然環境中提供服務。用戶驅動但基於證據的心理健康平台可以最佳化用戶參與度，同時針對具有特殊模式的心理社會條件。 方法 本研究將採用兩階段設計，是一個多從方法的心理生理學項目。第一階段涉及一項觀察性研究，旨在探索參與者如何使用智能手機應用程序。一部分參與者將被邀請使用一般消費者都可以穿戴的設備參與心理生理學部分，這些設備收集有關睡眠和身體活動的數據。總括來說，參與者的日常情感和反應模式，加上生理追踪器的數據，使我們能夠建立一個能夠反映壓力和應對的日常波動以及其生理基礎，具有平行路徑的模型。如果符合條件，本計劃將招募參與者的伴侶，報告他們的日常壓力和應對方式，以及如果他們選擇將麻煩暴露給他們的伴侶，他們為減輕參與者的壓力所做的努力。這種二元研究設計提供了一個機會，可以進一步探索來自其他關係密切者的支持如何促進數碼心理健康干預的有效性，以及症狀和反應的平行模式如何在夫妻中展開。第二階段涉及隨機對照試驗，該試驗檢查智能手機應用程序的有效性。參與者將被隨機分為三個條件，即個性化干預組、非個性化干預組或候補名單對照組。干預組將在自然環境中進行基於智能手機的評估和乾預，為期 4 週。 意義 這項研究的結果將揭示數碼健康平台的有效性，該平台旨在在自然環境中實時支援個人用戶。 研究結果將通過可穿戴設備擴大在線心理健康干預和移動健康領域。 該項目的模式和趨勢可以為個性化干預平台的未來方向提供信息，這些平台針對生理和健康之外的社會心理健康。 該平台的可行性和有效性將對快速發展的數碼健康領域產生越來越大的價值。

17601921.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17601921.value: 飲食之道，除了是一項文化產物，還有著釐定階級和界定身份的功能。本研究以皮耶·布迪厄的社會學說為立論基礎，旨在探討歷代文化特質與與當朝飲食書寫生成的關係。以韋巨源的食單為例，雖然記載並不全面，卻是了解當時中國飲食文化的重要資源，前人的研究主要關注該菜單所載的食物類型，但就忽略了當中食物命名方法的重要性。隋代以前，食物的名稱往往實而不華，較為精簡。當時的烤豬名為 "炮豚"，狗肉湯就是 "狗羹 "，菜如其名，實是求是，可是在韋巨源的菜單中， "甜雪"、"白龍臛" 等菜名屢見不鮮，前者是一種麵食，後者則是魚湯。這種命名習慣，與當時社會追求浮誇絇麗的文學風氣，有著明顯的關係。同樣地，陸遊在《老學庵筆記》中對蠻族大啖龜蛇的描寫，究竟是源自客觀的觀察，還是潛意識地受到了當時排外思想的影響，產生了以飲食行為來突出漢族優越感的舉動？透過把不同時代的飲食書寫重置於其特有的創作時空，重現這些作品的文學性與文化意義，乃是本研究的重點。

17602521.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17602521.value: Institutional change and maintenance have been a core focus of research in organizational institutionalism. The theoretical discussion often depicts institutional changes as a process by which novel institutional arrangements replace their predecessors. However, institutional arrangements that were once prominent but later dwindled may again become popular in the field. The re-institutionalization of remnants that preserve the essences of some dismantled institutional arrangements can be understood as regenerative institutional change. Past studies offer important insights into how regenerative change occurs, but their accounts focus largely on the revival of abolished institutional prescriptions and thus give insufficient attention to the new interpretations of the dismantled institutional arrangements. Also, most studies emphasize the heterogeneity of regenerative change in pluralistic environments, and underplay the structural conditions that enable some forms of change yet constrain others. This points to a theoretical issue that remains understudied: How do the dynamics of broader social change and its impact on actors’ interactions lead to different pathways for regenerative change across fields? To fill this lacuna, this study will compare regenerative change in two cultural fields with identical societal settings – Chinese medicine and Cantonese opera in Hong Kong, both of which are beset with similar tensions that arise from competing interpretations of their traditions, but elicit divergent pathways to change since the 1990s. We build on our earlier GRF project (Ref.14609317) about the professionalization of Chinese medicine practitioners in Hong Kong and add on a novel cross-field comparative perspective on the social and cultural foundations of regenerative change. In particular, we examine why in the field of Chinese medicine, the status quo welcomes novel integrative Chinese-Western medicines while its challengers strive to retain traditional Chinese medicine modalities. Conversely, the incumbents of Cantonese opera promote a traditional form of performance whereas the challengers advocate nouvelle performances. Answers to these questions will inform our understanding of how the fields evolve along with the ‘cultural repertoires’ that the key players assembled and deployed. This project develops an analytical framework based on insights from institutional theory and cultural sociology. It will compile a performance dataset and an event-history database on the development of Cantonese opera between 1990 and 2020, and conduct about 80 in-depth interviews with practitioners and representatives of Cantonese opera troupes and Chinese medicine in Hong Kong in order to explicate the divergent patterns of professional identities construction and transformation, and the differing process of regenerative change in the two fields. 制度的轉變和延續是研究組織和制度的重點。現有的文獻往往視制度轉變為一個新制度取代舊制度的結果。然而，已被取代的舊制度有可能再被社會接受、採納、並成為主流，「制度再生」便是把部分舊制度「再制度化」的結果。過往有關「制度再生」的研究主要聚焦於舊制度如何復興，卻未有仔細分析社會如何理解和建構舊制度的新含意。此外，大部分文獻專注於舊制度在不同社會環境「再制度化」的異質性，而忽略了在相同的社會環境下，社會的結構性條件如何一方面容許部分制度轉變、另一方面限制制度的其他部分改變。這指出了研究「制度再生」的一個缺口：社會發展與不同行業的持份者的互動會如何影響「制度再生」的過程和結果？ 為此，本研究以早前一項有關香港中醫從業員專業化的研究（優配研究金編號：14609317）為基礎，比較香港的中醫業和粵劇界在同一社會環境下「制度再生」的過程和結果。這兩個行業皆經歷傳承傳統和創新的轉變，但在90年代末兩者的發展卻出現不同的現象——在中醫業，較年長的從業員普遍支持中西醫結合治療法；年紀較小的中醫從業員則致力推廣傳統的純中醫療法。相反，在粵劇界年紀較小的從業員普遍提倡新派粵劇表演；較年長的則傾向擁護傳統的表演模式。本研究採用制度研究和文化社會學的理論框架，以檔案研究和訪談收集數據，分析香港社會發展與中醫業和粵劇界的持份者的互動對「制度再生」的影響。

17603321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17603321.value: In Content and Language Integrated Learning (CLIL) programmes, non-linguistic content is taught and assessed in an additional language (L2). This results in some issues related to assessment in CLIL: for instance, the difficulties faced by CLIL teachers, most of whom are content subject specialists, in evaluating students’ content knowledge independent of their L2 proficiency and in aligning objectives, instruction and assessment. These concerns are closely related to teachers’ assessment literacy, which is defined as the knowledge and skills required to evaluate and support student learning through appropriate assessment. Increasingly, assessment literacy is seen as integral to teachers’ pedagogical content knowledge and plays a crucial role in effective instruction and assessment. While frameworks for teachers’ assessment literacy exist, there have been calls to re-examine this important construct with reference to specific educational and disciplinary contexts. Given the curricular complexities of CLIL, this study seeks to conceptualise the assessment literacy of teachers in such programmes. The first phase of the study will adopt a grounded, data-driven approach to explore what CLIL teachers’ assessment literacy should entail. Theoretical and empirical literature, policy documents and codes of practice from different CLIL progammes will be collected and analysed. CLIL scholars and teacher educators will be interviewed regarding their conceptions of teachers’ assessment literacy, and experienced teachers will be interviewed and observed to explore their assessment knowledge and practices. Drawing on these various sources of data, a conceptual framework highlighting the key components of CLIL teachers’ assessment literacy will be generated. This conceptual framework will lay the groundwork for the second phase of the study, which aims to develop an instrument to understand CLIL teachers’ assessment literacy. The instrument development will follow the stages of initial item development, expert-panel review, and piloting with at least 200 in-service teachers to ensure its validity and reliability. This study thus addresses the existing research gap in CLIL assessment through exploring a fundamental construct – teachers’ assessment literacy. By outlining the key components of assessment literate CLIL teachers, this study will establish a solid theoretical grounding for future empirical research in the field. With the conceptual framework and evaluation instrument, this study will also have important implications for CLIL teacher education, in terms of how to enhance CLIL teachers’ assessment literacy, which is a key aspect of their professional knowledge. 在學科内容與語言融合教學(CLIL) 課程中，學生通過他們的第二語言（L2）學習非語文學科，並接受評估。這引起一些與 CLIL 評估相關的問題，例如CLIL 教師（當中大多數是學科教師）要在不受學生的L2水平影響下，評估他們的學科知識時感到困難；CLIL 教師在調整目標、教學和評估方面亦面對一些困難。這些問題皆與教師的評估素養有密切的關係。評估素養被定義為教師以適當的評估工具來評估和支持學生學習所需的知識和技能。它被視為教師專業知識中不可或缺的一部分，並能促進有效的教學和評估。雖然有一些學者提出了教師評估素養的框架，但亦有不少學者認為教師的評估素養應該根據特定的教育和學科背景而調適。鑑於 CLIL 課程的複雜性，本研究旨在將CLIL教師的評估素養概念化。 研究的第一階段將採用紮根的、數據推動的方法來探索 CLIL 教師評估素養的內容。研究團隊將收集和分析來自不同 CLIL 課程的研究文獻、政策文件和守則。研究團隊又會採訪CLIL學者和教師培訓人員，了解他們對教師評估素養的看法，並採訪和觀察有經驗的教師，探索他們的評估知識和實踐。研究團隊根據這些不同的數據來源，建立一個包含 CLIL 教師評估素養的關鍵組成部分的概念框架。根據這個概念框架，研究的第二階段將設計一種工具來檢視 CLIL 教師的評估素養。此工具的開發將遵循初始項目開發、專家小組審查和與至少 200 名在職教師進行測試的階段，以確保其有效性和可靠性。 本研究通過探索教師的評估素養這個基本概念，解答一些 關於CLIL 評估研究的問題。 通過描述 CLIL 教師評估素養的關鍵組成部分，本研究將為未來的研究奠定理論基礎。 本研究亦會為 CLIL 教師培訓提供了概念框架和評估工具，可協助提高 CLIL 教師的評估素養。

17603821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17603821.value: This project represents the first systematic study of Kongish, a unique and still-evolving vernacular widely used among multilingual language users in Hong Kong. Kongish is typically understood as a local variety of English arising from mixing English and Cantonese. This ‘varietal’ approach, however, belies several biases in multilingualism studies as conceived under the World Englishes paradigm, namely: a privileging of native speakership in English; a tendency to posit the simple co-existence of bounded languages in a relation of complementary distribution; and an exclusive focus on linguistic signs, precluding the role of para- and extra-linguistic resources in meaning-making processes. Together these biases lead to a limited conception of Kongish as an ‘offshoot’ (of English), which prevents us from appreciating the dynamic, innovative, and critical potential of the language in its situated usage in Hong Kong. The project aims to reposition Kongish as a creative register in its own right, as an outcome at the intersection of linguistic innovation, sociopolitical development, and social media communication in Hong Kong. It adopts a Translanguaging approach, designed to overcome the above-mentioned limitations of the varietal perspective and to enable us to reconceptualise Kongish as a fluid construct which: transcends socially-instituted boundaries between named languages; transgresses the distinction between spoken and written language as well as between linguistic and nonlinguistic modalities; and transforms the identity of Kongish users in their active linguistic engagement with social events. Importantly, the project highlights the relation between creativity and criticality by investigating how playful linguistic innovations in Kongish instantiate a more serious, often subversive, stance that may reveal deeper tensions between the articulation of a “bottom-up” vernacular and the social structures it seeks to critique. Methodologically, this project develops a Participatory Linguistics framework for a multi-level sociolinguistic analysis, combining digital ethnography and Interpretative Phenomenological Analysis. Using the popular Facebook site Kongish Daily as a source of Kongish examples, it not only undertakes a textual, multimodal, and theoretical analysis of the empirical material, but also closely engages with the editors and users of the Facebook page to elicit their perceptions toward Kongish and their responses to our analysis of the Kongish examples. In so doing, we draw on the interpretive processes of Kongish users to supplement our own observations. This will help deepen our understanding of Kongish as a translingual practice developed in response to the contingencies of Hong Kong society. 本項目旨在從「超語行動」的角度出發闡釋「港語」現象。港語是香港獨有的混雜語言，融合廣東話、英語等語言元素以及圖像、表情符號等視覺元素。過往的研究多從「世界英語」的範式出發，將港語界定為語碼轉換所派生的一個英語支系，即所謂「港式英語」。相關論述一般將港語視為兩種語言的簡單結合，如此一來，不僅過分強調了英語對在地語言發展的影響，模糊了在地跨語實踐所蘊含的流動性及能動性，更忽略了語言以外其他表意資源在傳意當中所起到的關鍵作用。 本項目嘗試對港語進行重新定位，視之為創意語言及社交媒體多元互動下的獨特文化產物。我們認為，作為「超語行動」的實踐場域，港語並非「世界英語」的旁支分流，而是一種超越語言疆界的跨符號系統，運用各種表意資源體現在地語言的流動性以及能動性。在方法論層面上，本項目擬發展「參與式語言學」，就Facebook網站「港語日報」專頁進行多層次分析，包括文本分析和多模態分析，更將與「港語日報」的編輯和使用者直接進行互動，從不同角度匯集各方對港語的反饋意見。

17604321.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17604321.value: 局部睡眠剝奪及睡眠恢復對習慣性飲食控制的影響

17604321.label: Project Objectives
17604321.value: To examine the effects of experimentally induced three-night partial sleep deprivation (PSD) and two-night sleep recovery (SR) compared to normal sleep duration (NSD) on the interaction among (a) cue-elicited, habitual control of eating, (b) palatability-driven hedonic eating, and (c) hunger-driven homeostatic eating. A within-individual randomized crossover study will be conducted to test the following hypotheses: a. Three-night PSD is hypothesized to augment habitual control of food-motivated behavior such that the effects of cues will be stronger following PSD than normal sleep control (NSD) and two-night SR. b. Food palatability is hypothesized to moderate the effects of three-night PSD on food-motivated behavior such that the effect of PSD is more pronounced when the food rewards are highly palatable. c. Sleep is hypothesized to moderate the effect of satiation on food-motivated behaviour such that food-motivated behavior is less sensitive to satiation following three-night PSD than NSD and SR.

A within-individual randomized crossover study will be conducted to test the following hypotheses: a. Three-night PSD is hypothesized to augment habitual control of food-motivated behavior such that the effects of cues will be stronger following PSD than normal sleep control (NSD) and two-night SR. b. 17604321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17604321.value: A robust relationship between short sleep duration and obesity has been observed in numerous epidemiological studies (for a review, see Patel & Hu, 2008), leading to enthusiasm for the study of the role of sleep in weight control. Our previous studies have shown that the relationship between insufficient sleep and the risks of obesity is dependent on one’s ability to regulate conflicting needs and actions (Chan, 2017, 2018; Chan et al., 2014). The preliminary findings from our pilot study suggest that one-night of experimentally induced total sleep deprivation can tip the balance between habitual control of behavior and goal-directed behavior, leading to overpowering habitual food-seeking behavior. Dominance of habitual control of eating behavior may constitute to the mechanism underlying the relationship between insufficient sleep and obesity. The proposed research aims to advance the pilot study and examine the relationship between sleep deprivation and food-motivated behavior using a novel methodology, which allows for the study of three interacting but separate mechanisms underlying eating, namely hunger-driven homeostatic eating, palatability-driven hedonic eating, and cue-elicited habitual eating. A computerized Pavlovian-instrumental transfer (PIT) paradigm with food rewards will be used in conjunction with the manipulation of food palatability and satiation procedures to study habitual, hedonic, and homeostatic aspects of eating. The PIT transfer effects refer to the enhancing effects of Pavlovian cues on instrumental responding to the cued or non-cued food outcomes. We propose to investigate the effects of three-night partial sleep deprivation and two-night sleep recovery on the PIT transfer effects. We hypothesize that (a) three-night PSD will modify the transfer effects of PIT such that the general transfer effects will be stronger following PSD than SR and NSD; (b) food palatability will moderate the effect of PSD on transfer effects such that the effect of PSD is more pronounced if the food rewards are highly palatable; and, (c) satiation will reduce the transfer effects and that sleep will moderate the effect of satiation such that the effect of satiation is weaker following PSD than NSD and SR. The findings will improve our understanding of the mechanisms by which insufficient sleep lead to an increased risk of obesity. This knowledge can then be leveraged to inform the development of effective sleep interventions for weight management and health promotion. 此研究將比較三晚「局部的睡眠剝奪」 及兩晚的「睡眠恢復」 與「正常持續睡眠」 如何影響 (一) 由提示引發的習慣性飲食控制，(二) 以滿足享樂的飲食機制，和 (三) 飢餓驅動的穩態飲食。研究將以隨機對照試驗的實驗方法，以驗證以下的假設： (一)三晚的局部睡眠剝奪可以增強由提示引發的習慣性飲食控制; (二) 三晚的局部睡眠剝奪對習慣性飲食控制的影響會因應食物可口性而改變, 面對愈可口的食物, 這種影響愈大; (三) 三晚的局部睡眠剝奪會減低飢餓驅動的穩態飲食機制住進食的影響。

17604421.value: To complete the systematic classification, selection, and cross-referencing of a "living corpus" of texts drawn from a collection of 2120 digitized manuscripts of the Lanten Yao (Yao Mun) ethnic group of Laos, previously collected and catalogued by members of the research team (led by PI David Palmer and Co-I Joseba Estevez) for the British Library Endangered Manuscripts Programme. To develop a digital platform to make collected materials available to the Lanten Yao themselves, allowing them to upload additional materials on their culture and to communicate across national boundaries. 17604421.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17604421.value: 瑤族廣泛分佈於中國境內，以及緬甸、老撾、泰國、法國、美國等國家，他們的道教儀式傳統歷來令研究中國宗教與道教的學者深感興趣。大部分瑤族社群有著一種獨特的宗教體系：全體青年男性必須「度戒」（相當於入道），作為他們成人禮的一部分——這與東漢時期的天師道運動（已知最早的道教團體）在結構上非常相似。為順利度戒，瑤人首先要接受許多宗教訓練，其中包括抄寫、記憶並諷誦各類儀式文本，而這些文本均用類似漢字的文字寫成。因此，道教儀式與手抄本是瑤族文化的重要組成部分，這也令他們與其他生活在中南半島的高地民族不同。 本項目立足於我們香港大學研究團隊的過往研究成果。我們的團隊曾在老撾瑯南塔省的藍靛瑤社群中參與觀察，對他們的文化、宗教與儀式進行了系統性的人類學研究。我們已對2120件手抄本進行了數位化與編目。這些手抄本在當地仍被藍靛瑤祭司所使用，因此，我們已著手對藍靛瑤儀式與敘事傳統的多個方面開展個案研究，同時運用了文本資料與民族誌資料。在本項目中，我們有以下研究計劃：完成數個手抄本的錄寫工作，這些手抄本均是從當地祭司仍在使用的「活著的文庫」（living corpus）中精選而出；將我們在瑯南塔省蒐集到的「活著的文庫」置於整個瑤族文獻的領域中加以考察，其他瑤族文獻或在越南的瑤族社群中保存，或收藏於歐洲多個圖書館中；在此基礎上，將這一「活著的文庫」出版為一系列專著，並搭建一個關於藍靛瑤宗教與手抄本的線上視聽平臺。 本項目的優勢在於，我們有一支跨領域的研究隊伍，專長學科包括人類學、漢學、歷史學與抄本學，專長區域也涵蓋中國、老撾與越南。本項目將會跨越國家邊界進行考察，以突破過往學者囿於國境線，在東南亞大陸少數族群研究領域所呈現出割裂局面。同時，本項目將會大幅促進學界對於非漢、非華語民族的道教傳統的研究。此外，本項目還將會緊密結合人類學與文本研究，這一方法論層面的創新將有助於推動道教與中國宗教研究，乃至整個手抄本文化研究領域。

17605221.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17605221.value: With increased emphasis on the quality of teaching and learning in schools, great efforts have been devoted to teachers’ professional development (PD). However, face-to-face delivery of quality PD or continuous support for all teachers is impossible due to a scarcity of resources and, currently, the COVID-19 pandemic. To address this challenge, the proposed project will develop and evaluate a new online PD approach that leverages video and visualizations to support ongoing teacher learning and reflection. We focus on productive classroom talk, a pedagogy central to classroom teaching and learning that engages students in active thinking and participation but in which teachers often lack training or find challenging. To develop the video-visualization online PD approach, we will incorporate a discourse visualization platform (Classroom Discourse Analyzer 2.0) developed by the research team to transform video-recorded lessons into multiple visual representations of classroom talk (e.g., visualizing the occurrences, lengths, and types of teacher and student talk). The platform’s interactive, process-oriented visualizations can aid teachers’ navigation of video and support their understanding of the dynamic process of classroom talk. Teachers can also use the platform to track changes in their teaching over time and discuss and collaborate with peers. To evaluate the effectiveness of this video-visualization online PD approach, we will use a one-year randomized controlled trial with a sample of 16 secondary schools. In total, 64 mathematics teachers (and their approximately 1,600 students) will participate in the study, 32 of whom will be randomly assigned to a treatment group and 32 to a comparison group. Teachers in the treatment group will learn, reflect, and follow up their classroom dialogic practices in the video- and visualization-supported online PD platform, while teachers in the comparison group will have similar PD activities except that they will use a video-based online PD approach without the support of visualizations. The main activities in this project are (1) development of a video-visualization online PD approach, (2) a year-long intervention involving teachers’ online PD, and (3) a pre-, post-, and delayed post-test for measuring the impact of the approach on the perceptions and behaviors of teachers and students with respect to their classroom talk, as well as on students’ mathematics achievement. This project will make significant contributions to the literature on classroom dialogic teaching and teacher professional learning. The proposed video-visualization online PD approach could scale up PD opportunities for teachers, improve PD efficacy, and enhance students’ performance in schools. 教師專業發展（PD）在很大程度上關係到課堂教學成效。然而，在當前條件，尤其受疫情影響下，教育系統往往無法為所有老師提供優質的線下PD服務。為了應對這一挑戰，本項目旨在研發一種以視頻和可視化促進教師學習和反思的線上PD方案。研究聚焦于有效課堂對話這一主題，以促進學生在課堂學習中的積極思考和主動參與。本項目將會使用和改進前期開發的課堂對話分析平台（CDA 2.0），老師可以使用該平台對教學視頻進行可視化、追蹤教學變化以及與其他同伴老師合作等。項目的主要活動包括：1）基於教學視頻可視化的線上PD方案開發；2）線上PD干預與實驗研究； 3）檢測此PD方案對師生課堂對話以及學生學習的影響。本項目的意義首先在於其對對話式教學和教師專業發展方面的理論貢獻。其次，項目對於教師專業發展的規模化、有效性以及提升學生課堂學習等方面也具有一定的現實意義。

17605721.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17605721.value: Spatial skills have been proposed to be closely linked to math competence, as the representation of math problem scenarios, numerical magnitudes, and arithmetic operations are all spatial in nature. Despite the rich amount of empirical evidence supporting the relation between spatial skills and math competence (Chan & Wong, 2019; Mix et al., 2016; Verdine et al., 2017), the causality of this space-math link remains to be determined. The proposed study aims to examine the causality of this space-math link through an intervention on children’s spatial skills using a randomized control trial (RCT). A total of 450 third graders will be recruited and randomly assigned to one of the four experimental groups or a control group. Five tablet games will be developed, with four targeting at improving children’s spatial skills (the experimental conditions) and one targeting at improving children’s vocabulary knowledge (the control condition). Participants will practice their spatial skills/vocabulary knowledge through the tablet games in 6 half-hour sessions spread over 3 weeks. A pre-test, an immediate posttest, and a delayed posttest will be conducted to assess the effects of different training games on children’s spatial skills and math competence. Children’s performance in the three potential mediators (i.e., representations of problem scenarios, numerical magnitude and arithmetic operations) and other potential confounding variables (e.g., intelligence, working memory) will also be assessed. The proposed research design enables a comprehensive investigation of the causality of the space-math link. First, the use of RCT allows the investigators to verify whether spatial skills are causally related to children’s math competence, and the delayed-posttest further tests whether such effects, if they exist, are long-lasting. Second, the inclusion of multiple spatial skills trainings enables the examination of the specificity of the spatial skills training effects on math competence (i.e., whether different spatial skills training produce similar effects on the math outcomes). Third, the assessment of the potential mediators enables the identification of mechanisms underlying the space-math link. The spatial skills trainings are expected to bring about long-term improvement in children’s math competence, with different spatial skills training games influencing math competence through different mechanisms. The proposed study is also significant in a practical sense because the tablet spatial skills trainings, if proven to be effective, offer a cost-effective intervention for educators to improve children’s math competence. Furthermore, tablet trainings can be conducted even under unexpected situations such as the current pandemic. 空間認知與數學能力有著密切的關係。各項主要的數學能力，包括對數量、四則運算及文字題題型的理解，均涉及到空間的認知。但即使空間認知及數學能力之間的關係已獲得不少研究支持 (Chan & Wong, 2019, Mix et al., 2016; Verdine et al., 2017)，當中的因果關係仍然有待探究。 本研究計劃希望通過一個隨機對照試驗以了解空間認知訓練能否提升兒童的數學能力。計劃包括4個實驗組及1個對照組，而450名三年級的兒童會被隨機分配到其中一組。每個組別均會被安排接受其中一種平版電腦遊戲訓練，實驗組別所接受的訓練集中提升兒童的空間認知，而對照組別所接受的訓練則旨在提升他們的詞彙量。每組訓練包含6節，每節半小時的訓練，而整個訓練為期三週。在訓練前、訓練後即時、以及訓練後一年，參加者均會接受一些關於空間認知及數學能力的評估，以檢視訓練的成效。 是次研究計劃容計我們全面地了解空間認知和數學能力之間的因果關係。首先，隨機對照試驗的設計與及延遲後測能讓我們了解空間認知訓練能否有效地提升兒童的數學能力，以及其效用是否持久。其次，通過各種不同的空間認知訓練，我們可以了解空間認知與各種數學能力的關係的獨特性 (即不同的空間認知訓練是否對不同的數學能力有著不同的效用？) 再者，通過評估兒童各種數學能力，我們能清楚了解空間認知如何影響兒童的數學能力。我們預期空間認知訓練能有效地提升兒童長遠的數學能力，而不同的空間認知訓練將有著不同的效用。 最後，從應用的角度，本研究計劃亦具有深遠的影響。如果是次研究計劃能證實平版電腦空間認知訓練的效用，老師將能夠通過是項高成本效益的方法去提升學生的數學能力。更重要的是，這些平版電腦的訓練不受地域所限，即使在疫症其間亦能應用。

17606221.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17606221.value: The aim of this research is to examine the changing dynamics of family relationships following gay men’s disclosure of their sexual orientation to their families of origin in Hong Kong. There is a burgeoning body of literature, both internationally and locally, documenting the richness of LGBTQ (lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer) lives, including the coming out experience, experience of forming intimate and sexual relationships, organisation of LGBTQ communities, sexual politics and LGBTQ movements. However, there is a paucity of research on LGBTQ individuals’ families of origin, with most of the few existing studies conducted in psychology and social work and in a Western (primarily US) context. Moreover, narratives about the reactions of family members are usually told retrospectively by LGBTQ people themselves rather than by the family members concerned. The limited research on heteronormative families of origin in Chinese societies is striking given the strength of inter-generational closeness and dependence. Situated in the “doing families” and life course literatures, this research will fill the gap by putting families of origin into the queer picture. In-depth interviews with 30 Hong Kong families, including gay men in different age cohorts and close family members who know their sexual orientation, will reveal the changing dynamics of family relations over time once that orientation has been disclosed. The interviews will not only focus on gay men’s coming out experiences but also on the reactions of and perceived change in family relationships on both sides once the sexual orientation has been disclosed. Also of interest will be the role that morality and emotion play, with family members potentially experiencing sadness, denial, shame/guilt and anger, as well as acceptance, love, care and pride. This research will thus pinpoint the changing meaning of (homo-)sexuality and family and the significance of coming out in the Chinese context against the backdrop of Hong Kong’s social transformation from colonial to contemporary times. It will make unique contributions by studying different gay generations, emphasising the voice of family members and examining dyadic relationships within the Chinese family, thus bridging generational studies and family studies with sexuality studies. The findings will have a strong social impact, as well as implications for policy on promoting family acceptance and social inclusion, thereby benefitting sexual minorities, their families, NGOs concerned with social inclusion and diversity, and the general public. 本研究旨在考察香港男同志向原生家庭揭露性向後的家庭動態變化。同志出櫃經驗、性與親密關係、同志社群的建立、性政治與同志運動等議題，在國際與本地均有豐碩的文獻累積。然而，有關原生家庭成員如何面對同志家人出櫃的研究，則除了少數以美國經驗為主的西方心理學與社會工作研究之外，尚缺乏社會學研究的分析。而上述研究也多以同志個人的回溯性敘事為主，而非由原生家庭成員來描述同志家人出櫃後的家庭變化。特別值得關注的是，以異性戀規範性下的華人家庭，父母與子女的關係一向親密並互相依賴，但既有研究卻往往忽略對原生家庭的探討。 立基於「做家庭」與生命歷程的文獻基礎，本研究將會填補對原生家庭成員的探討，企圖完整酷兒圖像的全貌。本研究採取深度訪談法，訪問30個不同世代的男同志及其家人，探討男同志的出櫃經歷以及其出櫃後家庭成員的反應及關係的動態變化。此外，訪談內容亦聚焦道德倫理與情緒在此過程中扮演的角色，特別是同志與家人經歷的種種複雜情緒例如傷心、否認、羞恥、罪惡與憤怒，又或是接受、驕傲、愛與關懷。本研究因而能夠精準的掌握在香港社會中殖民與後殖民背景下同性戀、家庭與出櫃經驗意義上的轉變。藉由分析不同男同志世代、強調家庭成員敘事的聲音與探討華人家庭關係的動態變遷，本研究能補足世代與家庭研究中對性研究的缺漏。本研究對社會有重要的影響力，特別是對相關政策的改革，旨在促進家庭接納，達到社會共融的目的，讓同志、同志家庭、持相關理念的非政府機構，以及社會大眾都能受惠。 * 摘要以英文版本為準

17606521.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17606521.value: Suicide is a major global health problem with more than 800,000 death each year. Suicide is the leading cause of death among youths (15-24). Despite the overall reduction of suicide at a global level, suicide cases among our teenagers are still increasing in many countries. The young adults are always the ones which are difficult to engage in. It is a global challenge with substantial long-term impacts and desperately needs more relevant knowledge to mitigate the problem. The proposed mixed-method study is to make use of a three-wave panel and a qualitative study to 1. exploring the characteristics and prevalence of young adults with suicidal ideation and their differences to those without suicidal ideation 2. investigating the transition in suicidal ideation over three measurement waves among young adults in Hong Kong from 2018 to 2020 3. examining the potential linkages between transitions in suicidal ideation and various help-seeking behaviours and changes in psychological distress 4. elucidating the moderating role of various types of suicide stigma on the pathways from suicidal ideation to help-seeking behaviours 5. understanding the rationale of the transition in suicidality and associated factors on psychological distress, help-seeking behaviours, and suicide stigma among young adults. Also, we conduct a qualitative study to understand the challenges and obstacles of help-seeking behaviours among young adults. We hope to develop a connected care model to provide the most appropriate care model for those in distress. We seek to understand in practical as well as systemic terms the best approach to develop and improve programmatic efforts that will lead to long-lasting changes, save lives, and promote holistic wellness in the community. Our proposal is meant to make a difference to the existing practice, improve its effectiveness, and reduce the suicide ideation and subsequent suicide attempts. One of our emphases is to raise the awareness and understanding of the importance of youth suicidality, their transition at a different time period, their help-seeking behaviours, and the associated suicide stigma. We aim to identify the stigmatizing attitudes and remove the barriers for young adults to seek help when necessary. We have been working to promote connectedness among our youths. The project will facilitate to consolidate a platform to do research and development on suicide prevention for young people and will not only benefit Hong Kong but also serve as a good reference model to many other countries. 自殺是一個主要的全球健康問題，每年有80多萬人死亡。自殺是15-24歲之青少年其中一個的主要死因。儘管在全球範圍內，自殺案例總體上有所減少，但在許多國家，青少年的自殺案例仍有所增加。由於年輕人對心理健康的污名化，助人專業人士很難與這人群接觸。自殺是一個具有實質性長期影響的全球性挑戰，故此，它迫切需要更多的相關知識來緩解這一問題。 在研究、資金、國際關注、政策/公共衛生戰略和社區主導的行動方面，往往需要我們將重點從西方國家轉向世界的其他地區。所有的利益相關者均需要認識到根據實際情況去制定戰略的需要，而不是制定在不同情況下可能不適用的普遍準則。另外，"沒有心理健康就沒有健康 "是世界衛生組織的座右銘，其目的是強調社區心理健康的重要性。 本混合方法研究透過利用三波數據來作量性研究和小組討論來作質性研究，以 1. 探討有自殺念頭的年輕人的特點和流行率，以及他們與沒有自殺念頭的年輕人的區別 2. 調查2018年至2020年香港年輕人自殺念頭在三個測量中的轉變情況 3. 研究自殺念頭的轉變與各種尋求幫助的行為和心理困擾的變化之間的潛在關聯 4. 闡明各種類型的自殺污名對從自殺念頭到求助行為的途徑的調節作用 5. 了解自殺傾向的轉變和相關因素對年輕人的心理壓力、求助行為和自殺成見的影響的合理性。 此外，我們還進行了一項質性研究，以了解年輕人求助行為的挑戰和障礙。我們希望開發一個相連的關懷支援模型，為處於困境的年輕人提供最適切的幫助。我們力求從實際以及有系統的角度上理解並發展和改善項目工作的最佳方法，從而帶來持久的變化，拯救生命，並促進社區的整體健康。 我們的提議是為了改變現有的做法，提高其有效性，並減少自殺念頭和隨後的自殺行為。本研究的其中一個重點是提高對年輕人自殺的重要性的認識和理解，並明白他們在不同時期的轉變、求助行為、以及相關的自殺污名的影響。 本研究的另一個目標是識別不同自殺污名化的態度，並為年輕人消除障礙，讓他們在必要時可尋求幫助。我們一直在努力促進年輕人之間的聯繫感。此項目將有助於鞏固一個提供情緒支援服務的平台，以進行預防年輕人自殺的研究和發展，研究結果將不僅使香港社會受益，也可成為許多其他國家的良好參考模式。

17606621.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17606621.value: Rapid urbanization has created more high-density cities, and this trend is more evident in non-Western countries. The evidence increasingly suggests two severe challenges associated with high-density built environments. (1) Residents in high-density cities are more vulnerable to health problems and suicidal tendencies than their counterparts in low- or moderate-density cities, and (2) compared with other urban dwellers, public housing residents with a low socioeconomic status (SES) in these high-density cities are more vulnerable to health problems and suicidal tendencies. Although the literature extensively covers many socioeconomic and demographic factors that may influence the health status and suicidal tendencies of public housing residents in high-density cities, it barely reveals the impacts of built environment factors in and around public housing communities on the health status and suicidal tendencies of public housing residents. In our proposed study, we will seek answers to the following crucial questions: What impact pathway models describe the complex relationships between all of the factors and outcomes? While considering the potential impacts of socioeconomic and demographic factors, to what extent are built environmental factors collectively associated with the health status and suicidal tendencies of residents? Which specific built environmental factors are significantly associated with the residents’ health status and suicidal tendencies? This proposed study is based on the findings of a pilot study. Built environmental factors will be objectively measured using ArcGIS 10.5 as a top-down measure and a deep learning-based image segmentation algorithm, Pyramid Scene Parsing Network (PSP-Net) as an eye-level measure. The mental, physical, and social health status and the perceived built environment quality and suicidal intention of 4,500 respondents will be measured through on-site questionnaire surveys. Suicidal tendencies will be measured using the surveyed residents’ suicide intention and the average suicide death rate of each community (suicidal deaths in Hong Kong recorded by the court between 2005 and 2017). A structural equation model (SEM) will be used to identify a pathways model linking built environment factors, socioeconomic, and demographic factors; mental, physical, and social health status; suicidal intention; and suicide rate. Semi-structured interviews will be conducted as a compatible qualitative method: Thematic and sentiment analysis of interviewees’ narrative text will be used to identify key logical lines and built environmental factors that have impacts on health status and suicidal tendencies. Last, findings from the SEM and semantic analysis will be integrated to identify significant pathways and built environmental factors that influence health status and suicidal tendencies. 近年來劇烈的城市化進程催生了很多高密度城市，這一現象在非西方國家尤為明顯。然而研究證據表明高密度的城市環境給健康城市帶來了巨大的挑戰：居住在高密度城市的人群通常比那些居住在中低密度城市的人群面臨著更多的健康問題，甚至是自殺傾向，並且這些健康危機在居住政府租賃公屋的低收入人群中更為嚴重。儘管已有研究發現社會經濟和人口統計特征可能會影響公屋居民的健康狀況和自殺傾向，但關於公屋及其周圍建成環境是如何影響居民健康水平鮮有報道。 是項研究我們將探究以下三個重要問題：1. 建成環境因子和公屋居民的健康狀況、自殺傾向之間的影響機制是怎樣的？2. 進一步考慮社會經濟和人口特征，建成環境影響居民健康狀況和自殺傾向的程度是多少？ 3. 具體哪個建成環境因子顯著影響居民的健康狀況和自殺傾向？主要的研究方法包括：1. 建成環境因子將從人类感知视角和规划视角，分别用ArcGIS地理影像数据处理和深度学习图像分割来进行客观测量；2. 精神、身體和社會健康狀況，以及自殺意願的數據將來自對4500名公屋居民的現場問卷調研，另外來自死因法庭的死亡數據也用來表征自殺傾向。3. 結構化方程模型用來探究建成環境因子、社會經濟和人口因子、精神身體和社會健康、自殺意願以及自殺率之間的影響機制。4. 半結構化訪談的定量研究用來檢測主題詞和情緒分析從而找出潛在的關係影響機制和重要的建成環境因子。 最後，綜合結構化方程模型和語義分析的結果進一步揭示建成環境、社會經濟和人口統計特征和公屋居民健康之間的影響機制以及對提升居民健康和福祉有重要作用的環境因子。我們期望通過是項研究能產生确凿的證據來推進城市設計和規劃，改善公屋住區環境，提升居民健康水平。

17607621.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17607621.value: Children exhibit significant individual differences in number skills such as counting, number comparison, and non-verbal calculation from an early age, and well before school entry. Acquisition of early number skills is essential, because these skills are predictive of later math achievement and even adulthood socioeconomic status. Within a child’s proximal environment, parents may facilitate early number learning by providing numeracy-related materials and encouraging children to be involved in counting and other numeracy activities. Over the past decade, a body of research has grown on the relation between parent–child numeracy activities and children’s number skills, generally focusing on the unidirectional effect of parent–child numeracy activities on children’s number skills. However, whether involvement of parents in numeracy activities is dependent on children’s differing levels of number skills remains unclear. Moreover, most prior studies have focused on parents as a unit or solely on mothers, overlooking the role of fathers and any possible reciprocal influences between mothers and fathers. To address these gaps, the proposed project will develop a comprehensive model of home numeracy activities that involves both mother–child and father–child activities. Based on a longitudinal design with young Chinese children, the project will examine how mother–child and father–child numeracy activities affect and are affected by children’s number skills. The project will also assess how mother–child numeracy activities influence and are influenced by father–child numeracy activities. The project carries important theoretical and applied implications. Because it will identify the home characteristics that may promote young children’s number skills, the findings will shed light on the key numeracy activities that intervention programs should prioritize with young children in the years prior to school entry. Moreover, because we expect that mother–child and father–child numeracy activities have independent effects on children’s later number skills, intervention programs that equip both parents to support their child’s early number skills may be more effective than those that target one parent only. On the basis of the findings, researchers and practitioners can develop and evaluate such programs, which will yield information of value in planning early mathematics education. 在進入小學之前，兒童很早就已經在數字技能（如數數、數字比較、非言語算術）上表現出明顯的個體差異。對這些數字技能的早期習得非常重要，因為這些技能可以預測兒童以後的數學成績，甚至成年後的社會經濟地位。在兒童耳濡目染的日常生活中，父母會通過各種方式，如為兒童提供蘊含數量的學習材料、鼓勵兒童數數或參加其它數學活動，來促進他們的數學學習。在過去的十年中，越來越多的研究關注親子數學活動與兒童數字技能之間的關係，特別是前者對後者的單向影響。然而，我們並不清楚父母參與親子數字活動是否會受到兒童數學能力差異的反向影響。不僅如此，以往大多數研究都把父母看成是一個整體，或者僅僅關注母親，忽視了父親在兒童數學學習中的作用以及父親和母親之間可能存在的相互影響。為了彌補這些研究空白，是項研究計畫會開發一個同時包含母子、父子互動在內的家庭數學活動理論。是項計畫將通過對華人幼兒的追蹤測試，研究母子、父子數學活動如何影響兒童的數字技能，以及兒童的數字技能如何影響母子、父子數學活動。它亦將研究母子、父子數學活動之間是否存在相互影響。是項計畫具有重要的理論和應用價值。因為我們會揭示促進幼兒數字學習的家庭特點，所以研究結論將告訴我們哪些關鍵的家庭數學活動對幼兒入學前的數學學習非常關鍵。而且，因為我們期望母子、父子數學活動各自對兒童數字技能具有獨特的作用，所以同時讓父母雙方幫助兒童學習數學，可能會比只關注父母中的一方更為有效。研究者和實踐人員可以在是項計畫的基礎上，開發和評估家庭介入計畫，這將給幼兒數學教育帶來莫大價值。

17607821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17607821.value: 聲線疲勞是教師們常遇到影響教學的問題。香港的教師人數接近 73,250。估計百分之69.9 到 72.8 有聲線毛病。這相對人口一般百分之６的病發率，高出 10 倍。而每年估計教學涉及經濟損失14.9億元港幣。香港大學 2009 年的綠化聲線計劃，針對受訓中的未來教師，培訓他們課堂中的用共鳴發聲方法，明顯有效減低教師們聲線毛病的病發率。我們把這綠化聲線計劃，拓展到應用健身房的概念。給現役教師應用垂直共震運動，達到減輕聲線疲勞，和強化課堂用聲功能。這研究會探討垂直共震對提升聲線能力的理論。我們假設垂直共震會令至喉嚨和聲帶同時共震，產生肌肉按摩功能，而達到減低聲線疲勞。

17607821.label: Realisation of objectives
17607821.value: As previously mentioned in the mid-term report, COVID led to suspension of the project, which was meant to be conducted in local schools. A change in the study plan allowed the team to continue the project on HKU campus and the first four objectives were achieved. However, it remained difficult to resume data collection in local schools even when the COVID measures were lifted. This was because the schools had to re-prioritise their non-teaching related commitments during the post-COVID era, in order to assist their students to return to routine learning. Unfortunately, this means that we had to drop the 5th objective from the project. There has also been a change in the Principal Investigator at the final months of the project (July 2023) as the original P.I. (Yiu) retired. Sadly, Prof. Yiu soon passed away in 2024. There are some missing information related to the research outputs that the current P.I. could not retrieve from the system. During the project period, we have recruited 160 participants to the project carried out on HKU campus. Among them, we have data from 154 for analysis with the following breakdown: Objective 1: Effectiveness of whole-body vibration to reduce vocal fatigue (N=48) Objective 2: Effectiveness of pivotal whole-body vibration to reduce vocal fatigue (N=66) Objective 3: Whether the larynx would oscillate at the frequency induced by the whole-body vibration platform (N=40) Objective 4: Effectiveness of voice rest in alleviating vocal fatigue (same N=66 in Objective 2) Two abstracts, based on these 3 objectives have been submitted to an international conference (15th Asia Oceania Otorhinolaryngology-Head & Neck Surgery, March 2023, Brisbane) (https://www.orlhns23.com/). Three papers have also been published based on the project. These outputs are listed in the report.

17607821.label: Major findings and research outcome
17607821.value: The following findings and research outcomes were achieved: 1) The study found that whole body vibration was effective in reducing vocal fatigue in healthy adults, as compared with vocal rest. The reduction in fatigue was reflected by improved self perception, perceptual voice ratings and instrumental vocal function measurements (acoustics and surface electromyography). 2) The study confirmed that by varying the frequency of the external whole body vibration device, similar oscillations at a specific frequency can be transferred to the larynx. This provides evidence for further studies to design voice treatment programs. It is anticipated that whole body vibration (WBV) can be included as part of voice treatment program, especially for prebyphonia, where WBV can help with laryngeal muscle strengthening. A research article was published at an international peer reviewed journal based on findings of this research objective (Yiu, Cheng and Wang, 2024),

17607821.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17607821.value: The current evidence suggests that whole body vibration can be one of the methods to reduce vocal fatigue in healthy adults. Theoretically, whole body vibration can also be used to enhance vocal functions in populations that may experience reduced vocal endurance, such as in the older adult population. Further study can be conducted to explore the effectiveness of using whole body vibration in enhancing vocal functions in older adults, especially those who are experiencing prebyphonia (vocal changes due to ageing).

17607821.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17607821.value: Vocal fatigue, the perception of exhaustion or increased sense of effort to produce voice can have significant negative impact on voice production and quality of life, especially in professional voice users. The current study aimed to investigate the use of whole body vibration to reduce vocal fatigue in healthy adults. The findings support the use of whole body vibration at relatively high frequency (>10Hz) to induce laryngeal vibrations. Such vibrations have been shown to be useful to reduce vocal fatigue in healthy adults. Future studies can further explore the effect of daily whole body vibration training over a longer period of time (>4 weeks) on vocal function. This training method has potential to be used as part of vocal training for professional voice users and older adults with presbyphonia.

17608221.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17608221.value: Recent digital design technologies have facilitated the strategic application and integration of design computation in architecture. With this, opportunities have emerged for a more performative and spatially diverse architecture production, even in low-tech developing construction contexts. Now, architects need practically applicable design methods that 1) permit the simultaneous organisation of structure, space, and program, and 2) enable design data management and communication with construction industries for project implementation. This study develops such a spatially versatile, computation-driven architectural design method for lightweight, large-span, suspended roof structures that incorporates the automated building data extraction for their low-tech production from glue-laminated (glulam) timber. The timber industry is expanding due to increased demand for environmentally sustainable building solutions and the increased mass production of timber products (ARUP, 2019). These include glulam – a structurally engineered wood product composed by layering and bonding treated lumber together with moisture-resistant adhesives. While research in its fire safety performance, robustness, and durability is ongoing globally, boosting glulam application in architecture practice requires further development of its tectonic systems and their integration in architecture design. Structures based on suspended beam geometries substantially reduce material needs when compared with those relying on straight beams, as catenary beams operate in pure tension throughout, avoiding inefficient neutral fibres along the centreline and removing risk of buckling. Yet, their manufacture from glulam typically requires costly bespoke individual hardware setups. Two pilot studies identified novel opportunities for suspended glulam structures by identifying a method minimising this required number of hardware setups, thus increasing fabrication simplicity: a structure’s catenary beams’ geometries and sections are algorithmically minimally tweaked until their combined manufacture becomes possible from a single reusable jig setup (Wong and Crolla, 2019; Crolla and Klisz, 2020). This proposal advances these pilots, bringing together research disciplines of structural optimisation, architectural geometry rationalisation, and engineered wooden construction. The pilots’ preliminary models will be developed and integrated in more robust computational design and fabrication setups with an improved algorithmic approach and broader architecture design solution space. This space will be iteratively tested through digital and physical prototypes. Methodological workflow, applicability, and versatility, as well as its spatial design solution space, will be summarised and explicated for implementation in architecture practice through a typology taxonomy overview. By facilitating architects’ access to a low-tech producible, spatially versatile, lightweight, eco-friendly, wooden roof structure typology, this study will contribute to environmentally sustainable building and facilitate reduction of the construction industry’s extensive CO2 emissions. 最近的數碼化設計技術促進了運算化設計在建築中的戰略應用和融入。 這樣，即使在技術含量低的建築環境中，更具表演性、空間更多樣化的建築能生產的機會也漸漸浮現了。 現在，建築師需要實際情況上適用的設計方法，以 1) 允許同時重組建築的結構、空間和工序的可能，以及 2) 在項目的執行上實現設計數據管理和與各種建築行業溝通。 本研究為輕型、大跨度及懸吊的屋頂結構開發了一種空間多變、運算驅動的建築設計方法，該方法結合了自動化建築數據提取，用於低技術的膠合木材生產。 由於對可持續發展的建築方案需求上升，以及木材產品的大規模生產，木材行業正在擴大（ARUP，2019）。 其中包括膠合木材—一種將實木分層處理再與防潮粘合劑粘合而成的結構工程木製品。 雖然針對其防火安全性能、堅固性和耐用性的研究尚在全球各地進行中，但要在建築的實踐上促進膠合木材的應用還需要其構造系統及建築設計的整合性進一步研究。 與傳統依賴直樑的結構相比，基於懸垂形狀的梁的結構大大減少了對建材的需求，因為懸鏈梁結構在純張力下運作，將效率低下的中性纖維排除在中心線範圍外，並消除屈曲變形的風險。然而，它們用膠合木材製造通常需要昂貴又不同的獨立定制硬件設置。兩項試驗研究透過找出一種能最大限度地減少所需的設置數量的方法，令製造過程更為簡單，從而確立了懸鏈膠合木結構的新機會：結構上的懸鏈樑的形狀和截面在運算過程上找出所需最低限度的調整，直到不同樑的組合能從單個可重複使用的夾具設置來製造（Wong and Crolla，2019 ；Crolla and Klisz，2020 ）。此提案將結構優化、建築幾何演化和工程木材建設的研究結合在一起，將先前的試驗研究再推進。 提案的初步模型將通過已改進的演算方法和更廣泛的架構設計解決方案空間中開發，並結合到更強大的數碼化設計和製造設置中。該空間將通過數碼和物理原型進行迭代測試。方法論的工作流程、適用性和多功能性，以及它的空間設計，將通過類型學分類概述在建築實踐中進行說明和總結。 通過促進建築師對能低技術地生產、空間多變的、輕量的、環保的木屋頂結構類型的理解，這項研究將有助於環境可持續的建築，並有助於減少建築行業的大量二氧化碳排放。

17608621.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17608621.value: 教導兒童審視臉孔方式是否有助他們臉孔識別能力？

17608621.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17608621.value: Prof Chan, Antoni B. Dr Palermo, Romina

17608621.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17608621.value: Face recognition is an essential social skill. In adults, individual differences in face recognition performance are associated with differences in face scanning pattern, with looking more at the eye region associated with better recognition performance. However, attempts to improve adults’ performance through face scanning training or other methods have been unsuccessful. This phenomenon may be because their preferred visual routines are inflexible to change. In contrast, children, as early learners, have less consistent face scanning patterns, and those who use a more consistent face scanning pattern have better recognition performance. Thus, it may be possible to improve children’s recognition performance by training them to adopt an optimal face scanning pattern. The proposed research will investigate whether training children with an optimal face scanning pattern derived from adults’ data and computational models facilitates their face recognition development. We hypothesize that children’s face scanning patterns continue to develop throughout childhood into adolescence and predict development in recognition performance. Thus, understanding the social-cognitive correlates of different face scanning patterns in children will help us identify children at risk of poor face processing development. We will then examine whether training sets them on a better developmental path. Since a suboptimal face scanning pattern may become inflexible to change later in life, as has been observed in adults, early identification of at-risk children and timely intervention are essential for their social wellbeing. We use a powerful approach of combining experimental and computational methodologies for this investigation. Experimentally, we examine developmental changes in children’s face scanning patterns, their relationships with recognition performance, and social-cognitive factors associated with this development, including autistic traits, executive function, and working memory abilities. Computationally, we use a novel unified learning model that simulates learning optimal face scanning patterns and perceptual representations simultaneously like humans. Thus, it provides possible information processing mechanisms underlying the observed effects. Based on these findings, we will identify children at risk of poor face processing development and examine whether training them to adopt an optimal face scanning pattern facilitates their development for face recognition. This project examines the development of face scanning patterns in children, an issue that has long been overlooked in the literature, as a window into a deeper understanding of face recognition difficulties. The findings will have significant implications for ways to facilitate face recognition in both healthy and clinical populations. The proposed interdisciplinary framework can be applied to other learning tasks, further increasing the impact. 臉孔辨識是一項基本社交技巧。成年人的臉孔辨識能力與臉孔審視的方式有關，專注在眼部範圍會有較好的臉孔辨識能力。但之前的研究嘗試利用臉孔審視方式訓練或其他方法來提升成年人的臉孔辨識能力都未能成功。這可能是由於成年人已經有自己固定的臉孔審視方式，而這些習慣的方式已難以改變。相比之下，作為早期學習者，兒童的臉孔審視方式還沒有固定，因此臉孔辨識能力待續提高。所以，通過訓練兒童採用最佳的臉孔審視方式，我們可能可以提升他們的臉孔辨識能力。 此研究計劃將利用成人數據和計算模型判斷最佳的臉孔審視方式，並且採用這些審視方式訓練兒童，觀察是否有助他們的臉孔辨識發展。我們假設兒童臉孔審視方式將繼續在成長中發展，預測他們在成年後的臉孔辨識能力。因此，了解兒童的不同臉孔審視方式以及社會認知的因素能夠幫助我們識別臉孔辨識能力較弱的兒童。此研究同時也探索訓練兒童是否有助於他們的成長及發展，並找出辨識能力較弱的兒童而在適當的時候提供緩助。 本研究將利用強大的實驗和計算方法去探討兒童臉孔審視方式。在實驗模式，我們會考究兒童臉孔審視方式的成長過程和他們與辨識能力的關係，以及其他社會認知的因素，例如自閉症特徵、執行功能和工作記憶能力。在計算模式，我們也會採用新穎的機器學習模型去展示出最佳的臉孔審視方式及知覺表徵。基於這些研究結果，我們會找出臉孔辨識能力較弱的兒童，並探討訓練兒童是否有助他們將來的臉孔審視的方法及發展。 由於現時的研究忽略兒童臉孔辨識的能力，本計劃將會探索兒童臉孔審視，並了解他們審視方式及其發展。相關研究結果不單會有助於健康與臨床人士，甚至可應用於其他跨領域的學習和研究，進一步增加影響力。

17608821.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17608821.value: 中國的私人治理：如何在無政府狀態下確保社會合作

17608821.label: Project Objectives

To develop an encompassing theory of private governance by integrating rational choice theory, game theory, socio-psychological theories of reputation and gossip, property rights theory, and signaling theory. To enhance our understanding of the diversity, complexity, and endogeneity of private order. To identify new directions for research and make policy recommendations to address government ineffectiveness in governance provision.

17608821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17608821.value: The aim of the proposed project is to develop an encompassing theory of private governance to enhance our understanding of the diversity, complexity, and endogeneity of private governance institutions in contemporary China. We will draw on several essential theories—socio-psychological theories on reputation and gossip, transaction cost theory, game theory, property rights theory, and signaling theory—to examine how private individuals, companies, and organizations enhance social cooperation in legal, semi-legal, and illegal markets. The project will adopt a multiple-case study design comprising four cases: trade secrets, small-property-right housing, online loan sharks, and corrupt exchanges. The PI and Co-I have already conducted 167 interviews, and will utilize previously established networks to conduct another 60. The primary research output will be a university press book, which will be the first English-language book focusing on private rules and mechanisms in authoritarian China. The project will, in general, contribute to the literature on Lawlessness and Economics, a significant topic in the field of Law and Economics. More specifically, it will add value to the study of how legitimate market actors secure cooperation and protect property in the shadow of the law. Its findings will also enhance our understanding of how private entrepreneurs in semi-legal and illegal markets avoid external risks brought by control agencies (e.g., the police and anti-corruption agencies) and handle internal conflicts caused by dishonest exchange participants without state law. 擬議項目的目的是發展一個包羅萬象的私人治理理論，以增強我們對當代中國私人治理機構的多樣性、複雜性和內生性的理解。我們將利用幾個基本理論——關於聲譽的社會心理學理論、交易成本理論、博弈論、產權理論和信號理論——來研究私人、公司和組織如何在合法、半合法市場和非法市場開展合作以及促進交易。該項目將採用多案例研究的設計，包括四個案例：商業秘密、小產權房、網絡高利貸和腐敗交易。 PI 和 Co-I 已經進行了 167 次採訪，並將利用先前建立的人際關係網絡進行另外 60 次採訪。主要研究成果將是一本學術專著，這將是第一本專注於中國社會的私人規則和機制的英文書籍。總的來說，該項目將為關於私人秩序的文獻做出貢獻，私人治理是法律和經濟學領域的一個重要主題。更具體地說，它將為合法市場參與者如何在法律的陰影下確保合作和保護財產的研究增加價值。其調查結果還將增強我們理解半合法和非法市場中的個體和私營企業家如何避免控制機構（例如警察和反腐敗機構）所帶來的外部風險以及處理由不誠實的交易者引起的內部衝突。

17609121.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17609121.value: 辨識社會性科學議題新聞: 科學本質之應用及價值

17609121.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17609121.value: Dr Barzilai, Sarit Dr Cheng, Maurice Man Wai

17609121.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17609121.value: 在以科學為主的社會，培養市民嚴謹地評估社會性科學議題的需要愈趨急切。這些議題通常涉及科學及道德論証，才能做出決定。認識科學的本質，能夠幫助理解和評估社會性科學議題。然而，過往研究較著重知識層面，並假設學生們能夠直接運用科學本質的知識，理解社會性科學議題，而忽略了這概念的價值面向。 這個研究將會1) 重新把科學的本質這個概念嵌入教學實踐，而非只是知識；2) 檢視學生們在評估社會性科學議題新聞時，置入的價值。 此研究每年會邀請120位報讀了有關社會性科學議題的課程的大學本科生，參與一個為期12週的課程。此研究為期共兩年，並採用混合研究。這些學生會被分成兩組，一組的教學以實踐為本，另一組則以知識為本。當中兩組學生皆會a) 評估社會性科學議題新聞，b) 反思他們在評估有關新聞時所用的準則，c) 撰寫評估的草議，d) 進行面談以及e) 進行小組討論。數據會在教學前，教學後，及教學一段時間後收集，而這些數據，會用以比較兩組的分別。第二年的結果會用作完善理論及教學框架。此研究有望促進科學的本質及社會性科學議題的相關課程及教學實踐。

17609321.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17609321.value: 為神經適應性研究開發基於 EEG 的瞬時神經反饋系統

17609321.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17609321.value: Dr Dien, Joseph Dr Lorenz, Romy

17609321.label: Project Objectives
17609321.value: To develop an instantaneous neural feedback (INF) system based on brain responses. One way to assess cognitive states is to observe the patterns of neural activation in response to external stimuli. The brain’s response pattern has been shown to reflect the cognitive process more precisely than the spontaneous activity, which contains more irrelevant activity and heterogeneous components. However, obtaining a reliable brain response pattern to a specific stimulus requires a highly complex routine comprising design, set-up, and sophisticated offline processing, typically costing hours of labor. Conventional cognitive research segregates raw data collection and data processing into two organizationally independent endeavors. The aim of this project is to develop and validate a system that can reliably obtain various aspects of brain response patterns in an instantaneous manner. The instantaneously obtained brain response patterns will then serve as indicators of cognitive states, providing feedback to support innovative research or practices, e.g., allowing the development of neuroadaptive research paradigms. The features of the instantaneously obtained brain response patterns will include average event-related potentials (ERPs), latency-jitter-corrected ERPs, trial-to-trial brain response variability, and event-related spectral perturbation. These multifaceted brain response features will be integrated into the system and visualized in a user-friendly way. To validate the utility and effectiveness of the INF system in neurocognitive researches that incorporate neuroadaptive paradigms. In the majority of conventional neurocognitive research paradigms, neither the participants nor experimenters have access to the pattern of brain responses during data collection, as preprocessing requires a high degree of sophistication. There are several disadvantages to the segregation of online data collection and offline processing and analysis, one of which is that it does not allow neuroadaptive experiments to be conducted. For example, it would be interesting to know how feedback of a participant’s own brain response modulates top-down attentional control, which may affect subsequent cognitive processes, or how it might enhance cognitive and learning processes. Therefore, a system capable of providing both instantaneous and reliable neural feedback would have profound significance, although it would need to undergo a strict and thorough process of validation before it could be used in scientific research. To demonstrate the validity, feasibility, and benefits of brain response pattern-based neural feedback in neurocognitive research, we will design strictly controlled experiments. The first experiment will use cognitive task paradigms to investigate the effects of neural feedback on cognitive processing, and the second will examine how reliable the brain response pattern indicates cognitive load in real time. To apply a Bayesian optimization framework for searching individually optimal experimental parameters to maximize the stimulus-evoked neural response characterized by event-related potentials. The relationships between the features of a stimulus input and the brain’s response are extremely intricate and high-dimensional. In sharp contrast, the scope of a conventional, strictly controlled cognitive experiment is extremely narrow, meaning that such experiments have limited efficacy and efficiency in revealing complex brain-stimulus relationships and their underlying mechanisms. Bayesian optimization offers an efficient way of making inferences about stimulus-brain response relationships based on active data sampling in an online mode, which requires online data acquisition of brain response patterns. Therefore, one of the advantages of building the INF system is to enable the application of a Bayesian optimization framework to leverage neuroadaptive research, which is one of the major objectives of the proposed project. Another obstacle in neuroimaging-based cognitive research is the individual differences in brain-stimulus relationships, which leads to difficulties in analyzing the results using simple methods that assume a high level of cross-subject homogeneity. In this regard, the Bayesian framework will also be applied to efficiently search the individually optimal parameters to generate the strongest neural response activation, which may help to tackle the issue of individual differences in cognitive research that examines between-group effects. To provide training for researchers to help them to acquire the knowledge and skills needed to conduct neuroadaptive research. At a late stage of the project, the intellectual materials collected will be assembled and organized for educational purposes, i.e., to train researchers in the theoretical and technical aspects of conducting research studies based on neuroadaptive paradigms. The intellectual materials will include the theoretical fundamentals of neuroadaptive research, the principles of the methodologies concerned, the structure of the system and data-processing pipelines, and the training data. Theme-focused training workshops will be organized to conduct the training activities.

17609321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17609321.value: The use of brain signals to study mental processes has a century of history behind it. Recent years have seen rapid advances in neuroscientific technologies for investigating mind-brain relationships, offering improved convenience and accuracy in brain signal aquisition. However, the relationship between brain signals and mental states remains fuzzy in many domains, owing in large part to the overwhelming complexity of brain signals. Scientific studies focusing on mind-brain relationships face major challenges in tackling of high-level complexity using simplistic designs and approaches. These challenges are partially rooted in the complexity of the procedures for extracting accurate information about mental processes, which require highly specialized expertise and settings and are too time-consuming for efficient study of complex relationships. The most cutting-edge approach designed to quickly assess the mental states are Brain Computer Interfaces (BCI). However, they are mainly focused on exploiting major signal variations to exert control rather than focusing on complex mental states that are not easily revealed by noisy brain signals. The ability to instantaneously and accurately extract brain activity patterns related to specific mental processes would have profound significance: 1) providing straightforward information on how the brain responds to various inputs, thereby boosting the efficiency of experimental piloting, investigation, and quality control, and 2) enabling the development of research paradigms or practices that utilize brain signals as instantaneous feedback to form an optimization loop (e.g., the optimization of cognitive processes or experimental designs). We propose to develop and combine cutting-edge methods to address the major obstacles in signal processing and design and to establish a system for the instantaneous extraction of brain response signals to monitor mental states based on electroencephalography (EEG). First, mental states will be evaluated by the multifaceted features of the instantaneously collected EEG signals. Second, we will test the capacity of the system in developing neuroadaptive research paradigms that use online brain acitivities as reliable feedback that will interact with ongoing mental processes. Finally, a Bayesian optimization-based search of individually optimal experimental parameters will be developed to demonstrate the system’s power for studying the complexity of mind-brain relationships. The proposed system development, which will focus primarily on pipelining, automatization, and validation based on strictly controlled experiments, is expected to prepare for the advent of convenient neural signal acquisition facilities and speed up the scientific investigation and industrial applications in brain-based life enhancement. 使用大腦信號來研究心理過程已有一個世紀的歷史。近年來，用於研究心智與腦關係的神經科學技術取得了快速發展，提高了大腦信號採集的便利性和準確性。然而，大腦信號與精神狀態之間的關係在許多領域仍然模糊不清，很大程度上是由於大腦信號極其複雜。專注於心智與腦關係的科學研究多數使用簡單的設計和方法，這些方法在處理高度複雜系統面臨重大挑戰。這些挑戰部分源於提取有關心理過程的準確信息的程序的複雜性，主要體現在需要高度專業化的專業知識和設置，對於復雜關係的有效研究過於耗時。在快速評估心理狀態的最前沿方法是腦機接口 (BCI)。然而，此領域主要專注於利用信號變化來施加控制，而不是專注於從嘈雜的大腦信號中揭示複雜心理狀態。即時準確地提取與特定心理過程相關的大腦活動具有下列深遠的意義：1) 提供有關大腦如何對各種輸入做出反應的直接信息，從而提高實驗研究調查和質量控制的效率； 2 ) 能夠開發利用大腦信號作為即時反饋來形成優化循環的研究範式或實踐（例如，優化認知過程或實驗設計）。我們計劃開發和結合尖端方法來解決信號處理和設計中的主要障礙，並建立一個基於腦電圖 (EEG) 的即時提取大腦反應信號以監測心理狀態的系統。首先，精神狀態將通過瞬時收集的 EEG 信號的多方面特徵進行評估。其次，我們將測試系統在開發神經適應性研究範式方面的能力，這些範式使用在線大腦活動作為與正在進行的心理過程相互作用的可靠反饋。最後，我們將開發基於貝葉斯優化的最佳實驗參數搜索，以證明該系統在研究心智與腦關係的能力。擬開發的系統將主要基於嚴格控制實驗的流程、自動化和驗證，有望為將來的神經信號採集便捷設施的出現做好準備，並加速基於大腦特徵的生命增益方面的科學研究和工業應用。

Document the similarities and differences in the views of women and men from different generations and from different backgrounds on (i) son preference; (ii) the value of girls’ education; and (iii) government-funded programmes that focus on enhancing early childhood development.
