27606721.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27606721.value: 我的項目旨在通過跨越英美和日本話語的跨國視角，以酷兒理論和女性主義的視角，對當代日本的女性寫作提出新的方法。關於日本女作家的學術研究往往強調男性主導的文學典籍中 "女權主義 "女作家的貢獻。然而，隨著20世紀80年代末日本女作家的急劇增加，需要對她們在文學機構中的角色進行多樣化的理解，找到對性別和性的細微分析，從而產生新的女權主義的可能性。 我的項目研究了女性在日常生活中的場景--享受食物、做家務、在鄰里間散步--包括吉本芭娜娜、川上弘美、江國香織、川上美惠子和村田沙耶加等日本女性作家在1980年後的小說中的場景。我認為，對與女性和家庭相關的日常的低級方面的關注--例如重複、常規、瑣碎、舒適、家、鄰里--揭示了一條路徑，可以有效地重新審視女性主義和同性戀研究中激進和規範的界限。從歷史上看，這些領域與女性化的、私人化的日常有一種麻煩的關係，由於其作為性別主義、異性戀版本的家庭的地位，被認為是非政治的和傳統的。然而，這種偏見排除了對世俗經驗中的性別和性的複雜性的緊急調查形式。作為回應，我研究了迄今為止在日本文學的討論中基本沒有涉及的日常背景，特別是對親密關係和情感（情緒）的描寫，描述了女性同社會和同性關係的脆弱或不可能。 我的項目借鑒了英美同性戀和女權主義的情感理論，這些理論最近才通過日語學術研究引入日本。雖然這些理論引起了人們的興趣，但由於缺乏翻譯，它們在很大程度上只被日本的英國文學或美國研究的學者所了解。關於日本女作家的日語研究顯示，普遍缺乏同性戀的方法。同時，在英美的日本研究中，同性戀的學術研究往往轉向以男性同性社會/同性戀表現和歷史為中心的方法。我的專著將在關於女作家的日語學術研究和英美同性戀和女權主義影響理論之間架起一座橋樑，提供一個參與女性同社會性和同性戀的獨特視角，而我的文章將探討與我研究的作者有關的女性寫作、女權主義和翻譯的最新跨國流動。

27606721.label: Realisation of objectives
27606721.value: Below, I summarize my realization of objectives with my project. In general, I did not experience serious obstacles in terms of making progress with my research. However, due to changes in my research direction over the course of the project, there was some deviation from achieving the original objectives. Objective 1: To contribute queer feminist research on Japanese women writers receiving limited attention in English-language research. In the form of a book monograph and article, my project on Japan will offer new perspectives from outside of an Anglocentric framework for English-language queer studies. Also, I will disseminate knowledge of these writers through a monthly podcast and public talks for general audiences. I decided to disseminate my research on Japanese women writers from this project largely in the form of articles submitted to top interdisciplinary English-language academic journals related to my research interests. This research will act as the stepping stone for my upcoming GRF project (application submitted during 2023-2024 cycle), which includes a book monograph. In terms of dissemination of knowledge of these writers, I discovered that it was less than ideal given my research, teaching, and administrative duties to take on the task of creating a monthly podcast. However, I indeed gave numerous public talks for audiences in Hong Kong, Taiwan, the United Kingdom, and the United States over the course of my research, which generated greater interest in the authors of my study. Objective 2: To promote knowledge of prominent Anglo-American queer and feminist theories of affect and the everyday that are largely unutilized in both English- and Japanese-language scholarship on Japanese literature. In addition to my English-language monograph, article, and presentations, I plan to give a series of Japanese-language talks for literary and activist communities dedicated to feminist and LGBTQ issues in Japan. Compared with dissemination of my research in English, Japanese-language dissemination of research proved relatively difficult for me. This issue can be explained by the number of public talks that I gave on an international level in places outside of Japan. In addition, my research took a transnational turn where it became advantageous for me to conduct Chinese-language research in Taiwan and connect with scholars there. Nonetheless, I did present my research at the Cultural Typhoon conference in Tokyo, Japan, in 2022, which was a bilingual conference using Japanese and English. I have also planned an upcoming public lecture at Waseda University that will possibly be bilingual in an attempt to increase accessibility for academic and other communities based in Japan. Objective 3: To use a queer approach to fill in a gap in research on female homosocial and homoerotic relations in Japanese literature, complicating existing scholarship on gender that tends to assume a homogeneous female reading community centered on Japanese women’s writing. Moreover, existing queer scholarship in Japanese studies often deals with male homosocial and homoerotic relations. My research has consistently pushed the boundaries of thinking in terms of queer approaches in Japanese studies. During my project period, I worked on writing and presentations that offered a unique queer feminist approach to examining Japanese literature. My work was further innovative in drawing from queer women of color feminisms—theories and writing by racial minority women in the United States and elsewhere—to apply thoughtfully to Japanese and Asian contexts. Objective 4: To complicate expectations concerning the “feminist” nature of literary production by Japanese women. Attention to Japanese women writers often takes the form of canonization premised on their critique of gender and sexual norms. Instead, I focus on making visible sexist biases in both intellectual and popular discourses related to aspects of the everyday associated with women, such as conventionality, routine, lack of progress, and the trivial. I was successful in accomplishing this objective in terms of reframing the feminism of Japanese women writers. While my focus on the everyday was partly sacrificed for other research directions involving the transnational, my newer focus did extremely well at suggesting new and innovative ways of considering the contributions of women writers of Japanese literature. To date, most literary scholarship on Japanese women writers still considers them in the context of Japanese national culture; in contrast, I began to explore ways of reading their works through the lens of other Asian and diasporic contexts in order to find meaning going beyond the nation. Objective 5: To touch upon related developments in Japan surrounding transnational flows of women’s writing, feminisms, and translation. Research findings from my article will inform my promotion of women’s literary voices through new networks of translators, writers, readers, activists, and scholars in Japan and Hong Kong. As my project developed, this objective became the most crucial focus, serving as the material for multiple public lectures, conference presentations, and article manuscripts, as well as my tentatively planned upcoming GRF project. Japanese feminism and women’s writing have become increasingly intertwined with transnational feminist politics through a rising number of translations from English, Korean, and other languages. My research is disseminated in three languages—English, Japanese, and Chinese—making me well positioned to comment upon these contemporary developments. In particular, my research on authors such as Li Kotomi and Ocean Vuong—whose texts have recently been circulated in these three languages—breaks new ground in considering reception and genre across transnational contexts for feminist and queer literature.

27606721.label: Major findings and research outcome
27606721.value: My research project allowed me to discover the possibilities of increased innovative engagement with interdisciplinary contexts when conducting research in Japanese literary and cultural studies. While my original objectives were more concerned with bilateral engagement between Anglophone queer studies and Japanese literature, I eventually expanded the scope of my project to consider the potential of queer and feminist theories and literature circulated between three languages (English, Japanese, Chinese) in a much broader transnational context. My numerous public lectures and conference presentations—in Japan, Taiwan, the United Kingdom, and the United States—resulted in feedback from diverse audiences of colleagues and students, contributing greatly to my sense of the relevance of my research across multiple cultural contexts. While I had previously limited myself to issues of English- and Japanese-language cultural exchange, I now conclude that such a framework is limiting and indeed inaccurate when it comes to tracing transnational flows of theories and literary texts. Now, I have a vision of Japanese literary studies that is more subtly defined by the transnational, regional connections, postcolonial histories, and multilingualism when it comes to examining the impact of feminist and queer thinking and writing.

27606721.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
27606721.value: The ECS project will serve as an excellent jumping point for additional research in the future, which I have outlined in my 2023-2024 GRF application. This proposed upcoming project is titled “Reenvisioning Japanese Literary Studies through the ‘Minor-to- Minor’: Women Writers, Queer Feminisms, and Marginalized Voices across Transnational Asian Contexts” and greatly enlarges the scope of my research up to this point. While it involves continued research on a few writers of my ECS project, it recontextualizes the work of these writers in transnational Asian and Asian diasporic contexts. Furthermore, given the contemporary nature of my research, I plan for future research to incorporate interviews with literary authors, translators, and other community members to be interwoven with my analysis of texts and historical/cultural contexts.

27606721.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
27606721.value: My ECS project has increased visibility for Japanese women writers on an international scale involving English-, Japanese-, and Chinese-speaking contexts, particularly through numerous public lectures and conference presentations given in the United States, the United Kingdom, Japan, and Taiwan. In addition, my queer feminist approach has offered unique ways of understanding these writers—instead of viewing them solely from the perspective of Japanese national culture, I have suggested the importance of reflecting upon increased meanings that texts take on when traveling across borders and languages in terms of how they circulate feminist and queer discourses. Japanese literary studies has historically been cautious in terms of applying critical theory to the analysis of Japanese texts. However, I have argued that, in the highly transnational world we live in, it is absolutely relevant to “translate” theories from U.S.-based and other contexts in order to understand Japanese literature, feminisms, and queer politics in meaningful ways. This project focused on analysis of literary works by women writers of Japanese literature that innovatively applied queer and feminist theories and queer women of color feminisms in ways highly unusual within Japanese literary studies.

27607321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27607321.value: The proposed project will study the determinants of national identity in Malaysia, a country plagued by rampant ethnic politics and a weak national identity where, despite its salience, little is known as to the deeper roots behind these phenomena. Based on preliminary fieldwork and socio-anthropological literature I hypothesize that observed rural ethnic segregation between the Chinese and Malays could be a key determinant and I test this hypothesis by leveraging on plausibly exogenous variation in segregation arising from a large-scale British resettlement policy (1949-1952). Termed the New Village program, this program resettled nearly 500,000 rural ethnic Chinese squatters to cutoff support for Chinese communist insurgents. Many ethnic Chinese continue to live in these village camps today. Hence, I will conduct a large-scale retrospective survey of non-camp village residents to investigate the causal effects of segregation on national identity and attendant mechanisms. To measure the relative strength between ethnic and national identification, I will ask respondents to self-rank identities and use Implicit Association Tests to capture implicit biases. I will also ask about linguistic proficiency and preferences, a key marker of national identity in Malaysia. As auxiliary outcomes, I will measure attitudes such as inter-ethnic trust and preferences for marriage and residence. Existing literature and fieldwork suggests that changes in the frequency and scope of inter-group contact is likely to be a key mechanism. Survey measures will allow me to identify these changes in contact and the mechanisms that might drive them including (i) segregation in schools or workplaces, (ii) interethnic inequality in state resources, and (iii) interethnic competition. To identify causality, I will construct and use optimal distance measures to counterfactual camps as an instrumental variable for inter-group contact. Specifically, for each existing Chinese camp, I use known British military criteria and historical maps to select “optimal” site location from the universe of all possible sites. Differences in contact arising from plausibly more exogenous camp placement helps to rule out potential endogeneity concerns. To the best of my knowledge, this is the first quantitative study of the determinants of identity in Malaysia. Hence, it will provide key insights for policy-makers seeking to improve social cohesion. Academically, it bridges a gap between macro, cross-country studies and small N micro-level studies of contact. Both studies have both found a negative impact of ethnic diversity on economic development but long-term impacts and linkages between the two are unclear. 这个研究将会探讨国家认同感背后的决定因素。马来西亚是个多元种族的国家，不以为然的，从独立以来，群分政治是个普遍的现象。这个现象对马来西亚人的国家认同感造成了什么样的影响？如果影响是负面的话，政策者又能用什么方式舒缓这些影响？ 根据初步的田野调查，我将会探讨其中的因素之一：马来西亚农村地区的种族隔阂。因英国殖民地政府的移置计划而起（1949-1952），这个命名为新村计划的政策把500,000住在农村地区的华裔移置到550个新村。到现在，大多数的这些华裔还居留在这些新村地区。 为了探讨这个计划对于国家身份认同的影响，我将会在多个新村举办回顾性调查。为了衡量种族身份认同和国家身份认同之间的相对强度，我将会请受访者做自我评价和回答相关的问卷问题。 我也将会收集相关的语言和居住态度资料。这些资料将会让我很密切的测试种族隔阂在什么情况下会影响到国家身份认同

27607921.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27607921.value: Anxiety and fear-related disorders are among the most prevalent mental disorders, affecting up to one-third of the population according to large population-based surveys. Affected individuals suffer significant distress and reduced quality of life, while associated high health-care utilization and lost productivity place a significant economic burden upon society. Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is an efficacious and empirically supported intervention for fear-related and anxiety disorders, and extinction learning is considered the key process contributing to fear reduction during treatment. However, the overall CBT response rates are only about 50 % and dropout rates are high. It is therefore important to find strategies to optimize the mechanisms underlying extinction learning in order to achieve better treatment adherence and outcomes. The proposed research seeks to identify psychological interventions for modulating maladaptive fear responses by harnessing visual unawareness in the process of extinction learning. This novel perspective is motivated by a growing body of scientific studies in the consciousness domain indicating that fear learning and extinction might be implicit; in other words, taking place outside of conscious awareness. Building on pilot data acquired from the PI’s laboratory, the applicant proposes three studies to further examine the physiological and neural mechanisms underlying these processes. Study 1 will investigate whether experimentally induced fear can be modulated effectively outside of visual awareness using a binocular rivalry technique called continuous flash suppression (CFS). Pupil responses and skin conductance responses will be employed to identify the psychophysiological mechanisms underlying implicit extinction. Study 2 will examine the neural mechanisms of fear modulation during implicit extinction using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), with specific emphasis on the interactions between traditionally identified areas in the fear network and a newly proposed pre-cortical area: the pons. Study 3 seeks to further the potential clinical implication of implicit extinction by testing whether implicit extinction as an intervention will modulate fear responses and intrusive memories related to an experimentally induced trauma. Understanding the psychophysiological and neural mechanisms underlying implicit fear extinction will provide important insights about how information of which humans are perceptually unaware might help reduce maladaptive fear. The proposed research will have translational implications for the treatments of pathological fear found in anxiety disorders such as specific phobia and social anxiety disorder, and stress-related disorders such as post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). 27608921.value: 嬰幼兒到 12 個月大時在玩具選擇偏好上就表現出性別差異，例如男孩偏好玩具車，女孩則偏好洋娃娃。到 24 個月大時，兒童在肢體攻擊行為和表達性詞彙發展上表現出明顯的性別差異 —— 男孩更具攻擊性，而女孩則會使用更多詞彙。這些在早期就出現的性別差異有著跨越不同發展階段的長期影響，兒童對跨性別遊戲的強烈偏好與其性別認同困難之間的關聯便是其中一例。而且，青少年犯罪和語言困難在男性之間更為普遍，這在男女早期發展階段的肢體攻擊行為和表達詞彙量上是有跡可循。因此，研究早期發展階段的性別差異及其根源將有助了解一系列發展議題。數以千計的動物實驗表示，關鍵期的睪酮水平對及後男女行為特徵差異有長期和連續性的影響。人類嬰兒出生後的 1-3 個月，睪酮水平會大幅提升，這段時間亦常被視作產後關鍵期。有些研究曾嘗試探討嬰兒1-3 個月大時的睪酮水平及其後的玩具偏好、肢體攻擊行為和表達性詞彙發展之間的關聯。然而，這些研究都只依靠父母報告來了解兒童行為表現，部分研究更並未直接測量睪酮水平。而且，這些研究並未考慮如父母影響等社會心理因素，但早期性別差異卻有機會是由父母對性别遊戲行為的社會化、嚴厲教養、言語輸入促成。是項研究將是首個探討嬰兒睪酮水平和父母因素是否，以及如何共同，影響兒童早期階段中的性別差異的縱貫研究。研究將招募500 名兒童，並進行為期約 2 年的觀察。在參加者為 1-3 個月大時，研究團隊將收集他們的唾液樣本以測量睾酮水平 (時間點1)。通過父母提交的報告和在實驗室的觀察，研究團隊將在參加者約 12 個月大時測量其玩具偏好(時間點2)，並在參加者約 24個月大時測量其肢體攻擊行為和表達性詞彙發展(時間點3)。研究團隊在時間點1、2和3均會透過父母報告和實驗室觀察測量父母對性别遊戲行為的社會化、嚴厲教養、言語輸入這三項父母因素。是項研究結果將空前地為一系列與性別相關的辯論以及實踐提供嶄新依據。研究結果亦有助了解嬰兒睪酮水平能否被視作犯罪風險和語言困難的生物標記，以及親子教育如何左右嬰兒時期荷爾蒙帶來的影響。

27611921.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27611921.value: 技高藝廣：盛清揚州的戲曲表演與城市文化（1736-1820）

27611921.label: Project Objectives
27611921.value: To examine the questions concerning profession, identity, aesthetic taste and knowledge culture in High Qing Yangzhou performance culture, by exploring the practice or discourse of performers, literati playwrights and scholars in Yangzhou. To investigate the production mode of Yangzhou drama in relation to salt merchants and the reception of the emperor, thereby identifying the characteristics and ramifications of Yangzhou performance culture. To examine how High Qing drama went beyond the literary traditions of lyrics and indoctrination and developed into a genre characterized by performability, techniques and appreciatability. To illuminate the understudied question pertaining to the craft and voice of actors from the perspectives of social, cultural and intellectual history. To shed light on how the Confucian question concerning “techniques versus Dao” was revisited in the discourses on drama and therefor explore the new trends of literature, art and intellectual thought in Qing China.

27611921.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27611921.value: During the period of High Qing (1736-1820), Yangzhou played an important role in the shaping of the developments of various drama genres, performance skills, script styles and dramatic theories. The performance of a number of “excerpts” (折子戲) in Kunqu Opera was meticulously refined in High Qing Yangzhou. Besides, the Huizhou troupes recruited by Yangzhou merchants to celebrate the birthday of Emperor Qianlong in Beijing held ramifications for the later development of Peking Opera. High Qing Yangzhou also left a rich legacy of dozens of playscripts and several seminal monographs on the theory of drama. The prosperity of economic and cultural consumption in eighteenth-century Yangzhou, along with the influence of salt merchants and the royal taste, contributed to the formation of Yangzhou culture of drama. Many plays were commissioned for the reception of Emperor Qianlong or for entertainments in the gardens in Yangzhou. For the literati, playwriting was not just a medium of self-expression or indoctrination, which was the mainstream literary tradition of Ming-Qing literati drama, but also a means of livelihood. For the actors, Yangzhou became a city where they could gain recognition, either by presenting their skills to the emperor, high-ranked officials and rich merchants or by winning popularity among the public. This project investigates the production and discourse of Yangzhou drama by integrating various approaches in the studies of Chinese drama, culture history and intellectual history. With a focus on the relation between “Techniques and Dao,” I will examine the question of “craftsmanship” in the profession, techniques, aesthetic taste and knowledge culture of High Qing drama. Through a nuanced analysis of playscripts, monographs on the theories of drama, as well as city guidebooks, my research addresses how the urban culture of Yangzhou influenced the production mode of drama, how actors’ sense of their own crafts and profession was changed, how literati playwrights repositioned their writings and roles, and how Li Dou and the intellectuals of the Yangzhou School viewed drama and revisited the question concerning crafts. The study of Yangzhou dramatic performance will cast new light on the “craft” of Chinese drama, which can serve as a window to view various aspects and new trends of literature, art and intellectual thought of Qing China. This project will also create a cross-disciplinary dialogue with scholars in the history of urban culture, material culture and art. 在中國戲曲史上，盛清時期（1736-1820）的揚州曾扮演過重要地位。揚州不僅見證崑曲表演藝術的登峰造極時刻；揚州鹽商為乾隆祝壽而選派的「徽班進京」，更直接影響京劇的誕生。在文本生產方面，揚州也留下一批劇本及數部重要的曲論著作。可以說，盛清揚州劇壇對清代戲曲的劇種、表演技藝、文本風格及戲曲理論之發展，均產生了深遠影響。 十八世紀揚州強大的經濟與消費能力，以及鹽政、鹽商與皇家主導塑造的城市文化，是盛清揚州演劇高度繁榮的重要背景。為滿足清代帝后的戲曲喜好，兩淮鹽商不僅精心招募戲班，更專門聘養文人創作劇本，以供迎鑾或祝嘏之用。在這種城市文化背景下，戲曲創作不再只是文人用以「抒情」或「載道」的途徑，更成為其謀生技藝；劇本也發展出偏重表演性、技術性的風格傾向。與此同時，伶人亦憑藉技藝顯名於揚州。他們不僅獻技於帝王、高官、富商，也直接參與文人的劇本創製，甚至開始把自身的技藝與行業知識化、理論化。「技高藝廣」既是當時伶人著作中的自我期許，也恰是理解揚州戲曲與城市文化的關鍵。 本計畫結合戲曲戲、文化史與思想史的研究路徑，系統討論盛清揚州的戲曲實踐與論述。通過細緻分析揚州的劇本、戲曲論著及城市書寫等一系列文本，本計畫旨在以「技藝」作為關鍵詞，探析伶人、文人戲曲家、學者等不同群體在謀生方式、技藝認同、審美觀念、知識視野等方面的新動向。具體而言，本研究涉及一系列問題，包括揚州城市文化如何影響劇本的生產模式與風格，文人戲曲家如何重新調整其寫作姿態，伶人的技藝認同如何轉變，揚州學者如何看待素來被視為「末技」的戲曲，以及傳統的儒家「道－技」關係是否被重新論述。 中國戲曲表演的高度技藝性日益受到重視，但綜合考量表演美學、劇本文學、曲學理論、城市文化的系統研究尚很少見。本計畫採用跨學科的研究進路，探討清代揚州演劇與城市文化之互動，以及由此折射出的文學、藝術與思想文化新動向，期能與明清藝術史、物質文化史、城市史等領域之研究成果互相對話。

27613921.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27613921.value: Cancer-related fatigue (CRF) is the most distressful symptom among cancer patients and is nearly universal in those undergoing chemotherapy, which in some cases may lead to treatment interruption or discontinuation. Aerobic exercise is the most recommended non-pharmacological strategy for CRF. However, implementation can be limited by the low motivation of fatigued individuals to exercise. Self-administered acupressure is emerging as a promising new strategy for reducing CRF in post-treatment disease-free cancer survivors, but it has not yet been tested rigorously among patients receiving chemotherapy. While both exercise and acupressure are inexpensive and safe self-management strategies that may alleviate CRF, acupressure is less energy demanding and more convenient to practice, and thus may be feasible and acceptable for a wider range of patients experiencing CRF. To date, no study has examined the equivalence of self-administered acupressure and exercise for reducing CRF. If acupressure’s effects are shown to be equivalent to those of exercise on CRF, patients undergoing cancer treatment can be offered an alternative strategy that is potentially applicable for a wide range of patients experiencing CRF. The primary aim of this randomized controlled equivalence trial is to examine whether a self-administered acupressure intervention leads to a post-intervention improvement in CRF equivalent to aerobic exercise. A total of 138 breast cancer patients scheduled to undergo chemotherapy are randomized to an exercise or acupressure group. Both interventions last 12 weeks, i.e., covering the first four chemotherapy cycles. Participants of both groups attend a 90-minute instructional session before the chemotherapy starts. Then, the exercise group participate in a home-based walking program targeting to achieve 90 minutes of moderate intensity aerobic exercise per week, while the acupressure group self-administer acupressure for 8-10 minutes daily. A follow-up session is conducted one week after the intervention commences to reinforce home practice. The primary outcome is CRF, as measured by the Brief Fatigue Inventory, which is administered before the chemotherapy starts, post-intervention (primary endpoint), and one month after the end of all chemotherapy cycles. The secondary outcomes include sleep disturbance, activity levels, quality of life, return to work after chemotherapy, chemotherapy completion, and adherence. The quantitative findings are supplemented by qualitative evaluation about the acceptability and perceived benefits of acupressure. Knowledge of the equivalence of aerobic exercise and acupressure for relieving CRF has important clinical implications that could allow practitioners to target recommendations on the basis of patient preference for a particular type of self-care management.

27614021.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27614021.value: 研究背景：香港殘疾人士的勞動力參與率和工作保留率繼續偏低，心理健康和福祉也更差。自我污名理論亦已被提出以解釋殘疾人士不良心理和行為結果的差距 (可力根等, 2009; 可力根和列, 2012) 。 自我污名理論認為，雖然公眾對殘疾人的歧視確實存在，但正是這些負面刻板印象的內在化導致心理健康和生活質量下降 (陳, 麥, & 林2020) 。儘管新興研究表明消極的人際交往等社會過程會導致自我污名化（皮可等人，2017 年），但很少有人關注研究積極的工作經驗如何有助於減少自我污名，以及促進殘疾人士的心理健康。此外，很少有研究確定如何設計工作場所環境以促進有意義的工作並減少殘疾人士員工的自我污名（辛達等，2018）。 目的：基於主研究者之前對有意義工作的研究（徐等，2019），這個為期 30 個月的提案檢驗了有意義的工作、自我污名和心理健康之間的理論聯繫；設計一個有利於有意義工作的工作環境，並減少香港視障人士的自我恥辱感。 研究重點：本研究有三個目標 (1) 檢驗有意義的工作對視力障礙人士心理健康的影響； (2) 檢驗自我污名在有意義的工作和視力障礙者心理健康之間的中介作用； (3) 設計一個有利於有意義工作的工作環境，並減少視障人士的自我恥辱感。 研究方法：本研究採用序貫混合方法研究。在研究的第一階段，將對 18 至 64 歲的視力障礙人士（n=577）進行包括標準化測量在內的橫斷面調查。四階段結構方程模型將用於測試提出的概念模型。在第二階段的研究中，將有 40 名參與者通過設計思維進行參與式行動研究。設計思維研討會產生的數據將使用主題分析進行分析。 研究含義：研究結果將有助於建立有意義的工作、自我污名和視力障礙者的心理健康之間的理論聯繫。調查結果還將為未來工作環境的設計和有利於殘疾人有意義的工作和心理健康的干預措施提供信息。

27614321.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27614321.value: 反殖民社會學：從活力論到萬隆的「亞洲-非洲」

27614321.label: Project Objectives
27614321.value: The primary goal of this research project is to expand our understanding, both aesthetically and historically, of anticolonial writing across the Global South in the twentieth century. This project re-situates anticolonial writing in its historical context, and with its original interlocutors: social scientific theory, political theory, and literary modernism. It thus connects the US with the Third World activism. The project thus challenges the common notion that certain types of writing possess no aesthetic merit; in this case, anticolonial writing from the Global South, and sociological writing from the early twentieth century. Anticolonial thought has been seen as dully pragmatic or flatly political. Sociological thought has been treated as academic or as potentially theoretical. In both cases, scholars have heretofore missed the aesthetic and political commitments that are implicit in the text. This project corrects this scholarly omission. The project will intervene in multiple disciplinary debates, and will be valuable to scholars working across multiple fields. This includes, in the first instance, debates about postcolonial literature; debates about ‘world literature’; and the circulation of texts between the Global North and the Global South. This includes the history of sociology; the history of anticolonial, decolonial, and postcolonial activism; and the history of Third World solidarity movements during the Cold War. The project’s most significant long-term outcome will be a book-length monograph that offers the first sustained analysis of political thought in the Global South, across the twentieth century. The monograph, tentatively titled Anticolonial Sociology: ‘Afro-Asia’ from Vitalism to Solidarity, has been already been solicited by Fordham University Press and Cambridge University Press. I will write and submit one academic essay, taken from my research on sociological critique, to PMLA, one of the leading journals in my field. I expect to submit this essay in March 2022. In addition to these two primary research outputs, this project will also result in the production of an anthology, Theory and Criticism from the Global South, already under contract with Bloomsbury Press. The research I will conduct for this project will make available, in many cases for the first time, political and aesthetic writing from South Asia, Africa, and East Asia.

27614321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27614321.value: Anticolonial Sociology reveals how Black and Asian activists in the early twentieth-century used what W.E.B. Du Bois called the ‘hesitant’ field of sociology to imagine new anticolonial and decolonial political communities. Through close literary analysis, this project demonstrates that the most vibrant theories of Afro-Asian solidarity were indebted to the shared conjuncture of Anglo-American sociology, anticolonial thought, and postcolonial politics formed as a collaboration between Black and Asian thinkers and the Anglo-American academy. Simultaneously, the project reveals that the most innovative sociologists in the early twentieth century were thinkers from the colonised world who used the field to theorise decolonisation half a century later. The project maps the persistence of sociological theory within anticolonial thought over the course of these sixty years, and recuperates the ‘sociological imagination’ at the centre of Afro-Asian connections. It is more than a mere coincidence that the most notable anticolonial and anti-racist agitators in the Indian Ocean region all received degrees in the social sciences from universities in the United States at the beginning of the twentieth century. Jawaharlal Nehru, future prime minister of India, received a degree in political science; W.E.B. Du Bois, the famous Black thinker, received degrees in sociology; Kwame Nkrumah, the first president of Ghana, earned a degree in sociology; and B.R. Ambedkar, the famous Dalit (formerly ‘untouchable’) activist, received degrees in sociology and law. Understanding this overlooked historical fact is an absolute necessity for accounting for the particular forms of anticolonial thought that emerge by the 1940s and 1950s. These thinkers received degrees in the social sciences at a point when they were still nascent fields of inquiry. Early twentieth-century sociology borrowed heavily from literature, vitalism, and philosophy as well as the natural sciences. William James noted that early social scientists wrote in such a way ‘that made biology and psychology continuous’. In 1905, Du Bois famously declared that sociology a ‘hesitant’ discipline, with the hope that its hesitation would make it particularly useful for anti-racist and anticolonial causes. Drawing on their sociological training, anticolonial thinkers in the Indian Ocean world were able to imagine new political collectives heralded under the rubrics of ‘Afro-Asian’, ‘coloured’, and, most famously, the ‘wretched of the earth’. By reframing early sociological thought and its decolonial afterlives as literary and aesthetic endeavours, this project illuminates the ways in which thinkers imagined alternative political communities in the face of the Cold War. 反殖民社會學這個課題力圖描繪二十世紀初黑人和亞洲的社會活動家們如何使用被W.E.B.杜博依斯稱為「犹豫」的社會學來想像一個全新的反殖民和去殖民的政治共同體。通過細致的文本分析，本課題將闡明關於亞非團結的最有利的理論乃產生於英美社會學、反殖民思想和後殖民政治學交會之處的黑人、亞洲和英美學界的合作。同時，本課題也指出二十世紀初最有啟發性的社會學家均來自被殖民的區域，他們以社會學為工具，將半個世紀後的去殖民化率先訴諸理論。本課題梳理六十年來社會學理論在反殖民思想中的持續的影響力，以重新塑造在亞非聯繫中心的「社會學想像」。 無獨有偶，在印度洋區域反殖民和反種族歧視運動中最重要的人物大多於二十世紀初在美國的高等院校中取得社會科學的學位。賈瓦哈拉爾·尼赫魯，未來的印度總理，取得了政治學學位；W.E.B.杜博依斯，著名的黑人理論家，取得了社會學學位；夸梅·恩克魯瑪，迦納的第一任總統，取得了社會學學位； 還有阿姆貝伽爾，曾經的印度「賤民」活動家，取得了社會學和法學的學位。理解這個重要的歷史現象對於我們分析湧現於1940和1950年代的特殊的反殖民思潮至關重要。這些重要人物是在社會科學仍是新興學科的建樹時期接受教育的。二十世紀初的社會科學從文學、活力論、哲學以及自認科學中吸取了重要的養分。威廉·詹姆斯曾指出，早期的社會科學研究者使得「生物學和心理學帶有延續性」。1905年，杜博依斯描寫社會學是一門「猶豫」的學科，正是希望學科的「猶豫」能為反種族歧視和反殖民運動帶來契機。 憑藉他們的社會學訓練，印度洋區域的反殖民思想家們在「非-亞」、「有色」以及最為著名的「大地上的苦難者」這些話語旗幟下想像新的政治可能。本課題將這些早期政治學理論和後殖民演變置於文學和美學的框架中，力圖呈現在冷戰背景之上形成的一個另類政治共同體。

27614421.label: Project Objectives
27614421.value: Perform an experiment investigating perception and production of Cantonese by native speakers of English and Mandarin using a) percetpual discrimination, categorization, and goodness rating tasks; and b) dynamic articulatory production data including simultaneous ultrasound images of the tongue, video of the lips, and acoustic speech recordings. 27614421.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27614421.value: 此項研究將調查英語與普通話母語者是如何發出和感知粵語中的元音。前人的研 究表明，對於第二語言學習者來說，感知和發出不存在於母語中的元音對立是有困難 的，其困難程度取決於這些非母語元音與母語元音的相似程度。然而，我們依然不確 定語言學習者依靠的是聲學上的相似點還是發音上的相似點，這兩方的理論為此爭論 不休。值得注意的是，只有少數的研究從發音的角度（比如唇形和舌位）考察語言學 習者發出的非母語元音，大部分的研究依靠聲學測量，這種方法有時難以確定發音的 機制。 此項研究聚焦於粵語元音/i y u/（即「絲」si1、「書」syu1、「褲」fu3 這三個字 中的元音），以及/ɛ œ ɔ/（即「些」se1、「靴」hoe1、「梳」so1 這三個字中的元音）。 元音對/i/-/u/以及/ɛ/-/ɔ/之間，舌位和唇形皆有區別，並且在這三種語言中都可找到類似 的元音。另一方面，/y œ/與/i ɛ/和/u ɔ/有相似之處；/y œ/和/i ɛ/的舌位都比較靠前，同時 它們和/u ɔ/都是圓唇元音。粵語和普通話都有/y/，同時粵語也有/œ/，普通話則沒有。 英語既沒有/y/，也沒有/œ/，但在某些情況下，英語中的元音與它們在聲學上相似。 本研究的受試者是英語和普通話母語者，一部分人是高階粵語學習者，另一部分 人則沒有學習粵語的經歷。聽感實驗將會測試他們是否能夠區分一些粵語元音對（比 如/i/-/y/，/y/-/u/），同時也考察他們如何根據母語與非母語的元音系統對粵語中的元 音進行分類。語音產出實驗將會收集聲學錄音、超聲舌位影像和唇形錄像。所收集的 數據將會用於分析以決定非母語者的粵語元音與母語者的元音是在聲學特徵上還是在 發音方式上比較接近，以及非母語者的語音產出是否在發音方式和時間上帶有他們母 語的痕跡。 此項研究的結果將會用於檢驗音系學和二語習得理論，同時提供必要的發音資料， 這是粵語和普通話尤其缺乏的。此項研究的發現也會為將來研究利用超聲舌位影像進 行二語發音教學奠定基礎。

27615721.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27615721.value: 透過即時通訊軟件為中風後抑鬱人士傳遞的簡短網絡認知行為治療（iCBT）：混合方法研究

27615721.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27615721.value: Around one third of stroke survivors develop depression at any point of time following the stroke event. Post-stroke depression (PSD) is associated with negative care outcomes including poorer function, longer hospital stays, increased outpatient and inpatient clinic use, and higher mortality rate. In Hong Kong (HK), the prevalence of PSD within the hospital setting was 36%, and up to 68% in the community setting. However, PSD is seldom addressed in either settings in HK and elsewhere. Meta-analyses reported the effectiveness of Internet-based cognitive behavioural therapy (iCBT), particularly when guided by therapists (d = 0.63). Personalised and synchronous instant message-based intervention guided by therapists is an emerging form of psychological intervention. While such intervention showed medium to large effect (Hedges’ g = 0.73) on negative psychological distress episodes including depression, no study has investigated its effect on PSD. The proposed study aims to 1) investigate the effect of therapist-guided brief iCBT delivery through instant messaging applications (e.g. WhatsApp and WeChat) to provide personalised and synchronous PSD support and 2) understand the experience of and compliance with the intervention. No similar study has been found in PubMed, Cochrane Library or Clinicaltrials.gov. 160 community-dwelling stroke survivors with Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) scores ranging from 5 to 19 indicating mild to moderate depressive symptoms will be recruited and then individually randomised into the Intervention group (n=80) or Control group (n=80). Intervention group will receive 1) instant message-delivered brief iCBT for 3 months at participants’ chosen times and frequencies, and 2) therapist-led text or voice message-based PSD support to enhance the effects of iCBT through real-time counselling and practical advice. Control group will only receive messages on general mental health information and reminders to participate in follow-up surveys. The primary outcome is PHQ-9 score at 6 months. Secondary outcomes will include blood tests (depression-sensitive biomarkers including cortisol and high-sensitivity c-reactive protein), anxiety (GAD-7), perceived stress (PSS-4), loneliness (ULS-8), and quality of life (EQ-5D-5L) at 6 months. We will strictly follow the CONSORT-EHEALTH checklist. A cost-effectiveness analysis and post-trial qualitative study will be conducted to compute the cost-effectiveness of the intervention and understand the participants’ experience of and compliance with the intervention (n=20) respectively. This study will provide the first and practical evidence on the effectiveness of instant message-delivered brief iCBT intervention in addressing PSD in HK and beyond. 大約三分一的中風康復者會在中風後患上抑鬱症。中風後抑鬱與更差的自我護理有關聯，包括：較差的身體功能、更長的留院時間、使用更多門診和住院服務，及更高的死亡率。在香港的醫院及社區環境中，中風後抑鬱的普遍率分別為36%及 68%。然而，在香港和其他地區的醫院及社區內，中風後抑鬱都很少被提及。薈萃分析曾指出網絡認知行為治療的有效性，而由治療師引導的治療尤為有效(d = 0.63)。由治療師引導透過即時通訊軟件提供同步個人化的介入是一種新興的心理介入方式。雖然此類心理介入對負面情緒困擾(包括抑鬱症)有中度至大程度的效果(Hedges' g = 0.73)，但仍未有針對網絡認知行為治療對處理中風後抑鬱的成效的研究。 此擬議研究旨在 1) 研究由治療師引導透過即時通訊軟件（例如： WhatsApp 及微信）提供簡短同步個人化的網絡認知行為治療對支援中風後抑鬱的成效及2)了解參與者對治療的體驗及依從性。PubMed、Cochrane Library 或 Clinicaltrials.gov上並沒有類似的研究。 160名在社區居住及在病人健康狀況問卷-9（PHQ-9）中得到5-19分（輕微至中度抑鬱徵狀）的的中風康復者會將被邀請參與本計劃，他們會被隨機分配到試驗組（n=80）或對照組（n=80）。試驗組會接受1)為期3個月透過即時訊息傳遞的簡短網絡認知行為治療，其訊息傳遞的時間及頻率將由參與者選擇，及2) 由治療師提供以文字或語音形式提供的實時輔導及實用建議的中風後抑鬱支援，以提升網絡認知行為治療的效果。對照組僅會接收到一般心理健康資訊和提醒參與後續問卷調查的訊息。 本項研究的主要指標為參與者在第6個月時的病人健康狀況問卷-9分數。次要指標為參與者在第6個月時的驗血結果（抑鬱症敏感生物指標，包括：皮質醇及高敏度C反應蛋白）、焦慮（GAD-7）、壓力知覺（PSS-4）、孤獨感（ULS-8）及生活質素（EQ-5D-5L）的分數。我們會嚴格跟從CONSORT-EHEALTH的指引。我們亦會在試驗完成後進行成本效益的分析及質性研究去計算介入的成本效益，並了解參與者（n = 20）對治療的體驗和依從性。此項研究將會為香港及其他地區在處理中風後抑鬱上提供透過即時通訊軟件傳遞的簡短網絡認知行為治療有效性的首個證據。

27617821.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27617821.value: 〈繁「骨」茂盛：「花園」體裁與後殖民文學〉

27617821.label: Project Objectives
27617821.value: To conduct the first literary critical study on how postcolonial writers—both novelists and poets from the anglophone and francophone Caribbean particularly—create in their works innovative memorials for both cultural and natural worlds destroyed by colonial violence. To use the figure of the “garden-ossuary” in order to demonstrate how writers blend literary, architectural, and horticultural forms in order to fashion novel ways to represent unwitnessed and unwritten histories of violence as well as of survival. To create a new methodology that blends literary criticism with archival research as well as documentary recording. This project will involve the semiotic analysis of, and archival research on, actual architectural and horticultural sites in a way that treats these locales, including their flora and fauna, as autonomous discursive objects possessed of a literary character. The documentation or transformation of these sites by authors can only be assessed in light of a thickly described reconstruction of them as physical and cultural entities. By reconstructing a database and semiotic baseline of the sites authors select for poeticization, this project will reconceive emerging literary canons in the anglophone and francophone Caribbean as a collective symbolic activity through which individual authors assertively define cultural space. To publish scholarly articles, present talks to interdisciplinary and culturally diverse audiences, and to organize conferences and events on the relationship between conserving the environment and preserving cultural and historical memory. This project looks to reach both scholarly and general publics by speaking to timely issues concerning the practices of conservation and memorialization. It also looks to rethink critical writing in literary studies by working with academics at the forefront of generating innovative models of scholarly writing.

27617821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27617821.value: “Flowering Ossuary: Garden Form and Postcolonial Literature” is primarily a work of literary and cultural criticism. As a contribution to the fields of English and postcolonial studies as well as ecocriticism, it will be the first in-depth study of anglophone and francophone Caribbean writers who experiment with literary form in order to build imaginative memorials for the dead within their novels and poems. In order to do this, these writers construct, astonishingly, anti-conventional gardens in their written works to offer space for healing from the trauma of historical violence. These gardens appear consistently in major works of postcolonial literature, so I argue, as a way to rebuild and repair together the cultural and natural worlds destroyed through the colonial conquest of the Americas. It is important to remember that this conquest involved the simultaneous uprooting, transplantation, and erasure of human beings and the continent’s flora and fauna. Many of the writers I study did not live in times as ecologically conscious as ours, but they make certain that this shared history of natural and cultural loss is brought to the forefront. Their urgent focus on the centrality of natural worlds to the building of cultural ones needs to be analyzed with more attention as we today have much to learn from it. In studying these writers, the argument I further is that the gardens of postcolonial literature are not only actual gardens, but gardens also in the sense that they allow for disappeared lives and worlds “to grow” like so many flowers; and they are ossuaries because they are places in which the bones of the dead—and particularly the dead who never received a resting place—can finally be housed. In my project, I study this unique blending of architectural, horticultural, and literary activities in textual works to demonstrate how the processes of memorialization they represent offer imaginative ways to rethink the relationship between the human and the non-human in the present.

27621121.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27621121.value: 中國老齡自雇者的多層次前置因素與長期影響：8年追蹤調查

27621121.label: Project Objectives
27621121.value: To understand the prevalence/engagement, intensity, and longitudinal dynamics/patterns of self-employment among the near-old and older workers in China. To investigate the direct impacts and relative importance of individual and environmental correlates of self-employment on engagement in, and the intensity and dynamics of, self-employment. To examine how interactions between these individual and environmental antecedents may contribute to self-employment in later life. To assess how self-employment—including engagement, intensity, and its patterns—influences longitudinal physical, mental, cognitive, and financial well-being. To explore self-employment’s complexities by testing how the relationships across correlates, self-employment, and well-being vary by gender and rural/urban differences.

27621121.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27621121.value: 人口高齡化伴隨諸多對社會、經濟與健康的挑戰。如何增進個人的經濟安全，同時維持個人健康是高齡社會必須面對的課題。自雇—一個協助高齡者留在勞動市場的新趨勢—近來受到諸多重視，因為此工作型態能提供機會協助個人持續賺取經濟資源暨保持有意義的社會交往。然而，有關高齡自雇者的研究大多只探討個人因素，缺少對於環境因素如何影響個人變成自雇者；也缺乏對於健康與經濟的長期性效果；更甚者，研究大多集中於西方國家，缺少來自於華人社會脈絡的證據。 使用資料具有樣本代表性的中國健康與養老追蹤調查（2011至2018年），本研究探討高齡者選擇自雇，相對於全職受薪工作之行為如何受到個人與環境因素影響，以及自雇行為如何影響長期的生理、心理與經濟福祉。此外，也探討這些關係如何受到性別與城鄉差距的影響。研究預期提供一個來自華人社會的觀察，探討中國高齡自雇的行為、其前置的個人與環境因素，以及長期性效果。研究發現期待能夠帶來政策與方案的改變，以強化個人的經濟與健康老化。

27621121.label: Realisation of objectives
27621121.value: Aim 1: Prevalence and dynamics in self-employment To understand the prevalence and dynamics of self-employment of older adults, analyses by the types of self-employment (i.e., agricultural, non-agricultural, and combined self-employment) focusing on those aged 45+ were conducted. All the analyses were limited to the working population (i.e., excluding retirement, seeking jobs, never working, etc.) to gain a clear understanding of self-employment prevalence and dynamics. The results were from the 2011-2018 China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS). Among working respondents aged 45 and older, approximately half (range: 49.11% to 59.24%) were engaged in agricultural self-employment, and approximately one in ten (range: 9.75% to 11.11%) were engaged in non-agricultural self-employment. When both self-employment types are combined (i.e., total self-employment), the rates range from 60.22% to 68.99%. The dynamics revealed that Chinese workers intensively switch or change their work, reflecting the nature that, as retirement approaches, individuals often experience employment transitions that involve switching jobs or careers and moving in and out of retirement. Rather than immediately leaving the labor force, individuals may opt for flexible employment to stay in the labor market, in which they may change from full-time to part-time employment or switch types of employment between waged or salaried (hereafter “waged employment”) and self-employment. The results showed that, for agricultural self-employment, approximately 43% have job transitions either into or out of self-employment (1-time: 12.92%; 2-times: 13.72%; 3-times: 16.24%). Approximately 40% stayed self-employed (36.74%). However, distinct dynamics in non-agricultural self-employment were identified: only 3.15% stayed self-employed, and 14% experienced transitioning between self-employment and waged employment (1-time: 8.58%; 2-times: 3.34%; 3-times: 2.38%). Lastly, when all types of self-employment are combined, 44.47% stayed self-employed, and approximately 41% experienced job transitions (1-time: 11.61%; 2-times: 13.79%; 3-times: 17.60%). The stark differences in self-employment rates between agricultural and non-agricultural sectors probably reflect the developing nature of the Chinese occupation system and the urban-rural divides. As one of the largest developing nations in the world, fewer Chinese workers are engaged in nonagricultural-related work when it comes to self-employment, such as manufacturing, services, and selling goods. The low rates of non-agricultural self-employment may also reflect that Chinese workers may face greater challenges when engaging in such type of employment, for example, insufficient technology and management skills, limited job-seeking channels, inadequate competitiveness, and mismatched market demand. Aims 2 and 3: Impacts of individual and environmental factors on self-employment To examine whether and how individual and environmental factors may be associated with self-employment, two-level (i.e., individuals nested within cities) and three-level (i.e., individuals nested within cities and provinces) multilevel logistic regression models were employed to investigate whether and how individual, city-level (n=125), and provincial-level (n=28) factors related to engagement in three types of self-employment. Using combined SE as an example, the two-level multilevel logistic regression models showed that individual and environmental antecedents were associated with the propensity to be self-employed. In city-level multilevel logistic regression models, when only considering environmental variables, the results showed that lower GDP per capita and lower social protection and employment fiscal expenditure per capita were associated with self-employment. When considering individual and environmental variables, the results showed that those who were married, with lower income, older, and living in cities with lower investment in social protection and employment were likely to be self-employed. The provincial-level multilevel logistic regression models indicated that those with lower incomes, poor health conditions, and older people were associated with higher odds of being self-employed. The results of three-level multilevel logistic regression models that controlled city- and provincial-level environmental variables showed that marital status, lower income, older age, and living in cities with lower investment in social protection and employment were associated with self-employment. These results suggested that individual attributes may be more important in influencing individuals’ actions in pursuing self-employment. In particular, those with lower income, older, and married were more likely to be “pushed” into self-employment due to economic reasons. However, where older adults live also affects their propensity toward self-employment, particularly in areas with lower levels of social protection and employment investment. The findings also revealed that the city, compared to the province, has a stronger impact on the self-employment status of older adults. These findings highlight the need to build social protection programs to ensure economic security for older adults, particularly at the city level. The findings of Aims 1 to 3 have been synthesized into one single paper and are currently submitted to a journal under review. Aims 4 & 5: Self-employment on physical, mental, and cognitive health outcomes and subgroup analyses This study examined the changing patterns of self-employment—whether individuals experience transitions between self-employment and waged employment—on multiple health outcomes to investigate whether and how self-employment influences older adults’ physical, mental, and cognitive health. It also explored subgroup differences by gender, hukou, education, and locality. To address the endogeneity of individual and environmental variables as found in Aims 2 and 3, this study employed two-way fixed effect panel data analysis to examine the effects of transitions in self-employment on cognition, depressive symptoms, self-rated health, and life satisfaction. This study also explored interaction terms by gender, education, locality, and hukou status. This study used 4,606 respondents aged 45 and older from 2011-2018 waves of the CHARLS data. Multiple imputations with chained equations were used to address missing values. A total of 20 imputed data sets were created, and the results were combined using Rubin’s rule. The two-way fixed effect models showed that individuals transitioning into or remaining in self-employment had lower self-rated health and life satisfaction than those in waged employment. There was no significant difference in cognitive functioning or depressive symptoms. Additionally, those who transitioned from self-employment into waged employment rated their health worse than those who remained in waged employment. The health impacts were more apparent for agricultural than nonagricultural self-employment, particularly for older workers in urban regions with rural hukou and lower education levels. The findings revealed significant interaction effects by education, locality, and hukou status. Those with lower education, with rural hukou, and those living in urban areas tend to have poor health outcomes. The effects of urban hukou produced mixed findings: they observed better cognition and self-rated health only when they engaged in non-agricultural self-employment. Additionally, they also reported higher depressive symptoms. Such positive associations are consistent with previous research showing that favorable aspects of self-employment, such as autonomy and self-direction, can stimulate brain activity and increase perceived health. This may be especially relevant for older adults with urban hukou, as they have more resources, economic advantages, and capacities to reap the health benefits of self-employment than rural hukou holders. However, this study also observed higher depressive symptoms among older adults with urban hukou. This suggests that, although urban hukou holders are entitled to better education and welfare schemes (i.e., pension and social insurance), the nature of self-employment—longer working hours and income uncertainty—compounded with a feeling of being left out of the traditional employment economy, may impair their mental well-being. The findings of Aims 4 and 5 were published in 2024 in Innovation in Aging, a top journal in the gerontology field (2023 impact factor = 4.9, 2/48 in gerontology; 96.8%).

27621121.label: Major findings and research outcome
27621121.value: Self-employment is a vital alternative to waged employment for older workers. Recent research has shown that employment transitions frequently occur when individuals approach retirement. However, evidence of how older people’s health changes when they switch between self and waged employment is lacking, particularly outside Western contexts. To address this research gap, we explored the health impact of employment transitions for the older working population in China by hukou (urban or rural household registration status), region, and education. We employed fixed effect models to examine the impact of employment transitions on cognitive, mental, and physical health and life satisfaction drawing on data from four waves (2011, 2013, 2015, and 2018) of the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (N = 4,606). Given China’s unique context, we analyzed the results of agricultural and nonagricultural work separately. The findings revealed that individuals transitioning into or remaining in self-employment had lower self-rated health and life satisfaction than those remaining in waged employment. There was no significant difference in cognitive functioning or depressive symptoms. Additionally, those who transitioned from self-employment into waged employment rated their health worse than those who remained in waged employment. The health impacts were more apparent for agricultural than nonagricultural self-employment, particularly for older workers living in urban regions with rural hukou and lower education levels. Our findings suggest that most older Chinese transitioning into or staying self-employed are or were pushed into self-employment due to their low human capital and socioeconomic status, which affects their subsequent health. Pension reform and policies supporting older adults to stay in the workforce could help close the economic and health gaps between rural and urban older adults.

27621121.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
27621121.value: The results of this project provide implications for facilitating the quality of longer working lives. Policies and programs should provide economic and health support to the older population, especially those with socioeconomic disadvantages and facing more challenges in pursuing a continued working life. For instance, for rural hukou holders and those living in the urban region, improving accessibility to the social wel¬fare system, integrating the pension system, or strengthening redistribution in benefit provisions could mitigate the adverse effects of transitioning to self-employment on health. The actionable strategies include a series of policy amendments, such as hukou reform to relax welfare entitlement to resi¬dents, unified pension insurance for urban and rural areas, and establishing integrated community-based services for social, health, and employment issues. For those with insufficient education, encouraging continuing education and job coaching may help them find suitable jobs. To prevent older adults from being pushed into work due to individual or structural disadvantages (e.g., workplace ageism or lack of skills), efforts related to eliminating discrimination, providing skills training, and creating age-friendly and equal-opportunity employment are crucial to achieving longer and healthier working lives, especially for older adults facing chal¬lenges in pursuing or engaging employment.

27621121.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
27621121.value: This study looks at how older people in China experience health changes when they switch between self-employment and regular jobs. It found that older adults who are self-employed—whether they chose this path or had to switch—tend to rate their health and life satisfaction lower than those who keep regular jobs. Many of these older individuals are pushed into self-employment due to limited job options, especially those from rural areas with less education. China’s retirement rules and low pensions often force older people to work for themselves to make ends meet. However, they face challenges finding new jobs because of age discrimination and a lack of skills. Those who are self-employed usually have lower education, come from rural backgrounds, earn less money, and report worse health. The study also found that where a person lives, and their education level can affect their health. Older people with urban residency tend to have better health and cognitive function, but those with less education living in cities report lower life satisfaction and health. Overall, social factors in China significantly influence how self-employment affects the health of older adults.

28600321.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
28600321.value: Worldwide, there has been a rapid expansion of international schools, broadly defined as schools offering international programmes at least partly in English outside an English-speaking country. Significantly, international schooling has diversified beyond its original purposes of providing education for the children of mobile expatriates. The greatest growth has been from affluent local families entering an increasing array of international school types. The trend is potentially having a profound impact on students and societies through a more internationalised education with enhanced opportunities for overseas higher education. Yet the aspirations, experiences, and outcomes of international schooling in different contexts are unclear, especially in non-Western contexts. Situated in the sociology of international education, the proposed research investigates if and how international schooling is re/producing a 'global middle-class' of socio-economically privileged professionals who are highly credentialed, globally mobile, multilingual, and post-national in worldviews, lifestyles, and careers. In doing so, the research will investigate the potential societal disruptions in how international schooling may exacerbate inequalities in educational opportunities and create disconnections between young people and host communities. The research context, China’s Greater Bay Area, encompassing Guangdong Province, Hong Kong SAR, and Macau SAR, offers an extraordinary opportunity to investigate international schooling. First, the region has geopolitical significance at the forefront of China’s globalisation, while providing opportunities for intra-regional comparison by socio-political and regulatory environments. Second, it has one of the world's most dynamic international school markets where affluent families in metropolitan centres can choose among high schools offering programmes including Advanced Placement, the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme, and Cambridge International A-Levels. The proposed research design is a qualitative multi-site case study of five international high school types across the Greater Bay Area. It will identify what is driving the proliferation of international schooling, determine what constitutes ‘international’ schooling beyond English language and international programmes, demonstrate if and how international schooling serves as a pipeline to a ‘global middle-class’, and uncover the potential disruptions caused by international schooling for societies. Data will be collected from i) interviews with school leaders, teachers, parents, and students (n=105); ii) school brochures and websites to examine how the international schools articulate their missions to the public; (iii) background information about admission policies, student and staff profiles, and student outcomes. The findings will significantly contribute to the sociology of international education, while also generating policy recommendations for how international schools can better serve families and societies where they are situated. 在非英語國家以英語作為教學語言（或之一）教授國際課程項目的國際學校正在全球範圍內迅速擴張。值得注意的是，國際學校同時也日益多元化，不再僅僅為外籍人士子女提供教育。這其中最顯著的擴張體現在來自富裕家庭的本地學生越來越多地進入不同類型的國際學校學習。在這一趨勢下，更為國際化的教育和更優的海外高等教育機會，將對國際學校的學生和整個社會產生深遠的影響。然而，過去的研究並未釐清不同社會環境下，尤其是眾多非西方國家和地區中，與國際學校相關的願景、經驗和教育產出。本研究將立足於國際教育社會學，調查國際學校是否以及如何正在（再）生產一個“世界中產階級”(global middle-class)，即具備高學業資質與多種語言能力的，在全球範圍內流動的，在世界觀、生活方式及事業發展各方面都超越了單一國家範疇的，社會經濟優勢專業人士。在此過程中，本研究也將調查國際學校可能帶來的社會破壞，即其如何加劇教育機會的不公平，以及造成年輕人與本土社會的脫節。中國的粵港澳大灣區為研究國際學校提供了絕佳的機會。首先，該地區處於中國國際化的前沿，具有重大地緣政治意義，並為不同社會政治與監管環境下的跨地區比較提供了可能。其次，大灣區擁有世界上最具活力的國際學校市場之一。都市的富裕家庭能選擇不同的國際高中項目，包括來自美國的大學先修課程(Advanced Placement)，國際文憑大學預科課程(International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme)及劍橋國際A-Levels課程(Cambridge International A-Levels)。本研究將對粵港澳大灣區內的五類國際高中學校展開質性的多點案例研究。它將識別推動國際學校發展的因素，在英語語言和國際課程之外定義何謂“國際”學校，發掘國際學校是否以及如何成為培養“世界中產階級”的途徑，並且揭示國際學校可能對社會形成的干擾。研究數據將來自i) 與國際學校領導者、教師，以及家長和學生的訪談 (n=105)，ii) 國際學校對外宣傳其辦學宗旨的刊印物及網站，(iii) 有關國際學校招生政策，師生構成情況，教育產出等背景信息。本研究所得將極大地貢獻於國際教育社會學的發展，並針對如何使國際學校更好地服務家庭與社會提出政策建議。

28602021.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
28602021.value: Redressing Atrocities: Forms of Reconciliation in Postcolonial Southeast Asian Literature This project offers a critical exposition of reconciliation in postcolonial Southeast Asian literature in English. It considers how literary forms are used as a medium to explore reparative possibilities for past and present conflicts in Southeast Asia. How might we read Anglophone Southeast Asian literature and critically frame the apparent lure of reconciliation for postcolonial Southeast Asia? How do these texts register reparative desires in their literary strategies, narrative shapes, and formal structures? What aesthetic, ethical, and epistemological roles do literary imaginations perform in present-day conflict-ridden spaces around the world? Though reconciliation assumes a prominent status in public discourses and transitional justice mechanisms such as Truth and Reconciliation Commissions globally, it has yet to attain sustained discussion in the literary humanities. This is particularly so in postcolonial critical discourses which have often stressed the ethical value of resistance and viewed reconciliation with suspicion. While some postcolonial scholars have begun to examine the complexity of reconciliation in recent years, they have hitherto tended to overlook the remedial potential of English-language Southeast Asian narratives. As a first attempt to address these critical lacunae, this proposed ECS project seeks to reclaim the vocabulary of reconciliation for postcolonial studies and shift the field’s geographical ambit from the dominant sites of Canada, South Africa, Australia to the often neglected Southeast Asia. In particular, the project examines a corpus of Anglophone Southeast Asian literature on four conflicts: Tan Twan Eng’s novel on the Japanese occupation of Malaya, Viet Thanh Nguyen’s short story collection on the war in Vietnam, Vaddey Ratner’s literary memoir on the Cambodian genocide, and the recent poetry on the Rohingya crisis. This proposed project argues that by addressing atrocities and their aftermaths, the selected postcolonial Southeast Asian texts thematically and formally register an ethics of reconciliation. Such literary expressions seek to redress injustices and repair injured communities within and beyond Southeast Asia, despite the acknowledged enormity, if not impossibility, of the task. Contrary to its often reductive representation in governmental policies and legal avenues, reconciliation as articulated in the selected aesthetic forms captures the paradoxes, partiality, and cultural-historical embeddedness of reparative work. All four cases consider the possibility of reconciliation and the countervailing prospect of irreconcilability. Overall, this project demonstrates that Anglophone Southeast Asian literature makes an important contribution to rethinking reconciliation outside bureaucratic and legal-judicial domains. 本研究對後殖民東南亞文學中的和解想像進行批判性的闡述。其旨在考慮文學作為媒介如何探索東南亞過去和現在衝突的修復可能性。我們如何理解東南亞英語文學，並批判性地理解和解的魅惑？這些文本如何在其文學策略、敘事形式和形式結構中記錄修復的慾望？文學想像在當今世界各地衝突頻發的空間中扮演著什麼美學、倫理和認知角色？儘管和解在全球公共話語和過渡機制（如真相與和解委員會）中佔據重要地位，但在文學人文領域尚未獲得持續的討論。在後殖民研究中尤其如此，這些話語經常強調抵抗的倫理價值，並以懷疑的態度看待和解。儘管近年來一些後殖民學者開始研究和解的複雜性，但他們往往忽視了東南亞英語敘事的和解潛力。作為第一次嘗試，本項目旨在為後殖民研究恢復和解這個詞彙，並將該領域的範圍從加拿大、南非、澳大利亞的主要地點轉移到經常被忽視的東南亞。具體而言，本研究審查了東南亞英語文學關於四個衝突的討論：日本佔領馬來亞的小說，越戰的短篇小說集，柬埔寨種族滅絕的文學回憶錄，以及最近關於羅興亞人危機的詩歌。本項目認為，通過處理暴行及其後果，後殖民東南亞文本在主題上和結構中記錄了和解的倫理。這些文學試圖糾正東南亞內外的不公正現象並修復受傷害的社區，儘管這項任務是艱鉅的。與其在政策和法律途徑中的表現有别，美學中表達的和解捕捉了修復工作的矛盾性、局部性和文化歷史背景。所有案例都考慮了和解的可能性以及不可能性。總體而言，本研究表明東南亞英語文學對重新思考官僚和法律領域之外的和解做出了重要貢獻。

To examine the underlying mechanisms behind the change in physical activity associated with self-determination theory

28602121.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
28602121.value: COVID-19 forces exceptional changes in work and school cultures across the world. The school suspension has led teachers to look for innovative ways of engaging students online. The remarkable benefits of doing exercise are relieving stress, maintaining our sanity, staying healthy and preventing muscle atrophy due to spending much more time at home and adopting a more sedentary lifestyle. Teachers have been playing a significant role in encouraging their students to be physically active, while the reduction in student-teacher interaction during the closure of schools makes this less achievable. The safest place to exercise during the pandemic is at home where students and their guardians are likely to spend most of their time. However, motivating children to exercise can be challenging. Technology has connected our community with a brave new, impeccably choreographed channel. Physical education teachers can upload daily workout for students to complete at home using crude equipment. However, without having any theory to guide implementation strategy, the effectiveness is in doubt. Research on exercise motivation from the standpoint of the Self-determination Theory (SDT) has been growing substantially recently. SDT advocates a motivational approach that prompts favourable outcomes by satisfying the three innate, essential, and universal psychological needs, namely autonomy, competence, and relatedness. Taken together, research grounded in SDT that encourages guardians to promote children’s PA level and motivation is limited. Therefore, this research aims to i) investigate the effectiveness of online daily workout for improving physical activity (PA) level at home among primary school-age children and ii) examine the underlying mechanisms behind the change of PA associated with SDT. A randomised controlled trial will be conducted. 290 guardian-children pairs will be recruited and allocated to four groups: i) given exercise choices, ii) coaching cues, iii) both choices and cues, and iv) nothing (waiting-list-control). Students’ PA level, sleep quality, physical fitness, motivation and basic psychological needs as well as guardians’ behaviour will be assessed before, immediately after, and eight weeks after the eight-week intervention so as to evaluate the immediate effect and sustainability of the intervention. The findings will provide evidence on the mechanism for online daily workout relating to basic psychological needs, which may ultimately improve PA level at home. The information will be valuable to schools’ emergency response to bad weather or any disruption in society. COVID-19 迫使世界各地的工作和學校文化產生了異常的變化。停課更促使教師必須尋找創新而有效的網上學習形式。疫情下顯生的持續在家生活和久坐的生活模式，更突顯了運動對調整壓力、保持理智、防止肌肉萎縮和保持健康的重要。 教師在鼓勵學生體育鍛煉方面一直發揮著重要的作用。停課期間，師生互動的減少使這一目標變得難以實現。疫情下，學生及其監護人亦持續留在家中，剛好最安全的運動空間就是在家。然而，如何鼓勵在家孩子運動對家長來說是有挑戰性的。 科技將我們的社區帶到一個全新而精心編排的互動平台。體育老師可以上傳日常訓練，讓學生使用簡單的設備在家運動。然而，沒有理論指導的情況下，當中活動安排的成效是值得懷疑的。自我決定理論（SDT）對運動動機研究的數量一直在大幅增長。 SDT 提倡的激勵方法，是要通過滿足三個與生俱來的心理需求，即自主性、能力感和關聯需要來促進有利的結果。 以 SDT探討監護人對提高兒童身體活動水平和動機的研究是有限的。因此，本研究旨在 i) 調查網上體育活動對提高小學生在家中身體活動水平的有效性，以及 ii) 研究與 SDT 相關的身體活動水平變化背後的潛在機制。本研究將進行隨機對照試驗。將招募 290 名參與者，並將其分配給四組：i) 訓練選擇組，ii) 指導提示組，iii) 選擇和提示組，以及 iv) 什麼都沒有（等候控制組）。學生的身體活動水平、睡眠質量、身體素質、動機和基本心理需求以及監護人的行為會在訓練前、八星期訓練後和額外的八星期跟進三個時間點被評估，用以了解當中訓練安排的即時效果和可持續性。 研究結果將為與基本心理需求相關的網上體育活動原理提供證據，最終可能會提高家庭 身體活動水平。這些信息對於學校處理因惡劣天氣或任何社會變化需要的應急處理有非常大的參考價值。

28603921.label: Project Title(Chinese)
28603921.value: 承變之間：朱駿聲《六十四卦經解》研究價值的發現

28603921.label: Project Objectives
28603921.value: 梳理《六十四卦經解》材料，尋繹該書所引《易》說出處，以區分朱氏自注的文字，為學術界提供首個《經解》整理本。整理成果擬編成網頁或出版，公開予學者參考，以為研究朱氏《易》說的基礎。 分析朱駿聲《易》說承繼前朝成果和開創新義之處，探討在清中葉的時代背景下朱氏的詮《易》特色，以重新審視其成就。 全面整理和分析《六十四卦經解》的訓詁材料，以觀察朱駿聲如何將《說文》的研究成果融入《易》學之中，並發明這些材料對《周易》研究的價值。 比對《六十四卦經解》與《說文通訓定聲》字詞訓釋的異同，以更全面地分析朱駿聲在語言學方面的成就，並探討漢字釋義隨文變化的情況。 通過對朱駿聲《六十四卦經解》的研究分析，提出批判學術史既有「成說」的重要性，期望日後能以此為基，發掘更多在學術史上被忽視的典籍的潛在價值。

28603921.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
28603921.value: 清代《說文》名家朱駿聲（1788-1858）著有《六十四卦經解》，學者多因其形式類近於資料彙編而認為此書只是集舊說之作，這使《經解》的價值歷來被忽視。其實在承繼之餘，朱氏創建亦多，本計劃將從以下兩方面發掘《經解》的研究價值： 其一，《經解》吸納前人《易》說，但朱氏引錄時往往刪改或重組材料，亦會補充看法。他引史說《易》，對史事的評說反映清中葉知識分子的時代意識，而他將當時的天文、地理等新知融入說解，注入了新元素。學者謂《經解》「瑕瑜并列，而無所是非」，評價並不公允。研究《經解》承變之處，能觀察傳統經典如何在後代獲得新生命。 其二，朱駿聲《說文通訓定聲》的成就備受肯定，但學者研究此作，往往忽略了朱氏其他著作的訓詁材料。《說文》通釋字義，《定聲》解說字的一般義，但《經解》專門解《易》，說的是字的經典義，故說釋每異於前兩者。本計劃比對《經解》與《定聲》的訓詁材料，觀察朱氏如何以《說文》的研究成果解《易》，更著重探討他如何在經籍的具體注解之中變化字義。這將突破學者研究朱氏語言學時只取《說文通訓定聲》為材的盲點。 Renowned for his work on the dictionary Shuowen Jiezi, Qing philologist Zhu Junsheng (1788—1858) is also author of Liushisi Gua Jingjie, a work generally viewed as a repository of existing interpretations without scholarly innovation and thus largely overlooked. However, to gauge its worth simply on the format presented is to conclude on bias rather than evidence. In fact, on top of being transmissive in nature, Zhu’s work is pivotal and innovative in many ways. It is proposed that the following two areas of Jingjie’s significance will be uncovered: (1)While Jingjie does incorporate a wealth of existing interpretations, Zhu would often present an abridged or restructured extraction, to which his own views are provided. Zhu is also keen on making historical references alongside his interpretations. His historiographical acumen reflects mid-Qing intellectual scholarship, invoking new understandings on astronomy and geography to support his theses, which in turn makes a fresh contribution to classical exegesis. The criticism that Jingjie is “with a clear lack of a critical eye” is an imbalanced assessment. Only through thoroughly understanding how Zhu accepts past scholarship and makes transformative innovations can we observe how new life is breathed into the Chinese classics that has seen continued reinvigoration throughout the ages. (2)It is indisputable that Zhu’s Shuowen Tongxun Dingsheng is his philological magnum opus. However, in evaluating the extent of his achievements, scholars often overlook the philological evidence presented in his other works. It must be acknowledged that Shuowen Jiezi is an analytical dictionary and Zhu’s work on it strives to examine each character’s basic (or definitive) meaning. Whereas the goal of Jingjie is interpret Zhou Yi and its philological exegeses serve such a purpose. It is therefore not surprising to see competing glosses between Zhu’s two works. Only through a systematic examination of Zhu’s philological evidence from Jingjie in contrast with that of Shuowen Tongxun Dingsheng can we observe how his preparatory work for the latter has informed the formation of his understanding of Zhou Yi, and more importantly, how Zhu applies his philological expertise in the interpretive and extended meanings of individual characters found in the Chinese classics. The research output would be pioneering in its evaluation of Zhu’s philological and linguistic achievements outside of the singular source thoroughly examined by other scholars.

28606821.label: Project Title(Chinese)
28606821.value: 假髮：一種冷戰時期商品的全球史，1958-1979

28606821.label: Project Objectives
28606821.value: To explain the importance of US influence on Asian industrialization in the 1960s and 1970s, revealing how US military, policy, cultural, and economic interventions shaped the East Asian “miracle” in unexpected ways. This approach reframes our understanding of US postwar empire by describing new modes of engagement with US allies and antagonists around Asia. To decenter Cold War narratives that focus on US-USSR relations by redirecting our focus to Asia and the Pacific World, illuminating how Asian wars and commerce built Cold War relationships and shaped Cold War outcomes. This approach emphasizes the importance of inter-Asian trade and cooperation in evading, contradicting, and undermining US intentions during the Cold War. To articulate and demonstrate new methods of global history that highlight flows of things, people, ideas, and capital along networks that cross national boundaries, and thus illustrate the importance of seeing beyond the state. This new approach combines methods from history (commodity histories), sociology (the commodity chain) and anthropology (the “social life of a thing”) to enable us to follow the local and global “lives” of a commodity. To put ordinary people and detailed accounts of their lives back into global history, revealing how the top-down political and economic decisions made during the Cold War often were counterbalanced by everyday decisions made in factories, villages, and corner stores. This project thus intends to illustrate how to tell a richer history of globalization during the Cold War, moving beyond accounts of diplomats and bureaucrats.

28606821.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
28606821.value: “Wig: The Global History of a Cold War Commodity, 1958-1979,” examines Asia’s “miraculous” economic growth under the US Cold War umbrella by tracing the “life” of a strange commodity: the human-hair and synthetic-fiber wig. In the 1960s-70s, wigs became a key Cold War commodity in Asia: the #2 export in South Korea, employing over 40,000 people; the #4 export in Hong Kong, employing 30,000; and a state-supported industry in India and Singapore. By the 1970s, when 40% of US women wore wigs or hairpieces, the wig was a US$1 billion global industry, dominated by Asian wigmakers and Korean-American wig retailers. But while no one intended for wigs to fuel Asian industrialization and globalization, the rise of wigs was not an accident. The wig became a Cold War commodity in 1965, when the US extended its 1950 trade embargo against China to include communist “Asiatic” hair – cutting off China’s US$10 million hair trade to punish its escalation of the Vietnam War. This seemingly minor intervention had major consequences: by restricting trade in communist hair, the embargo devastated Hong Kong’s wig industry (which relied on Chinese hair) and jumpstarted South Korea’s industry (since the ROK harvested its own “anti-communist” hair). And as Asian wigmakers scrambled to find new, ideologically acceptable hair sources, they produced a complex map of the Cold War Asia-Pacific: hair was smuggled from China to Hong Kong through Indonesia, and flown from non-aligned India to US-allied South Korea. Wigs thus reveal how Asian export-led industrialization took shape under and beyond US Cold War influence. This project introduces global and interdisciplinary approaches to studying Cold War history. By examining how wigs moved, we understand Asian growth differently: seeing how Asia’s industrialization was shaped not only by Cold War politico-economics but also by ordinary people, from bureaucrats and factory workers to hair peddlers and wig-wearers. The project thus makes a methodological intervention in two growing fields of history, the history of capitalism and global history, by combining “top down” (diplomatic history, political history, economic history) and “bottom up” (social history, labor history, material culture) approaches, producing a thick, transnational approach to global history. “Wig” will yield a book proposal, conference presentations, a journal article, and a complete book draft. To create impact beyond academia, project findings will be used to produce multilingual global history teaching materials, which will be disseminated locally and through a web site for educators around the world. 透過追溯一種奇怪商品的「生命」—人髮與合成纖維假髮，〈假髮：一種冷戰時期商品的全球史，1958-1979〉探討了在美國冷戰保護傘下亞洲的「奇蹟性」經濟增長。 在1960 至 70 年代期間，假髮成為亞洲重要的冷戰時期商品。它是南韓的第二大出口產品，受雇人口超過40,000 人；同時是香港第四大出口產品，產業聘用高達30,000人，並在印度和新加坡屬於國家支援產業。到 1970 年代，當只有四成的美國女性配戴假髮的時候，假髮已成為由亞洲假髮製造商和韓裔美國假髮零售商主導，價值達 10 億美元的全球產業。即使沒有人打算以假髮來推動亞洲工業化和全球化，其興起並非偶然。隨著美國將其1950 年對華禁運擴大至包括共產主義「亞洲」頭髮，切斷中國 1000 萬美元的頭髮貿易以懲罰其越戰升級，假髮於1965年成為冷戰商品。 這種看似微不足道的干預實際上產生了重大影響。通過限制共產主義頭髮貿易，禁運摧毀了依賴來自中國頭髮的香港假髮業，而韓國藉著自行收集「反共」頭髮，造就了南韓產業的興起。當亞洲假髮製造商爭先恐後地尋找新的、意識形態上可接受的頭髮來源時，一幅錯綜複雜的冷戰時期亞太地區地圖由之而成。商人從中國經印度尼西亞走私頭髮到香港，再從非結盟的印度空運到美國盟友南韓。因此，假髮揭示了亞洲出口導向工業化如何在美國冷戰影響底下及其範圍之外形成。 本計劃以全球和跨領域進路研究冷戰時期歷史。研究假髮的移動軌跡讓我們對亞洲的發展有不同的理解。亞洲的工業化不僅受到冷戰政治及經濟層面影響，更受到從官僚及工廠工人到美髮小販和戴假髮者等普通百姓的影響。通過結合「自上而下」（外交史、政治史及經濟史）和「自下而上」（社會史、勞工史及物質文化）的方法，本計劃以方法論介入兩個發展中的歷史領域—資本主義歷史及全球史，並建構對全球史厚實的跨國研究進路。 〈假髮〉將產生一份書籍提案、會議報告、一篇期刊文章和一份完整的書稿。為了在學術界之外產生影響，項目成果將用於製作多語言全球史教材，這些教材將在本地和通過網站向世界各地的教育工作者傳播。

28609121.label: Project Title(Chinese)
28609121.value: 塑造學生數學學習的生活空間：數學教師的信念和價值如何影響教學

28609121.label: Project Objectives
28609121.value: To investigate the beliefs and values of teachers and students that underlie effective mathematics teaching and learning in school and to examine their similarities and differences; To explore the negotiation strategies and evolution of values differences or conflicts in the classroom in an attempt to achieve value alignment by teachers and students; To develop effective teaching strategies for mathematics teachers through the value lens.
